grammar.meaning: too awful to …; cannot contain (one's gratitude, regret)
grammar.ja: 多くの方々から温かいご支援をいただき、感謝の念に堪えない。
grammar.en: Having received warm support from so many people, I cannot express how grateful I am.

grammar.meaning: too awful to …; cannot contain (one's gratitude, regret)
grammar.ja: SNSには、見るに堪えない誹謗中傷のコメントがあふれている。
grammar.en: Social media is flooded with abusive comments too vile to look at.

grammar.meaning: on top of …; besides …; not only … but also
grammar.ja: 道に迷った上に、雨まで降り出した。
grammar.en: On top of getting lost, it even started to rain.

grammar.meaning: on top of …; besides …; not only … but also
grammar.ja: この店のランチは安い上に量も多いので、いつも行列ができている。
grammar.en: Lunch at this place is cheap and generous too, so there is always a queue.

grammar.meaning: knowing …, surely …; since it's … we're talking about
grammar.ja: 几帳面な母のことだから、旅行の準備はとっくに済ませているはずだ。
grammar.en: Knowing how meticulous my mother is, she must have finished packing for the trip long ago.

grammar.meaning: knowing …, surely …; since it's … we're talking about
grammar.ja: 飽きっぽい弟のことだから、買ったばかりのギターもどうせ三日で放り出すだろう。
grammar.en: Knowing how quickly my younger brother loses interest, he'll probably give up on the guitar he just bought within three days.

grammar.meaning: whether … or …; one way or the other (fixed pairs such as sooner or later, more or less)
grammar.ja: 多かれ少なかれ、誰でも人前で話すときは緊張するものだ。
grammar.en: Everyone gets nervous, to a greater or lesser degree, when speaking in front of people.

grammar.meaning: whether … or …; one way or the other (fixed pairs such as sooner or later, more or less)
grammar.ja: このまま赤字が続けば、遅かれ早かれ店を畳むことになるだろう。
grammar.en: If the losses keep up like this, the shop will have to close sooner or later.

grammar.meaning: how …!; how many times …! (exclamation)
grammar.ja: これまで何度禁煙に挑戦し、何度失敗したことか。
grammar.en: How many times I have tried to quit smoking, and how many times I have failed!

grammar.form: 待ち望んでいたことか
grammar.meaning: how …!; how many times …! (exclamation)
grammar.ja: この日が来るのを、どれほど待ち望んでいたことか。
grammar.en: How eagerly I have been waiting for this day to come!

grammar.meaning: even a little; at least …
grammar.ja: 一目なりとも、故郷の桜をもう一度見たいものだ。
grammar.en: I would love to catch even a glimpse of my hometown's cherry blossoms once more.

grammar.meaning: even a little; at least …
grammar.ja: 少しなりとも被災地の役に立ちたいと、多くの若者がボランティアに参加した。
grammar.en: Wanting to be of at least some help to the disaster area, many young people joined as volunteers.

grammar.meaning: nothing beats …; the best thing is to …
grammar.ja: 疲れがたまっている時は、何も考えずにぐっすり寝るに限る。
grammar.en: When you're worn out, the best thing is to sleep soundly and not think about anything.

grammar.meaning: nothing beats …; the best thing is to …
grammar.ja: 蒸し暑い夏の夜は、やっぱり冷えたビールに限る。
grammar.en: On a muggy summer night, nothing beats an ice-cold beer.

grammar.form: 泣いていたかと思ったら
grammar.meaning: no sooner … than …; just when I thought …
grammar.ja: 子どもたちは泣いていたかと思ったら、もう笑って遊んでいる。
grammar.en: The kids were crying a moment ago, and now they're already laughing and playing.

grammar.form: 暗くなったかと思うと
grammar.meaning: no sooner … than …; just when I thought …
grammar.ja: 空が急に暗くなったかと思うと、激しい雨が降り出した。
grammar.en: No sooner had the sky suddenly darkened than it started pouring.

grammar.form: 悔しいといったらない
grammar.meaning: indescribably …; so … beyond words
grammar.ja: 決勝であと一歩のところで逆転負けするなんて、悔しいといったらない。
grammar.en: Losing the final to a comeback when we were just one step from winning is unbearably frustrating.

grammar.form: 美しさといったらなかった
grammar.meaning: indescribably …; so … beyond words
grammar.ja: 山頂から初めて見たご来光の美しさといったらなかった。
grammar.en: The beauty of the sunrise I saw from the summit for the first time was beyond words.

grammar.form: 間に合わないものでもない
grammar.meaning: it is not impossible that …; one might (reluctantly) …
grammar.ja: 今すぐタクシーで向かえば、最終の新幹線に間に合わないものでもない。
grammar.en: If we head there by taxi right now, it's not impossible that we'll make the last bullet train.

grammar.form: 引き受けないものでもない
grammar.meaning: it is not impossible that …; one might (reluctantly) …
grammar.ja: 報酬などの条件次第では、その仕事を引き受けないものでもない。
grammar.en: Depending on the terms, such as the pay, I wouldn't rule out taking on that job.

grammar.meaning: the most … in all of (a group or place); the best in …
grammar.ja: 球団きってのスター選手が、今季限りでの引退を表明した。
grammar.en: The team's biggest star has announced that he will retire at the end of this season.

grammar.meaning: the most … in all of (a group or place); the best in …
grammar.ja: この旅館は温泉街きっての老舗で、創業は江戸時代にさかのぼる。
grammar.en: This inn is the hot-spring town's foremost long-established inn, dating back to the Edo period.

grammar.meaning: nothing more than …; merely
grammar.ja: これはあくまで個人の感想にすぎませんので、参考程度にお読みください。
grammar.en: This is nothing more than a personal impression, so please read it only as a reference.

grammar.meaning: nothing more than …; merely
grammar.ja: 発表された数字は氷山の一角にすぎない。
grammar.en: The figures announced are merely the tip of the iceberg.

grammar.form: 安いに越したことはない
grammar.meaning: nothing is better than …; it is best (if possible) to …
grammar.ja: 家賃は安いに越したことはないが、駅から遠すぎると毎日の通勤がつらくなる。
grammar.en: Lower rent is always better, but if the place is too far from the station, the daily commute becomes a pain.

grammar.form: 備えておくに越したことはない
grammar.meaning: nothing is better than …; it is best (if possible) to …
grammar.ja: 災害はいつ起きるかわからないので、水や非常食は多めに備えておくに越したことはない。
grammar.en: Since you never know when a disaster will strike, it's best to keep extra water and emergency food on hand.

grammar.meaning: do … through to the end; do … thoroughly
grammar.ja: 何か月も考え抜いて出した結論なので、後悔はしていません。
grammar.en: It's a conclusion I reached after thinking it through for months, so I have no regrets.

grammar.meaning: do … through to the end; do … thoroughly
grammar.ja: 足を痛めながらも、その選手は42キロを最後まで走り抜いた。
grammar.en: Despite an injured leg, the runner ran the full 42 kilometres to the finish.

grammar.meaning: nothing other than …; none other than …; precisely …
grammar.ja: この商品が売れ続けているのは、品質へのこだわりが消費者に支持されているからにほかならない。
grammar.en: The reason this product keeps selling is precisely that consumers value its commitment to quality.

grammar.meaning: nothing other than …; none other than …; precisely …
grammar.ja: 今回の優勝は、選手一人ひとりの地道な努力の成果にほかならない。
grammar.en: This championship is nothing other than the fruit of each player's steady hard work.

grammar.meaning: … would be one thing, but …; … might be acceptable, but …
grammar.ja: 値段が高いだけならまだしも、品質まで落ちたのでは客離れも当然だ。
grammar.en: Being expensive would be one thing, but with the quality dropping too, it is no wonder customers are leaving.

grammar.meaning: … would be one thing, but …; … might be acceptable, but …
grammar.ja: 一度ならまだしも、毎週のように遅刻されては困る。
grammar.en: Once would be one thing, but being late practically every week is a problem.

grammar.meaning: -looking; with an air of …; seeming …
grammar.ja: その店員は、何か言いたげな顔でこちらをじっと見ていた。
grammar.en: The clerk was staring at me with a look that suggested they wanted to say something.

grammar.meaning: -looking; with an air of …; seeming …
grammar.ja: 公園では、子どもたちが楽しげに鬼ごっこをしていた。
grammar.en: In the park, the children were cheerfully playing tag.

grammar.meaning: that is what … truly is; that is simply …
grammar.ja: 相手の話を最後まで聞くのが、礼儀というものだ。
grammar.en: Hearing the other person out to the end is what courtesy is.

grammar.meaning: that is what … truly is; that is simply …
grammar.ja: うまくいく日もあれば、そうでない日もある。それが人生というものだ。
grammar.en: Some days go well and some don't. That's just what life is.

grammar.meaning: utterly …; … in the extreme (the literary variant kiwamaru means the same)
grammar.ja: 予約の時間に一時間も遅れておきながら謝罪の一言もないとは、失礼極まりない。
grammar.en: Turning up an hour late for the reservation without a single word of apology is the height of rudeness.

grammar.meaning: utterly …; … in the extreme (the literary variant kiwamaru means the same)
grammar.ja: 運転中にスマホを操作するのは、危険極まりない行為だ。
grammar.en: Using a smartphone while driving is an extremely dangerous act.

grammar.form: できてからというもの
grammar.meaning: ever since … (a lasting change)
grammar.ja: 駅前に大型ショッピングモールができてからというもの、商店街の人通りはめっきり減ってしまった。
grammar.en: Ever since a big shopping mall opened in front of the station, foot traffic in the shopping street has dropped sharply.

grammar.form: なってからというもの
grammar.meaning: ever since … (a lasting change)
grammar.ja: 在宅勤務になってからというもの、通勤の疲れがなくなり、朝の時間を有効に使えるようになった。
grammar.en: Ever since I started working from home, the fatigue of commuting has gone and I can make good use of my mornings.

grammar.meaning: as if …!; no way …!; I'll never …!
grammar.ja: こっちの苦労なんて、あの人たちにわかるものか。
grammar.en: As if those people could understand what we've been through.

grammar.meaning: as if …!; no way …!; I'll never …!
grammar.ja: あんなひどい言い方をされて、黙っていられるものか。
grammar.en: After being spoken to like that, how could I possibly keep quiet?

grammar.form: ご確認いただいた上で
grammar.meaning: after (doing, as a necessary step); in (doing) / for (the purpose of)
grammar.ja: 利用規約をご確認いただいた上で、お申し込みください。
grammar.en: Please apply after reading the terms of use.

grammar.meaning: after (doing, as a necessary step); in (doing) / for (the purpose of)
grammar.ja: 家族とよく話し合った上で、転職を決めた。
grammar.en: I decided to change jobs after talking it over thoroughly with my family.

grammar.meaning: from the standpoint of …; in terms of …; speaking from …
grammar.ja: 価格の面から言えば、こちらのプランのほうがはるかにお得だ。
grammar.en: In terms of price, this plan is by far the better deal.

grammar.meaning: from the standpoint of …; in terms of …; speaking from …
grammar.ja: 経験から言うと、新しい職場では最初の三か月がいちばん大変だ。
grammar.en: Speaking from experience, the first three months at a new workplace are the hardest.

grammar.meaning: now that …; since … (so one must / intends to …)
grammar.ja: 日本に住むからには、日本語をきちんと話せるようになりたい。
grammar.en: Since I'm going to live in Japan, I want to be able to speak Japanese properly.

grammar.meaning: now that …; since … (so one must / intends to …)
grammar.ja: 引き受けたからには、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
grammar.en: Now that I've taken it on, I intend to take responsibility and see it through to the end.

grammar.meaning: ever since …
grammar.ja: 駅前に大型商業施設が開業して以来、周辺の地価は上昇を続けている。
grammar.en: Ever since a large shopping complex opened by the station, land prices in the area have kept rising.

grammar.meaning: ever since …
grammar.ja: 大学を卒業して以来、毎年同じ仲間で旅行に出かけている。
grammar.en: Ever since graduating from university, we've gone on a trip with the same group of friends every year.

grammar.meaning: regardless of …; irrespective of …
grammar.ja: あの店の主人は見かけによらず、週末にはフルマラソンを走るほどの体力の持ち主だ。
grammar.en: The owner of that shop may not look it, but he is fit enough to run full marathons on weekends.

grammar.meaning: regardless of …; irrespective of …
grammar.ja: この奨学金は、国籍によらず、すべての留学生が応募できる。
grammar.en: This scholarship is open to all international students, regardless of nationality.

grammar.meaning: no way that …; there is no chance … (colloquial)
grammar.ja: 宝くじなんて当たりっこないって分かってるけど、つい買っちゃうんだよね。
grammar.en: I know there's no way I'll win the lottery, but I end up buying tickets anyway.

grammar.meaning: no way that …; there is no chance … (colloquial)
grammar.ja: こんな量の仕事、一晩で終わりっこないよ。
grammar.en: There's no way this much work is getting finished in one night.

grammar.meaning: in accordance with (rules, custom)
grammar.ja: お預かりした個人情報は、法律にのっとって適切に管理しております。
grammar.en: The personal information entrusted to us is properly managed in accordance with the law.

grammar.meaning: in accordance with (rules, custom)
grammar.ja: 式典は古くからの伝統にのっとって厳かに執り行われた。
grammar.en: The ceremony was solemnly conducted in accordance with long-standing tradition.

grammar.form: 大企業であれ中小企業であれ
grammar.meaning: be it …; no matter what …; whether … or …
grammar.ja: 大企業であれ中小企業であれ、人手不足は深刻な問題になっている。
grammar.en: Whether at large companies or small ones, labor shortages have become a serious problem.

grammar.meaning: be it …; no matter what …; whether … or …
grammar.ja: 理由が何であれ、無断で仕事を休むのは許されない。
grammar.en: Whatever the reason, missing work without notice is not acceptable.

grammar.form: 起きようにも起きられなかった
grammar.meaning: even if one wants to …, one cannot
grammar.ja: 熱が三十九度もあって、起きようにも起きられなかった。
grammar.en: I had a fever of 39 degrees, and even when I tried to get up, I couldn't.

grammar.meaning: even if one wants to …, one cannot
grammar.ja: 財布を家に忘れてきたので、昼ご飯を買おうにも買えない。
grammar.en: I left my wallet at home, so even if I want to buy lunch, I can't.

grammar.meaning: there is something … about it; it is truly …
grammar.ja: 毎日二時間の通勤は、正直かなりつらいものがある。
grammar.en: Honestly, a two-hour commute every day is pretty tough.

grammar.meaning: there is something … about it; it is truly …
grammar.ja: 若い選手たちのひたむきなプレーには、胸を打つものがある。
grammar.en: There is something truly moving about the young players' wholehearted play.

grammar.meaning: not until … has been done; unless … first
grammar.ja: この薬は、医師の診察を受けてからでないと処方してもらえません。
grammar.en: This medicine cannot be prescribed until you have been examined by a doctor.

grammar.meaning: not until … has been done; unless … first
grammar.ja: 実物を見てからでないと、購入するかどうか決められない。
grammar.en: I can't decide whether to buy it until I've seen the real thing.

grammar.meaning: while …, nevertheless …; although
grammar.ja: 体に悪いと知りながらも、つい夜中にラーメンを食べてしまう。
grammar.en: Even though I know it's bad for me, I end up eating ramen in the middle of the night.

grammar.meaning: while …, nevertheless …; although
grammar.ja: 狭いながらも日当たりのいい部屋で、在宅勤務には十分だ。
grammar.en: Though small, the room gets plenty of sunlight, so it's good enough for working from home.

grammar.meaning: over …; concerning …; surrounding … (a dispute or debate)
grammar.ja: 遺産をめぐる兄弟の争いは、ついに裁判にまで発展した。
grammar.en: The siblings' dispute over the inheritance finally ended up in court.

grammar.meaning: over …; concerning …; surrounding … (a dispute or debate)
grammar.ja: 新しい空港の建設をめぐって、住民の意見は大きく分かれている。
grammar.en: Residents are sharply divided over the construction of the new airport.

grammar.meaning: irrespective of …; regardless of whether …
grammar.ja: 経験の有無にかかわらず、やる気のある方を歓迎します。
grammar.en: We welcome motivated applicants, whether or not they have experience.

grammar.meaning: irrespective of …; regardless of whether …
grammar.ja: このイベントは天候にかかわらず予定通り開催します。
grammar.en: This event will be held as scheduled regardless of the weather.

grammar.meaning: the height of …; the ultimate in …
grammar.ja: 事故の責任を現場に押しつける経営陣の姿勢は、無責任の極みと言わざるを得ない。
grammar.en: Management's attitude of pinning the blame for the accident on frontline staff can only be called the height of irresponsibility.

grammar.meaning: the height of …; the ultimate in …
grammar.ja: 朝から露天風呂に入って地酒を味わうなんて、贅沢の極みだ。
grammar.en: Soaking in an open-air bath from the morning and savoring the local sake is the height of luxury.

grammar.meaning: to make (something) truly what it is; to make … into a true …
grammar.ja: この店を名店たらしめているのは、創業以来変わらない手仕事へのこだわりだ。
grammar.en: What makes this shop a truly renowned one is its commitment to handwork, unchanged since its founding.

grammar.meaning: to make (something) truly what it is; to make … into a true …
grammar.ja: 言葉こそが、人間を人間たらしめているものだと言われる。
grammar.en: It is said that language is precisely what makes human beings human.

grammar.meaning: far from …; not only not A, but (the opposite) B
grammar.ja: 子どもの頃は、泳ぐどころか水に顔をつけることさえできなかった。
grammar.en: As a child, far from being able to swim, I couldn't even put my face in the water.

grammar.meaning: far from …; not only not A, but (the opposite) B
grammar.ja: 薬を飲んだのに、熱は下がるどころか上がってきた。
grammar.en: I took medicine, but far from going down, my fever has gone up.

grammar.meaning: going so far as to …; even to the point of …
grammar.ja: 徹夜までして仕上げた企画書が、会議であっさり却下された。
grammar.en: The proposal I'd stayed up all night to finish was flatly rejected at the meeting.

grammar.meaning: going so far as to …; even to the point of …
grammar.ja: 借金までして高級車を買う必要が、本当にあるのだろうか。
grammar.en: Is it really necessary to go so far as to borrow money to buy a luxury car?

grammar.meaning: without doing …; without ever …
grammar.ja: その法案は、十分に議論されることなく国会で可決された。
grammar.en: The bill was passed by the Diet without being properly debated.

grammar.meaning: without doing …; without ever …
grammar.ja: その職人は四十年間、一日も休むことなく工房に立ち続けてきた。
grammar.en: For forty years, the craftsman has worked in his studio without taking a single day off.

grammar.meaning: in light of …; measured against …
grammar.ja: 法律に照らして判断すれば、この契約は無効になる可能性が高い。
grammar.en: Judged against the law, this contract is very likely to be void.

grammar.meaning: in light of …; measured against …
grammar.ja: 今回の処分は、過去の事例に照らして重すぎるとの声が上がっている。
grammar.en: Some are saying the penalty is too harsh in light of past cases.

grammar.meaning: … means …; to think that …! (surprise)
grammar.ja: あの老舗が閉店するとは、誰も想像していなかった。
grammar.en: No one ever imagined that long-established shop would close.

grammar.meaning: … means …; to think that …! (surprise)
grammar.ja: 「フードロス」とは、まだ食べられるのに捨てられてしまう食品のことだ。
grammar.en: 'Food loss' refers to food that is thrown away even though it is still edible.

grammar.meaning: due to … (in notices); per …
grammar.ja: 参加費は一人につき三千円で、当日会場でお支払いください。
grammar.en: The participation fee is 3,000 yen per person, payable at the venue on the day.

grammar.meaning: due to … (in notices); per …
grammar.ja: 本日は改装工事中につき、休業とさせていただきます。
grammar.en: We are closed today due to renovation work.

grammar.form: 見るなり買い物に行くなり
grammar.meaning: either … or …; … or … (suggesting options)
grammar.ja: 週末くらい、映画を見るなり買い物に行くなりして気分転換したらどう？
grammar.en: At least on weekends, why not refresh yourself by seeing a movie or going shopping?

grammar.form: 聞くなり自分で調べるなり
grammar.meaning: either … or …; … or … (suggesting options)
grammar.ja: わからないことがあれば、先輩に聞くなり自分で調べるなりしてください。
grammar.en: If there is something you don't understand, either ask a senior colleague or look it up yourself.

grammar.meaning: such as … (listing)
grammar.ja: 地震や台風といった自然災害に備えて、日頃から非常食を用意しておきたい。
grammar.en: It's wise to keep emergency food on hand in preparation for natural disasters such as earthquakes and typhoons.

grammar.meaning: such as … (listing)
grammar.ja: 京都や奈良といった古都には、一年を通して多くの観光客が訪れる。
grammar.en: Ancient capitals such as Kyoto and Nara draw many tourists all year round.

grammar.form: 報告が遅いだの資料が見にくいだの
grammar.meaning: … and … and so on (listing, often as complaints)
grammar.ja: 部長は、報告が遅いだの資料が見にくいだの、細かいことにうるさい。
grammar.en: The department head is fussy about details, complaining that reports are late, that documents are hard to read and so on.

grammar.form: 苦いだの魚は骨があるだの
grammar.meaning: … and … and so on (listing, often as complaints)
grammar.ja: うちの子は、野菜は苦いだの魚は骨があるだのと文句ばかり言って、なかなか食べない。
grammar.en: Our child keeps complaining that vegetables are bitter, that fish has bones and so on, and hardly eats anything.

grammar.meaning: to (my / our) …; much to one's … (emotion stated first)
grammar.ja: 残念なことに、雨のため今年の花火大会は中止になってしまった。
grammar.en: Unfortunately, this year's fireworks festival was canceled because of the rain.

grammar.meaning: to (my / our) …; much to one's … (emotion stated first)
grammar.ja: 驚いたことに、その古い民家の床下から江戸時代の小判が見つかった。
grammar.en: Surprisingly, Edo-period gold coins were found under the floor of the old house.

grammar.meaning: unbecoming of …; that must not be done (by someone in that position)
grammar.ja: 患者の個人情報を外部に漏らすなど、医療従事者にあるまじきことだ。
grammar.en: Leaking patients' personal information to outsiders is utterly unacceptable for a healthcare worker.

grammar.meaning: unbecoming of …; that must not be done (by someone in that position)
grammar.ja: 飲酒運転は、警察官としてあるまじき行為だ。
grammar.en: Drink-driving is conduct utterly unbecoming of a police officer.

grammar.meaning: although …; even though … (and yet the expected result does not follow)
grammar.ja: 景気は回復傾向にあるものの、個人消費はまだ伸び悩んでいる。
grammar.en: Although the economy is on a recovery trend, consumer spending is still sluggish.

grammar.meaning: although …; even though … (and yet the expected result does not follow)
grammar.ja: 免許は取ったものの、車がないので一度も運転していない。
grammar.en: I got my licence, but since I don't have a car I've never actually driven.

grammar.meaning: because …; since it is (the case that) … (formal excuse or apology)
grammar.ja: 急なこととて、十分なおもてなしもできず失礼いたしました。
grammar.en: As it was so sudden, please forgive us for not being able to welcome you properly.

grammar.meaning: because …; since it is (the case that) … (formal excuse or apology)
grammar.ja: 何分にも慣れないこととて、ご迷惑をおかけしましたことを深くお詫び申し上げます。
grammar.en: As we were entirely unaccustomed to this, we deeply apologise for the inconvenience caused.

grammar.meaning: as one would expect of …; befitting …
grammar.ja: 十年かけて開発されただけあって、この新型エンジンは燃費が驚くほどいい。
grammar.en: As you'd expect from something ten years in development, this new engine has remarkably good fuel economy.

grammar.meaning: as one would expect of …; befitting …
grammar.ja: さすが老舗の旅館だけあって、細かいところまで心配りが行き届いている。
grammar.en: As you'd expect of a long-established inn, the care extends to the smallest details.

grammar.form: 不快なことこの上なかった
grammar.meaning: extremely …; nothing could be more …
grammar.ja: 雨の中、三時間も行列に並ばされたのは不快なことこの上なかった。
grammar.en: Being made to wait in line for three hours in the rain was as unpleasant as it gets.

grammar.form: 迷惑なことこの上ない
grammar.meaning: extremely …; nothing could be more …
grammar.ja: 深夜まで続く工事の騒音は、近隣住民にとって迷惑なことこの上ない。
grammar.en: Construction noise that goes on late into the night is an enormous nuisance for local residents.

grammar.meaning: I thought …, but (unexpectedly) …
grammar.ja: 簡単な試験だと思いきや、最後の問題がとんでもない難問だった。
grammar.en: I thought it would be an easy exam, but the last question turned out to be fiendishly hard.

grammar.meaning: I thought …, but (unexpectedly) …
grammar.ja: 今日は一日晴れると思いきや、午後から激しい雷雨に見舞われた。
grammar.en: I thought it would be sunny all day, but in the afternoon we were hit by a violent thunderstorm.

grammar.meaning: in line with …; in keeping with (the facts, reality, actual conditions)
grammar.ja: 地域の実情に即して、バスの運行本数を見直すことになった。
grammar.en: It was decided to review the number of bus services in line with the actual situation in the area.

grammar.meaning: in line with …; in keeping with (the facts, reality, actual conditions)
grammar.ja: 報告書は推測を避け、事実に即して書くべきだ。
grammar.en: Reports should avoid speculation and be written in line with the facts.

grammar.meaning: is in the process of …ing; is gradually …
grammar.ja: 新薬の開発によって、かつては不治とされた病気も克服されつつある。
grammar.en: Thanks to the development of new drugs, even diseases once thought incurable are being overcome.

grammar.meaning: is in the process of …ing; is gradually …
grammar.ja: 地方でも、キャッシュレス決済が急速に広がりつつある。
grammar.en: Cashless payments are rapidly spreading, even in rural areas.

grammar.meaning: no matter how / what / whether …; even if …
grammar.ja: どんなに高かろうが、本当に欲しいものなら買う価値はある。
grammar.en: However expensive it is, if you really want it, it's worth buying.

grammar.meaning: no matter how / what / whether …; even if …
grammar.ja: 誰に何を言われようと、自分の決めた道を進むつもりだ。
grammar.en: No matter what anyone says, I intend to follow the path I've chosen.

grammar.meaning: someone of (high) standing like …; for a … of all people
grammar.ja: 一流ホテルともあろうものが、予約の手違いで客を一時間も待たせるなんて。
grammar.en: For a top-class hotel, of all places, to keep a guest waiting a whole hour over a booking mix-up is unthinkable.

grammar.meaning: someone of (high) standing like …; for a … of all people
grammar.ja: 大臣ともあろう人が、記者会見でこんな失言をするとは信じられない。
grammar.en: It is hard to believe that a cabinet minister, of all people, would make such a gaffe at a press conference.

grammar.form: 笑わずにはいられなかった
grammar.meaning: cannot help but …; cannot stop oneself from …
grammar.ja: あまりにもばかばかしい言い訳に、笑わずにはいられなかった。
grammar.en: The excuse was so ridiculous that I couldn't help laughing.

grammar.form: 願わずにはいられない
grammar.meaning: cannot help but …; cannot stop oneself from …
grammar.ja: 被災地の映像を見るたびに、一日も早い復興を願わずにはいられない。
grammar.en: Every time I see footage of the disaster area, I can't help hoping for a swift recovery.

grammar.meaning: for the first time in (a period); manner or way of …
grammar.ja: 今年の冬は寒さが厳しく、湖が全面結氷したのは三十年ぶりのことだという。
grammar.en: This winter has been so severe that, reportedly, it is the first time in thirty years the lake has frozen over completely.

grammar.meaning: for the first time in (a period); manner or way of …
grammar.ja: 大雪の影響で運休していた路線が、五日ぶりに運転を再開した。
grammar.en: The line, suspended because of heavy snow, resumed service for the first time in five days.

grammar.term: 〜というと／〜といえば／〜といったら
grammar.meaning: speaking of …; when it comes to …
grammar.ja: 日本の夏の風物詩というと、花火大会を思い浮かべる人が多い。
grammar.en: When it comes to the classic sights of a Japanese summer, many people think of fireworks festivals.

grammar.term: 〜というと／〜といえば／〜といったら
grammar.meaning: speaking of …; when it comes to …
grammar.ja: 京都といえば、やはり秋の紅葉が一番の見どころだろう。
grammar.en: Speaking of Kyoto, the autumn leaves are surely the top attraction.

grammar.form: 言わないのをいいことに
grammar.meaning: taking (unfair) advantage of …
grammar.ja: 上司が何も言わないのをいいことに、彼は毎日のように遅刻している。
grammar.en: Since the boss never says anything, he takes advantage and comes in late almost every day.

grammar.form: 留守なのをいいことに
grammar.meaning: taking (unfair) advantage of …
grammar.ja: 親が留守なのをいいことに、子どもたちは夜遅くまでゲームをしていた。
grammar.en: Taking advantage of their parents being away, the children played games until late at night.

grammar.form: 几帳面なのにひきかえ
grammar.meaning: in contrast to …; whereas …
grammar.ja: 兄が几帳面なのにひきかえ、弟は部屋の片付けもろくにしない。
grammar.en: Whereas the older brother is meticulous, the younger one barely even tidies his room.

grammar.meaning: in contrast to …; whereas …
grammar.ja: 去年の猛暑にひきかえ、今年の夏はずいぶん過ごしやすい。
grammar.en: Compared with last year's brutal heat, this summer has been much more comfortable.

grammar.meaning: on the occasion of …; when embarking on …
grammar.ja: 海外で働くにあたって、まず現地の生活習慣を学ぶことが大切だ。
grammar.en: When starting to work abroad, it is important first to learn the local way of life.

grammar.meaning: on the occasion of …; when embarking on …
grammar.ja: 新店舗のオープンにあたって、地元の食材を使った限定メニューを用意しました。
grammar.en: To mark the opening of our new store, we have prepared a limited menu using local ingredients.

grammar.meaning: as far as … goes; to the extent that …
grammar.ja: 調べた限りでは、同じような事故は過去に報告されていない。
grammar.en: As far as we have been able to find, no similar accident has been reported before.

grammar.meaning: as far as … goes; to the extent that …
grammar.ja: 私の知る限りでは、この店は昭和の初めからずっと同じ場所で営業している。
grammar.en: As far as I know, this shop has been in business in the same spot since the early Showa era.

grammar.meaning: without … (something cannot happen)
grammar.ja: 日々の地道な努力なくしては、どんな才能も花開くことはない。
grammar.en: Without steady daily effort, no talent will ever blossom.

grammar.meaning: without … (something cannot happen)
grammar.ja: 地域住民の協力なくして、この祭りの成功はありえなかった。
grammar.en: Without the cooperation of local residents, this festival could never have succeeded.

grammar.form: 観光業を抜きにしては
grammar.meaning: leaving … out; without …; setting … aside
grammar.ja: 観光業を抜きにしては、この島の経済は語れない。
grammar.en: You can't talk about this island's economy without tourism.

grammar.meaning: leaving … out; without …; setting … aside
grammar.ja: 堅い挨拶は抜きにして、さっそく乾杯しましょう。
grammar.en: Let's skip the formal speeches and get straight to the toast.

grammar.meaning: along …; in line with …
grammar.ja: 会社の方針に沿って、来年度から在宅勤務の日数を増やすことになった。
grammar.en: In line with company policy, it has been decided to increase the number of work-from-home days from next fiscal year.

grammar.meaning: along …; in line with …
grammar.ja: 川に沿って桜並木が続き、春には多くの花見客でにぎわう。
grammar.en: A row of cherry trees runs along the river, and in spring it is busy with crowds of blossom viewers.

grammar.meaning: not hesitate to …; unabashedly …
grammar.ja: 新社長は、利益よりも社員の幸せを優先すると言ってはばからない。
grammar.en: The new president does not hesitate to say that he puts employees' happiness ahead of profit.

grammar.form: 公言してはばからない
grammar.meaning: not hesitate to …; unabashedly …
grammar.ja: その監督は、自分の新作こそ今年最高の映画だと公言してはばからない。
grammar.en: The director openly declares that his new film is the best movie of the year.

grammar.meaning: while also …; alongside (one's main work) …
grammar.ja: 彼女は大学で研究を続けるかたわら、地域の子どもたちに無料で勉強を教えている。
grammar.en: Alongside her research at a university, she tutors local children for free.

grammar.meaning: while also …; alongside (one's main work) …
grammar.ja: その作家は、会社勤めのかたわら、毎朝欠かさず小説を書き続けた。
grammar.en: Alongside a day job at a company, the writer kept writing fiction every morning without fail.

grammar.meaning: (from …) through …; over a span of time or area
grammar.ja: この花は春から初夏にかけて、山の斜面一面に咲く。
grammar.en: This flower blooms across the whole mountainside from spring through early summer.

grammar.meaning: (from …) through …; over a span of time or area
grammar.ja: 今夜から明日の朝にかけて、関東地方では大雪のおそれがあります。
grammar.en: Heavy snow is possible in the Kanto region from tonight through tomorrow morning.

grammar.meaning: except for …; excluding …
grammar.ja: 一部の地域を除いて、全国的に晴れるでしょう。
grammar.en: Apart from some areas, it will be sunny across the country.

grammar.meaning: except for …; excluding …
grammar.ja: 当店は年末年始を除いて、毎日営業しております。
grammar.en: We are open every day except over the New Year holidays.

grammar.meaning: spanning …; over (a whole period, area or number of times)
grammar.ja: 専門家チームは、三年にわたって現地で聞き取り調査を続けてきた。
grammar.en: The team of experts has spent three years carrying out interviews on site.

grammar.meaning: spanning …; over (a whole period, area or number of times)
grammar.ja: 台風の影響で、関東地方の広い範囲にわたって停電が発生した。
grammar.en: Because of the typhoon, power outages occurred over a wide area of the Kanto region.

grammar.meaning: only at …; even …; both … and …
grammar.ja: ベテランの専門医にして見抜けなかった病気の兆候を、AIが見つけ出した。
grammar.en: AI detected signs of disease that even a veteran specialist had failed to spot.

grammar.meaning: only at …; even …; both … and …
grammar.ja: その男性は六十歳にして初めてフルマラソンを完走した。
grammar.en: The man finished a full marathon for the first time at the age of sixty.

grammar.meaning: there is a risk of …; … may (unfortunately) happen
grammar.ja: このまま値上げが続けば、若い世代の消費がさらに冷え込む恐れがある。
grammar.en: If prices keep rising like this, spending by younger people may cool even further.

grammar.meaning: there is a risk of …; … may (unfortunately) happen
grammar.ja: 台風の接近に伴い、明日は関東地方でも大雨になる恐れがあります。
grammar.en: With the typhoon approaching, there is a risk of heavy rain in the Kanto region tomorrow as well.

grammar.meaning: starting with …; … and others; including …
grammar.ja: 社長をはじめ、社員一同心よりお待ちしております。
grammar.en: Our president and all of our staff look forward to welcoming you.

grammar.meaning: starting with …; … and others; including …
grammar.ja: 東京をはじめ、全国の主要都市で記録的な猛暑となった。
grammar.en: Record-breaking heat hit major cities across the country, Tokyo first among them.

grammar.meaning: must be …; there is no doubt that …
grammar.ja: 平日の昼間からこんなに行列ができているのだから、この店のラーメンはよほどおいしいに違いない。
grammar.en: If people are lining up like this in the middle of a weekday, the ramen here must be exceptionally good.

grammar.meaning: must be …; there is no doubt that …
grammar.ja: 窓ガラスが割られているから、犯人はここから侵入したに違いない。
grammar.en: The window has been smashed, so the culprit must have broken in here.

grammar.form: 生まれたのをきっかけに
grammar.meaning: taking … as the occasion; triggered by …; since …
grammar.ja: 子どもが生まれたのをきっかけに、郊外の一戸建てに引っ越した。
grammar.en: When our child was born, we took the chance to move to a house in the suburbs.

grammar.meaning: taking … as the occasion; triggered by …; since …
grammar.ja: 留学をきっかけに、環境問題に関心を持つようになった。
grammar.en: Studying abroad was what got me interested in environmental issues.

grammar.meaning: the instant …; no sooner had … than …
grammar.ja: ベルが鳴るや否や、生徒たちは教室を飛び出していった。
grammar.en: The moment the bell rang, the students rushed out of the classroom.

grammar.meaning: the instant …; no sooner had … than …
grammar.ja: 新作ゲームは発売されるや否や、販売サイトに注文が殺到した。
grammar.en: The moment the new game went on sale, orders flooded the online store.

grammar.meaning: worthy of …; sufficient to …
grammar.ja: 現時点では、その説を裏付けるに足る証拠は見つかっていない。
grammar.en: So far, no evidence sufficient to support that theory has been found.

grammar.meaning: worthy of …; sufficient to …
grammar.ja: 投資家に対して信頼に足る情報を開示できなければ、資金は集まらない。
grammar.en: If you can't disclose information that investors can trust, you won't raise any money.

grammar.meaning: heedless of …; without caring about …
grammar.ja: 人目もかまわず、駅のホームで大声で泣いている人がいた。
grammar.en: Someone was crying loudly on the station platform, heedless of who was watching.

grammar.meaning: heedless of …; without caring about …
grammar.ja: その子は服が汚れるのもかまわず、水たまりで遊び続けた。
grammar.en: The child kept playing in the puddle without caring that their clothes were getting dirty.

grammar.meaning: smacking of …; coming across unpleasantly as … (disapproved)
grammar.ja: 遅刻の理由を長々と説明すると、かえって言い訳がましく聞こえる。
grammar.en: If you go on at length about why you were late, it just sounds like you're making excuses.

grammar.meaning: smacking of …; coming across unpleasantly as … (disapproved)
grammar.ja: 手伝ってくれたのはありがたいが、あんなに恩着せがましく言われると素直に喜べない。
grammar.en: I'm grateful for the help, but when they make such a point of how much I owe them, I can't feel properly pleased about it.

grammar.meaning: judging from …; from the viewpoint of …
grammar.ja: 地元の住民からすれば、観光客の急増は必ずしも歓迎できることではない。
grammar.en: From the local residents' point of view, the sudden surge in tourists is not necessarily welcome.

grammar.meaning: judging from …; from the viewpoint of …
grammar.ja: 空の様子からすると、午後から雨になりそうだ。
grammar.en: Judging from the look of the sky, it will probably rain from the afternoon.

grammar.meaning: via …; after going through …
grammar.ja: 三年に及ぶ議論を経て、ようやく新しい条例が成立した。
grammar.en: After three years of debate, the new ordinance was finally enacted.

grammar.meaning: via …; after going through …
grammar.ja: この便はドバイを経てロンドンに向かいます。
grammar.en: This flight goes to London via Dubai.

grammar.meaning: without …ing; without having done … (literary)
grammar.ja: 労せずして大金が手に入るという話には、たいてい裏がある。
grammar.en: Stories about getting big money without any effort usually have a catch.

grammar.meaning: without …ing; without having done … (literary)
grammar.ja: 相手チームの棄権により、わがチームは戦わずして優勝を手にした。
grammar.en: Because the opposing team withdrew, our team took the championship without having to play.

grammar.meaning: like …; as …; (with nouns for people) the likes of …
grammar.ja: 前述のごとく、今年度の予算は大幅に削減される見通しだ。
grammar.en: As stated above, this fiscal year's budget is expected to be cut sharply.

grammar.form: 過ぎ去ったかのごとき
grammar.meaning: like …; as …; (with nouns for people) the likes of …
grammar.ja: 会場は、まるで嵐が過ぎ去ったかのごとき静けさに包まれた。
grammar.en: The hall fell into a silence as if a storm had just passed.

grammar.meaning: together with …; along with …; as … (changes)
grammar.ja: 同社は新製品を発表するとともに、既存モデルの価格改定も明らかにした。
grammar.en: The company announced a new product and, at the same time, disclosed price revisions for its existing models.

grammar.meaning: together with …; along with …; as … (changes)
grammar.ja: 年齢とともに、睡眠の質が変化していくことが知られている。
grammar.en: It is known that the quality of sleep changes with age.

grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: 新型のスマートフォンは、性能は言うに及ばず、デザイン面でも高い評価を受けている。
grammar.en: The new smartphone is highly rated for its design, not to mention its performance.

grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: この祭りには、国内は言うに及ばず、海外からも多くの観光客が訪れる。
grammar.en: This festival draws many tourists from abroad, not to mention from within Japan.

grammar.meaning: as one who is …; one worthy of the name …
grammar.ja: 教師たるもの、生徒の前では常に手本となる姿を見せなければならない。
grammar.en: A teacher worthy of the name must always set an example in front of the students.

grammar.meaning: as one who is …; one worthy of the name …
grammar.ja: 政治家たる者、自らの発言には責任を持つべきだ。
grammar.en: Anyone who is a politician should take responsibility for what they say.

grammar.meaning: must not …; should not … (attributive form before a noun: that must not / cannot be …)
grammar.ja: 水は人間の生活にとって欠くべからざるものだ。
grammar.en: Water is indispensable to human life.

grammar.meaning: must not …; should not … (attributive form before a noun: that must not / cannot be …)
grammar.ja: 公園の入り口には「芝生に立ち入るべからず」と書かれた看板が立っている。
grammar.en: At the park entrance there is a sign that reads 'Keep off the grass.'

grammar.meaning: end up (in a deplorable state); it has come to the point of …
grammar.ja: うちの新人は何度注意しても遅刻が直らず、最近では連絡すらよこさない始末だ。
grammar.en: No matter how many times we warn our new hire, the lateness continues, and lately they don't even bother to let us know.

grammar.meaning: end up (in a deplorable state); it has come to the point of …
grammar.ja: 息子は毎晩ゲームに夢中で、ついには学校を休む始末だ。
grammar.en: My son is absorbed in games every night, and now it has come to the point where he skips school.

grammar.meaning: combined with …; coupled with …
grammar.ja: 円安が航空便の増便と相まって、今年の夏の訪日客数を過去最多に押し上げた。
grammar.en: The weak yen, coupled with more flights, pushed the number of foreign visitors this summer to a record high.

grammar.meaning: combined with …; coupled with …
grammar.ja: この映画では、俳優たちの迫真の演技が美しい映像と相まって、観客を深く感動させた。
grammar.en: In this film, the actors' powerful performances, combined with the beautiful visuals, deeply moved the audience.

grammar.meaning: there is no way that …; it cannot possibly be that …
grammar.ja: 一か月で十キロもやせられるなんて、そんなうまい話があるわけがない。
grammar.en: Losing ten kilos in a month? A deal that good can't possibly be real.

grammar.meaning: there is no way that …; it cannot possibly be that …
grammar.ja: こんなに練習したんだから、負けるわけがない。
grammar.en: We've practised this hard, so there's no way we'll lose.

grammar.meaning: rather than …; more … than …
grammar.ja: あの店は飲食店というより、地域の人が集まる居場所になっている。
grammar.en: That shop has become less a restaurant than a place where locals gather.

grammar.meaning: rather than …; more … than …
grammar.ja: 今日は涼しいというより、むしろ寒いくらいだ。
grammar.en: It's not so much cool today as downright cold.

grammar.meaning: whenever …; every time … (a feeling or memory arises); whether … or …
grammar.ja: うちの上司は何かにつけて「昔はよかった」と言うので、正直うんざりしている。
grammar.en: My boss says "things were better in the old days" at every turn, and honestly I'm sick of it.

grammar.meaning: whenever …; every time … (a feeling or memory arises); whether … or …
grammar.ja: 地方の空き家問題のニュースを聞くにつけ、故郷の町の行く末が気にかかる。
grammar.en: Whenever I hear news about empty houses in the countryside, I worry about what will become of my hometown.

grammar.meaning: without doubt …; must be … (formal)
grammar.ja: この発見は、宇宙の成り立ちを解き明かす大きな手がかりになるに相違ない。
grammar.en: This discovery will undoubtedly be a major clue to unraveling how the universe came to be.

grammar.meaning: without doubt …; must be … (formal)
grammar.ja: 現場に残された足跡から見て、犯人は裏口から侵入したに相違ない。
grammar.en: Judging from the footprints left at the scene, the culprit must have come in through the back door.

grammar.meaning: worth …ing; able to stand up to …
grammar.ja: このスーツケースは、十年以上の使用に堪える頑丈さが売りだ。
grammar.en: This suitcase's selling point is that it is sturdy enough to stand up to more than ten years of use.

grammar.meaning: worth …ing; able to stand up to …
grammar.ja: 学生の自主制作とはいえ、十分に鑑賞に堪える作品に仕上がっている。
grammar.en: Although it is a student's independent production, it has turned out to be a work well worth watching.

grammar.meaning: will simply …; (I) merely did …, nothing more
grammar.ja: 別に深い意味はありません。思ったことを言ったまでです。
grammar.en: There's no deeper meaning. I merely said what I thought.

grammar.meaning: will simply …; (I) merely did …, nothing more
grammar.ja: 電車が動かないなら、歩いて帰るまでだ。
grammar.en: If the trains aren't running, I'll simply walk home.

grammar.meaning: leaving … aside for now; setting … aside
grammar.ja: 費用の問題はさておき、そもそもこの計画に賛同する人がどれだけいるだろうか。
grammar.en: Leaving the question of cost aside, how many people would support this plan in the first place?

grammar.meaning: leaving … aside for now; setting … aside
grammar.ja: 冗談はさておき、本題である来月のイベントの予算について話し合いましょう。
grammar.en: Joking aside, let's discuss the main issue: the budget for next month's event.

grammar.meaning: while at it; taking the chance to …; combining … with …
grammar.ja: 週末は海沿いをドライブがてら、隣町の道の駅まで野菜を買いに行くつもりだ。
grammar.en: This weekend I plan to take a drive along the coast and, while I'm at it, go buy vegetables at the roadside station in the next town.

grammar.meaning: while at it; taking the chance to …; combining … with …
grammar.ja: 散歩がてら、駅前に新しくできたパン屋をのぞいてみた。
grammar.en: While out for a walk, I stopped to take a look at the new bakery in front of the station.

grammar.form: 始まるか始まらないかのうちに
grammar.meaning: scarcely had … when …; almost before … had finished
grammar.ja: 新作のチケットは、販売が始まるか始まらないかのうちに完売した。
grammar.en: Tickets for the new production sold out almost the moment sales opened.

grammar.form: 鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに
grammar.meaning: scarcely had … when …; almost before … had finished
grammar.ja: 授業終了のチャイムが鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに、学生たちは教室を飛び出した。
grammar.en: The bell marking the end of class had barely rung when the students rushed out of the classroom.

grammar.meaning: while one is at it; taking the opportunity of …
grammar.ja: 出張のついでに、学生時代を過ごした街を久しぶりに歩いてみた。
grammar.en: While on a business trip, I took the chance to walk around the town where I spent my student days, for the first time in years.

grammar.meaning: while one is at it; taking the opportunity of …
grammar.ja: 郵便局に行ったついでに、駅前のクリーニング店にも寄ってきた。
grammar.en: While I was out at the post office, I also stopped by the dry cleaner's near the station.

grammar.meaning: it is not as if …
grammar.ja: 一生会えなくなるわけではあるまいし、そんなに泣かなくてもいいよ。
grammar.en: It's not as if we'll never see each other again, so there's no need to cry like that.

grammar.form: 子どもではあるまいし
grammar.meaning: it is not as if …
grammar.ja: 子どもではあるまいし、自分の部屋くらい自分で片付けなさい。
grammar.en: You're not a child, so at least tidy your own room yourself.

grammar.meaning: after (a long, troublesome process), in the end … (usually an unwelcome result)
grammar.ja: 交渉は半年に及んだが、さんざんもめたあげく、計画そのものが白紙に戻された。
grammar.en: The negotiations dragged on for six months, and after endless wrangling the plan itself was scrapped.

grammar.meaning: after (a long, troublesome process), in the end … (usually an unwelcome result)
grammar.ja: 三時間も迷ったあげく、結局いちばん安いプランに決めた。
grammar.en: After agonizing for three whole hours, I ended up choosing the cheapest plan anyway.

grammar.meaning: will have to …; cannot get away without …ing
grammar.ja: これだけの騒ぎを起こしたのだから、何らかの処分を受けずにはすまないだろう。
grammar.en: Having caused this much uproar, they will surely not get away without some form of disciplinary action.

grammar.form: 謝罪せずにはすまない
grammar.meaning: will have to …; cannot get away without …ing
grammar.ja: 大切な取引先に迷惑をかけた以上、社長が直接謝罪せずにはすまないだろう。
grammar.en: Having caused trouble for an important client, the company president will have to apologise in person.

grammar.form: 失敗するに決まっている
grammar.meaning: definitely …; bound to be …; of course …
grammar.ja: 準備もしないで本番に臨んだら、失敗するに決まっている。
grammar.en: If you go into the real thing without preparing, you're sure to fail.

grammar.form: セールスに決まってる
grammar.meaning: definitely …; bound to be …; of course …
grammar.ja: こんな時間に電話してくるなんて、どうせセールスに決まってるよ。
grammar.en: Someone calling at this hour? It's bound to be a sales call.

grammar.meaning: worth …ing; the effort of …ing pays off
grammar.ja: 山頂からの絶景を目にして、四時間かけて登ったかいがあったと心から思った。
grammar.en: Seeing the spectacular view from the summit, I truly felt the four-hour climb had been worth it.

grammar.meaning: worth …ing; the effort of …ing pays off
grammar.ja: 朝早くから並んだかいがあって、限定品を無事に手に入れることができた。
grammar.en: Queuing from early morning paid off: I managed to get the limited-edition item.

grammar.meaning: cannot help feeling …; cannot suppress (an emotion)
grammar.ja: 公金がこれほど無駄に使われていたことには、怒りを禁じ得ない。
grammar.en: I cannot suppress my anger that public money was wasted to this extent.

grammar.meaning: cannot help feeling …; cannot suppress (an emotion)
grammar.ja: 被害者の手記を読み、深い同情を禁じ得なかった。
grammar.en: Reading the victim's written account, I could not help feeling deep sympathy.

grammar.form: 色づき始めといったところです
grammar.meaning: about …; at most …
grammar.ja: 紅葉はまだ見頃には早く、ようやく色づき始めといったところです。
grammar.en: It's still too early for peak autumn color; the leaves have only just begun to turn.

grammar.form: 五十人といったところだ
grammar.meaning: about …; at most …
grammar.ja: 新しい店の客の入りは、平日で一日五十人といったところだ。
grammar.en: The new shop gets about fifty customers a day on weekdays, and that's it.

grammar.meaning: just when …, (something or someone arrives)
grammar.ja: 会議の準備をしているところへ、部長から急な電話が入った。
grammar.en: Just as I was preparing for the meeting, an urgent call came in from the department head.

grammar.meaning: just when …, (something or someone arrives)
grammar.ja: 出かけようとしているところに、宅配便が届いた。
grammar.en: Just as I was about to go out, a parcel arrived.

grammar.meaning: it appears that …; seemingly …
grammar.ja: 新型のスマホはよほど人気があるとみえて、どの店でも品切れが続いている。
grammar.en: The new smartphone must be extremely popular, as it remains sold out at every shop.

grammar.meaning: it appears that …; seemingly …
grammar.ja: 隣の家は留守とみえて、何度チャイムを鳴らしても返事がない。
grammar.en: The house next door seems to be empty; no matter how many times I ring the bell, there is no answer.

grammar.meaning: to reach …; to end up …; to come to …
grammar.ja: 小さな配線ミスから、大規模な停電に至ることもある。
grammar.en: A small wiring mistake can sometimes escalate into a large-scale blackout.

grammar.meaning: to reach …; to end up …; to come to …
grammar.ja: 三か月に及ぶ話し合いの末、両社はようやく合意に至った。
grammar.en: After three months of talks, the two companies finally reached an agreement.

grammar.meaning: undaunted by …; in defiance of …
grammar.ja: 救助隊は余震の危険をものともせずに、がれきの下に取り残された住民を捜し続けた。
grammar.en: Undeterred by the danger of aftershocks, the rescue team kept searching for residents trapped under the rubble.

grammar.meaning: undaunted by …; in defiance of …
grammar.ja: 選手たちは激しい雨をものともせず、最後まで全力で走り抜いた。
grammar.en: Undaunted by the heavy rain, the athletes ran all out to the very end.

grammar.meaning: it is not that … not …; it is not impossible to …
grammar.ja: 辛いものは食べられないこともないけど、あまり得意じゃない。
grammar.en: It's not that I can't eat spicy food, but I'm not really fond of it.

grammar.meaning: it is not that … not …; it is not impossible to …
grammar.ja: 急げば間に合わないことはないが、少し厳しい。
grammar.en: If we hurry it's not impossible to make it, but it will be tight.

grammar.meaning: is there no way to …?; if only somehow …
grammar.ja: もっと手軽に地方の魅力を伝えられないものかと、若手職員たちが動画制作を始めた。
grammar.en: Wondering whether there was an easier way to convey the region's appeal, young staff members started making videos.

grammar.meaning: is there no way to …?; if only somehow …
grammar.ja: この渋滞、何とかならないものか。毎朝一時間も無駄にしている。
grammar.en: Isn't there something that can be done about this traffic? I waste a whole hour every morning.

grammar.form: あったにもかかわらず
grammar.meaning: despite …; in spite of …; even though …
grammar.ja: 再三の注意喚起があったにもかかわらず、山での遭難事故は今年も後を絶たない。
grammar.en: Despite repeated warnings, there has again been no end to mountain accidents this year.

grammar.meaning: despite …; in spite of …; even though …
grammar.ja: 平日の朝にもかかわらず、新しいカフェの前には長い行列ができていた。
grammar.en: Even though it was a weekday morning, there was a long line outside the new café.

grammar.meaning: not likely to …; does not look as if …
grammar.ja: 仕事が山積みで、今夜は終電に間に合いそうもない。
grammar.en: I have a mountain of work, so it doesn't look like I'll make the last train tonight.

grammar.meaning: not likely to …; does not look as if …
grammar.ja: この雨はしばらくやみそうにないから、タクシーを呼ぼう。
grammar.en: This rain doesn't look like it will stop any time soon, so let's call a taxi.

grammar.meaning: as soon as …; depending on …
grammar.ja: 成功するかどうかは、最初の一年の頑張り次第だ。
grammar.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on how hard you work in the first year.

grammar.meaning: as soon as …; depending on …
grammar.ja: 詳細が決まり次第、改めてご連絡いたします。
grammar.en: We will contact you again as soon as the details are settled.

grammar.meaning: there is no need to …
grammar.ja: 資料はメールでお送りしますので、わざわざ取りに来ていただくには及びません。
grammar.en: We'll send the documents by email, so there's no need to come all the way to pick them up.

grammar.meaning: there is no need to …
grammar.ja: 軽い風邪ですから、ご心配には及びません。
grammar.en: It's only a mild cold, so there's no need to worry.

grammar.meaning: ignoring …; in disregard of …; in contrast to …
grammar.ja: 住民の反対をよそに、市はごみ処理施設の建設計画を着々と進めている。
grammar.en: Paying no heed to residents' opposition, the city is steadily pushing ahead with its plan to build a waste-processing facility.

grammar.meaning: ignoring …; in disregard of …; in contrast to …
grammar.ja: 親の心配をよそに、息子は大学を辞めて世界一周の旅に出た。
grammar.en: Ignoring his parents' worries, the son quit university and set off on a trip around the world.

grammar.meaning: even without …ing; even if one does not (or is not) …
grammar.ja: この程度の手続きなら、わざわざ窓口に行かずとも、オンラインで済ませられる。
grammar.en: For paperwork of this kind, you can finish it online without going all the way to the counter.

grammar.meaning: even without …ing; even if one does not (or is not) …
grammar.ja: 長年連れ添った相手なら、言わずとも気持ちは伝わるものだ。
grammar.en: With a partner of many years, your feelings get across even without putting them into words.

grammar.meaning: even if there is …, (still) …; if anything …, but never …
grammar.ja: 親の厳しい言葉には、今となっては感謝こそすれ、恨む理由など一つもない。
grammar.en: Looking back now, I feel nothing but gratitude for my parents' harsh words, and have no reason at all to resent them.

grammar.meaning: even if there is …, (still) …; if anything …, but never …
grammar.ja: 程度の差こそあれ、どの業界も深刻な人手不足に悩んでいる。
grammar.en: The degree may differ, but every industry is struggling with a serious labour shortage.

grammar.meaning: when I did …, (I found that) …
grammar.ja: 市の窓口に問い合わせたところ、申請の締め切りはすでに過ぎているとのことだった。
grammar.en: When I enquired at the city office, I was told the application deadline had already passed.

grammar.meaning: when I did …, (I found that) …
grammar.ja: 駅前の新しいパン屋に行ってみたところ、開店前から長い行列ができていた。
grammar.en: When I went to try the new bakery by the station, there was already a long line before it had even opened.

grammar.meaning: if one so much as dared to …
grammar.ja: レース中に少しでも油断しようものなら、すぐに後続に抜かれてしまう。
grammar.en: Let your guard down even slightly during a race and the runners behind you will overtake you in no time.

grammar.meaning: if one so much as dared to …
grammar.ja: 会議に一分でも遅れようものなら、部長に大声で怒鳴られる。
grammar.en: If you're even a minute late to a meeting, the department head yells at you.

grammar.meaning: even (just) …ing (e.g. to imagine or think of); not even …
grammar.ja: 宮殿の衛兵は、観光客に囲まれても微動だにしなかった。
grammar.en: The palace guard did not move a muscle, even when surrounded by tourists.

grammar.meaning: even (just) …ing (e.g. to imagine or think of); not even …
grammar.ja: 首都直下地震が深夜に起きた場合の被害は、想像するだに恐ろしい。
grammar.en: The damage if a major earthquake struck directly beneath the capital late at night is frightening even to imagine.

grammar.meaning: let alone …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: その村には、コンビニはおろか信号機さえ一つもない。
grammar.en: That village doesn't have a single traffic light, let alone a convenience store.

grammar.meaning: let alone …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: 入社して三か月、ボーナスはおろか、まともな残業代すら支払われていない。
grammar.en: Three months after joining the company, I haven't even been paid proper overtime, let alone a bonus.

grammar.meaning: based on …; drawing on … (as source material)
grammar.ja: アンケートの結果をもとに、来年度のサービス内容を見直す予定です。
grammar.en: We plan to review next year's services based on the survey results.

grammar.meaning: based on …; drawing on … (as source material)
grammar.ja: この映画は、実際に起きた事件をもとに作られている。
grammar.en: This film is based on an incident that actually happened.

grammar.meaning: only after … (does one realise or manage something)
grammar.ja: 病気をして初めて、健康のありがたさに気づく人は多い。
grammar.en: Many people only realise how precious good health is after falling ill.

grammar.meaning: only after … (does one realise or manage something)
grammar.ja: 親になって初めて、自分の両親の苦労がわかった。
grammar.en: Only after becoming a parent did I understand what my own parents went through.

grammar.meaning: all the way to …; right down to …; even …
grammar.ja: 新しい校則は、髪型から靴下の色に至るまで細かく定めている。
grammar.en: The new school rules lay down everything in detail, from hairstyles right down to the color of socks.

grammar.meaning: all the way to …; right down to …; even …
grammar.ja: この店では、調味料から食器に至るまで、すべて地元産のものを使っている。
grammar.en: This restaurant uses only local products, from the seasonings all the way to the tableware.

grammar.form: 平日といわず週末といわず
grammar.meaning: … and … alike; both … and … (and everywhere else); without distinction
grammar.ja: 平日といわず週末といわず、駅前のあのカフェはいつ行っても満席だ。
grammar.en: Weekdays or weekends alike, that café in front of the station is full whenever you go.

grammar.form: 手といわず足といわず
grammar.meaning: … and … alike; both … and … (and everywhere else); without distinction
grammar.ja: キャンプ場で手といわず足といわず、全身あちこち蚊に刺されてしまった。
grammar.en: At the campsite I got bitten by mosquitoes all over, on my hands, my legs, everywhere.

grammar.meaning: with …, by means of … (formal); as of …, at … (marking an end point)
grammar.ja: 選考の結果につきましては、後日書面をもってお知らせいたします。
grammar.en: We will inform you of the selection results in writing at a later date.

grammar.meaning: with …, by means of … (formal); as of …, at … (marking an end point)
grammar.ja: 当店は今月末をもって閉店いたします。長年のご愛顧、誠にありがとうございました。
grammar.en: Our shop will close at the end of this month. Thank you very much for your many years of patronage.

grammar.meaning: connected with …; surrounding … (stories, legends, rumours)
grammar.ja: 番組では、お金にまつわる失敗談を視聴者から募集している。
grammar.en: The program is inviting viewers to send in stories of their money-related blunders.

grammar.meaning: connected with …; surrounding … (stories, legends, rumours)
grammar.ja: この城にまつわる伝説を集めた本が、地元で静かなブームになっている。
grammar.en: A book collecting the legends surrounding this castle has become a quiet hit locally.

grammar.meaning: as if to say …; as though …
grammar.ja: 猫は「早くご飯をちょうだい」とばかりに足元にすり寄ってきた。
grammar.en: The cat rubbed against my feet as if to say, 'Feed me, quick.'

grammar.meaning: as if to say …; as though …
grammar.ja: 開店と同時に、客たちは待ってましたとばかりに売り場へなだれ込んだ。
grammar.en: The moment the store opened, the customers poured onto the sales floor as if they had been waiting for this.

grammar.meaning: nothing but …; … from top to bottom; full of …
grammar.ja: 防犯カメラに映っていたのは、全身黒ずくめの男だったという。
grammar.en: The person caught on the security camera was reportedly a man dressed in black from head to toe.

grammar.meaning: nothing but …; … from top to bottom; full of …
grammar.ja: 今年は昇進に結婚と、いいことずくめの一年だった。
grammar.en: With a promotion and a wedding, this year has been nothing but good news.

grammar.meaning: only by …ing (does it count or have value)
grammar.ja: 法律は、守られてこそ意味がある。
grammar.en: Laws only mean something when they are obeyed.

grammar.meaning: only by …ing (does it count or have value)
grammar.ja: 自分で失敗を経験してこそ、本当の意味で学ぶことができる。
grammar.en: Only by experiencing failure yourself can you learn in the true sense.

grammar.meaning: perhaps because of …; maybe due to …
grammar.ja: 気温が急に下がったせいか、今週は風邪で欠席する生徒が多い。
grammar.en: Perhaps because the temperature dropped suddenly, many students have been absent with colds this week.

grammar.meaning: perhaps because of …; maybe due to …
grammar.ja: 昨夜遅くまでスマホを見ていたせいか、朝から頭が重い。
grammar.en: Maybe because I was on my phone until late last night, my head has felt heavy since this morning.

grammar.form: 進学するにしろ就職するにしろ
grammar.meaning: whether … or …
grammar.ja: 進学するにしろ就職するにしろ、早めに準備を始めたほうがいい。
grammar.en: Whether you go on to further study or get a job, it's better to start preparing early.

grammar.form: 賛成にしろ反対にしろ
grammar.meaning: whether … or …
grammar.ja: 賛成にしろ反対にしろ、自分の意見をはっきり言うべきだ。
grammar.en: Whether you are for it or against it, you should state your opinion clearly.

grammar.meaning: this is no time for …; … is out of the question
grammar.ja: 雨が強すぎて、花見どころではなかった。
grammar.en: The rain was far too heavy for any cherry-blossom viewing.

grammar.meaning: this is no time for …; … is out of the question
grammar.ja: 締め切りが迫っていて、旅行どころではない。
grammar.en: With the deadline closing in, a trip is out of the question.

grammar.meaning: centring on …; mainly in/among …
grammar.ja: 新製品は若い女性を中心に売り上げを伸ばしている。
grammar.en: The new product's sales are growing, mainly among young women.

grammar.meaning: centring on …; mainly in/among …
grammar.ja: 台風の影響で、九州を中心に大雨が降り続いている。
grammar.en: Because of the typhoon, heavy rain continues to fall, mainly in Kyushu.

grammar.meaning: as …, gradually …; in proportion as …
grammar.ja: 年齢を重ねるにつれて、若い頃には分からなかった親の苦労が見えてきた。
grammar.en: As I've grown older, I've come to see the hardships my parents went through that I couldn't understand when I was young.

grammar.meaning: as …, gradually …; in proportion as …
grammar.ja: 日が暮れるにつれて、通りの人出はますます増えていった。
grammar.en: As the sun went down, the streets grew more and more crowded.

grammar.meaning: in order to …; for the sake of … (with strong resolve)
grammar.ja: 真実を明らかにせんがために、記者は十年にわたって取材を続けた。
grammar.en: Determined to bring the truth to light, the journalist kept investigating for ten years.

grammar.meaning: in order to …; for the sake of … (with strong resolve)
grammar.ja: 勝たんがために手段を選ばないやり方には、到底賛成できない。
grammar.en: I simply cannot agree with an approach that uses any means just to win.

grammar.meaning: … aside, but …; it may be different for …, but …
grammar.ja: 昔はいざ知らず、今はスマホ一台で世界中の情報が手に入る。
grammar.en: The past may have been different, but now you can get information from all over the world with a single smartphone.

grammar.meaning: … aside, but …; it may be different for …, but …
grammar.ja: 子どもならいざ知らず、大人がこんな簡単なルールも守れないとは情けない。
grammar.en: A child would be one thing, but it is pathetic that adults can't follow even such a simple rule.

grammar.meaning: just as one was about to …; just when …
grammar.ja: 新店舗の出店計画が発表された矢先、運営会社の不正会計が明らかになった。
grammar.en: Right after plans for the new store were announced, accounting fraud at the operating company came to light.

grammar.meaning: just as one was about to …; just when …
grammar.ja: 家を出ようとした矢先に、激しい雨が降り出した。
grammar.en: Just as I was about to leave the house, it started pouring with rain.

grammar.meaning: only … (would do that); about the only … is …
grammar.ja: この難しい修理を一日で仕上げられるのは、町でもあの職人くらいのものだ。
grammar.en: That craftsman is about the only person in town who could finish such a difficult repair in a day.

grammar.form: 観光客くらいのものだ
grammar.meaning: only … (would do that); about the only … is …
grammar.ja: こんな真冬に半袖で外を歩いているのは、観光客くらいのものだ。
grammar.en: The only people walking around in short sleeves in the dead of winter like this are tourists.

grammar.meaning: if it is (for) …, then
grammar.ja: 必要とあれば週末でも対応いたしますので、遠慮なくご連絡ください。
grammar.en: If necessary, we can help on weekends as well, so please don't hesitate to contact us.

grammar.meaning: if it is (for) …, then
grammar.ja: 子どものためとあれば、親はどんな苦労もいとわないものだ。
grammar.en: If it is for their children, parents will gladly endure any hardship.

grammar.meaning: even if …; even granting …; even for …
grammar.ja: 冗談にしても、その言い方はちょっとひどいと思う。
grammar.en: Even as a joke, I think that way of putting it is a bit harsh.

grammar.meaning: even if …; even granting …; even for …
grammar.ja: 忙しかったにしても、連絡ぐらいはできたはずだ。
grammar.en: Even if you were busy, you could at least have gotten in touch.

grammar.meaning: even …; even if …
grammar.ja: 今から急いだとて、最終電車にはもう間に合わないだろう。
grammar.en: Even if we hurry now, we probably won't make the last train.

grammar.meaning: even …; even if …
grammar.ja: 専門家とて、すべての地震を正確に予測できるわけではない。
grammar.en: Even experts cannot accurately predict every earthquake.

grammar.meaning: using … as a pretext
grammar.ja: 歓迎会にかこつけて、結局はいつものメンバーで飲みたいだけなんだよ。
grammar.en: They're just using the welcome party as an excuse; in the end they only want to drink with the usual crowd.

grammar.meaning: using … as a pretext
grammar.ja: 出張にかこつけて、地方の温泉巡りを楽しむ社員もいるらしい。
grammar.en: Apparently some employees use business trips as an excuse to tour hot springs in the countryside.

grammar.meaning: hard to …; can hardly …
grammar.ja: 子どもを狙った今回の犯行は、到底許しがたい。
grammar.en: This crime targeting children is utterly unforgivable.

grammar.meaning: hard to …; can hardly …
grammar.ja: あれほど慎重な人がそんな初歩的なミスをするとは、にわかには信じがたい。
grammar.en: It is hard to believe, at least at first, that such a careful person would make such a basic mistake.

grammar.meaning: supposing that …; if it were the case that …
grammar.ja: このペースで値上がりが続くとすれば、家計への影響は避けられない。
grammar.en: If prices keep rising at this pace, the impact on household budgets is unavoidable.

grammar.meaning: supposing that …; if it were the case that …
grammar.ja: もし宝くじが当たったとしたら、何に使いますか。
grammar.en: If you won the lottery, what would you spend it on?

grammar.meaning: never cease to …; sincerely …
grammar.ja: 地元の人々が愛してやまない老舗の和菓子店が、今月で閉店することになった。
grammar.en: A long-established Japanese sweets shop that local people dearly love is closing at the end of this month.

grammar.meaning: never cease to …; sincerely …
grammar.ja: 被災地の一日も早い復興を心から願ってやみません。
grammar.en: We sincerely hope for the swiftest possible recovery of the disaster-stricken area.

grammar.meaning: without regard for …; heedless of …
grammar.ja: 家庭を顧みずに働き続けた結果、気づけば子どもはもう成人していた。
grammar.en: I kept working without regard for my family, and before I knew it my children were already grown up.

grammar.meaning: without regard for …; heedless of …
grammar.ja: 消防士は身の危険を顧みず、燃え盛る建物に飛び込んだ。
grammar.en: Heedless of the danger to themselves, the firefighter dashed into the blazing building.

grammar.meaning: contrary to …; against …
grammar.ja: 本人の意思に反して、無理やり退職させることは認められない。
grammar.en: Forcing someone to resign against their will is not permitted.

grammar.meaning: contrary to …; against …
grammar.ja: 大方の予想に反して、新人候補が現職を破って当選した。
grammar.en: Contrary to most predictions, the first-time candidate beat the incumbent and won the election.

grammar.meaning: prior to …; in advance of … (formal)
grammar.ja: 工事の開始に先立ち、近隣住民を対象とした説明会が開かれる。
grammar.en: Before construction begins, a briefing session will be held for local residents.

grammar.meaning: prior to …; in advance of … (formal)
grammar.ja: 映画の公開に先立って、主演俳優による舞台あいさつが行われた。
grammar.en: Prior to the film's release, the lead actor greeted the audience on stage.

grammar.form: を余儀なくさせている
grammar.meaning: be forced to …; have no choice but to … (causative form: force someone into …)
grammar.ja: 円安による原材料費の高騰が、多くの中小企業に値上げを余儀なくさせている。
grammar.en: Soaring raw-material costs caused by the weak yen are forcing many small and medium-sized firms to raise prices.

grammar.meaning: be forced to …; have no choice but to … (causative form: force someone into …)
grammar.ja: 台風の接近により、野外コンサートは中止を余儀なくされた。
grammar.en: Because of the approaching typhoon, the outdoor concert had to be cancelled.

grammar.meaning: affecting …; concerning (something serious)
grammar.ja: 会社の信用にかかわる問題なので、慎重に対応してほしい。
grammar.en: This is an issue that affects the company's credibility, so please handle it carefully.

grammar.meaning: affecting …; concerning (something serious)
grammar.ja: 命にかかわる病気ではないが、早めに治療したほうがいい。
grammar.en: It is not a life-threatening illness, but it is better to get treatment early.

grammar.meaning: precisely because …; all the more since …
grammar.ja: 人気の観光地だけに、週末はどこの宿も予約でいっぱいだ。
grammar.en: As you'd expect of such a popular tourist spot, every place to stay is fully booked at weekends.

grammar.meaning: precisely because …; all the more since …
grammar.ja: 期待が大きかっただけに、初戦での敗退はファンにとって大きなショックだった。
grammar.en: Because expectations had been so high, the first-round exit was all the more of a shock to fans.

grammar.meaning: not stopping at …; going beyond …
grammar.ja: 豪雨の被害は農作物にとどまらず、道路や鉄道にまで及んだ。
grammar.en: The heavy rain damaged not only crops but even roads and railways.

grammar.meaning: not stopping at …; going beyond …
grammar.ja: このアニメの人気は国内にとどまらず、アジアや欧米にも広がっている。
grammar.en: This anime's popularity is not confined to Japan; it has spread to Asia, Europe and North America.

grammar.meaning: only …; solely …; nothing but …
grammar.ja: 行方不明の登山者たちの無事を、今はただ祈るのみです。
grammar.en: Right now, all we can do is pray for the safety of the missing climbers.

grammar.meaning: only …; solely …; nothing but …
grammar.ja: やれるだけの準備はしてきた。あとはただ結果を待つのみだ。
grammar.en: We have done all the preparation we could. Now all that is left is to wait for the result.

grammar.meaning: at a time when … (despite the inconvenience; caught in the act)
grammar.ja: 本日はお足元の悪いところをお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。
grammar.en: Thank you for coming today despite the bad weather.

grammar.meaning: at a time when … (despite the inconvenience; caught in the act)
grammar.ja: お休みのところを申し訳ありませんが、少しお時間よろしいでしょうか。
grammar.en: I'm sorry to disturb you on your day off, but could I have a moment of your time?

grammar.meaning: through … (as a means or go-between); throughout … (a whole period or area)
grammar.ja: この地域は一年を通じて温暖で、観光客が絶えない。
grammar.en: This region is mild all year round and never short of tourists.

grammar.meaning: through … (as a means or go-between); throughout … (a whole period or area)
grammar.ja: 留学を通して、自分の国を外から見ることができた。
grammar.en: Studying abroad let me see my own country from the outside.

grammar.meaning: cannot afford to keep …ing; can't just …
grammar.ja: 他社が次々と新製品を出している以上、うちも黙って見てはいられない。
grammar.en: With rivals launching one new product after another, we can't just stand by and watch.

grammar.meaning: cannot afford to keep …ing; can't just …
grammar.ja: 締め切りまであと三日だ。のんびりしてはいられない。
grammar.en: Only three days left until the deadline. I can't afford to take it easy.

grammar.meaning: after (a long process of) …; at the end of …
grammar.ja: 家族と何度も話し合った末に、地方への移住を決めた。
grammar.en: After talking it over with my family many times, I decided to move to the countryside.

grammar.meaning: after (a long process of) …; at the end of …
grammar.ja: 三年に及ぶ研究の末に、ついに新しい素材の開発に成功した。
grammar.en: After three years of research, they finally succeeded in developing a new material.

grammar.meaning: while still …; as one is (unchanged); from the state of …
grammar.ja: 被害者の家族は、涙ながらに事故当日の様子を語った。
grammar.en: The victim's family, in tears, described what happened on the day of the accident.

grammar.meaning: while still …; as one is (unchanged); from the state of …
grammar.ja: ネットのおかげで、自宅に居ながらにして世界中の美術館を見て回れる。
grammar.en: Thanks to the internet, you can tour museums all over the world without leaving home.

grammar.meaning: not limited to …; not just … but more widely
grammar.ja: 最近は都市部に限らず、地方でもキャッシュレス決済が急速に広がっている。
grammar.en: These days cashless payments are spreading rapidly, not only in cities but in rural areas as well.

grammar.meaning: not limited to …; not just … but more widely
grammar.ja: この映画は子どもに限らず、大人が見ても十分楽しめる内容になっている。
grammar.en: This film isn't just for children; adults can thoroughly enjoy it too.

grammar.form: ドライバーはもとより
grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of … (formal)
grammar.ja: 安全運転は、プロのドライバーはもとより、すべての運転者に求められる。
grammar.en: Safe driving is expected of every driver, not just professional ones.

grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of … (formal)
grammar.ja: この地域の祭りは、地元の住民はもとより、海外からの観光客にも人気がある。
grammar.en: This region's festival is popular with visitors from overseas, not to mention local residents.

grammar.meaning: there is no need to …; it goes without saying
grammar.ja: 言うまでもなく、安全はすべてに優先する。
grammar.en: Needless to say, safety comes before everything.

grammar.meaning: there is no need to …; it goes without saying
grammar.ja: この程度の傷なら、病院に行くまでもない。
grammar.en: A cut this small isn't worth going to the hospital for.

grammar.meaning: too absorbed in … (neglecting something else)
grammar.ja: ゲームにかまけて宿題を後回しにしていたら、夏休みが終わってしまった。
grammar.en: I kept putting off my homework because I was absorbed in games, and summer vacation ended.

grammar.meaning: too absorbed in … (neglecting something else)
grammar.ja: 仕事にかまけて、家族との時間をおろそかにしていた。
grammar.en: I was so wrapped up in work that I neglected time with my family.

grammar.meaning: from the standpoint of …; in terms of …; for … reasons
grammar.ja: 法律上は問題がなくても、倫理的に許されるとは限らない。
grammar.en: Even if there is no legal problem, that does not mean it is ethically acceptable.

grammar.meaning: from the standpoint of …; in terms of …; for … reasons
grammar.ja: 経験上、こういうトラブルは週明けに起きることが多い。
grammar.en: In my experience, this kind of trouble tends to happen at the start of the week.

grammar.meaning: even …; even granting …
grammar.ja: いかに小さな会社といえども、法律を守る責任があることに変わりはない。
grammar.en: However small a company may be, it is still responsible for obeying the law.

grammar.meaning: even …; even granting …
grammar.ja: 専門家といえども、将来の株価を正確に予測することはできない。
grammar.en: Even experts cannot accurately predict future stock prices.

grammar.meaning: even … (citing an extreme example)
grammar.ja: その病気は、専門の医師ですら診断が難しいと言われている。
grammar.en: That illness is said to be hard to diagnose even for specialist doctors.

grammar.meaning: even … (citing an extreme example)
grammar.ja: 忙しすぎて、昼ご飯を食べる時間すらなかった。
grammar.en: I was so busy I didn't even have time to eat lunch.

grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: あの通訳は、英語はもちろん、中国語やスペイン語も話せるらしい。
grammar.en: Apparently that interpreter speaks Chinese and Spanish, not to mention English.

grammar.meaning: not to mention …; to say nothing of …
grammar.ja: この温泉街は、週末はもちろん、平日も観光客でにぎわっている。
grammar.en: This hot-spring town is lively with tourists on weekdays, not to mention weekends.

grammar.form: 使い回していたばかりに
grammar.meaning: simply because …; just because of … (with a bad result, regret)
grammar.ja: パスワードを使い回していたばかりに、複数のアカウントが乗っ取られた。
grammar.en: Simply because I had reused my password, several of my accounts were hijacked.

grammar.meaning: simply because …; just because of … (with a bad result, regret)
grammar.ja: 寝坊したばかりに、大事な面接に遅れてしまった。
grammar.en: Just because I overslept, I was late for an important interview.

grammar.meaning: the utmost …; deeply (honored, embarrassed, etc.)
grammar.ja: 学生時代に派手な髪色で面接に行ったのは、今思えば若気の至りだった。
grammar.en: Looking back, going to a job interview with flashy hair in my student days was a youthful indiscretion.

grammar.meaning: the utmost …; deeply (honored, embarrassed, etc.)
grammar.ja: このような栄誉ある賞をいただき、光栄の至りでございます。
grammar.en: I am deeply honored to receive such a prestigious award.

grammar.form: 信用していないきらいがある
grammar.meaning: have a (bad) tendency to …; be inclined to …
grammar.ja: この監督の作品は説明が多く、観客の想像力を信用していないきらいがある。
grammar.en: This director's films explain too much and tend to show little trust in the audience's imagination.

grammar.form: 考えすぎるきらいがある
grammar.meaning: have a (bad) tendency to …; be inclined to …
grammar.ja: 彼は物事を悲観的に考えすぎるきらいがあるが、そのぶん準備は周到だ。
grammar.en: He tends to be overly pessimistic about things, but that makes him all the more thorough in his preparation.

grammar.meaning: in (a situation, era); being in …
grammar.ja: 厳しい経営環境にあっても、同社は研究開発への投資を減らさなかった。
grammar.en: Even in a harsh business environment, the company did not cut its investment in research and development.

grammar.meaning: in (a situation, era); being in …
grammar.ja: 物価が上がり続ける状況にあって、多くの家庭が節約を強いられている。
grammar.en: In a situation where prices keep rising, many households are being forced to economize.

grammar.meaning: smeared all over with …; covered in …
grammar.ja: 真夏の引っ越し作業で、全員が汗まみれになった。
grammar.en: Moving house in midsummer left everyone drenched in sweat.

grammar.meaning: smeared all over with …; covered in …
grammar.ja: 試合が終わると、選手たちは泥まみれのユニフォームのまま観客に手を振った。
grammar.en: When the match ended, the players waved to the crowd still in their mud-covered uniforms.

grammar.meaning: accompanying …; along with …; as … changes
grammar.ja: 本社移転に伴い、来月から代表電話番号が変更になります。
grammar.en: Due to the relocation of our head office, our main phone number will change from next month.

grammar.meaning: accompanying …; along with …; as … changes
grammar.ja: 高齢化に伴って、介護の担い手不足が深刻になっている。
grammar.en: As society ages, the shortage of care workers is becoming serious.

grammar.meaning: … of all (times, people); precisely when …; only … in particular
grammar.ja: 傘を持たずに出かけた日に限って、夕方から土砂降りになる。
grammar.en: It's always the day I go out without an umbrella that it starts pouring in the evening.

grammar.meaning: … of all (times, people); precisely when …; only … in particular
grammar.ja: 急いでいる時に限って、電車が遅れたり信号に引っかかったりするんだよね。
grammar.en: It's always when I'm in a hurry that the train is late or I hit every red light.

grammar.term: 〜いかんで／〜いかんによっては
grammar.form: 検査結果のいかんによっては
grammar.meaning: depending on …; in some cases, depending on …
grammar.ja: 検査結果のいかんによっては、手術が必要になる場合もあります。
grammar.en: Depending on the test results, surgery may be necessary in some cases.

grammar.term: 〜いかんで／〜いかんによっては
grammar.meaning: depending on …; in some cases, depending on …
grammar.ja: 今後の交渉のいかんで、工場の存続が決まる。
grammar.en: Whether the factory survives will depend on how the coming negotiations go.

grammar.meaning: take on the air of …; show signs of …; -ish
grammar.ja: 上司は冗談めいた口調で言ったが、目は笑っていなかった。
grammar.en: The boss said it in a joking tone, but his eyes weren't smiling.

grammar.meaning: take on the air of …; show signs of …; -ish
grammar.ja: 三月に入り、日差しもすっかり春めいてきた。
grammar.en: Now that it's March, the sunlight has become quite spring-like.

grammar.meaning: not only … but (even) …
grammar.ja: 台風の影響で、電車が止まったばかりか、一部の地域では停電も発生した。
grammar.en: Because of the typhoon, not only did the trains stop, but some areas also lost power.

grammar.form: 教えてくれたばかりか
grammar.meaning: not only … but (even) …
grammar.ja: その店員は道を教えてくれたばかりか、わざわざ目的地まで案内してくれた。
grammar.en: The shop clerk not only told me the way but even went to the trouble of taking me to my destination.

grammar.form: 中止せざるを得なかった
grammar.meaning: cannot avoid doing; have no choice but to
grammar.ja: 台風の接近により、主催者はイベントを中止せざるを得なかった。
grammar.en: With a typhoon approaching, the organizers had no choice but to cancel the event.

grammar.meaning: cannot avoid doing; have no choice but to
grammar.ja: 原材料費の高騰が続き、当店も来月から価格を改定せざるを得ない状況です。
grammar.en: With raw material costs still soaring, our shop has no choice but to revise its prices from next month.

grammar.form: 失敗したからといって
grammar.meaning: just because … does not mean …
grammar.ja: 一度失敗したからといって、夢をあきらめる必要はない。
grammar.en: Failing once doesn't mean you have to give up on your dream.

grammar.meaning: just because … does not mean …
grammar.ja: 値段が高いからといって、品質がいいとは限らない。
grammar.en: Just because something is expensive doesn't mean it is good quality.

grammar.meaning: probably not (negative guess); will not, determined not to (negative resolve)
grammar.ja: この程度の雨なら、試合が中止になることはあるまい。
grammar.en: With rain this light, the match probably won't be called off.

grammar.meaning: probably not (negative guess); will not, determined not to (negative resolve)
grammar.ja: あの店の料理はひどかった。もう二度と行くまいと心に決めた。
grammar.en: The food at that restaurant was awful. I made up my mind never to go there again.

grammar.meaning: once it comes to (a higher level) …; when it reaches the point of …
grammar.ja: 社長ともなれば、休日でも仕事の電話が鳴りやまないらしい。
grammar.en: Apparently, once you become company president, work calls keep coming even on your days off.

grammar.meaning: once it comes to (a higher level) …; when it reaches the point of …
grammar.ja: 年末ともなると、デパートはどこも買い物客でごった返す。
grammar.en: Once the year-end comes around, every department store is packed with shoppers.

grammar.meaning: there is no need to …; (a reaction) is not warranted
grammar.ja: この程度の値上がりは過去にも何度もあり、驚くには当たらないと専門家は話す。
grammar.en: Experts say price rises of this size have happened many times before and are nothing to be surprised about.

grammar.form: 悲観するには当たらない
grammar.meaning: there is no need to …; (a reaction) is not warranted
grammar.ja: 新人が初戦で負けたからといって、悲観するには当たらない。
grammar.en: Just because the rookie lost the first match, there is no reason to be pessimistic.

grammar.meaning: now that …; since … (so one must)
grammar.ja: こうなった上は、正直にすべてを話すしかない。
grammar.en: Now that it has come to this, there is nothing for it but to tell the whole truth.

grammar.meaning: now that …; since … (so one must)
grammar.ja: 引き受けた上は、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
grammar.en: Now that I have taken it on, I intend to see it through to the end.

grammar.form: うれしいやらほっとするやら
grammar.meaning: what with … and …; … and … and so on
grammar.ja: 合格の知らせを聞いて、うれしいやらほっとするやらで涙が出てきた。
grammar.en: When I heard I'd passed, I was so happy and relieved that tears came to my eyes.

grammar.form: 荷造りやら役所の手続きやら
grammar.meaning: what with … and …; … and … and so on
grammar.ja: 引っ越しの前は、荷造りやら役所の手続きやらで目が回るほど忙しかった。
grammar.en: Before the move, what with packing and paperwork at the city office, I was dizzyingly busy.

grammar.meaning: precisely because …; it is because … that …
grammar.ja: 忙しいからこそ、意識して休む時間を作るべきだ。
grammar.en: It is precisely because you are busy that you should make a point of setting aside time to rest.

grammar.meaning: precisely because …; it is because … that …
grammar.ja: 失敗を経験したからこそ、人の痛みが分かるようになった。
grammar.en: It was precisely because I experienced failure that I came to understand other people's pain.

grammar.meaning: right in the middle of …; at the height of …
grammar.ja: シャワーを浴びている最中に、突然お湯が出なくなった。
grammar.en: Right in the middle of my shower, the hot water suddenly stopped.

grammar.meaning: right in the middle of …; at the height of …
grammar.ja: 大事な会議の最中に、携帯電話が鳴り出して冷や汗をかいた。
grammar.en: My phone started ringing right in the middle of an important meeting, and I broke into a cold sweat.

grammar.meaning: there is no way to …; cannot possibly …
grammar.ja: 地方の小さな診療所の設備は、最新鋭の大学病院とは比べるべくもない。
grammar.en: The equipment at a small rural clinic cannot possibly compare with that of a state-of-the-art university hospital.

grammar.meaning: there is no way to …; cannot possibly …
grammar.ja: あの頃の私たちには、今日のような便利な生活など望むべくもなかった。
grammar.en: Back then, we couldn't possibly have hoped for a life as convenient as today's.

grammar.meaning: as much as …; no less than … (size, weight, price)
grammar.ja: 一本十万円からするワインを、彼は惜しげもなく開けた。
grammar.en: He opened a wine costing no less than 100,000 yen a bottle without a second thought.

grammar.meaning: as much as …; no less than … (size, weight, price)
grammar.ja: 漁師たちは、二メートルからあるマグロを三人がかりで引き上げた。
grammar.en: The fishermen hauled up a tuna of at least two metres, three of them pulling together.

grammar.meaning: it is not hard to (imagine, understand, infer)
grammar.ja: 長年住み慣れた土地を離れる高齢者の心情は、察するに難くない。
grammar.en: The feelings of elderly people leaving the place they have lived in for so many years are not hard to understand.

grammar.meaning: it is not hard to (imagine, understand, infer)
grammar.ja: 突然の解散発表にファンがどれほど衝撃を受けたかは、想像に難くない。
grammar.en: It is not hard to imagine how shocked fans were by the sudden announcement that the group was breaking up.

grammar.meaning: … and … alternately; back and forth
grammar.ja: マラソンの終盤は、二人の選手による抜きつ抜かれつの激しい争いとなった。
grammar.en: The final stretch of the marathon became a fierce battle, with the two runners repeatedly overtaking each other.

grammar.meaning: … and … alternately; back and forth
grammar.ja: 地域の商店同士は、昔から持ちつ持たれつの関係で支え合ってきた。
grammar.en: The local shops have long supported one another in a relationship of give and take.

grammar.meaning: makes (someone) … ; causes even (someone) to … (literary causative)
grammar.ja: 長年の研究成果は、懐疑的だった学界をして認めさせるほどのものだった。
grammar.en: Years of research produced results strong enough to make the once-skeptical academic world accept them.

grammar.meaning: makes (someone) … ; causes even (someone) to … (literary causative)
grammar.ja: その圧倒的な演奏は、辛口で知られる批評家をして「完璧だ」と言わしめた。
grammar.en: That overwhelming performance made even a critic known for harsh reviews call it perfect.

grammar.form: と言っても過言ではない
grammar.meaning: it is no exaggeration to say …
grammar.ja: このヒット曲がバンドの運命を大きく変えたと言っても過言ではない。
grammar.en: It is no exaggeration to say that this hit song dramatically changed the band's fortunes.

grammar.form: と言っても過言ではない
grammar.meaning: it is no exaggeration to say …
grammar.ja: スマートフォンは今や現代人の生活必需品と言っても過言ではない。
grammar.en: It is no exaggeration to say that the smartphone is now a daily necessity for modern people.
