presentation.note: The standard written suffix for the person who does or is something (研究者, 利用者), more formal than ～人 and focused on the role rather than the individual.
collocations: 高齢者向けのサービス

presentation.defJa: 企業の数をかぞえることば。
presentation.note: Counts companies, especially in business news (大手三社 = the big three), while the same character as a suffix names a firm or shrine (出版社, 神社).
collocations: 数社から内定をもらう

presentation.meaning: person who does a job or role (e.g. driver, player)
presentation.defJa: そのことを仕事としてしたり、役目として受け持ったりする人。
presentation.note: Read しゅ in established compounds for a person with a skill or role (運転手, 選手, 歌手), unlike the native reading て in words like 聞き手 or 話し手.

presentation.defJa: その種類のアルコール飲料であることを表すことば。
presentation.note: Read しゅ in compounds naming a type of alcoholic drink (日本酒, 梅酒, 果実酒), while the standalone word is さけ and a few native compounds use ざけ (甘酒).

presentation.defJa: 同じ種類の作品などを選んで、一冊の本にまとめたもの。
presentation.note: Attached to a genre to name a compiled book of such pieces, from poetry and art (詩集, 作品集) to exam drill books (問題集).

presentation.meaning: place, facility, office (e.g. power plant, research institute)
presentation.defJa: ある仕事や活動をするために作られた建物や施設。
presentation.note: Attached to a noun to name a facility or office (研究所, 事務所), it is read しょ or じょ depending on the word (停留所 ていりゅうじょ), and some words such as 研究所 accept both.

presentation.defJa: 家族の中で何番目に生まれた娘かを表すことば。
presentation.note: Combines with numbers or with 長 and 次 to give a daughter's birth order (長女, 次女, 三女), parallel to ～男 for sons (長男, 次男).

presentation.defJa: 国の行政を分けて受け持つ、中央の大きな役所の名前につけることば。
presentation.note: Names the central government ministries (財務省, 外務省); many agencies attached to them take ～庁 instead (気象庁, 観光庁), and 同省 refers back to a ministry just mentioned.

presentation.defJa: その品物を売り買いする人や店を表すことば。
presentation.note: Attached to a kind of goods or line of trade to name a dealer (宝石商, 貿易商), sounding more businesslike or historical than ～屋 (八百屋), the everyday shop suffix.

presentation.defJa: 試合で相手を負かした回数をかぞえることば。
presentation.note: Counts wins and usually pairs with ～敗 for losses (十二勝三敗), as in sports standings and career records.

presentation.meaning: counter for articles or clauses (of a law)
presentation.defJa: 法律や約束ごとの中の、一つ一つの項目をかぞえることば。
presentation.note: Counts articles in laws, treaties and contracts, usually with 第 (第九条), while smaller subdivisions within an article are 項 and 号.

presentation.meaning: place, grounds, venue (e.g. parking lot, stadium)
presentation.defJa: ある目的のために使われる広い土地や施設を表すことば。
presentation.note: Read じょう in Sino-Japanese compounds for a facility or venue (会場, 競技場, 工場), while native and mixed-reading words use ば (売り場, 職場).

presentation.meaning: counter for tatami mats (measure of room size)
presentation.defJa: 部屋の広さを、たたみの枚数でかぞえることば。
presentation.note: Measures room size by the number of tatami mats (one mat is roughly 1.6 square meters), and real-estate listings use it even for Western-style rooms.

presentation.meaning: color, color type (e.g. warm color, primary color)
presentation.defJa: そういう種類や性質の、いろであることを表すことば。
presentation.note: Read しょく in Sino-Japanese compounds that classify colors (暖色, 寒色, 原色), as opposed to the native reading いろ in everyday color words like 水色 or 茶色.

presentation.defJa: 動作や状態の程度が、ちょうどよいところをこえているようす。
presentation.note: Attaches to verb and adjective stems (食べ過ぎる, 高過ぎる) to express excess, is often written in kana as ～すぎる, and its noun form ～過ぎ is common in warnings like 飲み過ぎ.

presentation.meaning: already done, finished (e.g. used, paid, checked)
presentation.defJa: その作業や手続きが、もう終わっていることを表すことば。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns of action (使用済み, 予約済み) and usually written with okurigana as ～済み, though labels and forms often shorten it to 済 alone (検査済).

presentation.meaning: counter for seats; seat of a given type (e.g. reserved seat)
presentation.defJa: 座る場所の数をかぞえることば。
presentation.note: Counts seats in theaters, restaurants and vehicles (八百席), and as a suffix also names a kind of seat (指定席, 自由席).

presentation.meaning: -ship, vessel (a type of ship, e.g. cargo ship)
presentation.defJa: ある目的や種類のふねであることを表すことば。
presentation.note: Read せん when it names a type of vessel (漁船, 客船, 貨物船), though some native compounds use ぶね (釣り船, 屋形船); ships themselves are counted with 隻 (large ships) or 艘 (small boats).

presentation.meaning: counter for games, matches; battle, contest (e.g. final match)
presentation.defJa: 試合や勝負の回数をかぞえることば。また、ある種類の試合や争いを表す。
presentation.note: Counts games or bouts in a series (残り三戦) and, as a suffix, names a kind of contest, from sports (決勝戦) to politics (選挙戦).

presentation.defJa: 川や道などから、はなれずにそって続いているところ。
presentation.note: Attached to a river, road or coast it is pronounced ぞい (川沿い, 線路沿い) and forms a noun for the strip of land itself, unlike the verb phrase ～に沿って.

presentation.defJa: 小さなふねの数をかぞえることば。
presentation.note: A rather literary counter for small boats such as rowboats and fishing boats, whereas large ships are counted with 隻 (せき), especially in news writing.

presentation.meaning: counter for pairs of footwear (shoes, socks)
presentation.defJa: 靴や靴下など、二つで一組のはき物を数える言葉。
presentation.note: Used for shoes and socks, with sound changes in 一足 (issoku) and 三足 (sanzoku), and the idiom 二足のわらじを履く means to hold two jobs at once.

presentation.meaning: group, party, corps (a body of people organized for a purpose)
presentation.defJa: 同じ目的のために集まった人々のまとまり。
presentation.note: Names an organized body such as 調査団 (research team), 選手団 (team delegation) or 劇団 (theater troupe), and sounds more formal and structured than グループ.

presentation.meaning: counter for suits, dresses and other clothing; finishing place in a race
presentation.defJa: 服を数える言葉。また、競走での順位を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Counts garments such as suits and coats, while in races 一着 means first place and after a place name it marks arrival, as in 東京駅着.
collocations: スーツを二着そろえる

presentation.defJa: 国や地方の行政の仕事をする役所。
presentation.note: Names national agencies that usually sit under a ministry (省), such as 気象庁 and 文化庁, and also appears in 県庁 and 都庁 for prefectural government offices.

presentation.defJa: 億の一万倍にあたる数。
presentation.note: Japanese groups large numbers by four digits, so 一兆 is ten thousand 億 (one trillion), a unit that appears constantly in budgets and market sizes.

presentation.meaning: head, chief (of an organization or group)
presentation.defJa: 組織やグループをまとめる立場の人。
presentation.note: Attaches to a unit or organization to name its head (社長, 部長, 校長, 市長, 船長), and such titles are often used in speech in place of the person's name.

presentation.meaning: book or notebook for recording things, register
presentation.defJa: 記録するために紙をとじたもの。ノート。
presentation.note: Forms words for books used to keep records, such as 手帳 (planner), 通帳 (bankbook) and 電話帳 (phone book), while ノート is the everyday word for a school notebook.
collocations: 手帳に予定を書き込む

presentation.meaning: chome, a numbered block or district of a town (in addresses)
presentation.defJa: 町をいくつかに分けた区画を表す、住所で使う言葉。
presentation.note: Comes after a district name and before the block number in an address, and the political idiom 一丁目一番地 means a top-priority issue.

presentation.meaning: counter for letters, emails and documents
presentation.defJa: 手紙やメール、書類などを数える言葉。
presentation.note: Counts letters, emails and copies of documents, with 一通 read いっつう, and is distinct from 枚, which counts the sheets of paper themselves.

presentation.meaning: use of ~, way of using ~ (as in 'choice of words' or 'spending habits')
presentation.defJa: ものの使い方や扱い方。
presentation.note: Lives in fixed compounds such as 言葉遣い (wording), 金遣い (spending habits), 無駄遣い (waste) and 気遣い (thoughtfulness), and is often written in kana as づかい.
collocations: 言葉遣いに気をつける

presentation.meaning: with ~, including ~, comes with ~ (as in 'breakfast included')
presentation.defJa: そのものがついていること、添えられていることを表す。
presentation.note: Attaches to nouns to mean 'comes with', common in ads and official language (朝食付き, 条件付き, 期限付き), and is normally written with okurigana as 付き.

presentation.meaning: to keep on happening, continue ~ing (after a verb stem)
presentation.defJa: 動詞のあとについて、その動きがやまずにずっと起こることを表す。
presentation.note: The intransitive partner of ～続ける, used for things that keep happening on their own (降り続く, 鳴り続く), while ～続ける is the productive form for deliberate actions (話し続ける).

presentation.meaning: hard to ~, awkward to ~ (after a verb stem)
presentation.defJa: 動詞のあとについて、そうするのが難しい、気が進まないという意味を表す。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana as づらい, and compared with ～にくい it stresses the doer's discomfort or reluctance, so 言いづらい is emotional while 燃えにくい is an objective property.

presentation.defJa: 液体のしずくを数える言葉。
presentation.note: Counts drops of liquid, and 一滴も～ない is a common emphatic negative (酒は一滴も飲まない), while the native word for a single drop is しずく.

presentation.meaning: point, score (counter for points); also a counter for items
presentation.defJa: 試合や試験の得点を数える言葉。
presentation.note: Counts points in games and tests, and in formal or business language it also counts items, as in 商品三点 or 作品十点.

presentation.meaning: counter for large animals (cattle, horses, elephants)
presentation.defJa: 牛や馬など、大きな動物を数える言葉。
presentation.note: Used for large animals such as cattle, horses and whales, while 匹 covers small ones like cats and fish, with medium-size dogs falling in a gray zone.

presentation.meaning: class, grade, prize rank (as in 'first prize')
presentation.defJa: 順位や階級の上下を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Ranks prizes and grades (一等, 二等), whereas the same character after a list in formal writing means 'etc.' and is read など in casual text.

presentation.meaning: island (in Sino-Japanese compounds, as in 'remote island' or 'archipelago')
presentation.defJa: まわりを海に囲まれた陸地。
presentation.note: Read とう in Sino compounds such as 離島, 無人島, 列島 and 半島, while the names of individual islands usually use the native reading しま or じま.

presentation.meaning: the way of ~, art or discipline (calligraphy, judo); kind of road
presentation.defJa: 芸や武術で身につけるべき方法や教え。また、車や人が通るところ。
presentation.note: Names traditional arts and martial disciplines as a lifelong path (書道, 柔道, 剣道, and 茶道 read さどう), and also kinds of road (国道, 歩道, 車道).

presentation.meaning: just as ~, in the way that ~, in accordance with ~
presentation.defJa: 前に言ったことや考えたことと同じように、という意味。
presentation.note: After a verb or の it is read とおり (思った通り, 説明の通り), but attached directly to a noun it becomes どおり (予定通り, 計画通り), and official documents and news style often write it in kana (次のとおり).

presentation.defJa: ある範囲や場所のなかであること。
presentation.note: The suffix reading ない appears in 社内, 国内, 車内 and 期限内, whereas the standalone word 内 is usually read うち, as in 心の内.

presentation.meaning: student in year ~ (first-year student, sixth-grader, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 学校で何番目の学年かを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Counts school years at every level (小学一年生, 大学四年生), while 学年 is the noun for 'school year' itself and some universities in western Japan say 回生 instead.

presentation.defJa: 宿に何晩とまるかを数える言葉。
presentation.note: Counts nights away, with sound changes in 一泊 (ippaku) and 三泊 (sanpaku), and trip lengths are given as nights plus days, as in 二泊三日.

presentation.defJa: 弾や花火など、うち出すものを数える言葉。
presentation.note: Counts anything fired or launched, while after a place name the same suffix means 'departing from' (東京発) and casual 一発で means 'in one go'.
collocations: 花火を一万発打ち上げる

presentation.defJa: 順番で、いくつ目にあたるかを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Turns a number into an ordinal, with 二番目に大きい the standard way to say 'second largest', while the prefix 第 (第二) is the more formal equivalent.

presentation.defJa: あることのためにかかるお金。
presentation.note: Names a category of spending (交通費, 食費, 医療費, 人件費) and is more formal than ～代, which is used for everyday charges like 電気代 or タクシー代.

presentation.defJa: ある種類の、体や心の不調を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Builds names of illnesses (糖尿病, 心臓病, 生活習慣病), while ～症 is a similar suffix used more for conditions and syndromes, as in 熱中症 or 花粉症.

presentation.meaning: part, area, section (of a region or whole)
presentation.defJa: 全体の中の、ある区切られたところ。
presentation.note: Marks a region or portion of something (都市部, 北部, 中心部, 上部), and in organizations it names a department or club (営業部, 野球部).

presentation.meaning: ~ style, in the manner of ~ (as in 'Western-style')
presentation.defJa: そのような様子や、やり方であること。
presentation.note: Attaches to nouns to mean 'in the style of' (和風, 洋風, 中華風, 昭和風), describing a look or flavor rather than an essential quality.

presentation.meaning: for the first time in ~ (after an interval of ~)
presentation.defJa: 前に同じことがあってから、それだけの時間がたったことを表す。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana as ぶり after a time span (五年ぶり, 久しぶり), and after a noun or verb stem the same suffix can mean 'manner', as in 話しぶり or 仕事ぶり.

presentation.defJa: 同じことをくり返す回数を数える言葉。
presentation.note: After some numbers it is read べん or ぺん (何遍 なんべん, 一遍 いっぺん). Slightly old-fashioned and spoken compared with 回, it survives mainly in 何遍も and in the set word 一遍 (once; all at one go).

presentation.defJa: ある地方で話されている言葉やなまりを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Attached to place names for regional speech (関西弁, 博多弁), it is more casual than 方言, the neutral linguistic term.

presentation.defJa: 足を前に出して進む回数を数える言葉。
presentation.note: The reading shifts to ぽ after some numbers (一歩 いっぽ, 三歩 さんぽ, 一万歩 いちまんぽ), and 一歩 is also widely used figuratively for a first step or small advance.

presentation.meaning: intended for, aimed at (a group or market)
presentation.defJa: ある人や目的に合わせて作られていることを表す言葉。
presentation.note: 向け marks the intended audience or destination (子ども向け, designed for children), whereas 向き means naturally suited to (子ども向き), even if not designed for it.

presentation.defJa: 人数を数えるときの、改まった言い方。
presentation.note: More formal than 人, it is the standard counter in notices, business writing and news (定員30名, 若干名募集).

presentation.meaning: counter for questions or problems (on a test or quiz)
presentation.defJa: 試験やクイズで、答えを求められる項目の数を数える言葉。
presentation.note: Used only for questions and exam problems, as in 全20問 or 一問一答, and 大問 names a major numbered section that contains smaller sub-questions.

presentation.meaning: counter for nights (also for nightly episodes)
presentation.defJa: 晩の数を数える言葉。番組や物語の回を数えることもある。
presentation.note: Counts nights as spans of time or nightly episodes (三夜連続, 一夜にして), while hotel stays are counted with 泊 (二泊三日).

presentation.meaning: style, way (of a person, country or school)
presentation.defJa: その人や国、グループに特有のやり方を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Attached to people, countries or schools (アメリカ流, 自分流), it names a characteristic way of doing things; 自己流 and 我流 often imply an untrained, self-taught method.

presentation.meaning: fee, charge (for a service or use)
presentation.defJa: 何かを利用したときに払うお金を表す言葉。
presentation.note: 料 is a fee for a service or for using something (入場料, 使用料), whereas 代 tends to be the price paid for goods or a bill (電気代, 食事代) and 賃 a payment for labor, transport or rent (賃金, 運賃, 家賃).

presentation.defJa: ある国が治めている土地であることを表す言葉。
presentation.note: As a suffix it marks a possession of a state (英領, フランス領, 仏領 ふつりょう), mostly in historical or geographical writing; related nouns are 領土 (territory) and 領地 (domain).
collocations: フランス領ポリネシア

presentation.defJa: ある働きをする強さや、その才能を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Read りょく in most compounds (想像力, 説得力) but りき in a few (馬力, 自力, 他力), so each word's reading has to be learned.

presentation.defJa: ある物事についての考え方や主張のまとまりを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Attached to a topic it names a body of argument or a stance (進化論, 文化論), and 精神論 is usually critical, meaning reliance on willpower instead of method.

presentation.defJa: 鳥やうさぎを数えるときに使う言葉。
presentation.note: After some numbers it often becomes ば or ぱ (三羽 さんば, 六羽 ろっぱ, 千羽 せんば, as in 千羽鶴 せんばづる), and its use for rabbits is traditional; today rabbits are usually counted with 匹.

presentation.defJa: うちわなどを動かして風を起こす。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana (あおぐ) in newspapers; it means moving a fan to make a breeze, while the similar-sounding 煽る (あおる) means to fan flames or stir people up.

presentation.meaning: pale, pallid (of a face or light)
presentation.defJa: 血の気がなく、白っぽく見える様子。
presentation.note: Describes a sickly bluish-white pallor or a cold light; 顔色が悪い is the everyday way to say someone looks unwell, while 青ざめる means turning pale from fear or shock.

presentation.meaning: to be appalled, to be dumbfounded (with disgust or disbelief)
presentation.defJa: あまりにひどくて、言葉が出ないほど驚く。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana in print; it mixes surprise with disapproval, unlike plain 驚く, and 呆れて物も言えない is the stock phrase.

presentation.meaning: strictly, merely (stressing a limit); persistently, to the last
presentation.defJa: ほかではなく、ただそれだけだと強調する様子。また、最後までやり通す様子。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana; in modern prose it most often limits a claim (あくまで参考です), while the older sense of 'persistently, to the end' survives in phrases like あくまで戦う.

presentation.meaning: the next, the following (day, morning, year)
presentation.defJa: その次の、という意味で、日や年の前につける言葉。
presentation.note: A slightly literary word used in narratives before 日, 朝 or 年; in conversation 次の日 or 翌日 is more common.

presentation.defJa: 夜が終わって、空が明るくなり始めるころ。
presentation.note: The ordinary word for the time around daybreak, while 夜明け focuses on the moment night ends and 早朝 is the more formal 'early morning'.

presentation.defJa: 朝、起きるはずの時間を過ぎても寝てしまうこと。また、そういう人。
presentation.note: An everyday word for sleeping in, often by accident; 寝坊 alone means the same, and 寝過ごす stresses missing something because you overslept.

presentation.defJa: 歩いたあとに地面などに残る足の形。
presentation.note: Read あしあと for literal footprints and for traces someone leaves; the reading そくせき is used in formal writing for a person's achievements or career path.

presentation.meaning: one's step, the ground at one's feet
presentation.defJa: 立っている足のあたりや、歩くところ。
presentation.note: Common in warnings like 足元にご注意ください; 足元が悪い means poor footing (as in bad weather), and 足元を見る means to exploit someone's weak position.

presentation.defJa: 遠慮をせず、自分の都合ばかりを押しつける様子。
presentation.note: Criticizes someone who imposes without shame; 図々しい is a close, slightly more colloquial synonym, and 厚かましいお願いですが is a humble formula for one's own request.

presentation.defJa: 手紙や荷物を送る相手の名前や住所。
presentation.note: The recipient's name as written on mail or receipts (領収書の宛名), whereas 住所 is only the address and 宛先 is the destination as a whole.

presentation.meaning: to apply (to), to fit, to hold true (for)
presentation.defJa: ある条件や説明に、ちょうど合う。
presentation.note: Intransitive: a case fits a rule or description (条件に当てはまる); its transitive partner 当てはめる means actively applying a rule to a case.
collocations: 当てはまる項目に丸をつける

presentation.meaning: to apply (a rule or model to a case), to fit
presentation.defJa: 決まりや考え方を、ある物事に合わせて使う。
presentation.note: The transitive partner of 当てはまる, used when actively fitting a rule, formula or framework to something; 適用する is the more formal, legal equivalent.

presentation.meaning: storm shutter (sliding shutter outside a window)
presentation.defJa: 風や雨を防ぐためや、防犯のために窓の外側に付ける戸。
presentation.note: A traditional fitting of Japanese houses closed at night or in storms; newer homes often have シャッター instead, but 雨戸を閉める is still the everyday phrase.

presentation.defJa: 子どもなどを必要以上に大事にして、好きなようにさせる。
presentation.note: Usually critical, describing indulgence that weakens discipline; 自分を甘やかす is common for going easy on oneself, while 可愛がる is the neutral, positive word for doting on someone.

presentation.defJa: 毛糸などを針で組み合わせて、布や服を作ること。また、作ったもの。
presentation.note: Covers knitting and crochet as an activity or the items produced; 手芸 is the broader word for handicrafts including sewing and embroidery.

presentation.meaning: to knit; to compile (a book or anthology)
presentation.defJa: 糸などを交互に組み合わせて、布や服を作る。また、文章を集めて本にまとめる。
presentation.note: Means to knit, braid or crochet by interlacing strands, and in written Japanese also to compile a collection (歌集を編む), which is why 編集 shares the kanji.

presentation.meaning: rough, violent (of waves, wind or manner); harsh
presentation.defJa: 勢いが激しく、おだやかでない様子。乱暴な様子。
presentation.note: 荒い describes something violent or harsh in force or manner (waves, breathing, temper, spending), whereas the homophone 粗い means coarse or lacking fineness in texture or detail.

presentation.defJa: 粒や網の目が大きく、細かくない様子。おおざっぱな様子。
presentation.note: 粗い means coarse-grained or lacking fineness (a mesh, grain, image or estimate), unlike the homophone 荒い, which describes violence or harshness.

presentation.defJa: 物語などの、だいたいの内容や流れ。
presentation.note: 粗筋 is almost always written in kana as あらすじ and refers to the plot outline of a story; for the outline of a plan or report, 概要 is more usual.

presentation.defJa: もう一度、新しい気持ちで。また、別の機会にもう一度。
presentation.note: 改めて means 'anew' with a sense of renewed awareness, or 'at a later time' in polite phrases like 改めて伺います, and is more formal than もう一度.
collocations: 改めて言うまでもない

presentation.defJa: 人の親切や物事がうれしく、感謝したい気持ちだ。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana as ありがたい, it says something is welcome or that one feels grateful, and the compound ありがた迷惑 means a favor that is actually unwelcome.

presentation.meaning: to become rough or chapped (skin); to be stormy (weather, sea)
presentation.defJa: おだやかな状態がくずれて乱れる。肌がかさかさになる。
presentation.note: 荒れる covers anything that loses its calm or smooth state: stormy weather and seas, chapped skin, neglected land, or a meeting or match that turns unruly.

presentation.meaning: to bring up, to suggest; to start saying
presentation.defJa: 話を始める。ある考えや希望を初めて口にする。
presentation.note: 言い出す stresses being the first to raise an idea or request, often one that is hard to bring up, while 提案する is the neutral formal word for proposing.
collocations: 言い出したら聞かない

presentation.meaning: to order, to instruct (someone to do something); to tell on
presentation.defJa: 目下の人に用事などをするよう命じる。人の悪い行いを目上の人に知らせる。
presentation.note: Usually written 言いつける, it means to give someone an order from above, and in children's speech it means to tattle (先生に言いつけるよ); the noun 言いつけ means an instruction.

presentation.defJa: 数がはっきりしないこと、また数が多いことを表す。「何回も」「多くの」などの意味になる。
presentation.note: 幾～ is a literary prefix meaning 'how many' or 'many' that survives mainly in set words such as 幾度 (いくど), 幾重 (いくえ), 幾多 (いくた) and 幾日 (いくにち).

presentation.defJa: 小さな子どもを育てること。
presentation.note: 育児 is the standard term in news and policy for parents' care of young children (育児休業 = parental leave), while 子育て is the warmer everyday word for raising children.

presentation.defJa: 少し。いくらか。
presentation.note: 幾分 is a slightly formal 'somewhat, to some degree', common in news and weather reports, where everyday speech would use 少し or ちょっと.

presentation.defJa: 草花や木の枝を器に挿して、美しく見せる日本の伝統的な芸術。
presentation.note: 生け花 (also written いけばな) is the Japanese art of flower arrangement, organized into schools (流派); 華道 is the more formal name for it as a discipline.

presentation.meaning: after (that time), since then; from now on
presentation.defJa: ある時から後。また、今から後。
presentation.note: 以後 means 'from that point on' and also 'from now on' (以後気をつけます), while 以降 is preferred for schedules and dates (十日以降) and is less usual in apologies.

presentation.meaning: on and after, from (a point in time) onward
presentation.defJa: その時を含めて、それより後。
presentation.note: 以降 means 'on and after' a point in time, including that point, and is standard in notices and schedules; 以後 overlaps but also carries the sense 'from now on'.

presentation.defJa: 恐れずに立ち向かっていく様子で、力強い。
presentation.note: 勇ましい describes bold, spirited bravery seen in action or bearing (it also fits stirring music), and can sound ironic when applied to big talk; 勇敢な is the more neutral written word for brave.

presentation.meaning: clothing, food and shelter; the necessities of life
presentation.defJa: 着るもの、食べるもの、住む所。生活の基本となるもの。
presentation.note: 衣食住 is a fixed compound for the basic necessities of life, used in discussions of living standards, welfare and disaster relief; note the Japanese order is clothing, food, then housing.

presentation.meaning: more or less, for now (though not perfectly); just in case
presentation.defJa: 十分ではないが、ひととおり。また、念のため。
presentation.note: 一応 signals that something is done to a basic or provisional degree, or as a precaution, and often sounds modest or hedging (一応できました = it's done, more or less).

presentation.defJa: 前よりもさらに。いっそう。
presentation.note: 一段と means 'markedly more than before' and is common in news and weather reports (冷え込みが一段と厳しくなる); it is more formal than もっと and close to いっそう.

presentation.defJa: その分野で最も優れた地位や腕前であること。
presentation.note: 一流 means top-class in skill or standing and is usually followed by の or used in compounds (一流の選手, 一流ホテル); 二流 and 三流 mark the lower tiers.

presentation.defJa: 去年の前の年。
presentation.note: 一昨年 has two readings: いっさくねん in formal speech, business and official statements, and おととし in everyday conversation (broadcast news also often says おととし).

presentation.meaning: simultaneous; all at once, in unison
presentation.defJa: 多くのものが、同時にそろって何かをすること。
presentation.note: 一斉 is mostly used as 一斉に ('all at once, in unison') or in compounds like 一斉休校 and 一斉送信, stressing that many people or things act at the same moment.

presentation.meaning: for a moment, for now; once (something happens)
presentation.defJa: ひとまず。少しの間。「一度…したら」の意味でも使う。
presentation.note: 一旦 means 'for now, temporarily' (一旦休憩する) or 'once' in conditional clauses (一旦始めたらやめられない); newspapers often write it in kana as いったん.

presentation.defJa: 決まっていて変わらないこと。また、ある程度の。
presentation.note: 一定 means 'fixed, unchanging' (一定の速度) and also 'a certain, reasonable amount of' (一定の評価を得る), a hedging use very common in official and news language.

presentation.defJa: 地面を深く掘って、地下の水をくみ上げられるようにした所。
presentation.note: 井戸 is an ordinary well for drawing water, and survives in the idiom 井戸端会議 ('well-side meeting'), meaning neighborhood gossip.

presentation.defJa: 地球上の位置を、赤道から南北にどれだけ離れているかで表した角度。
presentation.note: 緯度 is latitude (north-south position), paired with 経度 (けいど, longitude); 高緯度 refers to regions near the poles.

presentation.meaning: to dislike, to be reluctant (to do), to show aversion
presentation.defJa: いやだと思う気持ちを、態度や言葉に表す。
presentation.note: 嫌がる describes someone's visible dislike or reluctance and is usually used of others rather than oneself, whereas 嫌だ states the speaker's own feeling; the noun 嫌がらせ means harassment.
collocations: 人の嫌がることをする

presentation.meaning: to roast (coffee beans, tea leaves, etc.) in a dry pan
presentation.defJa: 油を使わずに鍋などで熱し、水分を飛ばして香ばしくする。
presentation.note: 煎る means to roast food such as beans, sesame or tea leaves in a dry pan, and is interchangeable with 炒る; do not confuse it with 炒める, which is stir-frying with oil.

presentation.defJa: 鍋で火にかけ、かき混ぜながら乾かすように熱する。
presentation.note: 炒る is the same word as 煎る (dry-roasting in a pan) and is the spelling usually seen with beans and sesame (炒り豆, 炒りごま), while 煎る is more common with coffee and tea.

presentation.defJa: 物を入れておくためのもの。箱やびん、袋など。
presentation.note: 入れ物 is the everyday word for any container or case, while 容器 is the more technical or formal term seen on labels and in regulations.

presentation.meaning: garden or potted trees and shrubs
presentation.defJa: 庭や鉢に植えて育てる木。
presentation.note: 植木 means trees or shrubs grown in a garden or pot for ornament, whereas 木 is the generic word for any tree; 植木鉢 is a flowerpot and 植木屋 a gardener.

presentation.meaning: to starve, go hungry; to crave (affection, knowledge, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 食べ物が足りず、ひどくおなかがすいて苦しむ。また、何かを強くほしがる。
presentation.note: Literally to go without food, but just as common figuratively with に for craving something like affection or knowledge (愛情に飢える); the noun 飢え and the formal 飢餓 appear in news about famine.

presentation.meaning: to float; to come to mind
presentation.defJa: 水面や空中に、沈んだり落ちたりせずにとどまる。また、考えや姿が心に現れる。
presentation.note: 浮ぶ is a shortened okurigana that the official spelling rules still permit, but the word is normally written 浮かぶ today; besides floating, it very often means an idea or image coming to mind (いい案が浮かぶ).

presentation.meaning: to show (an expression, tears, a smile); to float (something)
presentation.defJa: 表情や涙を顔に出す。また、物を水の上に浮くようにする。
presentation.note: The transitive partner of 浮かぶ; in modern writing it is used far more for showing an expression on one's face (笑みを浮かべる) or picturing something in the mind (思い浮かべる) than for literally floating objects.

presentation.meaning: (humble) to receive (an order or request); to hear
presentation.defJa: 「受ける」「聞く」「引き受ける」を、へりくだって言う言葉。
presentation.note: A humble verb used by staff toward customers, typical of shop notices, phone calls and hotel service (ご注文を承りました), where plain 受ける or 聞く would sound too casual.

presentation.meaning: receipt (of goods), pickup; a receipt slip
presentation.defJa: 届いた荷物やお金を自分の手におさめること。また、それを受けた証拠として相手に渡す書類。
presentation.note: The okurigana-less spelling 受取 is standard in compounds and on forms and signs (受取人, 店頭受取), while running text more often writes 受け取り.

presentation.meaning: to be in charge of (a class, area, task)
presentation.defJa: 仕事や役目を、自分の分として引き受けて担当する。
presentation.note: Close to 担当する but softer and more everyday, used especially for teachers taking a class or staff covering an area; the noun 受け持ち means one's charge or assigned area.

presentation.defJa: 光が少なくて、少し暗い。
presentation.note: Describes a place that is not fully dark but poorly lit, often with a gloomy or atmospheric feel; ほの暗い is a softer, more literary near-synonym.

presentation.meaning: to dilute, water down; to weaken
presentation.defJa: 水などを加えて、味や色の濃さを弱くする。
presentation.note: The general verb for diluting a liquid or weakening a flavor or color (原液を水で薄める); its intransitive partner is 薄まる, while fading memories or interest take 薄れる.

presentation.meaning: meeting to arrange details; preliminary discussion
presentation.defJa: 物事を進める前に、関係する人たちが前もって相談して決めておくこと。
presentation.note: A working session to coordinate details, smaller and more practical than a formal 会議; 打合せ is the compact spelling seen in business documents and schedules, while 打ち合わせ is usual in general writing.

presentation.meaning: to deny (a rumor or report); to cancel out
presentation.defJa: 言われていることを、そうではないとはっきり言う。また、ある効果を消す。
presentation.note: A native-Japanese verb close to 否定する: it is used for denying a rumor or report (うわさを打ち消す) and for one thing canceling out another, as in noise canceling (騒音を打ち消す); in grammar, 打ち消し means negation.

presentation.defJa: 相手を目上の人として大切にし、尊いものとして扱う。
presentation.note: Expresses deep, almost reverent respect for elders, ancestors or the divine, and sounds more formal and heartfelt than 尊敬する, the everyday word for admiring someone.

presentation.meaning: to turn over, flip; to turn inside out
presentation.defJa: 表と裏が逆になるように、ひっくり返す。
presentation.note: Covers both flipping something flat face-down or upside down and turning clothing inside out; ひっくり返す is the more casual word and can also mean knocking something over.

presentation.meaning: back door, rear entrance; (fig.) improper means, as in 'backdoor admission'
presentation.defJa: 建物の後ろや横にある出入り口。また、正規の手続きを通さない、ずるいやり方。
presentation.note: Literally the back or service entrance of a building; figuratively it implies getting in by improper means, most famously in 裏口入学 (buying one's way into a school).

presentation.meaning: to tell fortunes, divine; to forecast (an outcome)
presentation.defJa: いろいろな方法で、これから先のことや運勢を予想する。
presentation.note: Means fortune-telling in the literal sense, but in news writing it is very common figuratively for gauging an outcome, as in 今後の景気を占う (to read where the economy is heading).

presentation.defJa: ひどいことをされた相手を、いつまでも憎く思う気持ち。
presentation.note: A lingering, personal grudge against someone who wronged you, deeper and longer-lasting than 怒り; 恨みを買う means to make someone resent you.

presentation.meaning: to resent, bear a grudge against
presentation.defJa: ひどいことをした相手を、いつまでも憎く思う。
presentation.note: To hold a lasting grudge against someone or something; unlike 憎む (to hate), it implies you feel wronged, and it is often aimed at fate or circumstances as well (運命を恨む).

presentation.defJa: ほかの人が自分より恵まれているのを見て、自分もそうなりたいと思う。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary verb: in conversation people usually say うらやましい, while 羨む appears in writing and fixed phrases like 誰もが羨む (that everyone envies); unlike 妬む, it need not carry ill will.

presentation.defJa: 品物やサービスを売って得たお金の合計。
presentation.note: The compact spelling 売上 is standard in accounting, corporate reports and compounds such as 売上高 (net sales), while 売り上げ is common in ordinary prose; the meaning is the same.

presentation.defJa: 物を売って入ったお金。また、売れた量。
presentation.note: The money taken in from selling, not profit (利益); this okurigana spelling is the usual one in general writing, while 売上 dominates in business documents.

presentation.defJa: 品物が全部売れて、もう残っていないこと。
presentation.note: The noun form, often seen on signs and websites (本日売り切れ) and used with になる or となる; 品切れ is close but can simply mean out of stock, not necessarily because everything sold.

presentation.meaning: to be sold out, sell out
presentation.defJa: 品物が全部売れて、なくなる。
presentation.note: The intransitive verb for goods running out because they all sold; its transitive counterpart 売り切る means the seller sells everything off.
collocations: あっという間に売り切れる
チケットが売り切れる

presentation.defJa: 品物がどのくらい売れているかという様子。
presentation.note: 売行き is a shortened spelling seen mainly in business and official writing; newspapers and general text write the same word as 売れ行き, and it describes how well a product is selling rather than the amount earned.

presentation.defJa: 品物が売れていく具合。
presentation.note: Focuses on the pace or trend of selling, so it pairs with words like 好調, 不振 or 伸び悩む, whereas 売り上げ is the money actually taken in.

presentation.meaning: upper, outer, surface; over, exceeding (prefix in words for 'to exceed', 'jacket', 'overwrite')
presentation.defJa: 言葉の前について、高い位置にあること、表面や外側であること、数や程度をこえることを表す。
presentation.note: The うわ reading of 上 appears only as a prefix in fixed words such as 上回る, 上着, 上履き and 上書き, while the standalone noun is read うえ; it adds a sense of outer, surface or exceeding.
collocations: ファイルを上書きする

presentation.defJa: 船を通すために、人の手で掘った水路。
presentation.note: An artificial waterway dug for ships, as opposed to a natural 川; 水路 is the broader, plainer word for any channel.

presentation.defJa: 英語で書かれた文章。
presentation.note: Means text or sentences written in English, usually in the context of reading, translation or documents (英文契約書); 英語 refers to the language itself.

presentation.defJa: 英語の言葉の意味を日本語で説明する形式。主に辞書について言う。
presentation.note: Appears mostly in compounds about dictionaries and translation (英和辞典 goes from English to Japanese), and is the mirror image of 和英, which goes from Japanese to English.

presentation.defJa: 水や油のように、決まった形がなく流れる状態のもの。
presentation.note: The standard term for a liquid in both science and everyday notices (such as airport rules on 液体物), contrasted with 固体 (solid) and 気体 (gas).

presentation.defJa: 絵に色をつけるために使う材料。水や油でといて使う。
presentation.note: The everyday word for artists' paints of any kind, from children's watercolors to oils; 塗料 is industrial paint for walls or cars, not for art.

presentation.defJa: 大勢が集まって、酒や料理を楽しみながら開く会。
presentation.note: A fairly formal word for an organized party with food and drink, such as company or hotel functions (宴会場 is a banquet hall); casual get-togethers are usually called 飲み会.

presentation.defJa: 草花や野菜、果樹などを育てること。また、その技術。
presentation.note: Covers both hobby gardening and commercial horticulture, whereas the loanword ガーデニング suggests ornamental home gardening.

presentation.defJa: 俳優が舞台の上で物語を演じ、観客に見せる芸術。
presentation.note: The general word for theater as an art form or activity; 芝居 is more colloquial and can also mean putting on an act.

presentation.defJa: 円のまわりをぐるりと囲む線。また、その長さ。
presentation.note: A strictly geometric term for circles; for the outer boundary of other shapes or areas, 周囲 or 外周 is used.

presentation.defJa: 学校などで、見学や運動のために日帰りで出かける行事。
presentation.note: Mainly a school day trip; an overnight school trip is 修学旅行, and a casual walk in the hills is ハイキング.

presentation.defJa: けむりを外へ出すために、建物の上に高く立てた筒。
presentation.note: Covers everything from a house chimney to a factory smokestack; technical texts may use 排気筒 for exhaust stacks.

presentation.defJa: 先を行くものに追いつこうとして、後ろから急いで進む。
presentation.note: Stresses the ongoing chase, while 追いつく means actually catching up; it is also used figuratively for pursuing dreams or trends.

presentation.meaning: to overtake, to pass (a vehicle or person); to surpass
presentation.defJa: 後ろから進んで、前にいるものより先に出る。
presentation.note: Means to pass and get ahead, whereas 追いつく only means drawing level; figuratively it is used for surpassing someone in height, sales or rank.

presentation.defJa: 国王の娘。
presentation.note: Specifically a king's daughter; 姫 is broader and more storybook, and Japan's imperial princesses are called 内親王 or 皇女 rather than 王女.

presentation.meaning: to respond to, to comply with (a request or demand)
presentation.defJa: 相手の求めや、その場の状況に合わせて行動する。
presentation.note: A more formal, written variant of 応じる with the same meaning, common in legal and official texts, while 応じる dominates in speech.

presentation.defJa: 訪ねてきた客を迎えて相手をすること。
presentation.note: Today it appears mostly in compounds such as 応接室 and 応接間; for the act of dealing with people in general, 応対 or 接客 is more usual.

presentation.meaning: dealing with (people), handling callers or customers
presentation.defJa: 人の話を聞いて、受け答えをすること。
presentation.note: Focuses on how one receives and answers a person face to face or on the phone; 対応 is broader and also covers responses to situations and problems.

presentation.meaning: round trip; going back and forth
presentation.defJa: 行って、また戻ってくること。
presentation.note: Used for round trips and also for back-and-forth exchanges such as letters; its opposite is 片道.

presentation.defJa: ヨーロッパとアメリカ。西洋の国々。
presentation.note: Often used loosely for 'the West' in contrast to Japan or Asia, much like 西洋 but more common in news about society and economics.

presentation.defJa: 知識や原理を、実際の場面に当てはめて使うこと。
presentation.note: Pairs with 基礎 as in 応用研究 (applied research); 適用 is closer to applying a rule or law to a specific case.

presentation.defJa: 町の中心を通る、幅が広くて人や車の多い道。
presentation.note: Stresses a wide road with heavy traffic, while 表通り stresses a front-facing street as opposed to 裏通り.

presentation.defJa: だいたい。細かい点を除いた、全体の大まかなところ。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana today; slightly more formal than だいたい, and also used as a noun as in おおよその数.

presentation.defJa: 外から家に戻ってきた人を迎えるときのあいさつ。
presentation.note: The casual form of お帰りなさい, said by the person at home in reply to ただいま; as a noun it also politely means someone's return, as in お帰りはいつですか.

presentation.meaning: to pray (with palms together), to worship
presentation.defJa: 手を合わせたり頭を下げたりして、神や仏に祈る。
presentation.note: Describes the physical act of praying with joined palms, while 祈る focuses on the wish itself; colloquially it can also mean to plead with someone, or to get a rare look at something, as in 初日の出を拝む.

presentation.defJa: 同じ食べ物や飲み物を、もう一杯もらうこと。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; used for refills of rice, soup or drinks, and can be said directly as a request, as in おかわりください.

presentation.defJa: 建物の外。家の外。
presentation.note: A slightly formal, written-style word and the opposite of 屋内; in casual speech people simply say 外.

presentation.meaning: okurigana (kana written after a kanji stem to show inflection or reading)
presentation.defJa: 漢字の読み方をはっきりさせるため、漢字の後ろにつけて書くかな。
presentation.note: The kana that follow a kanji stem, as distinct from 振り仮名, the small reading aids printed above or beside kanji.

presentation.meaning: take care, all the best (said when parting for a long time)
presentation.defJa: しばらく会えない人と別れるときに、相手の健康と幸せを願って言うあいさつ。
presentation.note: Used when parting for a long time or for good, so it sounds weightier than じゃあね or またね and can feel oddly final in everyday partings.
collocations: お元気でお過ごしください

presentation.meaning: to hold down, to pin down; to secure
presentation.defJa: 動かないように、手や物で上から力を加える。
presentation.note: Means to hold something in place and, by extension, to secure a booking or grasp key points; the homophone 抑える is used for restraining emotions, prices or the spread of something.

presentation.meaning: before you, ahead (as in leaving first or letting someone go first)
presentation.defJa: 自分がほかの人より前に何かをするときや、相手を前に行かせるときに使う言葉。
presentation.note: Mostly heard in set phrases: お先に失礼します when leaving work before colleagues, and お先にどうぞ when letting someone go first.

presentation.defJa: 父または母の兄。
presentation.note: Written 伯父 for a parent's older brother and 叔父 for a younger one, though both are pronounced おじ and usually called おじさん in speech.

presentation.defJa: 父または母の弟。
presentation.note: Pronounced exactly like 伯父, with 叔 marking a parent's younger brother; the distinction exists only in writing, mainly in formal documents and careful prose.

presentation.meaning: so close, regrettable (of a near miss); too good to lose
presentation.defJa: もう少しのところでうまくいかず、残念だ。また、大切で失いたくない。
presentation.note: Expresses regret over a near miss or reluctance to lose something valuable; 残念 is broader and does not imply that success was close.

presentation.meaning: uncle (familiar term for a parent's older brother)
presentation.defJa: 父または母の兄を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言い方。
presentation.note: The everyday, affectionate way to refer to or address a parent's older brother, while plain 伯父 sounds formal and is used when speaking of him to outsiders.

presentation.meaning: middle-aged man (familiar term for an unrelated man)
presentation.defJa: よその中年の男の人を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana today; used by children or casually for unrelated middle-aged men, and can sound unflattering when adults use it about others.

presentation.meaning: uncle (familiar term for a parent's younger brother)
presentation.defJa: 父または母の弟を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言い方。
presentation.note: The familiar form for a parent's younger brother; in casual writing all three spellings are often replaced by kana おじさん.

presentation.meaning: take care (of yourself); said to someone who is ill or injured
presentation.defJa: 病気やけがをした人に、早く良くなるよう願って言うあいさつ。
presentation.note: Said only to someone who is sick or injured (or to their family), never as a general goodbye; お大事になさってください is the more formal version.
collocations: お大事になさってください

presentation.meaning: to calm down, to settle down; (of a situation) to settle
presentation.defJa: 興奮や不安がおさまって、静かな状態になる。
presentation.note: Now normally written 落ち着く (the bare compound 落着 is read らくちゃく and means the settling of a matter, as in 一件落着); it covers both emotions calming and places or situations settling, whereas 静まる is more about noise or activity dying down.

presentation.defJa: 遊びや用事のために家から外へ行くこと。
presentation.note: A soft, friendly word for going out, often for pleasure, usually written お出かけ; the verb is 出かける, and 外出 is the neutral, more formal noun.

presentation.defJa: よその家に雇われて、料理や掃除などの家事をする人。
presentation.note: A polite, somewhat dated word that replaced the older 女中; today 家政婦 or 家事代行スタッフ is more usual.
collocations: 住み込みのお手伝いさん

presentation.defJa: うっかり落としたり置き忘れたりした持ち物。
presentation.note: Now usually written 落とし物; 忘れ物 is something left behind, and 遺失物 is the formal legal term.

presentation.defJa: 相手をびっくりさせる。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 驚く; 驚かせる is an equally common form with the same meaning, and both work for pleasant surprises as well as frights.

presentation.meaning: please (lit. "I request"); used when asking for something or entrusting a task
presentation.defJa: 相手に何かを頼むときに使う、ていねいな言葉。
presentation.note: Politer than ください because it frames the request as a favor; the humbler お願いいたします is standard in business emails.
collocations: よろしくお願いします

presentation.defJa: 一人一人、または一つ一つ。それぞれ。
presentation.note: A slightly literary equivalent of それぞれ, common in essays and formal speech; it can also stand alone for "each person" (各々が意見を述べる).

presentation.meaning: aunt (older sister of one's parent, or wife of a parent's older brother)
presentation.defJa: 父や母の姉。または、父や母の兄の妻。
presentation.note: Written 伯母 for a parent's older sister or older brother's wife, and 叔母 for a younger sister or younger brother's wife; both are read おば, and in conversation people usually just say おばさん.

presentation.meaning: aunt (younger sister of one's parent, or wife of a parent's younger brother)
presentation.defJa: 父や母の妹。または、父や母の弟の妻。
presentation.note: Same reading as 伯母 but marks a parent's younger sister or younger brother's wife; the distinction shows up only in writing, such as letters and family records.

presentation.meaning: lady, middle-aged woman (familiar term for a woman not related to oneself)
presentation.defJa: 親しみをこめて、よその中年の女性を呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; warm when children use it or for a familiar neighborhood figure, but calling an adult woman おばさん to her face can sound rude.

presentation.meaning: visit to a shrine, temple or grave to pray
presentation.defJa: 神社や寺、墓などに行って、神や仏、先祖を拝むこと。
presentation.note: The everyday word for going to pray at a shrine, temple or grave; 参拝 is the formal written equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 前もって考えてもいなかった様子だ。予想外だ。
presentation.note: Usually written 思いがけない; it suggests something happening out of the blue, often pleasantly, and sounds softer and more personal than 予想外.

presentation.meaning: with all one's might, to one's heart's content; (noun) decisiveness
presentation.defJa: 力や気持ちを全部出して、ためらわずに何かをする様子。
presentation.note: As an adverb it means doing something all-out and is often pronounced おもいっきり in speech; as a noun (思い切りがいい) it means decisiveness.

presentation.meaning: to be convinced (often wrongly), to assume; to set one's heart on
presentation.defJa: よく確かめずに、そうだと強く信じてしまう。
presentation.note: Implies a fixed, often mistaken belief that one does not question, unlike neutral 信じる; the noun 思い込み (preconception) is very common.

presentation.meaning: to one's heart's content, as hard as one can; really, a lot
presentation.defJa: 遠慮やためらいをすべて捨てて、力や気持ちを出し切る様子。
presentation.note: An emphatic, conversational form of 思い切り; this kanji spelling is less common than 思いっきり but means exactly the same.
collocations: 思いっ切り体を伸ばす

presentation.meaning: as hard as one can, to one's heart's content; (colloquial) totally
presentation.defJa: 力の限り、心ゆくまで何かをする様子。
presentation.note: The usual everyday spelling of this emphatic adverb; in casual speech it also means "totally" (思いっきり忘れてた), a use the plainer 思い切り rarely has in writing.

presentation.defJa: 持ったときにずっしりと重く感じる。気分が沈むような感じにもいう。
presentation.note: Close to 重い but more subjective and colloquial, stressing how heavy something feels to the person; common in figurative uses like a heavy atmosphere.

presentation.meaning: day off, holiday, absence; (as a greeting) good night
presentation.defJa: 仕事や学校に行かない日や、店が営業しない日。寝る前のあいさつとしても使う。
presentation.note: The polite form of 休み, used for one's own leave in business speech and for shop closures; the bedtime greeting is usually written in kana as おやすみなさい.

presentation.defJa: 手や足の指のうち、いちばん太い指。
presentation.note: Covers both the thumb and the big toe (足の親指); 親指を立てる is the thumbs-up gesture.

presentation.defJa: ガラスやビニールで囲み、中を暖かく保って植物を育てる建物。
presentation.note: Besides the literal building, it appears in 温室効果 (greenhouse effect) and in 温室育ち, a mildly critical term for someone sheltered from hardship.

presentation.defJa: 地下から湧き出る温かい水や、一定の成分条件を満たす水。また、その水を使った入浴施設や土地。
presentation.note: Usually means naturally heated water or the resort area built around it, though some cold mineral springs also qualify; 銭湯 is a public bath and may use ordinary heated water or hot-spring water.

presentation.defJa: 熱帯と寒帯の間にある、気候が穏やかな地域。
presentation.note: A geography and climate term paired with 熱帯 (tropics) and 寒帯 (polar zone); 温帯低気圧 (extratropical cyclone) is common in weather reports.

presentation.meaning: Messrs.; honorific added after the name of a company, department or organization in an address
presentation.defJa: 会社や団体に手紙を送るとき、宛名の後に付ける敬称。
presentation.note: Used only in writing and only for organizations; when a specific person is named, 様 replaces it entirely.
collocations: 御中と様を使い分ける

presentation.defJa: 大人の女性を指す、ふつうの言い方。
presentation.note: The neutral everyday word for a woman; 女性 is more formal or written, while 女 alone can sound blunt or rude.

presentation.defJa: 「よその国の」「内側ではない」という意味を表し、語の頭につく言葉。
presentation.note: Read がい in most Sino-Japanese compounds such as 外国, 外資 and 外来語 (but げ in a few, like 外科); in native words the same kanji is read そと or ほか.

presentation.meaning: opening (of a meeting, session or event)
presentation.defJa: 会議や式、大会などを始めること。
presentation.note: Used for formal gatherings such as assemblies, ceremonies and tournaments; its opposite is 閉会, while 開始 is the general word for starting anything.

presentation.meaning: meeting hall, assembly hall, public hall
presentation.defJa: 集会や催し物などのために使われる大きな建物。
presentation.note: Usually part of a building's name (市民会館, 県民会館); 会場 is the venue of a particular event, while 会館 is the building itself.

presentation.defJa: 駅で乗客の切符を調べること。また、その場所。
presentation.note: In everyday speech it mostly means the ticket gate itself (改札で待ち合わせる); 改札口 names the gate area more explicitly.

presentation.meaning: sea bathing, swimming in the sea
presentation.defJa: 夏などに海に入って、泳いだり遊んだりすること。
presentation.note: Refers to swimming and playing at the beach as leisure; 海水浴場 is the standard word for a public swimming beach.

presentation.defJa: 同じことが何度起きたか、または何度行ったかの数。
presentation.note: A neutral everyday word for a simple count of occurrences, whereas 頻度 stresses how often something happens over a period.

presentation.meaning: book of discount tickets, coupon tickets (for a set number of rides or uses)
presentation.defJa: 何回分かの乗車券などをまとめて、割安な値段で売る券。
presentation.note: Usually refers to discounted bundles of transport or facility tickets, unlike 定期券, a pass for unlimited rides on a route for a fixed period.

presentation.meaning: amendment, revision (of a law or rule)
presentation.defJa: 法律や規則などの内容を、よりよい形に改めること。
presentation.note: Used chiefly for formal changes to laws, rules and timetables; 改定 is usually preferred for prices and fees, and 修正 for correcting errors in a draft.

presentation.defJa: 空に雲がほとんどなく、よく晴れわたっていること。
presentation.note: Stronger than 晴れ and also a meteorological term for cloud cover of ten percent or less, so it is common in weather reports and travel writing.

presentation.meaning: opening (of a road, tunnel or line) to traffic
presentation.defJa: 道路や鉄道、トンネルなどが完成して、通れるようになること。
presentation.note: Used when roads, railways, tunnels or phone and internet lines become usable, while 開業 is used for a railway or business starting operation as a service.

presentation.defJa: ある点や軸を中心にして、ぐるぐる回ること。
presentation.note: Covers physical spinning as well as figurative uses such as 頭の回転 (quick thinking) and customer turnover (客の回転), whereas 旋回 is a wider circling movement, as of an aircraft.

presentation.meaning: answer, solution (to a problem or exam question)
presentation.defJa: 問題を解いて答えを出すこと。また、その答え。
presentation.note: Used for answers to problems, quizzes and exams that have a correct solution, whereas the homophone 回答 is a reply to a question, survey or inquiry.

presentation.meaning: reply, response (to a question, survey or request)
presentation.defJa: 質問や問い合わせ、アンケートなどに対して答えること。また、その答え。
presentation.note: Used for replies to questions, surveys, requests and official inquiries, often in business or administrative contexts, in contrast to 解答, the solution to a problem with a right answer.
collocations: アンケートに回答する

presentation.defJa: ある組織や物の外側。また、そこに属さない人や物。
presentation.note: Often refers to people or bodies outside an organization (外部の人, 外部監査), while 外側 refers more to the physical outer side of an object.

presentation.defJa: 体や心をしばっていたものを取り除いて、自由にすること。
presentation.note: Means freeing from restraint or burden in both literal and emotional senses; do not confuse it with the homophones 開放 (opening a place to the public) and 介抱 (nursing someone).

presentation.defJa: 広々とした大きな海。また、地球上の海全体。
presentation.note: A formal, often technical word used in compounds about science, policy and resources (海洋学, 海洋国家), whereas everyday speech simply says 海.

presentation.defJa: ある学問や分野の全体について、大まかに述べたもの。
presentation.note: Typically the title of an introductory university course or textbook (心理学概論), more academic than 入門, which can be used for any beginner's guide.

presentation.meaning: on the contrary, instead; only (making things worse than expected)
presentation.defJa: 予想や期待とは反対の結果になるようす。むしろ。
presentation.note: Marks an outcome opposite to what was intended or expected and is normally written in kana; むしろ expresses a preference or comparison (rather) without that sense of backfiring.

presentation.defJa: 人が住むために建てられた建物。
presentation.note: A formal word for houses as physical structures, typical of news reports on disasters, taxes and real estate, while 家 or 住宅 is used in everyday talk.

presentation.meaning: to be involved with, to have to do with; to affect
presentation.defJa: 人や物事とつながりを持つ。また、影響が及ぶ。
presentation.note: Today usually written 関わる, with 係わる an older variant spelling; besides involvement with people or projects, it means 'to affect' in set phrases like 命に関わる (life-threatening).

presentation.defJa: 確実に届くように、受け付けから配達までを記録して扱う郵便。
presentation.note: Refers to Japan Post's tracked, signature-on-delivery service, with 簡易書留 as a cheaper variant; it differs from 速達, which is about speed rather than security.

presentation.meaning: dictation; writing out kanji from their readings
presentation.defJa: 読み方や読み上げられた言葉をもとに、それを文字で書くこと。
presentation.note: Normally written 書き取り with okurigana; in schools it usually means writing kanji from their given readings, while 聞き取り is listening comprehension.

presentation.meaning: limit; limited to, only (after a number); as long as, as far as
presentation.defJa: 数や範囲の終わり。それ以上はないという区切り。
presentation.note: After a noun or number it marks a strict limit (本日限り, 一日三十食限り), and after a verb it means 'as long as' or 'as far as' (私の知る限り).

presentation.defJa: 名詞の前について、それぞれの、一つ一つの、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A formal prefix attached to Sino-Japanese nouns (各国, 各社, 各紙) that gives a written, newsy tone compared with the native それぞれの.

presentation.defJa: 一人一人。めいめい。
presentation.note: Common in instructions and notices addressed to a group (各自で, 各自持参), slightly more formal than めいめい or それぞれ.

presentation.meaning: expansion and enhancement (of a service or system)
presentation.defJa: 設備や制度などの規模を広げ、中身もより豊かにすること。
presentation.note: Typical of policy and corporate writing for expanding and strengthening services or systems, whereas 拡大 is plain enlargement of size or scope without the sense of filling out content.

presentation.defJa: 専門的な研究によって積み上げられた学問や知識。
presentation.note: A formal word used mostly in compounds (学術誌, 学術会議) for scholarly research, while 学問 refers more broadly to learning or a field of study.

presentation.meaning: various places, every part (of a country or region)
presentation.defJa: あちこちの土地。いろいろな場所。
presentation.note: Means various places across a country or region and is frequent in news (各地で雨, 全国各地から), whereas 地方 refers to a particular region or to the provinces as opposed to the capital.

presentation.defJa: 範囲や規模、施設などを広げて大きくすること。
presentation.note: Used for physically or functionally extending something (roads, facilities, software features), whereas 拡充 adds the sense of enriching content and 拡大 is a general increase in size or scope.

presentation.defJa: 二つの線や面が交わってできる開きの大きさ。また、物を見る向き。
presentation.note: Used both for geometric angles and figuratively for viewpoints (さまざまな角度から検討する), while 観点 is the more abstract word for a point of view.

presentation.defJa: 学校で、入学した年によって分けた一年ごとの段階。
presentation.note: Refers to the year or grade level in school, whereas 学級 or クラス is a single homeroom group within that grade.

presentation.meaning: faculty or school (of a university); undergraduate level
presentation.defJa: 大学の中で、専門の分野ごとに分けた大きな組織。
presentation.note: Denotes a university faculty such as 経済学部, and by extension the undergraduate level as opposed to 大学院 (graduate school); 学科 is a smaller department within a faculty.

presentation.defJa: ある出来事が起こる見込みを、数で表したもの。
presentation.note: The standard word in both mathematics and daily talk for a numerical chance, whereas 可能性 is the vaguer, non-numerical word for possibility.

presentation.defJa: 勉強によって身につけた知識や能力。
presentation.note: Refers to measurable scholastic ability as assessed by tests and grades, often in education-policy debates, while 学問 is scholarship itself and 知識 is knowledge in general.

presentation.defJa: ある数を、別の数の回数だけ足し合わせる計算。
presentation.note: The everyday and school word for multiplication, often written かけ算 in textbooks, while 乗法 is the formal mathematical term.

presentation.defJa: 火山の頂上などにある、溶岩やガスが噴き出す穴。
presentation.note: Standard word in volcano news and hiking contexts; the same characters read ひぐち mean the point where a fire started.
collocations: 火口から噴煙が上がる

presentation.defJa: 高いところから低いほうへ下がっていくこと。また、数値や勢いが落ちていくこと。
presentation.note: Somewhat formal word for downward movement: literal (temperature, an aircraft) and, very often, figures and trends such as results, ratings or the economy; 下降の一途をたどる means 'to keep going downhill'. The opposite is 上昇.

presentation.defJa: 地下のマグマが地表に噴き出してできた山。
presentation.note: Everyday and scientific word; 活火山 (active volcano) and 火山灰 (volcanic ash) are frequent compounds in news.

presentation.meaning: lending, loan (e.g. of library books or equipment)
presentation.defJa: 品物やお金を、一定の期間だけ人に貸すこと。
presentation.note: Common on notices at libraries, rental counters and banks; often written 貸出 without okurigana in signs and compounds such as 貸出期間.

presentation.defJa: 不注意のために起こしてしまったあやまち。
presentation.note: Legal and formal word stressing carelessness rather than intent (contrast 故意); in everyday talk ミス or 落ち度 is more common.

presentation.meaning: fruit (as produce or in botany); fruits, results (figurative)
presentation.defJa: 植物の花が咲いたあとにできる実。
presentation.note: More formal or technical than 果物; used on labels (果実飲料), in agriculture and botany, and figuratively for the fruits of growth or effort, as in 成長の果実.

presentation.meaning: rented room (in a private house), room to let
presentation.defJa: 部屋代を取って人に貸す部屋。
presentation.note: Somewhat dated word evoking a room let in a private home; today アパート or 賃貸 is used for rental housing.

presentation.defJa: 家賃を取って人に貸す一戸建ての家。
presentation.note: Refers to a whole house let to tenants, as opposed to 貸間 (a single room) or an apartment; sometimes also read かしいえ.

presentation.defJa: 必要な量や程度よりも多すぎること。
presentation.note: Formal word for too much of something, frequent in health, economics and media criticism (過剰反応), and in compounds like 過剰在庫.

presentation.defJa: 国や自治体が、ものや収入に税をかけること。
presentation.note: Formal term from tax and policy news; 非課税 (tax-exempt) and 課税所得 (taxable income) are everyday compounds on forms and receipts.

presentation.defJa: 速さがだんだん増すこと。また、物事の進み方が速くなること。
presentation.note: Used literally for vehicles and physics and very often figuratively in news for trends gathering pace; the opposite is 減速.

presentation.defJa: 単位時間あたりに、速度がどれだけ変わるかを表す量。
presentation.note: Physics term for the rate of change of velocity; 加速度的に is used figuratively to mean 'at an ever-increasing rate'.

presentation.meaning: lump, chunk, block; (figurative) embodiment of a trait
presentation.defJa: ものが集まって、固く一つにまとまったもの。
presentation.note: Everyday word for a solid chunk, also often written in kana; figuratively 〜の塊 means someone is the very embodiment of a trait, as in 好奇心の塊.

presentation.meaning: to harden, to solidify; (of plans) to become settled
presentation.defJa: やわらかいものや液体が、かたくなる。
presentation.note: Intransitive partner of 固める; besides physical setting it often describes plans or resolve firming up (方針が固まる), and casually someone freezing up in shock.

presentation.defJa: 行きか帰りの、どちらか一方だけ。
presentation.note: Everyday travel word contrasted with 往復; 片道切符 is also used figuratively for a move with no way back.

presentation.meaning: to lean, to tilt; to lean toward (an opinion or choice)
presentation.defJa: ななめになる。また、考えや気持ちがある方向に寄っていく。
presentation.note: Covers physical tilting, the sun sinking (日が傾く), a business going downhill, and opinions leaning one way; 〜に傾く marks the direction of preference.

presentation.meaning: to shift to one side; to be lopsided or one-sided
presentation.defJa: 全体の中で、一方のほうにだけ寄ってしまう。
presentation.note: Mainly used for things physically bunching to one side; for bias in diet, opinion or distribution the spelling 偏る is now standard.

presentation.defJa: 大学などで、専門ごとに分けた勉強の区分。
presentation.note: At universities it names a department within a faculty (学部 > 学科); at driving schools 学科 means classroom subjects as opposed to practical skills.

presentation.defJa: 研究者が集まり、研究の成果を発表し合う団体や会合。
presentation.note: Means both a learned society (as in 日本物理学会) and its meetings; 学会発表 is the standard term for presenting at a conference.

presentation.defJa: 学校で、一緒に授業を受ける児童や生徒のまとまり。
presentation.note: Official term for a school class as a unit, as in 学級閉鎖 when flu closes a class; in conversation クラス is more common.

presentation.meaning: to carry on one's shoulder(s), to shoulder
presentation.defJa: 荷物などを肩にのせて運ぶ。
presentation.note: Literally shouldering a load; idioms extend it to 縁起を担ぐ (to be superstitious) and the passive 担がれる (to be tricked, or to be put forward as a leader).

presentation.defJa: 文字や語句を前と後ろからはさんで区切るための記号。
presentation.note: Umbrella term for brackets of every kind (丸括弧 round, かぎ括弧 corner quotes); often written in kana as かっこ in casual text.

presentation.defJa: 印刷に使う文字の型。また、印刷された文字や文章。
presentation.note: Originally movable type, it now mostly means print and reading matter, as in 活字離れ (the decline in reading) and 活字中毒 (a compulsive reader).

presentation.defJa: 生き生きと活動する力。
presentation.note: Somewhat formal word for vigor in people, organizations or regions; 元気 is the everyday equivalent, while 活力 is typical of policy and business language.

presentation.defJa: 漢字をもとに日本で作られた、音を表す文字。ひらがなとカタカナがある。
presentation.note: Umbrella term for hiragana and katakana, seen in compounds like 送り仮名 and 振り仮名; read かめい, the same characters mean a pseudonym.

presentation.defJa: ものに熱を加えて温度を上げること。
presentation.note: Neutral technical word on food labels and in recipes (要加熱 'cook before eating'); 過熱 (overheating) sounds the same but means something different.

presentation.defJa: 全体の半分より多い数。
presentation.note: Strictly means more than half, common in election and survey reports; 大多数 means 'the great majority', a much larger share.

presentation.meaning: to cover (something) with; to put (a hat etc.) on someone
presentation.defJa: ものの上から、ほかのものを覆うようにのせる。
presentation.note: Transitive counterpart of かぶる, usually written in kana; also used for pinning blame on someone else (罪をかぶせる) or talking over another speaker (声をかぶせる).

presentation.meaning: iron pot (for cooking rice or boiling water)
presentation.defJa: ご飯を炊いたり湯をわかしたりするのに使う、金属などでできた深くて大きななべ。
presentation.note: A kama is the deep, heavy pot for boiling rice or water (as in 釜飯 or the tea-ceremony kettle), heavier than an everyday 鍋; 同じ釜の飯を食う means to have lived or worked closely together.

presentation.defJa: それでも問題はない、気にしない、という意味のていねいな言い方。
presentation.note: The polite form of 構わない, used to give permission or say something is acceptable, typically after ～ても or ～て; a little more formal than 大丈夫です and common in service and office speech.
collocations: どちらでも構いません

presentation.defJa: いらなくなって捨てる紙や、その切れはし。
presentation.note: Usually written 紙くず; besides literal scraps, 紙くず同然 is a common figurative phrase for stocks, bonds or money that have become worthless.

presentation.defJa: 人の力をこえた不思議な力をもち、人々に信じられ、まつられる存在を親しみをこめて呼ぶ語。
presentation.note: 神様 is the everyday, affectionate way to say 'god' or 'deity', used both for Shinto kami and figuratively for a revered master (野球の神様), whereas bare 神 sounds more formal or theological.

presentation.defJa: ひげや髪の毛をそるのに使う、よく切れる薄い刃物。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana (カミソリ or かみそり) today; カミソリ負け is razor burn, and the word also describes something razor-sharp, as in カミソリのような切れ味.
collocations: カミソリでひげをそる

presentation.defJa: トラックや列車、船などで運ぶ荷物。
presentation.note: 貨物 is the formal word for freight carried commercially by truck, train, ship or plane, while 荷物 is the everyday word for any bags or parcels.

presentation.defJa: 中に何も入っていないこと。また、そのようす。
presentation.note: 空っぽ is a more colloquial, emphatic version of 空 (から), often used figuratively for a blank mind or an empty heart.

presentation.defJa: 草や木が水分を失って、生きる力がなくなる。
presentation.note: 枯れる is used for plants drying out and dying; with the same reading, 声が枯れる means to go hoarse, and 涸れる is used for wells or springs running dry.

presentation.meaning: to dote on, to treat with affection
presentation.defJa: 子どもや動物などを大切にして、愛情をもって接する。
presentation.note: Usually written かわいがる; it means showing affection to someone younger or weaker, such as children, pets or juniors, and in sumo slang かわいがり ironically means putting a junior through brutal training.

presentation.defJa: 国と国のお金を交換するときの比率や、その取引。また、現金を送らずに支払いをするしくみ。
presentation.note: In modern news 為替 almost always means currency exchange (為替相場, 為替レート), while the older 'money order' sense survives mainly in 郵便為替.

presentation.defJa: 粘土を焼いて作った、屋根をおおうための板。
presentation.note: 瓦 are the fired-clay tiles of traditional Japanese roofs; 瓦をふく is the set verb for laying them, and 瓦版 was an Edo-period broadsheet.

presentation.defJa: 部屋の中のよごれた空気を外に出し、外の新しい空気を入れること。
presentation.note: 換気 is the standard word for airing out a room, used with する and in 換気扇 (exhaust fan), while 通気 refers more to air passage or breathability.

presentation.defJa: 強く心を動かされて、深く喜んだりありがたく思ったりすること。
presentation.note: 感激 is a strong, usually joyful reaction to something specific such as a kindness or a win, whereas 感動 is broader and often used for being moved by art or stories.

presentation.meaning: Kansai, the region around Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe
presentation.defJa: 大阪や京都、神戸を中心とする地方。近畿地方とほぼ重なる。
presentation.note: 関西 centers on Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe and is constantly contrasted with 関東; it appears in set words like 関西弁 and 関西風 for the regional dialect or style of cooking.

presentation.defJa: 一年の最初の日。一月一日。
presentation.note: 元日 is the whole day of January 1, while 元旦 strictly means its morning, though many people use the two interchangeably.

presentation.defJa: 絵や音楽、映画などの芸術作品を味わい、楽しむこと。
presentation.note: 鑑賞 is for appreciating works of art, music or film, while the homophone 観賞 is for enjoying natural beauty such as flowers or fish.

presentation.defJa: 心や体で何かを受けとめて、そう思う。「感じる」のやや古く、かたい言い方。
presentation.note: 感ずる is an older, more formal variant of 感じる found mainly in essays, speeches and literature, and it survives in set phrases like 意気に感ずる (to be moved to act by someone's spirit); in everyday speech 感じる is the normal form.

presentation.defJa: あいだに別のものをはさんで、物事が伝わったり関係したりすること。
presentation.note: 間接 usually appears as 間接的 or in compounds like 間接税 and 間接照明, contrasting with 直接; don't confuse it with the homophone 関節 (joint).

presentation.defJa: 北極や南極に近く、一年中とても寒い気候の地域。
presentation.note: 寒帯 is a geography term used alongside 熱帯, 温帯 and 亜寒帯 in textbooks and science writing, rarely in casual talk.

presentation.defJa: 国の仕事を受け持つ役所。省や庁など。
presentation.note: 官庁 is a formal word for government ministries and agencies, common in news (中央官庁, 官庁街); in casual speech people say 役所 or name the specific ministry.

presentation.defJa: 東京を中心に、神奈川、埼玉、千葉などをふくむ地方。
presentation.note: 関東 is the region around Tokyo, made up of seven prefectures, and is constantly paired with 関西 in comparisons of food, dialect and culture.

presentation.meaning: idea, notion; sense (of time, duty, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 物事についてもっている考えやイメージ。また、あきらめて覚悟すること。
presentation.note: 観念 is a somewhat formal word for an ingrained idea or sense (固定観念, 衛生観念); as the verb 観念する it also means to give up and accept one's fate.

presentation.defJa: お祝いなどの席で、みんなでグラスを上げて酒などを飲むこと。また、そのときのかけ声。
presentation.note: 乾杯 is both the shout 'Cheers!' and the act of toasting; 乾杯の音頭をとる (to lead the toast) is a standard role at Japanese work gatherings.
collocations: グラスを合わせて乾杯する

presentation.defJa: 店の名前や商品などを書いて、人目につくところにかかげる板。
presentation.note: Besides a physical sign, 看板 figuratively means a shop's main draw or public face (看板商品, 看板娘), and 看板を下ろす means to close a business.

presentation.meaning: nursing (a sick person), caring for the sick
presentation.defJa: 病気の人のそばにいて、世話をすること。
presentation.note: 看病 is caring for a sick family member or loved one at home or at the bedside, while 看護 refers to professional nursing care.
collocations: つきっきりで看病する

presentation.defJa: 身分や名誉のしるしとして、頭にかぶるかざり。
presentation.note: 冠 read かんむり is a crown or ceremonial headgear, and the same word names kanji radicals that sit on top of a character (草冠, 竹冠); 冠スポンサー is a naming-rights sponsor, while in compounds such as 王冠 and 栄冠 the character is read かん.

presentation.defJa: 空気が地面などをおす力の大きさ。
presentation.note: 気圧 is atmospheric pressure, heard daily in weather forecasts through 高気圧 and 低気圧; 圧力 is the general word for pressure of any kind.

presentation.defJa: 服をかえること。また、かえるために用意しておく服。
presentation.note: 着替え is both the act of changing clothes and the spare clothes themselves, as in 着替えを持っていく (to bring a change of clothes).

presentation.defJa: 今着ている服をぬいで、別の服を着る。
presentation.note: 着替える takes に for the clothes you change into (私服に着替える); both きがえる and きかえる are accepted readings, with きがえる far more common.

presentation.defJa: 客車や貨車を引っぱって線路の上を走る車両。
presentation.note: 機関車 is a locomotive that pulls other cars, unlike a 電車, which has motors in some or all of its cars; 蒸気機関車 is often shortened to SL.

presentation.defJa: 作物の不作や戦乱などで食べ物が極端に足りなくなり、多くの人が飢えに苦しむこと。
presentation.note: A written word for a large-scale famine, typical of history and international news; 食糧不足 (food shortage) is milder and more general, and 飢餓 refers to the state of starvation itself.

presentation.defJa: ある目的のために使う、簡単な道具や装置。
presentation.note: Refers to relatively small tools or devices for a specific purpose, often in compounds like 医療器具 or 調理器具; 機械 implies larger machinery, and 道具 is the everyday word for tools.

presentation.meaning: to chop finely, to mince; to carve, to engrave
presentation.defJa: 包丁などで細かく切る。また、ほって形や文字をつける。
presentation.note: In the kitchen it means to chop or mince finely, while in writing it also means to carve or engrave and, figuratively, to mark time (時を刻む) or etch something in memory (心に刻む).

presentation.defJa: 物事を比べたり判断したりするときの、よりどころとなるもの。
presentation.note: The everyday and official word for a standard or criterion used to judge or measure something; 規準 is a rarer, more formal variant used for normative rules of conduct or evaluation.

presentation.defJa: 行いや評価のよりどころとして定められた、守るべき決まりや目標。
presentation.note: A formal, less common spelling used mainly in education and ethics for normative criteria (what ought to be), whereas 基準 is the general word for a measurable standard; teachers sometimes read the two のりじゅん and もとじゅん to keep them apart.

presentation.meaning: to dress (someone), to put clothes on (someone)
presentation.defJa: ほかの人に服などを身につけさせる。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 着る, meaning to dress someone else; it also appears in idioms such as 罪を着せる (to pin the blame on someone) and 恩に着せる (to make someone feel indebted).

presentation.defJa: 物事が成り立つための、いちばん下の土台となる部分。
presentation.note: Used both literally for a building's foundation and figuratively for the fundamentals of a skill or field; 基本 overlaps but stresses the basic principle or standard way, while 基礎 stresses what everything else is built on.

presentation.defJa: 軍隊や探検、観測などの活動の拠点となる場所。
presentation.note: Means a base of operations, most often military (米軍基地) but also for expeditions and research, or even a child's secret hideout (秘密基地); 拠点 is a broader word for any hub of activity.

presentation.defJa: 物事が始まったり変化したりする、直接の原因や機会。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana as きっかけ; it is the everyday word for the trigger or opening that starts something, whereas 契機 is its formal written counterpart.

presentation.defJa: 劇場や競技場などで、見る人が座る席。
presentation.note: Refers to the seating for spectators in a theater, hall or stadium, and by extension the audience itself (客席が沸く); 観客席 is a more explicit synonym, while 座席 is any seat, such as one on a train.

presentation.defJa: 訪ねてきた人をもてなすための部屋。
presentation.note: A somewhat old-fashioned word for a room in a house for receiving visitors; 応接間 is a Western-style reception room, and 客室 usually means a guest room in a hotel or a cabin on a ship or plane.

presentation.meaning: closure (of a business), suspension of operations
presentation.defJa: 店や会社、工場などが、一時的に仕事や営業をやめること。
presentation.note: Means a business suspends operations, usually temporarily, as on signs reading 本日休業; 廃業 implies closing for good, while 閉店 can also mean closing for the day, and 休業 also appears in labor terms like 育児休業 (childcare leave).

presentation.defJa: 大学などで、予定されていた授業が行われないこと。
presentation.note: Used almost exclusively for a university or college lecture that is canceled; its homophone 休校 (also read きゅうこう) means a whole school closing for the day, for example because of a typhoon.

presentation.defJa: 働いた人に、会社などが支払うお金や品物。
presentation.note: The formal, administrative term for salary used in contracts, payroll and statistics; 給料 is the everyday conversational equivalent, and 賃金 is the economic and legal term for wages.

presentation.meaning: clear, pure (of water); pure, innocent (of heart)
presentation.defJa: 汚れがなく、すきとおって美しい。また、心に濁りや悪いところがない。
presentation.note: A literary word found in writing, poetry and set phrases like 清き一票 (one's precious vote); in conversation, water is more often called きれい or described as 澄んでいる.

presentation.defJa: 土地や物事を分けている、さかいめの線。
presentation.note: A formal word for a dividing line between areas, used for land and borders but also abstractly (the boundary between fact and fiction); 境 is the plainer native word.
collocations: 境界があいまいになる

presentation.defJa: 財産を個人ではなく社会全体で持つという考え方に関わることを表す。
presentation.note: Appears almost only as the first element of compounds such as 共産主義 (communism), 共産党 (communist party) and 共産圏 (the communist bloc), mostly in political and historical writing.

presentation.defJa: 決まった時期に、決まったやり方で行う催し。
presentation.note: Refers to events held regularly or by custom, such as annual festivals or school events; イベント is a looser loanword for any event, and 催し is a more formal word for a gathering or show.

presentation.meaning: feeling obliged; being sorry for the trouble (humble)
presentation.defJa: 相手に迷惑をかけたり親切にされたりして、申し訳なく思い、身が縮むように感じること。
presentation.note: A humble, formal word common in business speech and email that expresses both apology for the trouble and gratitude; it is more deferential than すみません and often used in cushion phrases like 恐縮ですが.

presentation.defJa: 多くの人が順番に長く並ぶこと。また、その列。
presentation.note: In daily life it means a line or queue of people (行列のできる店 is a stock phrase for a popular shop), while in mathematics and AI it means a matrix; 列 alone is the plainer word for a row or line.

presentation.defJa: まっすぐではなく、なめらかに曲がっている線。
presentation.note: The standard word for a curve in mathematics, graphs and design, the opposite of 直線 (straight line); in everyday speech カーブ is more usual for a bend in the road or a curveball.

presentation.defJa: 集団や生活の中で、人の行いを正しく保つための決まり。
presentation.note: Refers to order maintained through rules and self-control, in schools, the military or personal habits (規律正しい生活); 規則 means the individual written rules, while 規律 emphasizes the orderliness that results.

presentation.meaning: to cut down with a sword, to slay; to criticize sharply
presentation.defJa: 刀などで人を切りつける。また、鋭く批判する。
presentation.note: A dramatic spelling of きる reserved for cutting with a blade, especially a sword, and for sharp criticism (世相を斬る); ordinary cutting is always written 切る.

presentation.meaning: to be careful, to watch out, to pay attention
presentation.defJa: 危なくないように、また失敗しないように、注意する。
presentation.note: The everyday expression for being careful or watching out, usually written 気をつける with つける in kana; 注意する is more formal, and お気をつけて is a polite parting phrase.

presentation.defJa: フナを改良して作られた、赤や黒などの色が美しい観賞用の魚。
presentation.note: The everyday word for goldfish, closely tied to the Japanese summer through festival 金魚すくい and glass bowls (金魚鉢); 金魚のふん (goldfish poop) is an idiom for someone who tags along everywhere.

presentation.defJa: 中に何も入っていない、からの状態であることを表す。
presentation.note: Read くう as a prefix, it marks something as empty or vacant, as in 空車 (vacant taxi or parking space), 空席 (empty seat) and 空室 (vacancy); the native reading から appears in words like 空箱.

presentation.defJa: 二で割り切れる整数。
presentation.note: The mathematical term for an even number, paired with 奇数 (odd number); outside math it appears in practical phrases like 偶数月 (even-numbered months) and in customs about lucky and unlucky numbers.

presentation.defJa: 現実には起こりそうにないことを、頭の中で自由に思い描くこと。
presentation.note: Stresses imagining things detached from reality, often with a nuance of idle fantasy; 想像 is the neutral word for imagination, and 妄想 suggests delusional or obsessive fantasies.

presentation.defJa: 地面から離れた、空のなか。
presentation.note: Refers to the space above the ground through which things float or fly, as in 空中に浮かぶ; 空 (そら) is the sky as we see it, while 空中 is the medium in which something moves.

presentation.defJa: 木などを打ちつけてとめるための、先のとがった細い金属の棒。
presentation.note: Besides the literal sense, 釘を刺す ('drive in a nail') is a common idiom for warning someone in advance, and newspapers often write the word in kana as くぎ.

presentation.meaning: to divide (into sections or units); to mark off, punctuate
presentation.defJa: ひと続きのものに切れ目をつけて、いくつかに分ける。
presentation.note: 区切る marks divisions within something continuous such as text, time or a task, whereas 仕切る means physically partitioning a space (or running an event).

presentation.defJa: 髪をとかしたり整えたりするのに使う、細い歯が並んだ道具。
presentation.note: 櫛 is still the ordinary word for a comb, though the kanji is outside the jōyō list, so newspapers and everyday text often write くし; the idiom 櫛の歯が欠けたよう describes a row with gaps where things are missing.

presentation.meaning: great pains; painstaking effort (to work something out)
presentation.defJa: よい方法や結果を得ようと、あれこれ考えて努力すること。
presentation.note: 苦心 stresses the mental effort of working out a solution, as in 苦心の末 'after much effort', whereas 苦労 covers hardship and toil in general.

presentation.defJa: 使ったあとに残った細かい切れはしや、役に立たなくなったもの。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana and attached to another noun (紙くず, 木くず, 星くず); applied to a person, as in 人間のくず, it is a harsh insult.

presentation.defJa: 手の、中指と小指の間にある指。
presentation.note: The name is said to come from the finger once used to mix or apply medicine; in Japan, as in the West, a ring on the left 薬指 signals marriage.

presentation.meaning: to break into pieces, shatter; (of waves) to break; to become informal
presentation.defJa: かたいものが強い力を受けて、こなごなに割れる。
presentation.note: 砕ける is intransitive (砕く is the transitive 'to crush'), and its form くだけた often means 'casual, informal', as in くだけた口調.

presentation.defJa: 口のまわりにある、やわらかく赤みのある部分。
presentation.note: 唇 is the everyday word for lips, and idioms like 唇をかむ (biting one's lip in frustration) and 唇をとがらせる (pouting) are common in narrative writing.

presentation.defJa: 唇に塗って色をつけるための化粧品。
