presentation.note: 口紅 is the general word; cosmetics marketing often prefers リップ or リップスティック, while 紅 alone sounds traditional.

presentation.meaning: to hand out, distribute; (with ki or me) to pay attention all around
presentation.defJa: 物をそれぞれの人に分けて渡す。
presentation.note: Besides physically handing things out, 配る is common with 気 or 目 (気を配る, 目を配る) for paying careful attention in every direction.

presentation.meaning: ingenuity; devising a clever way, a good idea or device
presentation.defJa: よい方法を考え出すこと。また、その考え出した方法。
presentation.note: 工夫 covers everyday clever adjustments as well as inventions, usually as 工夫する; read こうふ, the same characters are an old word for a laborer.

presentation.defJa: ある基準によって、全体をいくつかに分けること。また、分けたまとまり。
presentation.note: 区分 is a formal word typical of laws, statistics and official forms; 区別 means telling things apart, while 区分 means dividing a whole into set categories.

presentation.defJa: いくつかのものを合わせて、ひとまとまりにすること。また、そのまとまり。
presentation.note: Everyday text writes 組み合わせ, while 組合せ is a shortened spelling of official documents; in sports the word also means a tournament's draw or pairings.

presentation.defJa: すんだことを、ああすればよかったと残念に思う。
presentation.note: 悔やむ is more literary than 後悔する and also covers grieving a death, as in the condolence phrase お悔やみ申し上げます.
collocations: 悔やんでも悔やみきれない

presentation.defJa: 相手や話題の人への敬意を表すための言葉づかい。
presentation.note: 敬語 is the umbrella term covering 尊敬語 (respectful), 謙譲語 (humble) and 丁寧語 (polite) forms; 二重敬語 means applying the same type of honorific twice to one word, generally considered incorrect except in established expressions.

presentation.defJa: ガラス管の内側に塗った物質を光らせて明かりをとる照明。
presentation.note: 蛍光灯 refers to the tube or the light fitting; when it burns out you say 蛍光灯が切れる, and 蛍光ペン (highlighter) shares the same 蛍光 'fluorescent'.

presentation.meaning: form, format; formality (as opposed to substance)
presentation.defJa: ものごとを表したり行ったりするときの、決まった型ややり方。
presentation.note: 形式 is the outward form or format; it can be neutral (ファイル形式) or critical, as in 形式的 'perfunctory, a mere formality'.

presentation.defJa: 前から行っていることを、そのまま続けること。
presentation.note: 継続 is a formal Sino-Japanese word for keeping something going without a break, common in business and official language, where 続ける is the everyday verb.

presentation.defJa: 羊などの毛をより合わせて作った、編み物用の糸。
presentation.note: 毛糸 is yarn for knitting, typically wool, while ウール refers to the material or fabric in general.

presentation.defJa: 地球上の位置を、東西の方向の角度で表したもの。
presentation.note: 経度 is east-west position, paired with 緯度 (latitude); specific values are given as 東経 or 西経, e.g. 東経135度.

presentation.meaning: lineage, line of descent; system (of connected parts)
presentation.defJa: 同じもとから分かれて続いている、つながりのすじ。
presentation.note: 系統 covers both biological or historical lineage and organized systems such as 指揮系統 (chain of command) or 電力系統 (power grid); 血統 is narrower, meaning bloodline or pedigree.

presentation.defJa: 騎手を乗せた馬を走らせて速さを競うレース。また、その勝ち負けを予想してお金をかけるもの。
presentation.note: 競馬 is a legally sanctioned form of betting in Japan, run by JRA and local governments; related compounds include 競輪 (cycle racing) and 競艇 (boat racing).

presentation.defJa: ものの性質や状態を表し、言い切りの形が「い」で終わる言葉。
presentation.note: In Japanese school grammar 形容詞 means only the -i adjectives such as 高い, while the -na type is classed separately as 形容動詞.

presentation.defJa: 性質や状態を表し、言い切りの形が「だ」で終わる言葉。
presentation.note: 形容動詞 is the term of traditional school grammar; textbooks of Japanese as a foreign language call the same words な形容詞, and some linguists treat them as a kind of noun.

presentation.meaning: surgery (as a medical field); surgical department
presentation.defJa: けがや病気を、手術によって治す医学の分野。
presentation.note: 外科 treats by operating, in contrast to 内科 (internal medicine), and it forms department names such as 脳神経外科 (neurosurgery).

presentation.defJa: 毛がついたままの動物の皮。また、それで作った衣類。
presentation.note: 毛皮 is fur still attached to the hide (a pelt or fur garment), whereas 革 is leather with the hair removed.

presentation.defJa: 数や量が、短い間に急にひどく増えること。
presentation.note: 激増 is a strong written word for a dramatic rise, stronger than 急増, and its opposite is 激減.

presentation.meaning: getting off (a train or bus), alighting
presentation.defJa: 電車やバスなどの乗り物から降りること。
presentation.note: 下車 is a formal word seen on tickets and in announcements, the counterpart of 乗車, while conversation usually just says 降りる.

presentation.meaning: the 21st through the end of a month; late (in the month)
presentation.defJa: 一か月を三つに分けたうちの、二十一日から月末までの期間。
presentation.note: 下旬 is the last third of a month (the 21st to the end), paired with 上旬 and 中旬, and is common in weather reports and schedules.

presentation.defJa: 家庭や工場などから流れ出る、使ったあとの汚れた水。また、それを流すしくみ。
presentation.note: 下水 is used or waste water (and the sewer that carries it), contrasted with 上水 (clean supply water); the pipe network is usually called 下水道.

presentation.meaning: to cut, trim (spending, time); to shave, whittle
presentation.defJa: 少しずつ取り除いて、量や大きさを減らす。
presentation.note: Literally paring material away with a blade, it is widely used figuratively for trimming budgets, time or text, whereas 減らす is a neutral 'reduce' without that image of shaving something down.

presentation.meaning: digit, place (in a number); order of magnitude
presentation.defJa: 数を書き表すときの、それぞれの数字の位。
presentation.note: In everyday use it almost always means a digit place or an order of magnitude (桁違い 'in a different league'), while the original architectural 'crossbeam' sense survives mainly in compounds such as 橋桁.

presentation.defJa: 木で作られた、日本の昔ながらのはきもの。
presentation.note: Besides the footwear itself, it appears in idioms such as 下駄を預ける 'leave everything up to someone' and 下駄を履かせる 'pad scores or figures'.

presentation.defJa: 心臓から送り出された血液が、血管の壁を押す力。
presentation.note: An everyday word in health checkups and conversation, with 高血圧 and 低血圧 as the standard terms for high and low blood pressure.

presentation.defJa: 一か月ごとに支払われる給料。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 日給 (daily wage) and 時給 (hourly wage); 給料 is the general everyday word for pay.

presentation.defJa: とても優れた出来ばえの作品。
presentation.note: Standard in reviews and art criticism (名作 is close but stresses lasting fame), and in casual speech 傑作だ can also mean something is hilarious or absurd.

presentation.defJa: その月の終わりのころ。
presentation.note: Common in business and household contexts such as billing and deadlines (月末締め 'books closed at month's end'); its counterparts are 月初め and 月半ば.

presentation.defJa: 品がなく、見ていて不快に感じられるようす。
presentation.note: The opposite of 上品, it judges manners, speech or taste as crude, and is stronger than 行儀が悪い, which simply means bad manners.

presentation.defJa: 上品さに欠け、いやしい感じがするようす。
presentation.note: As a na-adjective it takes な before a noun (下品な冗談); for showy, cheap-looking style Japanese also uses けばけばしい, while 下品 is a broader judgment of taste and manners.

presentation.defJa: 煙が多くて、目やのどが苦しい。
presentation.note: Describes the physical discomfort of smoke, mostly in casual speech; the near-synonym 煙たい can also describe a person who is awkward to be around (煙たい存在).

presentation.defJa: 名詞の前について、「今の」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A formal prefix common in news and documents (現首相 'the current prime minister'), contrasting with 元～ 'former' and 前～ 'previous'.

presentation.defJa: 実際にその場所へ行き、仕事や様子を見て学ぶこと。
presentation.note: Implies going somewhere to see how it works and learn from it, unlike sightseeing (観光); at school 見学する also means sitting out a PE class and watching.

presentation.meaning: manuscript, draft, copy (of an article or speech)
presentation.defJa: 印刷したり発表したりする前の、書かれた文章。
presentation.note: Covers any text prepared for publication or delivery, from novels to speeches; 下書き stresses a rough, unfinished draft, while 原稿 can be the finished copy.

presentation.meaning: origin (of a species or product); native to
presentation.defJa: 動物や植物、品物などが、もともと生まれたり作られたりしたこと。また、その土地。
presentation.note: Mostly used for plants, animals and products, often as ～原産 'native to ~' or 原産地 'country of origin' on labels, whereas 産地 is simply where something is produced now.

presentation.defJa: 文明が発達する前の、ものごとのはじめのころ。
presentation.note: Usually appears in compounds such as 原始時代 or 原始的, and 原始的 can also mean crude or unsophisticated when describing modern methods.

presentation.defJa: 仕事に必要な知識や技術を、一定の期間をかけて学ぶこと。
presentation.note: Refers to structured training run by employers or institutions, while 訓練 suggests drills or physical practice and 練習 is general practice.

presentation.defJa: これ以上は越えられない、ぎりぎりのところ。
presentation.note: Used for a set ceiling on amounts or tolerance (物には限度がある 'there is a limit to everything'), whereas 限界 stresses the point where ability or endurance gives out.

presentation.defJa: 実際に。目の前の事実として。
presentation.note: Introduces concrete evidence for a claim just made, typical of argument in essays and speech; 実際に is the neutral equivalent, while 現に adds a 'look, it is really happening' force.

presentation.defJa: とても小さなものを、レンズで大きくして見る器具。
presentation.note: The standard term in science classes and labs; 虫眼鏡 is a simple magnifying glass and 望遠鏡 a telescope for distant objects.

presentation.defJa: ものごとが成り立ったり動いたりする、もとになるしくみ。
presentation.note: Refers to the fundamental mechanism or law behind something, common in science and technology writing, whereas 原則 is a rule or guideline for conduct.

presentation.defJa: 製品を作るときに、もとになる材料。
presentation.note: Means the basic material that is processed into a product (石油はプラスチックの原料), whereas 材料 is broader and includes materials used as they are, as in cooking.

presentation.defJa: 名詞などの前について、「ちいさい」「少しの」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Read こ in native Japanese compounds (小雨, 小声, 小走り) and しょう in Sino-Japanese ones (小学校, 小説), adding a sense of smallness or 'a little'.

presentation.defJa: 離れている人や場所などに、会いたい、戻りたいと強く思うようす。
presentation.note: Expresses longing for someone or something absent, including places, foods and seasons (こたつが恋しい季節), and unlike English 'miss' the thing longed for is the subject marked with が.

presentation.defJa: 名詞の前について、程度や水準がたかい、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A Sino-Japanese prefix common in ads and news (高画質, 高血圧), with 低～ as its opposite, as in 低収入 or 低価格.

presentation.defJa: 工場で、機械を動かすなどの作業をする人。
presentation.note: Somewhat dated and evocative of postwar manufacturing; today 作業員 or 工場で働く社員 is more common, and 従業員 is the general word for employees.

presentation.defJa: 工場の排水や排気ガスなどが、人々の健康や暮らしに害を与えること。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to pollution that damages public health and living conditions, strongly tied to Japan's 1960s and 70s industrial cases, whereas 汚染 is the general word for contamination.

presentation.defJa: 品質や値段が、ふつうよりずっと上であること。
presentation.note: Common in shopping and advertising for luxury goods (高級車, 高級ブランド); 上等 is a similar but more old-fashioned word for fine quality.

presentation.defJa: 社会のみんなに関わり、みんなで使ったり支えたりすること。
presentation.note: Used mainly in compounds about things shared by society (公共料金 'utility charges'), and more formal than みんなの; 公的 means 'official' or 'governmental' rather than 'shared'.

presentation.defJa: 実用的で美しい品物を、技術をこらして作ること。また、その作品。
presentation.note: Covers crafts that are both useful and beautiful, such as ceramics, lacquerware and textiles, whereas 美術 is fine art and 手芸 is handicraft done as a hobby.

presentation.meaning: filial piety, being good to one's parents
presentation.defJa: 親を大切にし、よく尽くすこと。
presentation.note: In modern speech it appears almost always as 親孝行, meaning doing something kind for one's parents, with 親不孝 as its opposite.

presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の線や道が、ある一点で互いに交わること。
presentation.note: Used for roads, rail lines and lines in a figure, and figuratively for feelings or ideas that cross (思いが交差する); the native verb 交わる is the softer, more literary equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 講演会や学校などで、人に教えたり話をしたりする人。
presentation.note: Covers guest speakers and instructors at schools, cram schools and seminars; at universities 講師 is also a rank below 准教授, and 非常勤講師 means a part-time adjunct.

presentation.defJa: 建物や道路、水道などを作ったり直したりする作業。
presentation.note: Refers to the physical work itself on roads, pipes and buildings, while 建設 stresses building something new, usually on a larger scale.

presentation.defJa: 政府や団体などが正式に認めていること。また、数学で計算のきまりを表した式。
presentation.note: As a modifier (公式サイト, 公式戦) it means "official" and is everywhere in media, while in school math it means a formula; 正式 is the more neutral word for a formal, proper procedure.

presentation.defJa: 本当の理由をかくすために持ち出す、表向きの理由。
presentation.note: Implies a pretext deliberately put forward to hide the real motive, whereas 言い訳 is an excuse offered after the fact to justify a failure.

presentation.defJa: 社会を作っている一般の人々。
presentation.note: A formal word that lives mostly in fixed compounds such as 公衆衛生 and 公衆トイレ and the phrase 公衆の面前で ("in front of everyone"); 大衆 instead means the masses as consumers of culture.

presentation.defJa: 体や服につけて、よいにおいをただよわせるための液体。
presentation.note: The general word for perfume; フレグランス is a softer marketing term, and 香り refers to the scent itself rather than the liquid.

presentation.defJa: まっすぐに進む光のすじ。
presentation.note: A slightly technical, descriptive word for a ray or beam, common in science writing and compounds like 太陽光線; everyday speech usually just says 光.

presentation.defJa: 建物の階がたくさん重なっていて、高いこと。
presentation.note: Almost always used as a modifier in compounds such as 高層ビル and 高層階; 超高層 means skyscraper-class, and in weather reports 高層 can also mean the upper atmosphere.

presentation.defJa: 決まった順番で、仕事や役目を入れかわること。
presentation.note: Traditionally preferred for regular rotations such as shift work (交替勤務), while 交代 is the general spelling for any replacement; many newspapers now use 交代 for both.

presentation.defJa: ある人や物が退いて、ほかの人や物がその役目につくこと。
presentation.note: The standard modern spelling for any replacement or turnover of people, from sports substitutions to 政権交代 (a change of government); 交替 survives mainly for rotating shifts.

presentation.defJa: 田や畑など、作物を育てるために耕している土地。
presentation.note: A formal term found in statistics and agricultural policy (耕地面積); in everyday speech people say 田畑 or simply 畑.

presentation.defJa: 電車やバス、飛行機など、人や物を運ぶための乗り物やしくみ。
presentation.note: Covers trains, buses, planes and ferries collectively and is standard in news and official notices, especially as 公共交通機関 (public transportation).

presentation.defJa: 程度や等級が高いこと。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in fixed institutional compounds (高等教育, 高等学校, 高等裁判所); on its own 高等な can sound dated or ironic, so 高度な is preferred for "advanced".

presentation.meaning: joint, combined (of separate groups acting together)
presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の団体などが一つにまとまって、いっしょに物事を行うこと。
presentation.note: Describes separate groups acting together as one (合同訓練, 合同葬), while 共同 stresses sharing a task or ownership and 協同 stresses cooperation.

presentation.defJa: 中学校を卒業した人が進む、ふつう三年間の学校。
presentation.note: The full formal name used in laws, official documents and school names; in conversation and most writing it is shortened to 高校.

presentation.defJa: 世間の人々に向けて、情報や事実を広く発表すること。
presentation.note: Stresses making information public, often something previously internal or sensitive, while 発表 is the neutral word for any announcement or presentation.

presentation.defJa: 地中などで自然にできた、岩石のもとになる物質。
presentation.note: A scientific and resource term (鉱物資源), distinct from 鉱石, which is ore mined for its valuable minerals, and 岩石, which is rock as a whole.

presentation.defJa: 国や地方の役所などが行う、おおやけの仕事。
presentation.note: Refers to work done in an official public capacity and is typical of politics and civil-service reporting; 公用 is close but often refers to official use of resources, as in 公用車.

presentation.meaning: autumn colors, leaves turning red and yellow
presentation.defJa: 秋になって、木の葉が赤や黄色に色づくこと。
presentation.note: Read こうよう in news and forecasts for the seasonal coloring of leaves, but also もみじ, which evokes maples in particular and is the reading in 紅葉狩り.

presentation.meaning: rationality, reasonableness (mostly in compounds meaning rational or streamlining)
presentation.defJa: 物事の筋道や理屈にかなっていること。
presentation.note: Rarely stands alone and lives in compounds such as 合理的 (rational, sensible), 合理化 (streamlining) and 合理性, while 論理的 means logical in the sense of consistent reasoning.

presentation.defJa: 別々の流れや人のグループが、途中で一つになること。
presentation.note: Used literally for rivers and traffic lanes that merge and, very often in conversation, for joining a group that is already together somewhere (後から合流する).

presentation.defJa: 法律や約束、薬などが持っている、はたらきや力。
presentation.note: Often refers to legal validity or how long something remains in force (効力を失う), whereas 効果 is the general word for an observable effect or result.

presentation.defJa: 火に当てすぎて、物の表面を黒くしてしまう。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 焦げる, used when someone burns food or fabric by accident; figuratively, 胸を焦がす means to burn with longing.

presentation.defJa: 一つの国をおさめる王。
presentation.note: The neutral term for the reigning monarch of a kingdom, common in news about foreign royalty; 王 alone is broader, and Japan's monarch is always 天皇, never 国王.

presentation.meaning: national, state-run (founded by the national government)
presentation.defJa: 国のお金でつくられ、国が運営していること。
presentation.note: Marks institutions founded by the national government, in contrast to 公立 (run by a local government) and 私立 (private).

presentation.meaning: thank you for your trouble, good work (said to someone who has worked or served)
presentation.defJa: 相手の働きや骨折りをねぎらうときに言うあいさつの言葉。
presentation.note: Often said by a superior to a subordinate or to service workers, so many guides advise お疲れ様です toward superiors, though this rule is fairly recent and still disputed.
collocations: 長い間ご苦労様でした

presentation.meaning: to get burnt, to be scorched
presentation.defJa: 火に当たりすぎて、表面が黒く焼けてしまう。
presentation.note: The intransitive counterpart of 焦がす, describing food or cloth that gets scorched; 焼ける is the neutral "to be cooked or toasted," while 焦げる implies it went too far.

presentation.meaning: to be numb with cold, to freeze (of a person or body)
presentation.defJa: 寒さのために体が冷えきって、思うように動かなくなる。
presentation.note: Describes people or animals numb with cold, unlike 凍る, which is for water or objects actually freezing solid.

presentation.meaning: idea, clue (about something one may know of)
presentation.defJa: 思い当たること。それについて何か知っている、または見当がつくこと。
presentation.note: Almost always in 心当たりがある／ない, used when someone is asked about a cause, a person or a lost thing; 思い当たる is the verb counterpart.

presentation.meaning: to know well, understand (how to do something); to be versed in
presentation.defJa: 物事のやり方や意味を十分に理解し、身につけている。
presentation.note: Usually in the resultative 心得ている for practical know-how or etiquette; it is more formal than 分かっている, and the noun 心得 means precepts to bear in mind.

presentation.defJa: 人が座るための台やいす。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned word for a simple seat or bench (いす and ベンチ are the everyday words); figuratively 腰掛け means a job taken only as a temporary stopgap.

presentation.defJa: 座るための台。特に、庭などに置かれた長いす。
presentation.note: The spelling without okurigana is older or formal and survives mainly in compounds and signs such as 腰掛待合 in tea gardens; ordinary prose writes 腰掛け.

presentation.meaning: to sit down (on a chair, bench or ledge)
presentation.defJa: いすや台などの上に、足を下ろして座る。
presentation.note: Means sitting on something raised with the legs hanging down rather than on the floor; slightly more descriptive and written than 座る.

presentation.defJa: かなを、あいうえおの順に縦と横に並べた表。また、その音。
presentation.note: Refers to the kana grid ordered by vowel rows and consonant columns; 五十音順 is the Japanese equivalent of alphabetical order in dictionaries and lists.

presentation.defJa: 生き物の一匹、一頭、一本など、それぞれ独立した一つの体。
presentation.note: A biology and ecology term for a single organism within a species or group; do not confuse it with the homophone 固体, a solid.

presentation.defJa: 自由に使うために、親などからもらう少しのお金。
presentation.note: Usually said with the polite prefix as お小遣い, for a child's allowance and also a spouse's personal spending money; 小遣い稼ぎ means earning a little on the side.

presentation.defJa: 昔に書かれ、長い時代を経ても価値が認められている作品。
presentation.note: In school 古典 specifically means classical Japanese (and Chinese) literature as a subject; the adjective 古典的 means classic or traditional, sometimes with a hint of old-fashioned.

presentation.meaning: to leave a message (with someone); to send something via someone
presentation.defJa: 直接会えない相手への伝言や品物を、ほかの人に頼んで届けてもらう。
presentation.note: Implies entrusting a message or item to a third person; it is somewhat old-fashioned and also spelled 託ける, while 伝言を頼む or 伝えてもらう is the everyday phrasing.

presentation.meaning: wording, way of speaking; choice of language
presentation.defJa: 話したり書いたりするときの、言い方や言葉の選び方。
presentation.note: Covers the politeness level and tone of someone's speech, often in judgments like 言葉遣いが悪い; 口調 focuses on tone of voice and 言い回し on a particular phrasing.
collocations: 言葉遣いに気をつける

presentation.meaning: long silence, failing to keep in touch for a long time
presentation.defJa: 長い間、訪ねたり連絡したりしないでいること。
presentation.note: Almost always written ご無沙汰 and used humbly about one's own neglect, as in the set greeting ご無沙汰しております; casual speech uses 久しぶり instead.
collocations: ご無沙汰しております
ご無沙汰をおわびする

presentation.meaning: no thanks, something one wants no more of; sorry, pardon
presentation.defJa: いやだと断ること。二度としたくないという気持ち。また、謝るときの言葉。
presentation.note: In ～は御免だ it bluntly rejects something one never wants to repeat; the familiar apology ごめん／ごめんなさい is normally written in kana, and ごめんください is a polite call at someone's door.

presentation.defJa: 手や足の、いちばん外側にある細くて短い指。
presentation.note: Covers both the little finger and, as 足の小指, the little toe; in older slang, holding up the little finger (小指を立てる) hinted at a girlfriend or mistress.

presentation.meaning: to hold back, suppress (an urge, tears, anger); to bear
presentation.defJa: 苦しさや感情が外に出ないように、がまんしておさえる。
presentation.note: Read こらえる when holding back an immediate urge such as tears, laughter or anger, and often written in kana; the same kanji is also read たえる (endure over time) and こたえる (take a toll on).

presentation.defJa: 仕事や勉強の合間に、人の心を楽しませるもの。
presentation.note: A slightly formal, collective word for entertainment as a category (films, games, TV), common in news and essays; エンタメ is the casual loanword, and 趣味 is a personal hobby.

presentation.defJa: 「見ること」の尊敬語。目上の人や客が見ること。
presentation.note: An honorific for another person's seeing, almost always written ご覧 in ご覧になる／ご覧ください／ご覧いただく; after a te-form, 〜てごらん is a gentle 'try doing it' said to children or juniors.

presentation.defJa: 物を回しながら動かす。
presentation.note: Transitive partner of 転がる; colloquially 車を転がす means to drive a car, and 手のひらで転がす means to manipulate someone with ease.

presentation.meaning: to roll, tumble; to lie around
presentation.defJa: 回りながら進む。また、倒れて横になる。
presentation.note: Intransitive partner of 転がす; besides rolling, it describes things lying about (床に転がる) and, figuratively, things that are common everywhere (どこにでも転がっている).
collocations: どこにでも転がっている

presentation.defJa: 紫がかった、濃い青色。
presentation.note: The traditional name for a dark shade of indigo dye, standard for school uniforms and business suits; 藍 is the dye and a somewhat lighter blue, and 紺色 is the same color with 色 added.

presentation.defJa: 「この」「現在の」という意味を表す。年や季節、大会などを表す言葉の前につく。
presentation.note: Read こん in many everyday words (今週, 今月, 今回, 今度) and, as a productive prefix, in news-style compounds such as 今世紀, 今年度, 今大会 and 今シーズン; watch the exceptions 今日 (きょう) and 今年 (ことし).

presentation.defJa: 性質の違うものがまじり合うこと。また、まぜ合わせること。
presentation.note: A kango word for mixing substances or groups, common in science and sports; 混ぜる is the everyday verb, and the similar-looking 混同 means confusing two things.

presentation.defJa: 「もう一度」「ふたたび」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Attaches mainly to Sino-Japanese nouns, mostly verbal ones (再開発する, 再放送), much like English re-; with native words, もう一度 or the suffix ～直す is often used instead.

presentation.defJa: 「いちばん」「この上なく」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Forms superlatives mainly in set compounds (最年少, 最高齢, 最前線); to say 'most' with an ordinary adjective, use もっとも or いちばん.

presentation.defJa: 学生や生徒として、その学校に籍を置いていること。
presentation.note: A formal term found in documents and news, mostly in 在学中 'while a student' and 在学生 'current students' (as opposed to 卒業生); 通学 means commuting to school.

presentation.defJa: 国民の祝日を指す、くだけた言い方。もとは皇室の祭祀が行われた日を指した。また、神社などで祭りを行う日。
presentation.note: In daily speech it loosely means a public holiday, but the official term is 祝日; strictly, 祭日 were pre-war days of imperial rites, which is why 祝祭日 covers both.

presentation.defJa: 思いがけず身にふりかかる、不幸な出来事。
presentation.note: Used for personal bad luck as well as accidents, often sympathetically as とんだ災難でしたね; 災害 refers to a large-scale natural or man-made disaster.

presentation.defJa: 布を切ったり、針と糸でぬい合わせたりして、衣服などを作ること。
presentation.note: Covers hand or machine sewing of clothes and the like, often as a domestic skill; 手芸 means decorative crafts such as embroidery, and 針仕事 is a homely word for needlework.

presentation.defJa: 家などを建てるために、切って加工した木。
presentation.note: Refers to cut wood as building material; 木材 is the more technical and common word in industry and news, while 材木 sounds more traditional (材木屋, 材木問屋).

presentation.defJa: 上と下、または前と後ろが、本来とは反対になっていること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears as 逆さに + verb (hang, hold, turn over) and in compounds such as 逆さ富士; さかさま is the more common standalone form, and 逆 (ぎゃく) is the general word for 'opposite'.

presentation.meaning: upside down; the wrong way round
presentation.defJa: 上下や順序などが、ふつうとは反対になっているようす。
presentation.note: Written 逆さま in modern text and used freely as a noun or na-adjective (逆さまの像, 逆さまになる); 真っ逆さま intensifies it for headlong falls.

presentation.meaning: to search for (someone or something missing)
presentation.defJa: 見えなくなった人や物を、見つけ出そうとしてあちこち調べる。
presentation.note: 捜す is for something lost or missing that you want back (a person, a wallet), while 探す covers seeking something you want or don't yet have (a job, an apartment); news writing keeps 捜す for missing persons.

presentation.meaning: to date back, go back (in time); to go upstream
presentation.defJa: 時間を過去の方へ戻る。また、川の流れと反対の方向へ進む。
presentation.note: Most common for tracing time backward (dates back to; retroactively, as 遡って); the literal sense of swimming upstream survives in nature writing about salmon and rivers.
collocations: 四月に遡って適用する

presentation.defJa: 客に酒を飲ませる店。飲み屋。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned, atmospheric word found on signs (大衆酒場), in songs and in essays; in conversation people say 飲み屋 or 居酒屋, and バー for a Western-style bar.

presentation.defJa: おとといの前の日。三日前。
presentation.note: An everyday spoken word, almost always written in kana; in formal writing and news, 三日前 is used instead.

presentation.defJa: 少し前。さっきの丁寧な言い方。
presentation.note: The polite, business-appropriate counterpart of さっき, standard in emails, meetings and announcements; usually written 先ほど.
collocations: 先ほど申し上げたとおり

presentation.defJa: 絵や小説、音楽などの作品を作った人。
presentation.note: The neutral word for whoever made a particular work; 著者 is specifically the writer of a book, and 作家 is a writer or artist as a profession.

presentation.defJa: 文章やデータなどの一部を取り除くこと。
presentation.note: Standard for deleting text, files, posts or contract clauses; in casual computer talk 消す is the plain alternative, and 撤去 is used for physically removing objects.

presentation.defJa: 書類や計画、地図などを作り上げること。
presentation.note: Used for documents, plans, data and software, things put together on paper or screen, whereas 作製 is for physically making objects; 作成 is by far the more common of the two.

presentation.defJa: 道具や機械を使って、形のある物を作ること。
presentation.note: Reserved for physically making things such as models, specimens, prototypes or devices; for documents and plans use 作成, and for factory-scale output 製造.

presentation.defJa: 隠れていることや分からないことを、手がかりをもとに調べようとする。
presentation.note: Implies feeling one's way toward something hidden or uncertain (causes, intentions, possibilities), while 探す and 捜す are about finding something; the literal 'grope with the hand' sense appears in ポケットを探る.

presentation.defJa: ほかの人に聞こえないように、小さな声でこっそり話す。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; besides literal whispering, the passive ささやかれる means something is quietly rumored (退任がささやかれる), a common newspaper usage.
collocations: うわさがささやかれる

presentation.defJa: 粉や液体をすくったり量ったりするための小さな道具。スプーン。
presentation.note: On its own さじ sounds old-fashioned next to スプーン, but it lives on in recipe measures (大さじ, 小さじ) and idioms such as さじを投げる (give up as hopeless) and さじ加減 (fine adjustment).

presentation.defJa: 畳を敷いた部屋。特に、客を通したり食事をしたりする和室。
presentation.note: A tatami-floored room used for receiving guests or dining, as in restaurants and inns; 和室 is the neutral real-estate term for any Japanese-style room.

presentation.defJa: ある数量から別の数量を引くこと。また、引いた後に残る数量。
presentation.note: Common in money and accounting talk for the net result once gains and losses offset each other, as in 差し引きゼロ (it evens out); the verb 差し引く means to deduct.

presentation.defJa: 新鮮な魚などを生のまま薄く切って、しょうゆなどをつけて食べる料理。
presentation.note: Sliced raw fish (or other raw foods, as in 馬刺し) served without rice, as distinct from sushi, which always involves vinegared rice.

presentation.defJa: 評判や期待のとおりで、改めて感心するようす。
presentation.note: Expresses admiration that something lives up to expectations (さすがプロだ), while さすがに adds 'even so, understandably' (さすがに疲れた); usually written in kana.

presentation.defJa: カメラで写真や映像をとること。
presentation.note: The formal word for taking photos or shooting film and video, seen on signs (撮影禁止) and in news; in conversation people simply say 写真を撮る.

presentation.defJa: 聞きたい音のじゃまになる、不快で余計な音。
presentation.note: Unwanted sound or signal interference (radio static, background noise), and figuratively outside chatter one should tune out; 騒音 is louder, disruptive noise such as traffic or construction that becomes a public nuisance.

presentation.defJa: 金属の表面が空気や水にふれて変化してできる、赤や茶色などのもの。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana in news and everyday text; figuratively, 身から出たさび means trouble one has brought on oneself.

presentation.defJa: 金属が空気や水にふれて、表面が赤茶色などに変わりもろくなる。また、技などが衰える。
presentation.note: Literally to rust, and figuratively for skills going rusty from disuse (腕がさびる); written in kana in most modern texts.

presentation.defJa: 床や畳の上に座るときに敷く、四角くて平たいクッション。
presentation.note: The square floor cushion of Japanese rooms; offering one to a guest (座布団を勧める) is basic hospitality, and the TV comedy show Shoten made 座布団一枚 a joking reward for a good quip.

presentation.defJa: 人の声や物音がうるさく、落ち着かない。また、世の中が不穏で落ち着かない。
presentation.note: Describes a noisy, restless atmosphere, usually of crowds and voices, and figuratively unsettled times (世の中が騒がしい); うるさい is the more direct, subjective complaint about noise.

presentation.defJa: 三つの角をもつ形。また、そのような形をしているもの。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a triangle or triangular shape; the mathematical figure is formally 三角形, and 三角関係 is a love triangle.

presentation.defJa: 小学校で習う、数の計算や図形などの基本的な学習。
presentation.note: The name of math in elementary school, which becomes 数学 from junior high on; also used loosely for simple calculations, as in 'it's just arithmetic'.

presentation.defJa: ある作物や品物が、多く作られたりとれたりする土地。
presentation.note: Used for farm produce and manufactured goods alike, and appears constantly in food labeling (産地表示) and phrases like 産地直送 (shipped direct from where it's produced).

presentation.defJa: 山にある林や森。また、木が育っている山の土地。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for forested mountain land, common in news on property, forestry and wildfires (山林火災); 森林 is the general ecological term for forests.

presentation.defJa: 作業がすべて終わって、物ができあがる。
presentation.note: The intransitive partner of 仕上げる, stressing the finished state and its quality (ふっくら仕上がる is common in ads and recipes); できあがる is the plainer equivalent.

presentation.meaning: three days from now (the day after the day after tomorrow)
presentation.defJa: あさっての次の日。今日から数えて三日後。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana, and because some eastern dialects swap it with やのあさって, careful speakers confirm the actual date in business.
collocations: あさってかしあさって

presentation.defJa: 自分の身や財産を、自分の力で守ること。
presentation.note: Stresses guarding oneself when outside protection is not enough, as in 自衛策 against crime or disasters; in political news it most often appears inside 自衛隊 and 自衛権.

presentation.defJa: イカなどの身や内臓を塩に漬けて、発酵させた食べ物。
presentation.note: A noun for the dish, not the taste (the adjective 'salty' is 塩辛い), and a classic accompaniment to sake or plain rice.

presentation.defJa: 塩の味が強い。しょっぱい。
presentation.note: Slightly more neutral and written than the everyday しょっぱい, which is especially common in eastern Japan.

presentation.defJa: 会議や番組、式などを進める役目。また、その役目の人。
presentation.note: Names both the role and the person (司会 or 司会者); MC (エムシー) is the casual term for parties and variety shows, while 議長 is the formal chair of a meeting or assembly.

presentation.defJa: 四つの角がある形をしている。
presentation.note: Covers both squares and rectangles in everyday speech; 正方形 and 長方形 are the precise geometric terms, and 四角 alone works as a noun.
collocations: 四角い部屋を丸く掃く

presentation.meaning: it can't be helped, there's no other way
presentation.defJa: ほかにどうすることもできない。あきらめるしかない。
presentation.note: Casual speech shortens it to しかたない or しょうがない, and after a て-form (心配で仕方がない) it means 'unbearably' rather than resignation.
collocations: 今さら言っても仕方がない
気になって仕方がない

presentation.defJa: 学校で、どの時間にどの授業をするかを決めた表。
presentation.note: Mainly for school and university class schedules; for trains or buses the word is 時刻表, and a personal plan is スケジュール or 予定.

presentation.defJa: 建物などを建てるための土地。また、ある建物が使っている土地の範囲。
presentation.note: Refers to land as the plot belonging to a building or institution, so it pairs naturally with 内 (敷地内禁煙); 土地 is the general word for land.

presentation.meaning: to lay out, spread (a futon, mat, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 布団やマットなどを、床の上に平らに広げて置く。
presentation.note: Literally for laying futons, mats or gravel flat on a surface, and figuratively for putting systems in place (体制を敷く); 広げる is the general word for spreading something open.

presentation.defJa: 草や木の葉や枝が、たくさん伸びて重なり合う。
presentation.note: Used only for plants growing densely; 生い茂る is a more vivid, slightly literary compound for luxuriant overgrowth.

presentation.defJa: 自分で品物などを持って行くこと。また、持って来ること。
presentation.note: A slightly formal word favored in notices and instructions (筆記用具を持参のこと), where everyday speech would say 持ってくる or 持っていく.

presentation.defJa: 鉄を引きつける性質を持つ物体。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a magnet, including fridge magnets; 磁気 and 磁力 name the property and the force, and 方位磁石 or コンパス is a compass.

presentation.meaning: constantly, all the time; from start to finish
presentation.defJa: 初めから終わりまで、ずっと。いつも。
presentation.note: A somewhat written or older-sounding adverb for 'constantly'; in speech いつも or ずっと are more common, and as a noun it survives mainly in 一部始終 'the whole story'.
collocations: 始終にこにこしている

presentation.defJa: 先生に教わらず、自分で勉強すること。
presentation.note: In Japanese schools 自習 also means a period with no teacher where pupils work on their own; 独学 is broader, meaning teaching oneself a subject with no school at all.

presentation.defJa: 騒がしかった音や気持ちなどが、落ち着いて静かになる。
presentation.note: Intransitive partner of 静める, describing noise, crowds, wind or emotions settling down; 静まり返る intensifies it to 'fall dead silent'.

presentation.defJa: 物理学や化学、生物学など、自然の仕組みを研究する学問。
presentation.note: The standard academic term, contrasted with 人文科学 (humanities) and 社会科学 (social sciences); 理系 is the casual label for students and fields on this side.

presentation.defJa: 一時間に進む距離で表した速さ。
presentation.note: Placed before the number (時速60キロ), unlike English 'per hour', which follows it; 分速 and 秒速 are the per-minute and per-second counterparts.

presentation.defJa: ある人の子や孫、さらにその後に続く血筋の人々。
presentation.note: Means all later generations of a line, not only one's children; the opposite is 祖先 or 先祖, and 子孫を残す is also the standard biology phrase for animals producing offspring.

presentation.defJa: 死んだ人や動物の体。
presentation.note: The plain, clinical word for a dead body, standard in police and legal language (死体遺棄, 死体解剖); news about victims of accidents or disasters uses the respectful 遺体, and an animal's remains are usually 死骸.

presentation.defJa: 清書する前に、ためしに書いておくもの。
presentation.note: Used for drafts of writing and for preliminary sketches in drawing; 草稿 and 草案 are more formal words for manuscripts and proposals, and email apps label unsent messages 下書き.

presentation.defJa: 自分が住んでいる家。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly formal word common in news and official language; 家 or うち is everyday speech, and 自宅 stresses one's own residence as opposed to the office or a hospital.

presentation.defJa: 都市の中で、昔から商人や職人が多く住んできた、庶民的な地域。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 山の手, the higher residential districts, and carries warm connotations of a down-to-earth, close-knit community rather than a city's business center.

presentation.defJa: 地域や団体が、自分たちのことを自分たちで決めて治めること。
presentation.note: Appears constantly in compounds such as 自治体 (local government body) and 自治会 (neighborhood association); 自立 is personal independence, whereas 自治 is collective self-rule.

presentation.meaning: room-, indoor (as in indoors, room temperature)
presentation.defJa: 「部屋の」「部屋の中の」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Attaches to Sino-Japanese words to mean 'room' or 'indoor', as in 室内, 室温 and 室外機; as a suffix the same kanji names or counts rooms (会議室, 三室).

presentation.defJa: 実際に体験して、本当にそうだと強く感じること。また、その気持ち。
presentation.note: Highlights a feeling grounded in direct experience, often in the negative (まだ実感がわかない 'it hasn't sunk in yet'); 感じる is the plain verb without that sense of lived reality.

presentation.defJa: 学んだ知識や技術を、実際の現場で使いながら身につけること。
presentation.note: Hands-on training that is part of a course of study, such as 教育実習 for student teachers; 研修 often refers to training for people already employed, and 練習 is general practice or drills.

presentation.defJa: これまでに実際にあげてきた成果。
presentation.note: Common in business and hiring for a proven record of results; 成績 is grades or performance over a period, and 業績 is a company's earnings or a scholar's achievements.

presentation.meaning: the real thing, the actual object
presentation.defJa: 写真や模型などではない、本当のもの。
presentation.note: Contrasts the actual object with a photo, model or description; 本物 is the everyday counterpart that also means 'genuine' as opposed to fake.

presentation.defJa: 実際の生活や仕事に、役に立てて使うこと。
presentation.note: Usually appears in compounds like 実用化 (bringing into practical use) and 実用的; 応用 means applying a principle to a new field rather than everyday usefulness.

presentation.defJa: 実際にあった例。本当に起きたことや、実際に使われたものから取った例。
presentation.note: Stresses that the example is real or attested rather than invented; 例 is the neutral word, and 事例 is preferred for cases studied in business, law or medicine.

presentation.defJa: 好きな人に気持ちを受け入れてもらえなかったり、恋人と別れたりすること。
presentation.note: Covers both unrequited love and being left by a partner; it works as a suru-verb (失恋する) and appears in everyday talk, songs and advice columns alike.

presentation.defJa: 国や公共の機関ではなく、民間の会社が経営する鉄道。
presentation.note: Contrasts with JR (formerly the state-run 国鉄) and municipal subways; 私鉄沿線 is a common phrase in housing ads and writing about suburban life.

presentation.meaning: to tie, bind (with string or rope); to restrict
presentation.defJa: ひもや縄などを巻きつけて、ほどけないように結ぶ。また、自由に動けないようにする。
presentation.note: Literally to tie something up, but very often used in the passive (規則に縛られる, 時間に縛られない) for being constrained; 結ぶ means to tie a knot or join, without the sense of restraint.

presentation.meaning: ground, subsoil (as a foundation); support base
presentation.defJa: 建物などを支える土地の表面やその下の土の層。また、活動の基礎となる勢力の範囲。
presentation.note: In science and construction it is the ground as a foundation (how firm the soil is), while in politics it means a politician's support base (選挙地盤); 地面 is just the visible surface you walk on.

presentation.meaning: to deflate, sink; to wither (of flowers)
presentation.defJa: ふくらんでいたものや、咲いていた花が、小さく縮んで力をなくす。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; used for flowers wilting, balloons deflating, and in news for hopes or demand fading (期待がしぼむ), whereas 枯れる means a plant has died and dried up.

presentation.meaning: to wring, squeeze; to narrow down
presentation.defJa: 強くねじったり押したりして、中の水分を出す。また、範囲や数を小さくまとめる。
presentation.note: Covers wringing cloth and squeezing fruit (where 搾る is also written for extracting juice or milk), and figuratively narrowing down (対象を絞る) or racking one's brains (知恵を絞る).

presentation.defJa: 細長い筋が何本も並んでできた模様。
presentation.note: Often appears in compounds such as 縞模様, 横縞 and 縦縞 (stripes in clothing); ストライプ is the trendier loanword in fashion writing.

presentation.defJa: 名字と名前を合わせたもの。書類などで使うかたい言い方。
presentation.note: The formal word for full name seen on forms, ballots and official documents; in conversation people say 名前 or politely お名前, while forms addressed to customers sometimes use ご氏名.

presentation.defJa: 申し込みや提出などを受け付ける最後の日や時刻。
presentation.note: This okurigana-less spelling is typical of notices, forms and headings (応募締切, 締切日); in running prose 締め切り is the more standard spelling, and both are read しめきり.

presentation.defJa: 仕事や書類などを出さなければならない最後の期限。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a deadline in work and school; 期限 is broader (expiry dates, time limits), and 納期 is a delivery deadline in business.

presentation.meaning: to close (applications, entries, sales) at a deadline or when full
presentation.defJa: 申し込みなどの受け付けを、期限が来たり定員に達したりしたところで終わりにする。
presentation.note: Used for closing applications, reservations or ticket sales once a deadline or capacity is reached; for shutting doors and windows tight, the usual modern spelling is 閉め切る (閉め切った部屋), and the noun 締め切り is the everyday word for deadline.

presentation.defJa: 土やアスファルトなど、地上の表面。人が立ったり歩いたりするところ。
presentation.note: The plain everyday word for the surface underfoot; 地盤 is the ground as a structural foundation, and 大地 is a grander, more literary word for the earth.

presentation.defJa: 経済学や政治学、社会学など、人間の社会の仕組みを研究する学問をまとめた呼び方。
presentation.note: An umbrella term set against 自然科学 (natural sciences) and 人文科学 (humanities); it appears mostly in academic, university and policy contexts.

presentation.defJa: 水道の管の先についていて、ひねったり押したりして水を出したり止めたりする器具。
presentation.note: The ordinary word for a tap or faucet in homes and public places; 水道 refers to the water supply system or tap water itself, as in 水道水.

presentation.defJa: 足りないところや劣っているところ。攻められると負けやすい部分。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly analytical word used for people, teams, systems and products; 短所 refers more to personal shortcomings, and 欠点 to defects or faults.

presentation.defJa: 自動車や電車などを入れておく建物や場所。
presentation.note: Means a garage for keeping vehicles and also a depot for buses and trains; ガレージ is the loanword favored for private homes, and 車庫入れ is the everyday term for reversing a car into a space.

presentation.defJa: 列車やバスに乗って、案内や安全の確認、切符の点検などをする係の人。
presentation.note: Refers to the crew member who handles doors, announcements and tickets, as distinct from the driver (運転士); in casual speech it often appears as 車掌さん.

presentation.defJa: 景色や物などを実際に見ながら、そのとおりに絵に描くこと。
presentation.note: Drawing or painting from direct observation, strongly associated with school outings and with the realist ideal in modern haiku; スケッチ is the looser loanword for quick drawings.

presentation.defJa: 新聞社などが、その会社の意見として出す論説の記事。
presentation.note: Specifically the unsigned editorial expressing a newspaper's institutional stance; a signed opinion column is a コラム, and 論説 is the broader term for editorial commentary.

presentation.defJa: 車の軸についていて、回ることで車を進ませる輪。
presentation.note: The general word for a wheel on carts, trains and machinery; for cars people usually say タイヤ or ホイール, and 車輪の再発明 (reinventing the wheel) is a common idiom in tech writing.

presentation.defJa: 音が同じ言葉や似た言葉を使って、人を笑わせる気の利いた言い方。
presentation.note: Because 洒 is not a standard-use kanji, newspapers write it in kana; しゃれにならない (it's no joke) is a very common expression, and the related おしゃれ means stylish.

presentation.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、目方や負担が大きい、程度がはなはだしい、規模が大きいという意味を加える。
presentation.note: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns with the on-reading じゅう (重工業, 重装備, 重症), conveying weight or seriousness; the opposite prefix is 軽～ (軽工業, 軽症).

presentation.defJa: 人が住むための家や建物。住んでいる場所。
presentation.note: A formal or technical word used in history, statistics and law (住居侵入, 住居費); in everyday speech people say 家 or 住まい, and 住宅 refers to housing as buildings or a market.

presentation.defJa: 料金や会費などのお金を、払う人のところを回って集めること。
presentation.note: Typically means going around in person to collect fees such as dues, subscriptions or bills; 徴収 is the more official term for levying taxes or charges.

presentation.meaning: gathering, assembling (at a set place and time)
presentation.defJa: 人やものが、決まった場所に一つに集まること。また、数学で、ある条件に合うものの集まり。
presentation.note: Common in schedules and instructions (集合時間, 現地集合) for meeting at a set place; 集まる is the plain verb, and in mathematics 集合 means a set.

presentation.defJa: 筆や鉛筆で、字を正しく美しく書けるように練習すること。
presentation.note: Refers to calligraphy as a lesson or school subject for practicing neat handwriting, while 書道 treats it as an art form or discipline; お習字 is the soft, child-oriented form.

presentation.defJa: 建物や道具などの壊れたところや傷んだところを直すこと。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word used especially for buildings, roads and household items; 修理 is more general and common for machines and cars, and 補修 suggests patching partial damage.

presentation.defJa: 電車やバスなどが最後に着く駅や停留所。また、物事の終わるところ。
presentation.note: The last stop of a train or bus route, also used figuratively for the endpoint of a process; 終着駅 is the more lyrical word, and 起点 is the opposite (starting point).

presentation.defJa: 特に大切だとして、力を入れるところ。
presentation.note: Used in policy, business and study contexts (重点を置く, 重点的に), and differs from 要点, which is the gist or main point of a text or argument.

presentation.meaning: assumption of office, taking up a post
presentation.defJa: ある役職や地位に新しくつくこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for taking up a public or corporate post, common in news; the opposite is 退任 or 辞任, while 着任 is used more for arriving at an assigned post, such as a teacher or diplomat.

presentation.defJa: 会社で、経営にかかわる重要な地位についている人。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned everyday word for board-level executives (取締役 and 役員 are the official terms); 重役出勤 jokingly describes someone strolling in late like a boss.

presentation.defJa: 続いていた物事が終わること。また、終えること。
presentation.note: A formal Sino-Japanese word for the official end of an event, service or process, typical of signs and announcements; 終わり is the everyday word, and 完了 stresses that a task has been completed.

presentation.defJa: 地球などの天体が、物をその中心に向かって引きつける力。
presentation.note: The everyday and scientific word for gravity as a force we feel; 引力 is the more general physics term for attraction between masses, as in 万有引力.

presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の漢字が結びついて、一つの言葉になったもの。
presentation.note: In Japanese schooling it mainly means a multi-kanji compound word (四字熟語 for four-character idioms), whereas an idiom in the English figurative sense is closer to 慣用句; in English classes, though, 熟語 also covers set phrases such as 'look after'.

presentation.defJa: 国が法律で定めた、記念やお祝いのための休みの日。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to official public holidays set by law; 休日 is any day off including weekends, and 祭日 is an older near-synonym still heard in speech.

presentation.defJa: 入学や資格を得るための試験を受けること。
presentation.note: Strongly tied to school entrance exams and the whole culture around them (受験生, 受験戦争); for simply sitting a test, 試験を受ける is the plain phrasing.

presentation.defJa: 文の中で、動作をする人や物、ある状態にある人や物を表す部分。
presentation.note: A grammar term from language classes and style guides that has also entered online slang: 主語が大きい criticizes someone for generalizing about a whole group.

presentation.defJa: 妻がほかの人に対して自分の夫を指して言う言葉。また、店や家の主。
presentation.note: Used by a wife for her own husband (ご主人 for someone else's), but many now find it dated because of its 'master' nuance and prefer 夫; it also still means the owner of a shop or inn.

presentation.defJa: 文の中で、主語がどうするか、どんなようすかを表す部分。
presentation.note: A grammar term almost always paired with 主語 in school and in writing guides; in Japanese it covers the verb, adjective, or noun plus だ that closes a clause.

presentation.defJa: 仕事のために、ふだんの職場を離れてほかの土地へ行くこと。
presentation.note: The standard word for travel on company business; in 出張サービス or 出張修理 it instead means a service that comes to the customer's home.

presentation.defJa: 劇や映画などで、物語の中心となる役。また、その役を演じる人。
presentation.note: Used for the lead in a play or film and, figuratively, for whoever is the center of attention (今日の主役 at a birthday party); 主人公 is the main character within the story rather than the role or the actor.

presentation.defJa: 電話機で、耳に当てて相手の声を聞き、口に向けて話す部分。
presentation.note: Refers to the handset of a landline phone, so it now sounds a little dated; with smartphones people simply say 電話に出る or 電話を切る.

presentation.defJa: 警察官の階級の中でいちばん下の位。また、その位の警察官。
presentation.note: Strictly the lowest police rank, typically the officers who staff a 交番; in casual speech people say お巡りさん, and 警察官 or 警官 is the general term.

presentation.meaning: in order, in turn, one after another
presentation.defJa: 一つずつ、順番にしたがって次へ移っていくようす。
presentation.note: Almost always used as 順々に and a little softer and more descriptive than 順番に; 次々に stresses rapid succession rather than orderly sequence.

presentation.defJa: 心がすなおで、けがれを知らないこと。特に、恋愛についてうぶなこと。
presentation.note: Describes an innocent, unworldly heart, usually in matters of love and often with a nostalgic or gently teasing tone; 純粋 is broader and can describe substances, motives or abstract qualities.

presentation.defJa: ほかのものがまじっていないこと。また、気持ちにうそや計算がないこと。
presentation.note: Covers both physical purity (純粋なアルコール) and sincere, uncalculating motives, and 純粋に is common as an adverb meaning 'simply, purely'; 純情 is narrower and refers to innocence of heart.

presentation.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、はじめての、いちばん先の、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Read しょ in established Sino-Japanese compounds such as 初対面, 初期 and 初日, whereas はつ is used for a first event or experience, as in 初雪 or 初出場.

presentation.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、多くの、いろいろな、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A formal prefix found in news and official writing (諸国, 諸費用, 諸説); in speech the same idea is usually expressed with いろいろな or さまざまな.

presentation.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、おんなの人であることを表す。
presentation.note: Read じょ in Sino-Japanese words such as 女子, 女優, 女王 and 女流 (but おんな in native words like 女心); in sports and schools 女子 is the neutral label for women's events and girls.

presentation.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、むだをはぶいて少なくする、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A productive prefix meaning 'using less of', heard mostly in 省エネ, 省スペース and 省力化; do not confuse it with the noun 省 meaning a government ministry, as in 外務省.

presentation.defJa: 食べた物を胃や腸で分解して、体に吸収しやすい形に変えること。
presentation.note: Primarily physical digestion, but also common figuratively for absorbing knowledge or working through a schedule or allowance, as in 有給を消化する.

presentation.defJa: 小学校に通っている子ども。
presentation.note: The standard word for a pupil in grades one to six; 児童 is the formal term used in official and school documents.

presentation.defJa: 盤の上で駒を動かし、相手の王を取り合う日本の伝統的なゲーム。
presentation.note: Note the verb 指す (go stones are 打つ instead), and 将棋倒し figuratively describes people toppling over one after another like a row of pieces.

presentation.defJa: 液体が熱などによって気体になったもの。特に、水が気体になったもの。
presentation.note: The general and technical word for steam as a gas or source of power; the visible white mist rising from hot water or food is usually called 湯気 in daily life.

presentation.defJa: まっすぐな線を引いたり、長さを測ったりするための細長い道具。
presentation.note: Strictly a straightedge for drawing lines (物差し is the measuring stick, though the two overlap in daily use), and 杓子定規 figuratively means applying rules rigidly.

presentation.defJa: 学年や段階、程度などが上であること。
presentation.note: Ranks a level or course above 初級 and 中級, and 上級生 means older students at school; in the civil service, 上級 can also mean senior rank.

presentation.defJa: 品物を売り買いして、利益を得る仕事。
presentation.note: A formal, categorical word for commerce as a sector, alongside 工業 and 農業; 商売 is the everyday word for running a business or trade.

presentation.defJa: 競技やコンテストで、成績のよかった人に与えられるお金。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to money won in a contest or offered as a reward; 賞品 is a prize in kind, and 報奨金 is a bonus paid for an achievement or a tip-off.

presentation.defJa: 木の枠に薄い和紙をはった、日本の引き戸。
presentation.note: Shoji use translucent paper that lets light through, whereas 襖 (ふすま) are covered in opaque paper and divide rooms; the saying 壁に耳あり障子に目あり warns that someone is always listening.

presentation.defJa: 外国との売り買いなど、商品の取引を主な仕事とする会社。
presentation.note: Refers to Japanese-style trading houses; 総合商社 are the giant conglomerates that deal in almost everything, while 専門商社 specialize in one field such as steel or textiles.

presentation.meaning: boarding, getting on (a train, bus or car)
presentation.defJa: 電車やバス、車などに乗ること。
presentation.note: A formal word used in railway and bus announcements and signage (ご乗車ありがとうございます); in conversation people simply say 乗る, and the opposite is 下車 or 降車.

presentation.meaning: first ten days of a month; early (in the month)
presentation.defJa: 月の初めの十日間。一日から十日まで。
presentation.note: Part of the set 上旬・中旬・下旬 that divides a month into three roughly ten-day periods, standard in forecasts and business schedules; 初旬 means the same but sounds a little more literary.
collocations: 上旬から中旬にかけて

presentation.defJa: 0.5や1.25のように、点を使って一より小さい部分を表す数。
presentation.note: Means a decimal such as 0.5; do not confuse it with the homophone 少数 (a small number, a minority), and 分数 is a fraction written with a numerator and denominator.

presentation.meaning: to arise, occur; to give rise to
presentation.defJa: 物事が新しく起こる。また、起こす。
presentation.note: A formal, written-style variant of 生じる found in legal texts and official documents; 生じる is the more common form in everyday writing, and both describe something arising rather than being deliberately made.

presentation.defJa: 薬や熱などを使って、病気のもとになる菌やウイルスを害のない状態にすること。
presentation.note: The everyday word for disinfecting hands, wounds and surfaces; 殺菌 stresses killing bacteria and appears on product labels, while 除菌 is a looser marketing term for reducing germs.

presentation.meaning: victory or defeat; the outcome (of a contest)
presentation.defJa: 勝つことと負けること。戦いや試合の結果。
presentation.note: A written-style noun for the result of a contest, win or loss; unlike 勝負 it does not mean the match itself, so you say 勝敗が決まる but 勝負をする.

presentation.defJa: 品がよく、落ち着いていて美しいようす。
presentation.note: Praises refinement in taste, manners or appearance and is the opposite of 下品 (vulgar); compared with エレガント it suggests restraint and modesty rather than glamour.

presentation.defJa: 勝ち負けを争うこと。また、その戦い。
presentation.note: Refers to the contest itself or the act of competing (勝負する), and in casual speech to a decisive moment (ここが勝負だ); 勝敗 is the more formal word for just the outcome.

presentation.defJa: 体の中のいらない水分が、尿として外に出されたもの。また、それを出すこと。
presentation.note: A blunt, colloquial word; in polite or medical contexts people say 尿 or お手洗いに行く, and with children おしっこ is the usual word.

presentation.defJa: 火事を消したり、急病人を救急車で運んだりする仕事の拠点となる、自治体の機関。
presentation.note: Names the local fire station and its unit; the fire service as a whole is 消防, its members are 消防士, and 119 calls go to a central dispatch center rather than to the station itself.

presentation.meaning: net (amount); actual amount, after removing extras
presentation.defJa: 入れ物や余分なものを除いた、中身だけの量。実際の分。
presentation.note: Means the net or actual amount once packaging, padding or wasted time is removed, and is common in casual speech (正味三十分); in Kansai slang it is also used as an adverb meaning 'honestly'.

presentation.defJa: 講座や試験などで、学ぶ内容がいちばんやさしいレベル。
presentation.note: One of the levels 初級・中級・上級 used for courses, exams and skills; 初心者 refers to the person who is a beginner, while 初級 names the level.

presentation.meaning: assistant professor (former title, now associate professor)
presentation.defJa: 大学で、教授の次の位の先生を指した、以前の呼び名。
presentation.note: An older title replaced by 准教授 in 2007, so it now appears mainly in older texts, fiction and the speech of older people; 助教 is a different, lower-ranked post created at the same time.
collocations: 助教授から教授になる

presentation.defJa: 料理などに使う、白くて細かい塩。
presentation.note: A slightly technical word used in science, on nutrition labels (食塩相当量) and in recipes that give precise amounts; in the kitchen people usually just say 塩.

presentation.defJa: 自分の手と技術を使って、物を作る仕事をする人。
presentation.note: Stresses hands-on skill honed through long experience, as in traditional crafts, carpentry or sushi; 匠 is a more elevated word for a master craftsman, and 職人気質 (しょくにんかたぎ) describes a perfectionist, uncompromising temperament.

presentation.meaning: first ten days of a month; early (in the month)
presentation.defJa: その月の初めの十日ほどの間。月の初め。
presentation.note: Means the same as 上旬, the first ten days of a month, but has a slightly more literary feel and is common in news and seasonal writing, while business schedules tend to use 上旬.
collocations: 初旬から中旬にかけて

presentation.defJa: 印刷して出版された本。また、本をまとめていう言葉。
presentation.note: A formal, collective word for books as publications, used in business, libraries and the publishing trade; in everyday speech people say 本.

presentation.defJa: 食事のときに使う、皿やおわん、はしなどの道具。
presentation.note: A general term for the plates, bowls, cups and chopsticks used for eating; 皿 is a single plate, and 器 (うつわ) is a more aesthetic word favored when talking about ceramics.

presentation.defJa: 本や雑誌を売る店。
presentation.note: A slightly more formal word for a bookstore than 本屋, used in news, signage and store names; 本屋 is the everyday conversational word and can also mean the person who runs one.

presentation.defJa: 筆と墨を使って、文字を美しく書く芸術。
presentation.note: Refers to calligraphy as an art and discipline, with 道 suggesting a path of training like 茶道 or 華道; 習字 is the school subject of practicing neat handwriting with a brush.

presentation.defJa: 物事を習い始めたばかりの、いちばん基本的な段階。
presentation.note: Means the very first, most basic stage of learning something, and 初歩的 often criticizes a basic mistake (初歩的なミス); 基礎 refers to the foundation everything else rests on, not just the starting point.

presentation.defJa: 年をとるなどして白くなった髪の毛。
presentation.note: The everyday word for grey or white hair; the Sino-Japanese reading はくはつ is literary and describes a head of fully white hair, as in 白髪の老人.

presentation.defJa: 互いに相手のことを知っている人。友人ほど親しくない場合にも使う。
presentation.note: A neutral word for someone you know, weaker than 友達 (friend); 顔見知り is looser still, meaning someone you merely recognize by sight.

presentation.defJa: 国や都道府県、市などではなく、個人や民間の団体が作って運営していること。
presentation.note: Means privately founded and run, the opposite of 公立 and 国立; because it sounds the same as 市立 (city-run), people often say わたくしりつ for clarity.

presentation.defJa: 物からしみ出た水分。また、だしなどに味をつけた、水分の多い料理。
presentation.note: On its own it usually means liquid that oozes or is squeezed from food (レモンの汁, 肉から出る汁); the soup sense lives mainly in compounds such as 味噌汁 and 汁物, and おつゆ is a softer spoken word for soup.

presentation.defJa: その仕事や分野を専門にしていない人。経験の浅い人。
presentation.note: Means a non-professional or layperson and is often used modestly about oneself (素人ですが); the opposite is 玄人 (くろうと) or プロ, and アマチュア is the neutral loanword for hobbyists in sports and the arts.

presentation.defJa: 物の中心にある部分。ろうそくや鉛筆の中の部分のほか、体の奥深いところも指す。
presentation.note: Literally the hard center of something (an apple core, pencil lead, a candle wick), and figuratively a person's inner strength, as in 芯が強い 'strong-willed'; 体の芯まで means 'to the bone.'

presentation.defJa: 日本の主要な都市を高速で結ぶ鉄道。
presentation.note: The everyday word for Japan's high-speed rail network; 'bullet train' is an English nickname, and Japanese speakers simply say 新幹線 for both the line and the train.

presentation.defJa: 空気などの物質がまったくない空間の状態。
presentation.note: Used in physics and also in everyday product terms such as 真空パック 'vacuum-packed' food and 真空断熱 'vacuum-insulated' bottles.

presentation.defJa: 会社や組織で、社員の採用や配置、評価などに関すること。
presentation.note: In business Japanese it covers hiring, transfers and evaluations; the same characters read ひとごと are an older spelling of 他人事 'someone else's business,' so the reading matters.

presentation.defJa: 本当だと思って疑わない。また、相手を頼りにする。
presentation.note: A literary, formal variant of 信じる found in speeches, essays and set phrases such as 信ずるに足る 'worthy of belief'; in conversation 信じる is the normal form.

presentation.defJa: 自然のものではなく、人の手で作られたこと。
presentation.note: Mostly used as the first element of compounds such as 人造湖 and 人造人間; in general use 人工 is the more common word for 'artificial' (人工知能, 人工衛星).

presentation.defJa: 寝るための台。特に列車などで横になって眠れる設備。
presentation.note: Today it appears almost only in railway and ship terms like 寝台列車 and 寝台車; for an ordinary bed at home Japanese uses ベッド.

presentation.defJa: 医者が体を調べて、病気があるかどうかやその状態を判断すること。
presentation.note: Primarily medical, but widely extended to machines and systems (故障診断, 経営診断) and even personality quizzes (性格診断).

presentation.defJa: 歴史・文学・哲学など、人間の文化や思想を研究する学問。
presentation.note: Strictly 'the humanities' (history, literature, philosophy), distinct from 社会科学 'social sciences' and 自然科学 'natural sciences'; often shortened to 人文, as in 人文系.

presentation.defJa: 人の命。特に、事故や災害などで守るべき命として言う。
presentation.note: A formal, news-register word used for accidents, disasters and safety; in ordinary speech people say 命 or 人の命.

presentation.meaning: late at night, the middle of the night
presentation.defJa: 夜がすっかりふけた時間。夜中。
presentation.note: Refers to the hours around midnight and after, later and more formal-sounding than 夜遅く; common in 深夜番組, 深夜料金 and 深夜バス.

presentation.defJa: 血のつながりや結婚によってつながっている人々。親戚。
presentation.note: Means the same as 親戚 but sounds slightly more formal or old-fashioned; 親戚 is far more common in everyday conversation.

presentation.meaning: course, heading (of a ship or aircraft); direction
presentation.defJa: 船や飛行機が進んでいく方向。また、物事が進むべき方向。
presentation.note: Originally the compass heading of a ship or plane (針 is the compass needle) and figuratively a nation's or company's direction; do not confuse it with the homophone 進路, used for paths, typhoon tracks and career choices.

presentation.defJa: 神々や世界の始まりなどについて、昔から語り伝えられてきた物語。
presentation.note: Besides literal myths, news writing often uses it for an unquestioned belief that proves false, as in 安全神話 'the myth of safety' or 不敗神話 'an aura of invincibility.'

presentation.defJa: 海や川でとれる魚や貝、海藻などの産物。また、それをとったり育てたりする産業。
presentation.note: Almost always appears in compounds (水産業, 水産物, 水産加工) in economic and administrative contexts; 漁業 refers more narrowly to fishing itself.

presentation.defJa: 食事を作ること。煮たり焼いたりする台所の仕事。
presentation.note: Refers to the household chore of preparing meals rather than cooking as a craft (料理); typical in 炊事場 at campsites and the pairing 炊事洗濯 'cooking and laundry.'

presentation.defJa: 水が熱などによって気体になったもの。
presentation.note: The scientific term for water in gaseous form; the visible white 'steam' from a kettle or bath is 湯気, which is actually condensed droplets.

presentation.defJa: 最も軽い元素で、燃えると水になる気体。
presentation.note: Common in science and energy news (水素社会, 水素ステーション); the element names 酸素 and 窒素 follow the same ～素 pattern.

presentation.defJa: はっきりした証拠はないが、手がかりをもとにおしはかって決めること。
presentation.note: A formal word common in news and science for estimates reasoned from evidence (推定人口, 死亡推定時刻), firmer than the looser guess 推測; in law it means a legal presumption.

presentation.defJa: 飲み物を入れて持ち歩くための入れ物。
presentation.note: Covers any refillable drink container, from a child's school flask to an insulated steel bottle, unlike ペットボトル, a disposable plastic bottle.

presentation.defJa: 見たことや感じたことを、自由な形で書いた文章。エッセー。
presentation.note: A slightly literary word for the personal-essay genre; エッセイ is the everyday loanword, while 論文 and 小論文 denote argumentative or academic essays.

presentation.defJa: 物や体の中に含まれている水。
presentation.note: Means 'water content' in food, soil or the body; 水分をとる is the standard health phrase for staying hydrated, where 水を飲む sounds more literal.

presentation.defJa: 静かな水の面のように、どちらにも傾かず平らであること。
presentation.note: The everyday and technical word for 'horizontal' or 'level,' paired with 垂直 'vertical'; figurative uses include 水平思考 'lateral thinking' and 水平分業 'horizontal division of labor.'

presentation.defJa: 海の遠くで、空と海面が接して見える線。
presentation.note: Strictly the line where sea meets sky; the horizon over land is 地平線, a distinction English does not make.

presentation.defJa: 池や川、海などの水のおもて。
presentation.note: Read すいめん in ordinary prose, while みなも is a poetic reading; 水面下で 'beneath the surface' is a common news idiom for behind-the-scenes negotiations.

presentation.defJa: 一週間のうち、火曜の次で木曜の前の日。
presentation.note: A clipped form of 水曜日, common in schedules, signs and casual speech (毎週水曜, 水曜定休); the full form is used in more careful speech.

presentation.defJa: 人の迷惑を気にせず、自分の都合ばかり考えてふるまうようす。厚かましい。
presentation.note: Strongly critical and conversational, sometimes written in kana as ずうずうしい; 厚かましい is a close synonym and the one used in the polite self-effacing phrase 厚かましいお願いですが.

presentation.defJa: きょうだいの中でいちばん後に生まれた子。
presentation.note: An everyday, warm-sounding word, often used with stereotypes about personality (末っ子気質); the eldest child is 一番上の子, and an only child is 一人っ子.

presentation.defJa: 動物や植物などを、絵や写真を使って種類ごとに説明した本。
presentation.note: Not a 'picture book' in the storybook sense (that is 絵本) but an illustrated encyclopedia organized by species or category.

presentation.defJa: 油断して、注意や守りがゆるんだところ。また、物と物のあいだのわずかな空き。
presentation.note: Means the opening that carelessness creates for an opponent or criminal, whereas 油断 is the careless state itself; the physical sense of a narrow gap usually appears as 隙間.

presentation.defJa: 日本の山に多く、まっすぐ高く伸びる針葉樹。木材として家などに使われる。
presentation.note: Japan's most widely planted timber tree, so the word turns up constantly in spring news about hay fever (杉花粉), usually alongside 檜 (Japanese cypress).

presentation.defJa: 物事、特に食べ物について、喜んで受け入れるものと受け付けないものがあること。また、その好みの偏り。
presentation.note: Most often about food, where 好き嫌いが多い means a picky eater, but it also covers taste in people and things generally.

presentation.defJa: 人によって好みがそれぞれ違うこと。
presentation.note: Used almost only as a predicate (〜は好き好きだ) to close an argument about taste, close to 人それぞれ, and famous from the proverb 蓼食う虫も好き好き (there's no accounting for taste).
collocations: 人には好き好きがある

presentation.defJa: 光がよく通って、向こう側や中がはっきり見える。
presentation.note: A vivid native verb for water, glass or skin that light passes through, also used for clear voices; 透明な is the more neutral, technical adjective.

presentation.defJa: どんなに少なく見積もっても。最低でも。
presentation.note: Sets a minimum (at least seven hours) or limits a claim to what is certain (少なくとも私は = I, for one); せめて differs in expressing a wish for that minimum.

presentation.defJa: 点や線、面などで作られた形。三角形や円など。
presentation.note: The standard term in math class and design for shapes defined by points and lines; 形 is the everyday word for any shape or form.

presentation.defJa: 中に小さな玉が入っていて、振ると音が鳴る丸い道具。
presentation.note: A small round bell with a rattling pellet inside, as on shrine ropes, cats' collars and hiking packs; a large hanging bell such as a temple bell is 鐘 (かね).

presentation.meaning: to cool off, enjoy the cool air
presentation.defJa: 暑いときに、日陰や風の通る所へ行って、暑さをしのぐ。
presentation.note: Means deliberately going somewhere cool, such as shade, a riverbank or an air-conditioned shop, to escape the heat; the related noun 夕涼み is cooling off outdoors on a summer evening.

presentation.meaning: open, receptive, honest; (of a child) obedient
presentation.defJa: ひねくれたところがなく、人の言うことや自分の気持ちをそのまま受け入れるようす。
presentation.note: Praises openness and a lack of stubbornness or pretense rather than mere obedience (従順); 素直になれない is the common way of admitting that pride gets in the way.

presentation.defJa: 物事を考えたり判断したりする力。また、そのような力を持つ優れた人。
presentation.note: More formal than 頭 and refers to intellect or to a person prized for it (チームの頭脳 = the team's brains), while the physical organ is 脳.

presentation.defJa: 数量や関係がひと目でわかるようにまとめたグラフや表など。
presentation.note: A formal umbrella term for charts, graphs and tables together, typical of reports, papers and textbooks; in conversation people just say グラフ or 表.

presentation.meaning: home, dwelling; place where one lives
presentation.defJa: 人が暮らしている家や場所。
presentation.note: Softer and a little more refined than 家, and far less stiff than the official 住居; common in real-estate ads and polite questions such as お住まいはどちらですか.
collocations: お住まいはどちらですか

presentation.defJa: 土俵の中で二人が組み合い、相手を倒すか外に出せば勝ちとなる日本の伝統的な競技。
presentation.note: Note the verb: one 相撲を取る rather than する; 大相撲 means the professional tournaments, while 相撲 alone also covers amateur and children's bouts.

presentation.defJa: 自分だけ得をしようとして、正しくないやり方をするようす。
presentation.note: Ranges from a child's protest ("No fair!") to criticism of underhanded tactics, and is almost always written in kana; 狡猾 is the stiff written equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 物の長さや幅、高さなどの大きさ。
presentation.note: The standard word for measured dimensions in carpentry, sewing and furniture, where サイズ is the casual loanword; in speech 〜という寸法だ can also mean "that's the plan."

presentation.defJa: 港や空港で、国に出入りする荷物を調べ、税金を取る役所。
presentation.note: The customs authority and checkpoint at ports and airports; 関税, with the characters reversed, is the duty itself, an easy pair to confuse.

presentation.meaning: production (of a film, program or artwork)
presentation.defJa: 映画や番組、美術品などの作品を作ること。
presentation.note: Used for creative works such as films, programs and artworks, whereas the homophone 製作 leans toward manufacturing goods or, in film, the financing side.

presentation.defJa: 子どもから大人になる途中の、十代から二十歳前後の若い人たち。
presentation.note: An official, somewhat bureaucratic term for people from their early teens to around twenty, frequent in laws, policy and news; 若者 is the everyday equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 0と、それに1ずつ足したり引いたりしてできる数。小数や分数を含まない。
presentation.note: The math term for whole numbers including zero and negatives, distinct from 自然数 (positive whole numbers) and 小数 (decimals).

presentation.defJa: 生きていること。危険な状況でも生き残ること。
presentation.note: Means staying alive, especially against danger or competition, and is more formal than 生き残る; mere existence of a thing is 存在.

presentation.defJa: 政治について同じ考えを持つ人々が集まり、政権を目指して活動する団体。
presentation.note: The formal term for a political party, which news usually shortens to 党 in compounds such as 与党 (ruling party) and 野党 (opposition).

presentation.meaning: maintenance, servicing; development (of facilities or systems)
presentation.defJa: 機械や施設などを点検し、いつでもよく使える状態にしておくこと。
presentation.note: Covers both keeping machines in working order and building up infrastructure or institutions (道路の整備, 法の整備), a broader range than the loanword メンテナンス.

presentation.defJa: ある物を作り上げている、一つ一つの物質や要素。
presentation.note: The neutral word for what a substance such as medicine, food or cosmetics is made up of, whereas 材料 is the raw material you assemble something from.

presentation.defJa: 四つの辺の長さがすべて等しく、四つの角がすべて直角の四角形。
presentation.note: Strictly a square with four equal sides and right angles; 四角 or 四角形 is any four-sided shape, and 長方形 is a rectangle.

presentation.defJa: 学校や施設などの、正面にある主な出入り口の門。
presentation.note: The main gate of a school, temple, palace or facility, as opposed to 裏門 (back gate) or 通用門 (service entrance).

presentation.meaning: enactment, passage (of a bill); conclusion (of a deal), formation
presentation.defJa: 物事がきちんとした形でまとまり、できあがること。法律や契約などが決まること。
presentation.note: Used when something comes into being through due process, such as a bill passing or a contract or deal being concluded, and also when an argument holds (議論が成立しない).

presentation.defJa: キリストが生まれたとされる年を紀元一年として年を数える、世界で広く使われている暦の数え方。
presentation.note: The Common Era year count, always contrasted in Japan with era names (元号 or 和暦) such as 令和, which still appear on many official forms.

presentation.meaning: to shoulder (a burden, debt); to carry on one's back
presentation.defJa: 物を背中にのせて運ぶ。また、重い責任や負担を引き受ける。
presentation.note: Used literally for backpacks and children and very often figuratively for debt, responsibility or expectations (期待を背負う); the colloquial reading しょう also exists.

presentation.defJa: 北極と南極からちょうど同じ距離にあり、地球をぐるりと一周する線。
presentation.note: The standard term in geography and science writing; 赤道直下 ('right on the equator') is a common set phrase for scorching tropical places.

presentation.meaning: with much trouble, specially (often implying the effort was wasted); precious, long-awaited
presentation.defJa: わざわざ手間をかけて。また、めったにない貴重な、という気持ちを表す。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; followed by のに it laments wasted effort, while せっかくの + noun means 'a rare, precious (chance)' and せっかくですが politely declines an offer.
collocations: せっかく来たのだから

presentation.defJa: 距離がだんだん縮まって、すぐ近くまで寄ってくること。
presentation.note: A formal suru-noun common in news about typhoons, astronomy and traffic; more technical than 近づく, and with people it can suggest approaching someone with an agenda.

presentation.meaning: to treat, deal with (a person); to come into contact with
presentation.defJa: 人と向き合って、ある態度で相手をする。
presentation.note: With に and a manner word it describes how one treats people; it also means 'to border on' (海に接する町) or 'to encounter' something (新しい考えに接する).

presentation.defJa: 機械や線、乗り物などをつないで、ひと続きにすること。
presentation.note: The standard word for technical and transport connections (電車の接続 means a timed transfer); つながり is the softer native word for human or abstract ties.
collocations: インターネットに接続する

presentation.defJa: 土を焼いて作った茶わんや皿などの焼き物をまとめていう言葉。
presentation.note: An everyday, slightly old-fashioned word for household ceramics, named after the pottery town of Seto; 陶磁器 and 焼き物 are the more formal or craft-oriented terms.

presentation.meaning: lines (in a play or film); a remark, stock phrase
presentation.defJa: 劇や映画などで、登場人物が話す言葉。
presentation.note: Often written セリフ in casual media; outside the theatre it can mean a stock or clichéd remark, as in よく聞く台詞 ('a line I've heard before').

presentation.defJa: びんや管などの口をふさいで、中身が出ないようにするもの。
presentation.note: Covers corks, bottle caps and drain plugs; 栓抜き is a bottle opener, and the word appears in compounds like 消火栓 (fire hydrant) and 耳栓 (earplug).

presentation.meaning: former, previous (holder of a post); pre-
presentation.defJa: いまの人より一代さかのぼって、その地位や役職についていた、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: On titles it means the immediate predecessor (前社長), whereas 元～ means any past holder; it also means 'previous' (前年度) or 'pre-' (前近代).

presentation.meaning: around, approximately (after a number); before and after, front and back
presentation.defJa: ある数や時間の少し上や下。また、前と後ろ。
presentation.note: After a number it means 'about, give or take' (like ぐらい but more written); as a noun it means before-and-after or front-and-back, and 前後する means to happen out of order.

presentation.defJa: ある作家などの作品をすべて集めて、何冊かの本にまとめたもの。
presentation.note: A multi-volume edition of an author's or a genre's works; 選集 is a selected-works edition rather than a complete one.

presentation.defJa: 竹の骨に紙や布を張った、折りたためるあおぐ道具。
presentation.note: A folding fan, distinct from うちわ, the flat fan that does not fold; 扇子 is also a key prop in rakugo and traditional dance.

presentation.defJa: 今月から数えて二か月前の月。
presentation.note: Common in business and everyday speech; formal reports counting back from a month other than the present use 前々月 instead.

presentation.defJa: 今週から数えて二週間前の週。
presentation.note: An everyday word for 'two weeks ago'; it pairs with 先週 and 今週, and 再来週 is its forward-looking counterpart.

presentation.defJa: その家の血筋をさかのぼった、ずっと昔の人々。
presentation.note: Refers to one's own family forebears; 祖先 is the more academic term, also used for species (人類の祖先).

presentation.meaning: tip, pointed end; leading edge (as in cutting-edge technology)
presentation.defJa: 細長い物のいちばん先の部分。また、時代や技術のいちばん新しいところ。
presentation.note: Literally the pointed end of an object, it is also used figuratively for the cutting edge, most often in 最先端 and 先端技術.

presentation.meaning: the front, head (of a line or group); the lead
presentation.defJa: 列や集団の、いちばん前。
presentation.note: Refers to the physical front of a line or group, and figuratively to taking the lead (先頭に立って改革を進める); 先端 is the tip of an object, not a position in a line.

presentation.meaning: the whole, all aspects; general, overall
presentation.defJa: ある物事にかかわることのすべて。
presentation.note: Usually attached to a noun (～全般) to mean 'everything to do with ~', or used as 全般的に ('on the whole'); more formal than 全体.

presentation.defJa: モーターで羽根を回して風を起こし、涼しくする電気器具。
presentation.note: The standard household electric fan; 換気扇 is an exhaust fan, and サーキュレーター is a fan built specifically for circulating air.

presentation.defJa: 顔を洗うこと。朝の身じたくとして、歯みがきなどとまとめていうことも多い。
presentation.note: On its own it appears mainly in 洗面を済ませる; it is far more common in compounds such as 洗面所 (washroom), 洗面台 (washbasin) and 洗面用具 (toiletries).

presentation.defJa: 持っている力のすべて。
presentation.note: Common in speech and news alike; 全力を挙げる is the formal news phrase for an organization's all-out effort, while 全力で is the everyday adverbial form.

presentation.defJa: 電車や列車が走るための、レールを敷いた道。
presentation.note: Refers to the physical track; 路線, with the characters reversed, is the route or service line, a common mix-up.

presentation.defJa: 全部をまとめた、全体の、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A formal prefix meaning 'total, all-inclusive' (総額, 総売上) or 'chief, general' (総理, 総会); it attaches mainly to Sino-Japanese nouns.

presentation.defJa: 二つのものの内容がくい違っていること。
presentation.note: A formal word used in documents and debate; 違い is the everyday equivalent, and ～に相違ない is a stiff written form of ～に違いない.

presentation.defJa: 床や机などをふいてきれいにするための布。
presentation.note: A cloth for wiping floors and surfaces, often sewn from old towels; ふきん is the cleaner cloth used for dishes and tables.

presentation.defJa: 数や量がふえたりへったりすること。
presentation.note: A neutral, formal word common in statistics and news; 変動 stresses instability, while 増減 simply states that numbers go up and down.

presentation.defJa: 品物をしまっておくための建物。
presentation.note: The general word for a storage building; 物置 is a small shed at home, and 蔵 a traditional earthen storehouse.

presentation.defJa: 亡くなった人を送るために行う儀式。
presentation.note: The everyday word, often softened to お葬式; 葬儀 is the more formal term used in notices and by funeral companies.

presentation.defJa: 船を設計し、つくること。
presentation.note: Used mainly in industry and economic reporting, typically in compounds such as 造船所 (shipyard) and 造船業 (the shipbuilding industry).

presentation.defJa: 人の声や物音が多くて、落ち着かない様子だ。
presentation.note: Stresses a restless commotion of voices and activity and can describe turbulent times (騒々しい世の中); うるさい is more colloquial and voices personal annoyance.

presentation.defJa: 数や量、程度などがふえて大きくなること。
presentation.note: A formal written word typical of news and reports; 増加 is the neutral word for numbers going up, while 増大 stresses swelling scale or seriousness.

presentation.defJa: 旅立つ人や去っていく人との別れを惜しみ、見送ること。
