presentation.note: Very common in health talk (不規則な生活, an irregular lifestyle) and in grammar (不規則動詞); the positive counterpart is 規則正しい.

presentation.defJa: 主となるものを補佐する、次の位の立場を表す。また、主なものに付随する二次的なものを表す。
presentation.note: On titles it means vice- or deputy (副社長, 副市長), and on other nouns it means secondary or side (副作用, 副業).

presentation.defJa: 文書や絵などを、元と同じように写し取ること。
presentation.note: The formal or legal word for copying, seen on notices and in law (無断複写を禁じます), whereas everyday speech says コピー.

presentation.defJa: 数が二つ以上であること。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly formal word for more than one, frequent in news (複数の関係者によると); in grammar it means plural, the opposite of 単数.

presentation.meaning: to inflate, to blow up (a balloon, a float); to puff out (one's cheeks); to swell (hopes, imagination)
presentation.defJa: 中に空気などを入れて大きくする。また、期待や想像を大きく広げる。
presentation.note: The transitive partner of 膨らむ: you inflate something (風船, 浮き輪) or puff out your cheeks in annoyance, and figuratively swell hopes or imagination (期待に胸を膨らます, 想像を膨らます); the variant 膨らませる is at least as common.

presentation.meaning: to swell, to expand; (of costs) to balloon
presentation.defJa: 中から押し広げられるように大きくなる。数や量が増える。
presentation.note: Intransitive (something swells by itself); news writing uses it constantly for costs, debts or deficits ballooning, while 膨らます is the transitive counterpart.

presentation.defJa: よごれていて、衛生的でないようす。
presentation.note: More clinical than 汚い, stressing a lack of hygiene, and it can also describe something morally distasteful; its opposite is 清潔.

presentation.meaning: (of night) to grow late, to wear on; (of a season) to advance
presentation.defJa: 夜になってから時間がたち、だんだん遅くなる。季節が深まる。
presentation.note: Used almost only with 夜 or a season and has a literary feel; do not confuse it with 老ける (to age) or 耽る (to be absorbed in), which share the reading.

presentation.meaning: to be blocked, to be closed up; to be occupied
presentation.defJa: 穴や通り道がつまって、通れなくなる。
presentation.note: The intransitive partner of 塞ぐ; besides physical blockage it appears in 手が塞がっている (my hands are full, I'm busy) and the idiom 開いた口が塞がらない (to be dumbfounded).
collocations: 開いた口が塞がらない

presentation.meaning: to block, to obstruct; to stop up (a hole)
presentation.defJa: 穴や入り口、通り道などをさえぎって、通れないようにする。
presentation.note: Transitive for physical blocking; 耳を塞ぐ can mean to refuse to listen. In 気が塞ぐ (to feel gloomy), 塞ぐ is intransitive; 塞がる is the intransitive partner for physical blockage.

presentation.meaning: failing to keep in touch for a long time; long silence
presentation.defJa: 長い間、訪ねたり便りを出したりしないこと。
presentation.note: Almost always used with honorific ご as a polite greeting when contacting someone after a long gap; 久しぶり is the casual equivalent.
collocations: ご無沙汰しております
ご無沙汰をおわびする

presentation.meaning: samurai, warrior (member of the warrior class)
presentation.defJa: 昔の日本で、刀を持ち、戦いを仕事とした身分の人。
presentation.note: The standard historical term for the warrior class, while 侍 originally meant retainers serving a lord and is the more popular, romantic word.

presentation.defJa: 漢字を分類するときの基準になる、字の一部分。
presentation.note: The component used to order kanji dictionaries (部首索引); radical names such as さんずい or くさかんむり are everyday vocabulary for describing characters.

presentation.defJa: 和室の部屋と部屋の間などにある、厚い紙を張った引き戸。
presentation.note: An opaque sliding door between rooms, unlike the translucent 障子 that lets in light; outside art writing (襖絵) it is often written in kana as ふすま.

presentation.meaning: attached, affiliated (esp. a school or hospital attached to a university)
presentation.defJa: 大きな組織や施設にくっついて、その一部となっていること。
presentation.note: An older spelling of 付属 that survives mainly in the official names of national-university schools and hospitals; in general writing 付属 is standard.

presentation.meaning: being attached or included (as an accessory); being affiliated
presentation.defJa: 主となるものにくっついていること。また、そのもの。
presentation.note: The standard spelling for an included accessory (付属品) or an affiliated institution (付属高校); 附属 is the same word in an older, official spelling.

presentation.defJa: 入れ物の口や穴をおおって閉じるもの。
presentation.note: Literally a lid or cover, also often written ふた; 蓋を開ける figuratively means to see how something turns out, and 臭いものに蓋 means to hush up something embarrassing.

presentation.meaning: unsafe, dangerous (of the times or a neighborhood); alarming
presentation.defJa: 何が起こるか分からず、安心できないようす。
presentation.note: Describes places or times that feel unsafe and has a conversational, slightly old-fashioned ring; 危険 is the neutral, technical word.

presentation.defJa: 船で荷物や郵便物を運ぶこと。また、その手段。
presentation.note: The cheaper, slower postal or shipping option, contrasted with 航空便 (airmail); logistics writing uses the more technical 海上輸送.

presentation.defJa: 強い風とともに、雪が激しく降ること。
presentation.note: Wind-driven heavy snow; 地吹雪 is snow whipped up from the ground, and 桜吹雪 poetically describes cherry petals falling like snow.

presentation.defJa: 父親と母親。両親。
presentation.note: A formal, written word for father and mother, found in documents and compounds like 父母会; in conversation people say 両親 or 親.

presentation.defJa: 道路と線路が同じ高さで交わっている所。
presentation.note: Where road and rail cross at the same level; 開かずの踏切 is a stock phrase in urban news, and 踏み切り is a less common spelling.

presentation.meaning: furigana, small kana printed beside kanji to show their reading
presentation.defJa: 漢字の読み方を示すために、そばに小さく書く文字。
presentation.note: Normally written in kana; ルビ is the printing term for the same thing, and 振る or 付ける are the verbs used with it.

presentation.meaning: to turn around (to look), to look back over one's shoulder
presentation.defJa: 顔や体を後ろのほうへ向ける。
presentation.note: A physical turn of the head or body; figuratively 振り向いてもらう means to win someone's attention or affection, while 振り返る is preferred for looking back on the past.

presentation.defJa: すでに人に使われた、また、昔からある、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Attaches to everyday nouns with the native reading ふる to mean used or secondhand (古着, 古本, 古新聞) or long-standing (古株); compare 旧～ (former) and 中古 (secondhand goods).

presentation.meaning: hometown, birthplace; place one feels at home
presentation.defJa: 生まれ育った土地。心が帰っていく場所。
presentation.note: A warm, emotional word for one's hometown, also written ふるさと or 故郷; 故郷 read こきょう sounds more formal.

presentation.meaning: to behave, to conduct oneself; to treat (someone) to food or drink
presentation.defJa: 人の前で、ある態度や様子を見せて行動する。また、客に食べ物や飲み物をごちそうする。
presentation.note: Describes outward conduct as others see it, usually with a manner word such as 堂々と; it also means treating guests to food or drink (酒を振る舞う), and is now normally written 振る舞う.

presentation.defJa: 物を包んで持ち運ぶための、四角い大きな布。
presentation.note: Besides the literal cloth, the idiom 大風呂敷を広げる means to talk big or announce grandiose plans.

presentation.defJa: 火山の中から、溶岩や灰、ガスなどが地上に激しく吹き出すこと。
presentation.note: The standard news and science term for a volcanic eruption, used as a noun or as 噴火する; 爆発 is broader and not specific to volcanoes.

presentation.defJa: 一つにまとまっているものを、部品や成分などにばらばらに分けること。
presentation.note: Covers both taking a machine apart and chemical or biological decomposition; 解体 is used for demolishing buildings or dismantling organizations rather than small devices.

presentation.defJa: 池などから水を高く吹き上げるようにした仕掛け。公園や広場によくある。
presentation.note: Refers to decorative fountains in parks and squares; a drinking fountain is usually called 水飲み場 instead.

presentation.defJa: ある数を別の数で割った形を、横線の上下に二つの数を書いて表したもの。
presentation.note: Strictly a mathematical term for numbers like 3/4; for 'a fraction' meaning a small part of something, Japanese uses 一部 or ごく一部 instead.

presentation.meaning: amount, quantity (of an ingredient, dose or task)
presentation.defJa: 物の多さや重さ、かさの程度。どれくらいあるかという量。
presentation.note: Common in recipes, medicine instructions and talk of workload (仕事の分量) for a specific measured amount; 量 is the more general word for quantity.

presentation.defJa: 同じ性質や特徴をもつものごとにまとめて、いくつかのグループに分けること。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly formal word for sorting things into categories by type; for separating household garbage the specific word is 分別 (ぶんべつ).
collocations: 大きく三つに分類される

presentation.meaning: closing (of a meeting, session or event)
presentation.defJa: 会議や国会、大会などが終わること。また、終わりにすること。
presentation.note: A formal term for the official closing of meetings, legislative sessions and events, the opposite of 開会; a shop closing for the day is 閉店 instead.

presentation.defJa: 困ったりつらかったりする様子を見せず、気にしないでいること。大丈夫なこと。
presentation.note: A conversational word for being unbothered or all right; 平気で followed by a verb often criticizes someone for doing something bad without a second thought.

presentation.meaning: running side by side; doing at the same time, concurrently
presentation.defJa: 二つ以上のものごとが、同時に進むこと。また、並んで進むこと。
presentation.note: Mostly appears as 並行して for doing things concurrently; 平行, with the same reading, is geometric 'parallel', as in 議論が平行線をたどる (the debate never meets).

presentation.defJa: 土曜日、日曜日、祝日以外の普通の日。
presentation.note: The neutral everyday word for Monday to Friday excluding public holidays, common in timetables, opening hours and price lists.

presentation.defJa: 軍隊に入って戦う人。また、その人たちの集まり。
presentation.note: An everyday, somewhat old-fashioned word for soldiers, common in wartime memories and stories; 兵士 is the more neutral term used in news reports.

presentation.defJa: 山などがなく、広く平らに続いている土地。
presentation.note: A geography term for a broad stretch of flat land, often part of proper names like 関東平野; 平地 is the more general word for any level ground.

presentation.meaning: to be dented, to cave in; (colloquial) to feel down
presentation.defJa: 表面の一部が、押されたりぶつかったりして内側にくぼむ。また、気持ちが落ち込む。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana as へこむ; in casual speech it very often means to feel down or discouraged, as in 失敗してへこむ.

presentation.defJa: 一緒ではなく、それぞれ分かれていること。
presentation.note: Stresses that two or more things are handled apart rather than together, most often as 別々に; バラバラ adds a sense of being scattered or disorganized.

presentation.defJa: 用を足すための場所。トイレの古い言い方。
presentation.note: A blunt, somewhat old-fashioned word now largely replaced by トイレ or the polite お手洗い in everyday speech, though it survives in compounds like 公衆便所.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の前について、その語が表す害や好ましくないものから守る、よせつけないという意味を表す。
presentation.note: A Sino-Japanese prefix meaning 'proof against' or 'protection from', joined to a following kanji or noun as in 防水, 防寒, 防虫 and 防災; it never stands on its own.

presentation.defJa: 遠くにあるものを、大きくはっきり見るための筒の形をした道具。
presentation.note: The general word for telescopes, from backyard stargazing (天体望遠鏡) to space observatories; binoculars are 双眼鏡.

presentation.defJa: 東西南北など、ある地点から見た向き。
presentation.note: Refers to compass bearings or the direction in which a place lies; 方向 is broader and also covers direction of movement or an abstract course.

presentation.defJa: 床や地面のごみやほこりを掃いて集めるための道具。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana; 竹ぼうき (bamboo broom) and the pair ほうきとちりとり (broom and dustpan) are everyday set phrases.

presentation.defJa: ある地域だけで使われている、その土地独特の言葉。
presentation.note: The neutral term for a regional dialect, contrasted with 標準語 or 共通語; お国言葉 is a warmer, more colloquial way to say it.

presentation.defJa: 寺に住んで仏教の修行をし、教えを伝える人を親しみをこめて呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: A familiar word for a Buddhist priest, almost always said with the polite お as お坊さん; 僧侶 is the formal term used in news and writing.
collocations: お坊さんにお経をあげてもらう

presentation.meaning: law (of nature or science), rule, principle
presentation.defJa: 一定の条件のもとで必ず成り立つ、ものごとの決まりやつながり。
presentation.note: Used for natural or scientific laws and reliable patterns (including pop phrases like 成功の法則); a law passed by a legislature is 法律, not 法則.

presentation.defJa: けがをしたところを守るために巻く、細長い布。
presentation.note: Refers to a strip of cloth or gauze wrapped around an injury; a small adhesive bandage is 絆創膏 instead.

presentation.defJa: 料理で、肉や野菜などを切るために使う刃物。
presentation.note: The everyday word for any kitchen knife, with types such as 出刃包丁 and 菜切り包丁; ナイフ usually means a Western table or utility knife.

presentation.defJa: 分からない数を文字で表し、それが特定の値のときにだけ成り立つ等式。
presentation.note: Primarily a math term, but also used figuratively for a winning formula, as in baseball's 勝利の方程式 for a team's reliable late-inning pitching relay.

presentation.defJa: 犯罪が起きないように、前もって備えること。
presentation.note: The standard term in news and public notices for crime prevention, very common in compounds like 防犯カメラ; 防災 is the parallel word for disaster preparedness.

presentation.meaning: direction, area (toward a place); field, quarter (of activity)
presentation.defJa: ある場所に向かう方向や、そのあたりの地域。また、物事の分野。
presentation.note: Common on station signs and in news (～方面行き); 各方面 means 'all quarters concerned', and in the 'field' sense it is vaguer and more conversational than 分野.

presentation.defJa: 小さな男の子を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: A warm, slightly old-fashioned word adults use for a small boy; said to a grown man it is condescending, like 'sonny' or 'greenhorn'.

presentation.meaning: to leave alone, to neglect (with -te oku); to throw, to toss
presentation.defJa: 気にかけずに、そのままにしておく。また、軽く投げる。
presentation.note: Casual to neutral: in the 'throw' sense it suggests a light, careless toss (compare the plainer 投げる), and 放っておく, colloquially ほっとく, is the everyday way to say 'leave it be'.

presentation.meaning: cheerful, sunny (in disposition); bright, clear (of weather, literary)
presentation.defJa: 心が明るく、さっぱりしていて楽しそうなようす。
presentation.note: A warm word for an open, sunny temperament and manner, a little more literary than 明るい and gentler than the boisterous 陽気; used of weather (朗らかな春の日) it sounds poetic.

presentation.defJa: 牛や馬、羊などを放し飼いにして育てる広い土地。
presentation.note: Read ぼくじょう in everyday and business use; the reading まきば survives in songs and poetry for a pastoral meadow.

presentation.defJa: 牛や羊などの家畜を飼って、育てたり増やしたりする仕事。
presentation.note: A textbook and history-writing term for livestock raising as a way of life; 畜産 is the more modern word used for the industry and in policy.

presentation.defJa: 体の健康を守り、病気を防ぐこと。
presentation.note: Appears mostly in compounds for public-health bodies and school health (保健所, 保健室, 保健師); do not confuse it with the homophone 保険 'insurance'.

presentation.meaning: to dry (in the sun or air), to air out
presentation.defJa: 日光や風に当てて、ぬれたものや湿ったものをかわかす。
presentation.note: 乾かす is the general 'make dry' (dryers included), while 干す pictures hanging or spreading things out in sun or air; figuratively 干される means being frozen out of work.

presentation.defJa: 地球の軸の北のはし。また、そのまわりの寒い地域。
presentation.note: Covers both the geographic pole and the Arctic region loosely; science writing narrows the region with 北極圏 or 北極域.

presentation.meaning: (someone else's) son, young master; sheltered, naive young man
presentation.defJa: 他人の男の子をていねいに呼ぶ言葉。また、苦労を知らずに育った男性。
presentation.note: A polite word for someone else's son, often with お, that can also mock a pampered, naive man; the spelling 坊っちゃん is familiar from Soseki's novel, though 坊ちゃん is the more common modern form.

presentation.defJa: 土や岩に穴をあけたり、地面の下のものを取り出したりする。
presentation.note: The basic verb for digging into the ground, unlike its homophone 彫る (carving into a surface); figuratively 掘り下げる means to dig deeper into a topic.

presentation.meaning: to carve, to engrave, to sculpt
presentation.defJa: 刃物などで木や石などをけずって、形や文字、模様を作る。
presentation.note: Means carving or engraving into wood, stone or metal (also tattooing, 入れ墨を彫る); its homophone 掘る means digging into the ground.

presentation.meaning: Obon, the summer festival of the dead; tray
presentation.defJa: 夏に先祖の霊を迎えてまつる行事。また、物をのせて運ぶ平たい道具。
presentation.note: Usually said with the polite お (お盆) for both the mid-August festival and a serving tray; 盆と正月が一緒に来たよう means good things (or busy events) all arriving at once.

presentation.defJa: まわりを山にかこまれた、低くて平らな土地。
presentation.note: A geography term common in weather reports and travel writing; basin cities such as Kyoto are known for muggy summers and cold winters.

presentation.defJa: 組織の中心となって、全体をまとめたり指示を出したりする所。
presentation.note: The central office or command post of any organization (police, disaster response, schools, associations), whereas 本社 is specifically a company's head office.

presentation.meaning: originally, by nature, essentially; proper, intended (used adjectivally)
presentation.defJa: もともと。はじめからそうであること、あるべき姿であること。
presentation.note: Also a noun (本来の + noun 'original, proper'); 本来なら signals what would normally be expected, often in contrast to reality, and it is weightier than もともと.

presentation.defJa: 時をあらわす言葉の前につけて、そのたびごと、どの…も、という意味をそえる。
presentation.note: Attaches to time words for 'every' (毎日, 毎晩, 毎回); in technical and news contexts 毎時 or 毎秒 means 'per hour' or 'per second'.

presentation.defJa: 紙や皿など、うすくて平たいものの数。
presentation.note: Counts anything counted with 枚 (sheets, tickets, plates, photos); in publishing, manuscript length is often measured as a number of 400-character manuscript sheets.

presentation.meaning: each time, every time; (shop greeting) thank you as always
presentation.defJa: そのたびごと。いつも。店で常連の客に感謝を表すあいさつにも使う。
presentation.note: In shops and announcements it is a set greeting to regulars (毎度ありがとうございます; in Kansai simply 毎度), while 毎度のことながら in writing means 'as always', often with a hint of weariness.
collocations: 毎度ありがとうございます

presentation.defJa: 寝るときに頭をのせる道具。
presentation.note: Besides 'pillow' it appears in idioms such as 枕を高くして寝る 'sleep free of worry', and in rakugo the 枕 is the comic warm-up before the main story.
collocations: 枕が変わると眠れない

presentation.meaning: to bend; to distort, to compromise (principles or facts)
presentation.defJa: まっすぐなものを、まがった形にする。また、考えや事実をゆがめる。
presentation.note: Transitive (the intransitive is 曲がる); besides physical bending it means twisting principles or facts, as in 自説を曲げない 'refuse to back down'.

presentation.meaning: to step over, to straddle; to cross, to span (a boundary or period)
presentation.defJa: 足を広げて物の上をこえる。また、境目の両側にわたる。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; literally stepping over something, it is common in news for crossing boundaries or spanning time (年をまたぐ), and 二度と敷居をまたがせない means 'never darken my door again'.

presentation.defJa: 病院や駅などで、順番や出発を待つための部屋。
presentation.note: The standard word for waiting rooms at clinics, stations and ferry terminals; at airports people more often speak of the 出発ロビー (departure lobby) or the gate area.

presentation.meaning: to meet (by prior arrangement), to rendezvous
presentation.defJa: 時間と場所を前もって決めておき、そこで会う。
presentation.note: Implies meeting at a time and place fixed in advance; in conversation the noun 待ち合わせ ('a meet-up') is even more common than the verb.

presentation.defJa: 少しの光もなく、何も見えないほど暗いようす。
presentation.note: An intensified 暗い meaning pitch dark; figuratively お先真っ暗 means 'the future looks hopeless'.

presentation.meaning: pitch black, jet black (also of a deep tan or burnt food)
presentation.defJa: ほかの色がまじらず、すっかり黒いようす。
presentation.note: An intensified 黒い used for deep tans, burnt food and grime; figuratively 腹の中が真っ黒 describes someone thoroughly scheming.

presentation.meaning: deathly pale (from fear or shock); deep blue
presentation.defJa: とても青いようす。また、おそれやショックで顔色がひどく悪いようす。
presentation.note: Of a face it means white with fear or shock, not literally blue, while of sky or sea it means a vivid deep blue; note the irregular reading まっさお.

presentation.meaning: the very first, the very beginning; the forefront
presentation.defJa: いちばん初め。いちばん前。
presentation.note: An emphatic 'the very first (thing)', almost always as 真っ先に; more vivid and conversational than 最初に or まず.

presentation.meaning: pure white; (of the mind) completely blank
presentation.defJa: まじりけがなく、すっかり白いようす。また、何も考えられなくなるようす。
presentation.note: An intensified 白い; 頭が真っ白になる 'my mind went blank' is one of its most frequent figurative uses.

presentation.meaning: to enshrine, to deify; to worship
presentation.defJa: 神や祖先の霊をあがめ、決まった場所にむかえておがむ。
presentation.note: Often passive (～が祭られている) for the deity a shrine houses; the spelling 祀る is common in religious contexts, newspapers keep 祭る because 祀 is outside the jōyō list, and the noun 祭り 'festival' comes from this verb.

presentation.defJa: 役所や駅、銀行などで、客の受付や手続き、相談に応じる場所。また、外との連絡を受け持つ部署や人。
presentation.note: Besides a physical counter, it is widely used for a contact point or liaison, as in 交渉の窓口 or a company's single point of contact.

presentation.defJa: ほかの人や物と同じようにふるまったり、作ったりする。
presentation.note: Newspapers usually write it in kana (まねる), and the noun まね appears in phrases like まねをする; 模倣する is the formal, written equivalent.

presentation.defJa: それほど時間がたたないうちに。もうすぐ。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana and common in announcements and news; Vてまもなく means 'shortly after V-ing', and it is a little more formal than すぐ.

presentation.defJa: めったに起こらない、あるいは見られないようす。
presentation.note: Normally written in kana; it is a little more formal than めったにない, and まれに見る ('seldom seen') is a set phrase of praise or emphasis.

presentation.defJa: まっすぐ行かずに、遠回りになる道を通って行くこと。また、その道。
presentation.note: Used both literally for a detour and figuratively for an indirect path in life or work; 遠回り is a near-synonym that stresses the extra distance.

presentation.defJa: 決められた人数いっぱいに人が入っていること。
presentation.note: Describes a place or vehicle filled to capacity with people; 満席 refers specifically to every seat being taken.

presentation.defJa: テストなどで、取ることのできるいちばん高い点。また、申し分のないこと。
presentation.note: Literally full marks on a test, and also used after a noun to mean 'full of' or 'excellent in', as in 栄養満点 or 迫力満点.

presentation.meaning: not yet, un- (something has not yet happened)
presentation.defJa: まだそうなっていない、まだ済んでいないという意味をそえる語。
presentation.note: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns to mean 'not yet', implying the state may still change, unlike 不～ or 非～ which simply negate.

presentation.meaning: to look up at; to admire
presentation.defJa: 下から上の方を見る。また、人の行いや心がけを立派だと感心する。
presentation.note: Mainly means physically looking up; 見上げた before a noun means 'admirable', as in 見上げた心がけ, and sounds somewhat old-fashioned.

presentation.meaning: to shelve, to decide against (for now); to see someone off
presentation.defJa: 予定していたことを、今回は行わないことにする。また、出かける人を送り出す。
presentation.note: In news it very often means deciding not to go ahead with something for now (採用を見送る); in daily life it means seeing someone off at a station or door.

presentation.meaning: to look down at (from above), to overlook
presentation.defJa: 高い所から下の方を見る。
presentation.note: Means physically looking down from a high place; for looking down on people with contempt, 見下す (みくだす) is the usual word.

presentation.defJa: 外から見たようす。外見。
presentation.note: Usually written 見かけ; 見かけによらず ('contrary to appearances') and 見かけ倒し ('all show, no substance') are very common, while 外見 is a more neutral written synonym.

presentation.defJa: 新月から三日目ごろに見える、細く弓のような形をした月。
presentation.note: Strictly the moon about three days after the new moon, seen low in the west at dusk, but loosely used for any crescent moon or crescent shape.

presentation.defJa: 海や湖に向かって、陸地が細長く突き出ている所。
presentation.note: Common in place names and coastal travel writing; 半島 is a whole peninsula, while 岬 is the pointed tip of land jutting into the sea.

presentation.defJa: 見ていられないほど、あわれで情けないようす。
presentation.note: Expresses a painful, humiliating kind of misery, often about one's own pitiful state, whereas かわいそう is pity felt for others.

presentation.defJa: 泳ぐときに着る服。
presentation.note: The everyday word for any swimsuit, men's or women's, despite older glosses limiting it to women; 海水パンツ is a casual word for men's trunks.

presentation.defJa: 品物を売る店。商店。
presentation.note: A homely, slightly dated word for a small shop where 店 or 商店 is usual today; note that 店屋物 is read てんやもの (food delivered from a restaurant).

presentation.defJa: ある場所へ行くときに通る道の順序。
presentation.note: Refers to the sequence of streets and turns that lead to a place; 経路 is more technical, and ルート is common in apps and travel planning.

presentation.meaning: to gaze at, to stare at
presentation.defJa: 目をそらさずに、じっと見続ける。
presentation.note: Usually written 見つめる; it implies a steady, focused gaze, and figuratively means facing something squarely, as in 自分を見つめ直す.

presentation.meaning: to review, to reconsider; to think better of
presentation.defJa: もう一度よく調べて、悪いところを改める。また、人や物のよさを改めて認める。
presentation.note: In news it means reviewing a rule or plan in order to change it (見直しを迫られる); in conversation 人を見直す means to think better of someone.

presentation.meaning: to become used to seeing, to be familiar with
presentation.defJa: 何度も見て、珍しくなくなる。
presentation.note: Most often appears as 見慣れた ('familiar') or 見慣れない ('unfamiliar') before a noun, as in 見慣れない顔, a stranger's face.

presentation.defJa: 見た目が悪く、いやな感じがする。また、行いが恥ずかしく見苦しい。
presentation.note: Describes ugliness in looks or, very often in news, unseemly conduct (醜い争い); do not confuse it with the homophone 見にくい, 'hard to see'.

presentation.meaning: to ripen, to bear fruit; to pay off (effort)
presentation.defJa: 植物が実をつける。また、努力などがよい結果となって表れる。
presentation.note: Used literally for crops and fruit ripening and very often figuratively for effort or love paying off; 実を結ぶ is a near-synonym idiom.

presentation.defJa: 社会の中での地位や立場。
presentation.note: Covers historical social rank (身分制度) as well as one's present standing or identity, as in 身分証明書 (ID card) or 学生の身分.

presentation.meaning: to visit (a sick or injured person); (passive) to be hit by a disaster
presentation.defJa: 病気やけがをした人を訪ねて、様子を尋ねたり慰めたりする。また、災害などが襲う。
presentation.note: In news the passive 見舞われる ('to be struck by') is very common with disasters and misfortune, as in 大雨に見舞われる, while speech tends to say お見舞いに行く for hospital visits.
collocations: 入院中の友人を見舞う

presentation.meaning: less than, under (not including the number)
presentation.defJa: ある数に達していないこと。基準の数そのものは含まない。
presentation.note: Strictly excludes the number itself (20歳未満 means under 20), unlike 以下 which includes it; common in law, statistics and pricing.

presentation.defJa: 家の名前として、家族が共通して名乗る名。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a family name, also written 苗字; 姓 is the formal equivalent used on official forms.

presentation.defJa: 国や役所に属さない、一般の人々や会社の世界。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 官 or 公 (government and public bodies), as in 官民一体; 民間人 means a civilian as opposed to military personnel or officials.

presentation.defJa: 国民が主権を持ち、国民の意思に基づいて政治を行うという意味を表す語。
presentation.note: Forms compounds about democracy such as 民主主義, 民主化 and 民主的, and also appears in party names.

presentation.defJa: その土地の人々の暮らしの中で生まれ、昔から歌い継がれてきた歌。
presentation.note: Refers to traditional songs tied to a region or to work life, as distinct from 演歌 (a commercial popular genre) and 童謡 (songs for children).

presentation.defJa: 限りがなく、どこまでも終わりがないこと。
presentation.note: Works as a noun and attributively with の (無限の可能性), often as hyperbole in everyday writing, whereas 無数 stresses separate things too many to count.

presentation.defJa: 模様や柄がなく、全体が一つの色であること。
presentation.note: Describes fabric, paper or tableware with no pattern and is used with の rather than な; it contrasts with 柄物 (patterned items).

presentation.defJa: 数えきれないほど多いこと。
presentation.note: Stresses a multitude of separate things too many to count, while 無限 means having no limit at all; it is usually used as 無数の or 無数に.

presentation.defJa: 赤と青をまぜたような色。
presentation.note: The basic color word, used alone or as 紫色; in Japan it has long carried associations with rank, refinement and classical court culture.

presentation.defJa: 自分のきょうだいの娘。
presentation.note: The male counterpart is 甥 (おい), and in conversation the affectionate 姪っ子 is very common; newspapers often write the word in kana as めい.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の前について、「すぐれた」「よく知られた」という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns to mean 'outstanding' or 'renowned' (名演技, 名監督), unlike the native reading な in words such as 名前 or 名札.

presentation.defJa: すぐれていて、高く評価されている作品。
presentation.note: Used for acclaimed works of literature, film, music or games; its close synonym 傑作 can also mean 'hilarious' in casual speech (それは傑作だ).

presentation.defJa: 景色がよかったり歴史があったりして、広く知られている場所。
presentation.note: Usually a scenic or historic site known for something specific (紅葉の名所), whereas 観光地 is the broader word for any tourist destination.

presentation.meaning: to order, to command; to appoint
presentation.defJa: 権限や上の立場をもつ者が、相手に何かをするよう言いつける。また、ある役職につかせる。
presentation.note: A formal written variant of 命じる, typical of court rulings, official appointments (〇〇部長を命ずる) and literary prose; everyday speech prefers 命令する or 言いつける.

presentation.defJa: その土地で特によく知られている食べ物や品物。
presentation.note: Most often a regional food or product, but it also describes a well-known, colorful person or event, as in 名物社長 or 名物先生.

presentation.defJa: 一人一人。それぞれ。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana and slightly more old-fashioned than それぞれ, it is used both as a noun and adverbially; the kanji survives in 銘々皿 (individual serving plates).

presentation.meaning: to be blessed with, to be rich in
presentation.defJa: よいものや運などを、十分に与えられている。
presentation.note: Marks what one is blessed with by に, and the negative 恵まれない often means underprivileged (恵まれない子どもたち); the active 恵む suggests giving charity and is far less common.

presentation.meaning: to aim at, to strive for
presentation.defJa: ある目標を決めて、そこにたどり着こうとする。
presentation.note: The standard verb for aiming at a goal or heading for a destination (合格を目指す, 山頂を目指す), whereas 狙う suggests more calculated targeting.
collocations: 合格を目指して努力する

presentation.defJa: 決まった時刻に音を鳴らして、寝ている人を起こす時計や仕組み。
presentation.note: Now usually spelled 目覚まし and short for 目覚まし時計; 目覚ましをかける means to set an alarm, and the related adjective 目覚ましい means remarkable (目覚ましい進歩).

presentation.defJa: 見つけやすいように、また見分けられるようにつけたしるし。
presentation.note: A physical marker or landmark used to find or identify something, common in giving directions (コンビニを目印に); 記号 is an abstract symbol rather than a guide.

presentation.meaning: to stand out, to be conspicuous
presentation.defJa: ほかと比べて、特によく人の目につく。
presentation.note: In news writing, 〜が目立つ often reports that something has become noticeably common (空き家が目立つ), and 目立ちたがり describes a show-off.

presentation.defJa: だいたいの基準。おおよその目標。
presentation.note: A rough guideline rather than a strict rule; softer than 基準, it often appears in labels and advice such as 摂取量の目安 (recommended intake).

presentation.defJa: 法律で決められた税金を払わなくてよいこと。
presentation.note: Usually refers to exemption from consumption tax or customs duties on goods, as in 免税店 (duty-free shop); 非課税 is the broader term for things that are simply not taxed.

presentation.defJa: 平面や土地などの広さ。
presentation.note: The neutral term for the measured size of a surface or region, used in math and statistics, while 広さ is the everyday word for how spacious something is.

presentation.meaning: troublesome, a hassle, too much bother
presentation.defJa: 手間がかかって、やる気が起きない。わずらわしい。
presentation.note: Usually written 面倒くさい and casual in tone, often shortened to めんどくさい or めんどい in speech; 面倒な is the more neutral way to call something troublesome.

presentation.meaning: to be profitable, to make money
presentation.defJa: 商売などで、利益が出る。
presentation.note: Intransitive, describing a business or deal that turns a profit, while 儲ける is the transitive 'make money'; newspapers often write it in kana as もうかる.

presentation.meaning: to make money, to profit; to have (a child)
presentation.defJa: 商売や取引などで、お金を得る。
presentation.note: Transitive counterpart of 儲かる; in formal writing 子をもうける (also spelled 設ける) means to have a child, and newspapers usually write the verb in kana.

presentation.defJa: 建物や家具などの材料として使う木。
presentation.note: The general term for wood as a raw material in industry and construction, while 材木 refers more concretely to cut lumber in traditional carpentry contexts.

presentation.defJa: 本の中の章や項目を、ページとともに順番に並べたもの。
presentation.note: The contents list at the front of a book, report or website, as opposed to 索引, the alphabetical index at the back.

presentation.meaning: to lean against, to lean on
presentation.defJa: 体の重みを、壁や柱などにかけて寄りかかる。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana; besides physically leaning, 胃にもたれる describes rich food sitting heavy in the stomach, while 寄りかかる also covers relying on someone.

presentation.defJa: 粘りの強い米を蒸して、ついて作る食べ物。
presentation.note: Glutinous rice pounded into a sticky cake, central to New Year's dishes such as お雑煮; 焼きもちを焼く is also an idiom meaning to be jealous.

presentation.meaning: originally, from the start; by nature
presentation.defJa: はじめから。最初のころは。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana, it contrasts an original state with the present (もともとは〜だった), and the set phrase だめでもともと ('nothing to lose') is shortened to ダメもと.

presentation.defJa: ふだん使わない道具や品物をしまっておく小屋や部屋。
presentation.note: A shed or room for storing seldom-used things, while 倉庫 is a larger warehouse and 押し入れ is a built-in closet for bedding.

presentation.meaning: to show, to testify to (a fact); to tell (a story)
presentation.defJa: ある事実や状態を、はっきりと示す。また、話して聞かせる。
presentation.note: In modern writing it is used far more often with a thing as subject (data, ruins, a face) meaning 'shows or attests to' than in its literal 'narrate' sense, typically as ～ことを物語っている.

presentation.meaning: yardstick, standard of judgment; ruler (measuring tool)
presentation.defJa: 長さを測る道具。また、物事を評価したり判断したりするときの基準。
presentation.note: Literally a ruler, but in essays and commentary it most often means a personal or social yardstick for judging things, close to 基準 but more concrete and conversational.

presentation.defJa: 程度が非常に大きくて、驚くほどである。
presentation.note: Emphatic and conversational, usually written in kana; in formal writing 非常に or 極めて would replace the adverbial ものすごく.

presentation.meaning: to massage, to knead; to rub
presentation.defJa: 手で何度もつかんだり押したりして、やわらかくする。
presentation.note: Everyday verb for massaging (肩を揉む); figuratively 気を揉む means to fret, and the related 揉める means to get into a dispute.

presentation.meaning: to serve (food) into a dish, to dish up; to heap up
presentation.defJa: 食べ物を器に入れる。また、物を高く積み上げる。
presentation.note: Standard verb for putting food into a bowl or onto a plate (よそう is a softer near-synonym for rice and soup); in casual speech 話を盛る means to exaggerate a story.

presentation.defJa: 質問したり答えたりすること。また、言い合い。
presentation.note: A literary-sounding word mostly met in fixed compounds: 押し問答 (a heated back-and-forth), 禅問答 (a cryptic exchange) and 問答無用 (no arguments allowed).

presentation.defJa: 音や声が大きくてうるさい。また、細かいことまで口うるさい。
presentation.note: Slightly older-sounding than うるさい and usually written in kana; besides noise it can mean fussy, as in 口やかましい (nagging).

presentation.defJa: 日が暮れてから朝までの間。夜のあいだ。
presentation.note: A formal, written word for night used in notices, news and official terms (夜間料金, 夜間救急), where everyday speech would simply say 夜.

presentation.meaning: actor (especially on stage or in kabuki)
presentation.defJa: 芝居で役を演じることを仕事にしている人。
presentation.note: Traditional word for a stage actor, especially in kabuki; 俳優 is the neutral modern term, and 役者が一枚上 means someone is shrewder than another.

presentation.meaning: government office, public office (especially a city or ward office)
presentation.defJa: 国や市町村の仕事をする機関。また、その建物。
presentation.note: Everyday word for municipal or government offices; お役所仕事 is a stock phrase for slow, red-tape bureaucracy.

presentation.defJa: 国や地方の公の機関で働く人。公務員。
presentation.note: Means public official but often carries a faintly critical or old-fashioned tone of rigid rule-following; 公務員 and 官僚 are the neutral or more specific modern terms.

presentation.defJa: 薬や、実験・工業などに使う化学的な物質。
presentation.note: Covers both medicines and industrial or laboratory chemicals; 薬 is the everyday word for medicine you take, while 薬品 sounds technical and is common in labs and regulations.

presentation.defJa: その人や物が受け持っている仕事。果たすべきつとめ。
presentation.note: Close to 役割, but 役目 sounds more concrete and personal (a duty assigned to someone or something), and 役目を終える is common for objects or facilities being retired.

presentation.defJa: 熱い物や火に触れて、皮膚が傷つくこと。また、その傷。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana in news and on warning labels; it is also used figuratively, as in 投資でやけどする (to get burned on an investment).

presentation.meaning: night train or bus; traveling by night
presentation.defJa: 夜のうちに走る列車やバス。また、夜に移動すること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds: 夜行バス and 夜行列車 for overnight transport, and 夜行性 for nocturnal animals.

presentation.defJa: 方向を示すために使う、矢の形をした記号。
presentation.note: Refers to the arrow symbol on signs, maps and keyboards, never to an actual arrow, which is 矢.

presentation.defJa: 薬を調合したり売ったりする店。
presentation.note: Strictly a pharmacy with a pharmacist who fills prescriptions; a ドラッグストア sells over-the-counter medicine and daily goods, though everyday speech often blurs the two.

presentation.meaning: landlord, owner of a rented house
presentation.defJa: 人に貸している家や部屋の持ち主。大家。
presentation.note: Slightly formal or legal-sounding; in everyday conversation people usually say 大家さん.

presentation.defJa: 紙や布などを引っぱって、さく。
presentation.note: A colloquial near-synonym of 破る limited to physically tearing paper or cloth; it cannot replace 破る in senses like breaking a promise or a record.

presentation.defJa: かたくなくて、押すとすぐに形が変わる様子。
presentation.note: 軟らかい is the spelling used when the opposite is 硬い (soil, food, metal), while 柔らかい is the general spelling and is preferred for flexibility, gentleness or a soft manner.

presentation.defJa: 乗り物など、遊ぶための設備がそろっている場所。
presentation.note: General word for an amusement park with rides; large themed resorts are usually called テーマパーク instead.

presentation.defJa: 夕方に発行・配達される新聞。朝刊に対していう。
presentation.note: Paired with 朝刊 (morning edition); 夕刊紙 also refers to tabloid-style papers sold at stations in the afternoon.

presentation.defJa: 郵便を使って送ること。
presentation.note: A formal word used for documents and applications (郵送で受け付ける); in conversation people often just say 郵便で送る.

presentation.defJa: 夏の午後から夕方にかけて、急に激しく降る雨。
presentation.note: A seasonal word strongly tied to summer, often with a nostalgic or poetic feel; news reports call today's violent downpours ゲリラ豪雨 or 局地的大雨 instead.

presentation.defJa: 夕方に西の空に沈んでいく太陽。また、その光。
presentation.note: A common, slightly lyrical word for the setting sun and its light; 夕焼け refers to the red glow of the sky rather than the sun itself.

presentation.meaning: calmly, leisurely, unhurriedly; easily, with room to spare
presentation.defJa: ゆったりと落ち着いていて、急がない様子。
presentation.note: Usually followed by と, it describes calm, unhurried movement or living, and can also mean doing something easily with margin to spare; 悠々自適 is the set phrase for a leisurely retired life.

presentation.defJa: 使ったり利用したりするのに、お金がかかること。
presentation.note: The opposite of 無料; often used as a modifier (有料道路, 有料会員) and in 有料化, the shift from free to paid.

presentation.defJa: お湯や温かい食べ物などから、白く立ちのぼって見えるもの。
presentation.note: The everyday word for the visible white mist above hot water or food; the scientific term for the invisible gas is 水蒸気.

presentation.defJa: 病気やけがの治療のために、ほかの人の血液を体に入れること。
presentation.note: A medical term used in news and hospitals; it pairs with 献血 (donating blood), the source of the blood that is transfused.

presentation.defJa: 人や物を、車や船などを使って運ぶこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for moving goods or people in bulk, common in logistics and news; 運送 leans toward commercial freight, while 輸送 is broader and includes passengers and military supply.

presentation.defJa: 安心して気をゆるめ、注意をおこたること。
presentation.note: Unlike 不注意, which is simple inattention, 油断 implies relaxing one's guard because one feels safe, and it is familiar from the proverb 油断大敵 ('carelessness is the greatest enemy').

presentation.defJa: 日本茶を飲むための、取っ手のない小さな器。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to the handleless cup used for Japanese tea, also written 湯呑み; a handled cup for coffee or black tea is a カップ.

presentation.defJa: 日本茶を飲むときに使う、取っ手のない器。
presentation.note: This spelling without okurigana appears mainly on product tags, in catalogs and in compounds such as 夫婦湯飲 or 湯飲茶碗, while running prose usually writes 湯飲み or 湯呑み.

presentation.defJa: 火山からどろどろにとけて流れ出た岩石。また、それが冷えて固まったもの。
presentation.note: 溶岩 covers both molten lava on the surface and the rock it hardens into, whereas マグマ is molten rock still underground.

presentation.defJa: ある分野で、特別な意味をもって使われる言葉。
presentation.note: 用語 is a word used as a term within a field (専門用語, 法律用語), whereas 言葉 and 単語 refer to words in general.

presentation.defJa: 入れ物の中に入れることのできる量。
presentation.note: 容積 is how much a container can hold, close to 容量, while 体積 is the geometric volume an object itself occupies, as in math and physics.

presentation.defJa: 考え方ややり方が子どもっぽく、未熟なようす。
presentation.note: As a na-adjective it is a criticism meaning childish or immature, harsher than 子どもっぽい; the neutral sense of early childhood survives mainly in 幼稚園 (kindergarten).

presentation.defJa: 物やお金などの使いみち。
presentation.note: 用途 is the purpose something is put to and is common in product descriptions and reports, while 使い道 is the everyday equivalent that is also used for money.

presentation.meaning: clothing store (selling Western-style clothes and accessories)
presentation.defJa: 洋服や、それに合わせる小物などを売る店。
presentation.note: A somewhat old-fashioned word evoking small family-run shops in local shopping streets; today a clothing shop is more often called アパレルショップ or, casually, 服屋.

presentation.defJa: 生き物が育つために取り入れる栄養のもと。
presentation.note: 養分 is used mostly for plants and soil or figuratively (心の養分), whereas 栄養 or 栄養素 is the usual word for the human diet.

presentation.defJa: ヒツジの体から刈り取った毛。
presentation.note: 羊毛 is the standard word in technical, textile and labeling contexts, while everyday speech and fashion copy more often say ウール.

presentation.meaning: finally, at last (after much time or effort)
presentation.defJa: 長い時間がかかったり苦労したりした末に、やっと。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; it is slightly more formal than やっと and common in news, and it can also describe a gradual change, as in ようやく春めいてきた.
collocations: ようやく春めいてきた

presentation.meaning: knack, efficient way of doing things; gist, main point
presentation.defJa: 物事をうまく進めるための大事な点や、そのやり方。
presentation.note: 要領がいい praises someone who works efficiently (sometimes with a hint of shrewdness), 要領をつかむ means to get the hang of something, and 要領を得ない describes an explanation that misses the point.

presentation.meaning: the next, the following (day, morning, year, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 「次の」という意味をあらわす語。日・朝・年などの前につける。
presentation.note: A slightly formal prefix attached to time words (翌日, 翌週, 翌月, 翌年, 翌朝); casual speech often says 次の日 or 次の朝 instead, though 翌日 is common in speech too.

presentation.defJa: 必要以上に何でもほしがること。また、そういう人。
presentation.note: Usually critical when describing a person, but advertising uses it playfully for deals that pack in a lot, as in 欲張りセット or 欲張りプラン.

presentation.defJa: 自分の家や自分のいる所ではない、ほかの場所。また、他人の家。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana; よそ carries a sense of 'not ours, outside our circle,' as in よそ者 (outsider), which the neutral ほかの場所 lacks.

presentation.defJa: 二本の道が十字に交わっている所。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned everyday word for a plain four-way crossing; 交差点 is the standard term in traffic and news contexts, and 十字路 is a near-synonym.

presentation.defJa: お酒を飲みすぎて、正常にふるまえなくなっている人。
presentation.note: Colloquial and somewhat disparaging; news reports often prefer the more neutral 酒に酔った客 or 酔客.

presentation.defJa: 必要になったときのために、前もって用意しておくこと。また、そのもの。
presentation.note: Most often used attributively as 予備の〜 (spare, backup), and in compounds like 予備知識 (background knowledge) and 予備校 (cram school for university entrance exams).

presentation.meaning: to call on, to appeal to (people to do something); to call out to
presentation.defJa: 多くの人に、ある行動をとるよう働きかける。また、相手に向かって声をかける。
presentation.note: In news Japanese it most often means a public appeal (〜を呼びかける) by authorities or groups, and it is usually written 呼びかける with the second verb in kana.

presentation.defJa: 声をかけたり連絡したりして、人をある場所に来させる。
presentation.note: Often passive (呼び出される) when an authority such as a boss, teacher or the police calls you in, and in computing it also means to call up data or a function.
collocations: 職員室に呼び出される

presentation.meaning: to come back (to mind), to be revived
presentation.defJa: 一度消えたり弱まったりしたものが、再びあらわれたり元気を取り戻したりする。
presentation.note: Most common today with memories, scenes or feelings returning to mind, and also for things revived or restored (町が蘇る); it is also written 甦る or in kana.

presentation.meaning: to rejoice, to be glad (formal spelling used to offer congratulations on auspicious occasions)
presentation.defJa: めでたいことを祝って、うれしく思う。
presentation.note: A formal spelling of 喜ぶ reserved for auspicious occasions, seen almost only in set greetings such as お慶び申し上げます in letters, New Year cards and speeches; the reading よろこぶ for 慶 is not in the jōyō kanji table, so official documents write お喜び.
collocations: 新春のお慶びを申し上げます
ご結婚をお慶び申し上げます

presentation.meaning: coming to Japan, visit to Japan
presentation.defJa: 外国の人が日本にやって来ること。
presentation.note: Used only for people from abroad coming to Japan; 訪日 means much the same but is favored in tourism statistics (訪日外国人), and 来日公演 is the fixed phrase for a foreign artist's tour of Japan.

presentation.meaning: failing (an exam or grade), being held back a year
presentation.defJa: 試験に受からないこと。また、成績が足りず上の学年に進めないこと。
presentation.note: A somewhat old-fashioned word for failing or being held back; universities now usually say 留年, and 落第点 is also used figuratively for a failing grade given to a policy or performance.

presentation.meaning: column, section (of a newspaper); field, box (on a form)
presentation.defJa: 新聞や雑誌、書類などで、内容ごとに区切られた部分。
presentation.note: Common in compounds for sections of print media (投書欄, 社説欄) and for boxes on forms (氏名欄, 備考欄), where 欄に記入する means to fill in a field.

presentation.defJa: ふるまいや物の扱い方があらっぽく、ていねいさに欠けるようす。また、力ずくで人を傷つけること。
presentation.note: The core sense is rough or violent behavior and handling (乱暴に扱う, 乱暴な運転); of speech it means coarse or rude (乱暴な言葉遣い), editorials use 乱暴な議論 for sweeping reasoning, and the verb 乱暴する means to assault someone.

presentation.defJa: 学校で、自然のしくみや性質について学ぶ教科。
presentation.note: 理科 is science as a school subject, while 科学 is science as a field of knowledge or research; 理科離れ describes students drifting away from science.

presentation.defJa: 得になることと損になること。また、それぞれの立場にとっての損得。
presentation.note: 利害 refers to the gains and losses at stake for each party and appears mostly in formal or news contexts, especially in 利害関係者 (stakeholders) and 利害が一致する or 対立する.

presentation.meaning: to abbreviate, to shorten; to omit
presentation.defJa: 言葉や手順などの一部をはぶいて、短くする。
presentation.note: 略す is the everyday verb for abbreviating words or skipping parts, while 省略する is the more formal and general equivalent; the form 略する also exists.

presentation.defJa: 川に水が流れこむ範囲の土地。川の流れにそった地域。
presentation.note: Used in geography, flood-control and history contexts (e.g. 黄河流域の文明); it covers the whole area drained by a river, while 川沿い or 沿岸 refers only to the land along its banks.

presentation.meaning: both ~, the two ~ (e.g. both countries, both hands)
presentation.defJa: 二つで一組になっているものの、どちらも。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns for a matched pair (両手, 両親, 両国, 両者); in news 両者 and 両国 refer back to two parties just named, while 両方 is the everyday stand-alone word for 'both'.

presentation.defJa: ある物の右と左、または表と裏の、二つの側。
presentation.note: Concrete and spatial (both sides of a road, river or door), whereas 双方 is used for the two parties in a dispute or negotiation.

presentation.defJa: 魚や貝などをとることを仕事にしている人。
presentation.note: The everyday word for someone who fishes for a living; 漁業者 is the formal term in statistics and policy, and 釣り人 is a hobby angler.

presentation.defJa: 外国に駐在して、自国民の保護や旅券の発行などの仕事をする役人。
presentation.note: A consul handles citizens' affairs such as passports and visas in a particular city, whereas an ambassador (大使) represents the government in diplomacy; the word is most often met in 領事館 and 総領事.

presentation.defJa: 代金などのお金を、確かに受け取ること。
presentation.note: Almost always met in 領収書, the receipt you ask for at a shop for expense claims, which is more formal than レシート, the printed register slip.

presentation.meaning: temporary, special, extraordinary (outside the regular schedule)
presentation.defJa: いつもの決まったものではなく、その時の必要に応じて行うこと。
presentation.note: Marks something arranged outside the regular schedule because of a particular need (臨時国会, 臨時収入), while 一時的 stresses that a state is short-lived.

presentation.meaning: looking after the house while others are out; staying home alone
presentation.defJa: 家の人が出かけている間、家に残って家を守ること。また、その人。
presentation.note: The everyday word for minding the house while the family is out, often of children or pets left at home; 留守 alone just means being away from home.

presentation.defJa: 試験や試合で、得点がまったくないこと。
presentation.note: The score is often written 0点 but still read れいてん; in sports 零点に抑える means to shut out the opponent, and in physics 零点 also means a zero point, as in 零点調整.

presentation.defJa: 粘土を型に入れて焼いた、四角いブロックの形の建築材料。
presentation.note: Usually written れんが or レンガ rather than the difficult kanji 煉瓦, which survives mainly in proper names and older texts.

presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の団体や国などが、同じ目的のために一つにまとまること。
presentation.note: Appears in the names of large bodies (国際連合, 欧州連合, 連合国) and for groups that join forces; a coalition government is usually 連立, and 同盟 implies a formal, often military, treaty alliance.

presentation.meaning: romanization; Japanese written in Roman letters
presentation.defJa: 日本語の音を、ABCなどのアルファベットで書き表したもの。
presentation.note: Refers to Japanese spelled in the Latin alphabet, as on station signs or in keyboard input, not to English itself; ヘボン式 and 訓令式 are its two main spelling systems.

presentation.defJa: 音や声を、あとで聞けるように機械に記録すること。
presentation.note: Covers sound only; recording video is 録画, and 収録 is the broadcasting term for recording a program, whether sound or picture.

presentation.meaning: to argue, to discuss (a subject in depth)
presentation.defJa: 物事について、筋道を立てて考えを述べる。
presentation.note: A formal, written-style verb for treating a subject systematically in essays and editorials; 論じる is the more common modern variant, and 議論する implies discussion among several people.
collocations: 一概には論じられない

presentation.defJa: 日本の、日本風の、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 洋～ (Western-style), as in 和室 and 洋室 or 和食 and 洋食; it marks traditional Japanese style rather than mere location in Japan.

presentation.defJa: 日本語と英語。特に、日本語の言葉に当たる英語を調べるための辞書。
presentation.note: Direction matters: 和英 goes from Japanese to English, while 英和 (as in 英和辞典) goes from English to Japanese.

presentation.meaning: our ~, my ~ (e.g. our country, our home)
presentation.defJa: 自分の、自分たちの、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: Written 我が or わが; 我が国 is the standard self-reference in government documents and editorials, while 我が家 and 我が子 are warm, everyday expressions.

presentation.defJa: 年のわりに元気があり、いかにも若い感じがする様子。
presentation.note: Praises someone for seeming young and lively regardless of actual age, so it is used of adults rather than children; 若い simply states that someone is young.

presentation.defJa: 着物など、日本に昔から伝わる衣服。
presentation.note: A slightly formal umbrella term that contrasts with 洋服 (Western clothes); in everyday talk people more often say 着物.

presentation.defJa: ほかと比べて、または予想していたよりも。比較的。
presentation.note: Slightly more formal than 割と and common in essays; it suggests 'more than one might expect' and is close to 比較的, which sounds more objective.

presentation.defJa: ある数を別の数で等しく分けると、いくつずつになるかを求める計算。
presentation.note: Usually written 割り算 today; it is the everyday school word, while 除法 is the technical mathematical term.

presentation.defJa: 思っていたよりも。けっこう。
presentation.note: Casual and conversational, often written わりと; 割合に is slightly more formal, and 比較的 is the neutral written choice.

presentation.defJa: 数字のあとにつけて、競争や成績で何番目かを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to Sino-Japanese numerals for rankings (一位, 二位, 三位) and read い, not くらい; 第三位 is a more formal variant, and ～番 (クラスで一番) is the everyday word for order or rank, while ～位 is used for official rankings and results.

presentation.defJa: 地域や集団を表すことばのあとにつけて、その中で最もすぐれていること、または程度が最も大きいことを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to a place or group to mean 'the best in' it (日本一, 世界一) and written with the kanji 一 in practice; colloquial speech also uses ～一番 the same way, as in 町一番の店.

presentation.defJa: 動物や植物などを集めて、人々に見せるために整えた場所。また、幼い子どもを預かる施設。
presentation.note: Forms names of laid-out grounds and facilities (動物園, 植物園, 庭園) and of preschools (幼稚園, 保育園); it also starts related words such as 園内, 園児 and 園長, and in preschool talk 園 alone means the school.

presentation.meaning: the end; it's all over, done for (after a conditional)
presentation.defJa: 物事が終わること。また、もう取り返しがつかない状態になること。
presentation.note: A soft, conversational word for 'the end' (今日はこれでおしまい); in the pattern ～たらおしまいだ it means a situation becomes hopeless, and 終わり is the neutral equivalent.

presentation.defJa: ふつか、みっかのように数のあとにつけて、期間の長さや、ひと月のうちの何番目かを表す。
presentation.note: Read か for days 2 to 10, 14, 20 and 24 (二日 ふつか, 三日 みっか, 二十日 はつか); other numbers use にち, as in 十一日 じゅういちにち, except 一日 (ついたち) for the first day of the month.

presentation.defJa: ある状態や支配、影響を受けている中で、という意味を表す。
presentation.note: A formal, written suffix attached to Sino-Japanese nouns (支配下, 管理下, 戦時下) and common in news; in speech the same idea is usually put as ～の中で or ～のもとで.

presentation.defJa: ことばのあとにつけて、そういう状態に変わること、または変えることを表す。
presentation.note: One of the most productive suffixes in modern Japanese, turning nouns into processes (自動化, 可視化, 少子化); the resulting word usually takes する or が進む.

presentation.meaning: department (of a hospital or school); family (in biology)
presentation.defJa: 病院や学校で、専門ごとに分けた部門を表す。また、生物の分類の一つ。
presentation.note: Marks a department in a hospital (内科, 外科, 小児科) or school (英文科) and, in biology, a family (イヌ科, ネコ科); in universities 学部 is a larger unit than 科.

presentation.meaning: song of ~ (a song of a certain kind or purpose, as in fight song or anthem)
presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その目的や種類の「うた」であることを表す。
presentation.note: As a suffix it is read か in Sino-Japanese compounds such as 国歌 and 校歌, whereas the standalone word and native compounds like 子守歌 use うた.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その範囲に入らないことを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns like 対象, 想定 and 専門 to mark something as falling outside a range, and it should not be confused with 以外, a separate word meaning 'other than'.

presentation.meaning: hard to ~, difficult to ~ (after a verb stem)
presentation.defJa: 動詞の連用形について、そうすることがむずかしい、なかなかできないという意味を表す。
presentation.note: A written, somewhat formal suffix that stresses emotional or principled difficulty, whereas にくい is used more for physical or practical difficulty; it is also often written in kana as がたい.

presentation.meaning: -edition, issued (of a newspaper or magazine's publication timing)
presentation.defJa: 新聞や雑誌などが出されること、また出される時期や回数を表す。
presentation.note: Appears only in compounds about publication timing or status, such as 朝刊, 週刊, 季刊 and 創刊, and is not used on its own.

presentation.meaning: volume (counter for books in a set or series)
presentation.defJa: 本やまとまった作品の冊数や順番を数えることば。
presentation.note: Used for volumes in a set or series, especially manga, encyclopedias and collected works, whereas 冊 simply counts individual books.

presentation.defJa: 人が集まったり、物を展示したりするための大きな建物を表す。
presentation.note: Marks public or cultural buildings such as museums, libraries and embassies, while 場 tends to mark open venues or sites like 会場 and 球場.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、心にわいてくるそのような気持ちや印象を表す。
presentation.note: Highly productive in modern Japanese for naming a felt quality (安心感, 一体感, 透明感), and on its own it survives in set phrases like 隔世の感がある.

presentation.meaning: period, stage, age (of development or history)
presentation.defJa: 名詞について、ある区切られた時間やその段階を表す。
presentation.note: Names a defined stage in a life, process or era with a recognizable start and end, whereas 時代 suggests a broader historical age.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その仕事をする装置を表す。また、空を飛ぶ乗り物を表すこともある。
presentation.note: Forms names of machines and aircraft (掃除機, 旅客機), while 器 tends to name smaller appliances, vessels and instruments such as 炊飯器 and 楽器.

presentation.defJa: 少しそういう様子や傾向があることを表す。
presentation.note: Indicates a mild degree of a state someone is in now, mostly undesirable, whereas がち describes a habitual tendency.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、宗教の名前を表す。
presentation.note: Forms the names of religions (仏教, イスラム教), and adding 徒 gives the believers, as in ヒンドゥー教徒.

presentation.defJa: 文章で、横または縦に並んだ文字のひと続き。また、それを数えることば。
presentation.note: Read ぎょう when it means a line of text, as in 改行 and 行間, not to be confused with こう in 銀行 or the verb 行く.

presentation.meaning: to do completely, to ~ up, to carry through (after a verb stem)
presentation.defJa: 動詞の連用形について、最後まで残らずすっかりそうするという意味を表す。
presentation.note: Also written 切る (使い切る), this auxiliary stresses total completion or full extent, and with states or emotions it means 'utterly', as in 疲れきる.

presentation.meaning: out of ~, having run out of ~
presentation.defJa: 名詞について、それがなくなること、また期限などが過ぎることを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns for supplies, power or deadlines (品切れ, 在庫切れ, 期限切れ, 時間切れ) to say that nothing is left or the limit has passed; 不足 only means 'short of' and does not imply that the supply is gone.

presentation.meaning: the house of ~, ~ family (as a lineage)
presentation.defJa: 名字や身分などのことばについて、その一族や血筋を表す。
presentation.note: Read け after family names and titles to mean a lineage or household (本家, 宮家), unlike か in 作家 or 専門家, where it denotes a person in a profession.

presentation.defJa: 名詞や数について、そのようなかたちであることを表す。
presentation.note: Read けい in geometric and grammatical compounds like 四角形 and 過去形, but がた in many shapes named after objects, such as ハート形.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、つながりのある一つのまとまりや、その流れをくむものを表す。
presentation.note: Ranges from scientific systems (神経系, 太陽系) to loose categories of people or styles (理系, 体育会系), where it conveys 'of the ~ type'.

presentation.meaning: sphere, area, zone (defined by influence or connection)
presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その力やつながりがおよぶ範囲を表す。
presentation.note: Marks a zone defined by influence or connection rather than strict borders, as in 経済圏 and 英語圏, and 圏外 on a phone means no signal.

presentation.defJa: 児童や生徒が学ぶ施設の数を数えることば。
presentation.note: As a counter it counts schools (五校, 千校), and as a suffix it forms words like 母校 (alma mater) and 進学校 (college-prep school).

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、そのような目的や性格をもつ、船が出入りするみなとを表す。
presentation.note: Read こう in compounds and port names like 漁港 or 横浜港, while the standalone word is みなと; 空港 extends the idea to airports.

presentation.meaning: issue, number (counter for magazine issues); suffix for names of ships and trains
presentation.defJa: 雑誌などの発行の順番を数えることば。また、船や列車などの名前の後につけることば。
presentation.note: Counts issues of periodicals and also follows the names of ships, trains and spacecraft, and for typhoons it numbers each storm, as in 台風十号.

presentation.defJa: 時間や数を表すことばについて、そのたびに、その一つ一つにという意味を表す。
presentation.note: This suffix is almost always written in kana as ごと in modern prose, and it differs from the prefix 毎 (まい) in 毎日 or 毎年, which comes before the noun.

presentation.defJa: 土地や国の名前について、そこでとれたりつくられたりしたものであることを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to place names on food labels and product descriptions (ブラジル産, 県内産), whereas 製 is preferred for manufactured goods, as in 日本製.

presentation.meaning: history of ~ (as a field or written account)
presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その分野や物事がたどってきた歩みや、それをまとめた記録を表す。
presentation.note: Names a history as a field of study or a written account (美術史, 戦後史), while 歴史 is the general standalone word for history.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その種類のかみ、また新聞であることを表す。
presentation.note: Read し in Sino-Japanese compounds for kinds of paper (和紙, 用紙) and for newspapers (全国紙, 地方紙), whereas the standalone word is かみ.

presentation.defJa: 仏教の建物の名前の後につけることば。
presentation.note: Most temple names use じ, but some take でら, as in 清水寺 (きよみずでら), so each name's reading must be learned individually.

presentation.meaning: -th period, -th class hour (of a school day)
presentation.defJa: 数について、学校の授業で何番目の授業かを表す。
presentation.note: Used for numbered class periods in Japanese schools, mostly in speech and everyday writing, while 時限 (as in 三時限目) is the more formal or university term.

presentation.defJa: 部屋の数を数えることば。また、名詞について、その目的の部屋を表す。
presentation.note: As a counter it is typical of hotel and inn listings (全十二室), while 部屋 is the everyday word and 間 counts rooms in older or traditional expressions.

presentation.defJa: 名詞について、その種類や目的の乗り物を表す。
presentation.note: Read しゃ in Sino-Japanese compounds for types of vehicles (電気自動車, 消防車), while the standalone word is くるま.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の後について、その行為をする人やその状態にある人を表す。
presentation.note: Attached to Sino-Japanese nouns it forms neutral, written-style words for people (研究者, 担当者), more formal than ～人, and it never stands alone in this reading.

presentation.defJa: 企業や団体の数を数えることば。
presentation.note: Counts companies and organizations in news and business writing (三社, 数社), and related forms such as 各社 'each company' and 他社 'other companies' are just as common.

presentation.meaning: collection (of works), anthology; -book (as in photo book)
presentation.defJa: 作品などを選んで、一冊の本などにまとめたもの。
presentation.note: Attaches to the kind of work collected (詩集, 短編集, 問題集), so a study workbook is also a ～集; a collection of objects is a コレクション, and the act of collecting is 収集.

presentation.meaning: place, facility, office (where a given activity is carried out)
presentation.defJa: ある仕事や活動のために設けられた建物や施設。
presentation.note: As a suffix it names institutions and facilities (発電所, 事務所, 研究所), and in some words it is voiced to じょ (保健所, 避難所), so the reading has to be learned word by word.

presentation.meaning: daughter (by birth order: eldest, second, third daughter)
presentation.defJa: 生まれた順を表す語の後について、何番目に生まれた娘かを表す。
presentation.note: Used for daughters by birth order (長女, 次女, 三女) and in formal family counts like 一男二女, with ～男 (長男, 次男) as the counterpart for sons.

presentation.defJa: 国の行政を分担して受け持つ、中央の大きな機関。
presentation.note: Names the central government ministries (財務省, 外務省), while agencies under them use ～庁, and 省庁 is the collective term in news writing.

presentation.defJa: ある品物を専門に売り買いする人や店。
presentation.note: As a suffix it names a dealer by the goods traded (貿易商, 古美術商) and sounds formal or slightly old-fashioned, where everyday speech would use ～屋 or ～店.
collocations: 貿易商として成功する

presentation.defJa: 試合や対局でかった回数を数えることば。
presentation.note: Paired with ～敗 for win-loss records (三勝二敗) in sports and shogi reporting, while 勝ち (かち) is the native word for a single win in conversation.

presentation.meaning: Article (counter for clauses of a law, treaty or contract)
presentation.defJa: 法律や規則、契約などの項目を数えることば。
presentation.note: Used with 第 for numbered articles in laws, treaties and contracts (第三条第二項), and it appears in the news whenever a specific legal provision is cited.

presentation.meaning: place, site, grounds (for a given purpose)
presentation.defJa: ある目的のために使われるところや施設。
presentation.note: As the Sino-Japanese suffix じょう it forms facility words (工場, 会場, 球場, 駐車場), while the native reading ば appears in words like 広場 and 売り場, so the reading must be learned per word.

presentation.defJa: その行為や手続きがすでに終わっていることを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to action nouns (確認済み, 学習済み) and usually written 済み, it is common on labels, forms and technical writing, where it is more compact than ～し終わった.

presentation.defJa: 座るための場所の数を数えることば。
presentation.note: Counts seats in restaurants, theaters and vehicles (二十席, 残り三席), while seats in a parliament are referred to as 議席.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の後について、ある目的や種類のふねを表す。
presentation.note: As a suffix it names a type of vessel (貨物船, 漁船, 客船), but ships themselves are counted with 隻, or 艘 for small boats, rather than with 船.

presentation.meaning: game, match (counter for contests in a series)
presentation.defJa: 試合や勝負の回数や順番を数えることば。
presentation.note: Counts or names games in a series (第三戦, 初戦, 決勝戦) in sports reporting, whereas shogi and go use ～局 for individual games.

presentation.meaning: before ~, pre- (as in before meals, BC, prewar)
presentation.defJa: ある出来事や時期より早いことを表す。
presentation.note: As the Sino-Japanese suffix ぜん it forms fixed compounds (食前, 戦前, 紀元前), while after amounts of time it is read まえ (三十分前) and as a prefix it means 'former' (前社長).

presentation.defJa: 川や道などにそって続いている場所であることを表す。
presentation.note: Attaches to nouns for long features (川沿い, 海沿い, 国道沿い), is voiced to ぞい after the noun, and is more compact than ～に沿って in descriptions of location.

presentation.defJa: 小さなふねを数えることば。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary counter for small boats such as rowboats and fishing boats, while large vessels are counted with 隻.

presentation.meaning: covered in ~, full of ~ (usually something unwanted)
presentation.defJa: よくないものがいっぱいあったり、全体についていたりするようす。
presentation.note: Usually negative, stressing that something unpleasant is everywhere (借金だらけ, ミスだらけ), so neutral or happy abundance is expressed with ～でいっぱい instead.

presentation.meaning: group, team, corps (formed for a purpose)
presentation.defJa: 同じ目的のために集まった人々のまとまり。
presentation.note: Forms names of organized bodies (調査団, 選手団, 楽団, 劇団) and sounds more official than グループ or チーム.

presentation.meaning: counter for suits and items of clothing; place (finishing position in a race)
presentation.defJa: 服を数えることば。また、競走でゴールした順番を表す。
presentation.note: Counts garments, especially suits, coats and dresses (スーツ一着), and in racing gives finishing position (一着, 二着), while socks and shoes take 足 instead.

presentation.meaning: agency, government office (as in the Meteorological Agency)
presentation.defJa: 国や地方の行政の仕事を受け持つ役所。
presentation.note: Names government agencies, usually under a ministry (気象庁, 警察庁), and prefectural headquarters (県庁, 都庁), and newspapers use 同庁 for 'the agency' on second mention.

presentation.defJa: 組織や集まりをまとめる、いちばん上の立場の人。
presentation.note: Forms titles for the head of an organization (社長, 校長, 部長, 市長), and these titles are used as forms of address in place of a name.

presentation.meaning: book, notebook, register (as in planner, bankbook)
presentation.defJa: 予定や記録を書きこむための冊子を表す。
presentation.note: Forms names of notebooks and registers (手帳, 通帳, 電話帳, 母子手帳), while a plain notebook for study or work is usually called ノート.

presentation.meaning: chome, block (numbered district of a town, used in addresses)
presentation.defJa: 町をいくつかに分けた区域を数える単位で、住所に使う。
presentation.note: Used after a numeral in Japanese addresses to mark a subdivision of a neighborhood (四丁目), and 一丁目一番地 is also a set phrase for a top priority.

presentation.meaning: use of ~, way of using (words, money, etc.)
presentation.defJa: ことばやお金などの使い方を表す。
presentation.note: Appears mainly in fixed compounds describing a manner of using something (言葉遣い, 金遣い, 気遣い), which are written with 遣い rather than 使い in standard spelling.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の後について、それがついていることを表す。
presentation.note: Usually written 付き in running text and attached to nouns (朝食付き, 条件付き, 期限付き), it is everywhere in ads, menus and contracts.

presentation.meaning: hard to ~, awkward to ~ (after a verb stem)
presentation.defJa: 動詞の後について、そうするのが難しい、気持ちのうえでしにくいことを表す。
presentation.note: Written in kana in modern texts and attached to verb stems, it suggests physical or emotional difficulty (言いづらい), whereas ～にくい is more neutral and objective.

presentation.defJa: 液体のしずくを数えることば。
presentation.note: Counts drops in recipes, medicine and lab instructions (数滴, 二、三滴); 一滴も with a negative means 'not a single drop', and 一滴残らず means 'every last drop'.

presentation.defJa: 試験の成績や試合の結果を数で表すときの単位。
presentation.note: Counts marks on tests and points in games (百点満点, 二点差), and in formal writing it also counts items such as artworks or pieces of merchandise (作品三点).

presentation.meaning: class, grade, rank (as in first prize, second class)
presentation.defJa: 数を表す字の後について、順位やランク、段階を表す。
presentation.note: After numerals it marks rank or class (一等賞, 二等車) and is standard for prizes and lottery tiers; 等 written after a list of nouns means 'etc.' and is read など, or とう in official documents.

presentation.meaning: -road, -way (suffix naming a kind of road, e.g. sidewalk, roadway, national highway); also the 'way' of an art such as judo
presentation.defJa: 人や車が通るために作られた通路の種類を表す語。「歩～」「国～」など。
presentation.note: As a suffix it is read どう and names a type of road (歩道, 車道, 国道) or a discipline (書道, 柔道), while a road on its own is みち.

presentation.meaning: in accordance with, just as (after a noun or a verb); also: ~ Street
presentation.defJa: 前に述べたものと同じ状態ややり方であること。
presentation.note: Directly after a noun it usually voices to どおり (予定通り, 計画どおり), while after の or a verb it stays とおり; news writing often spells it in kana.

presentation.meaning: (be) about to do (after the dictionary form of a verb); the point or moment of an action
presentation.defJa: ある動作をちょうどこれから始めようとしている時点。
presentation.note: Verb dictionary form + ところだ means about to, ている + ところ means in the middle of, and た + ところ means just did, so the verb form before it decides the meaning.
collocations: ちょうど始まるところだ

presentation.meaning: inside, within (a space, group or range), as in in-body, in-company, domestic
presentation.defJa: その範囲や場所のなかであること。「社～」「国～」など。
presentation.note: As a suffix it is read ない and belongs to formal or written Japanese (車内, 国内, 時間内), while the native word うち is used on its own.

presentation.meaning: -year student; counter for school year (first-grader, third-year student)
presentation.defJa: 学校で何学年目にいるかを数える語。
presentation.note: Used for every stage from elementary school to university; in speech, high school and university years are often shortened to forms like 高二 or 大三.

presentation.meaning: counter for nights of a stay (two nights, three nights)
presentation.defJa: 旅行先の宿で過ごす夜の数を数える語。
presentation.note: The sound changes with the number (いっぱく, にはく, さんぱく), and Japanese inns usually quote prices per person per night.

presentation.meaning: -th (ordinal suffix: first, second, third in order)
presentation.defJa: 順番で何番であるかを表す語。「二～」「三～」など。
presentation.note: Attaches to a number to give a position in a sequence; 三番 alone often works as a label (number three), while 三番目 stresses third in order.

presentation.meaning: cost of, expenses for (utility costs, living expenses, transportation costs)
presentation.defJa: あることのためにかかるお金を表す語。「生活～」「交通～」など。
presentation.note: A formal suffix for categories of expense in budgets, receipts and news, while casual speech often uses ～代 for everyday bills (電気代, ガス代).

presentation.meaning: disease, -sickness (suffix naming a type of illness, as in lifestyle disease, heart disease)
presentation.defJa: 体の不調や疾患の種類を表す語。「心臓～」「糖尿～」など。
presentation.note: As a suffix it is read びょう and forms the names of illnesses (心臓病, 糖尿病); compare ～症, which tends to name a condition or syndrome (熱中症, 認知症).
collocations: 生活習慣病を予防する

presentation.meaning: part, section, area (suffix for a region or portion: coastal areas, mountainous areas, the center)
presentation.defJa: 全体の中で、ある場所や区域にあたるところを表す語。「中心～」「都市～」など。
presentation.note: Read ぶ as a suffix for an area or portion (都市部, 上部, 一部); the same character also names company departments and school clubs (営業部, 野球部).

presentation.meaning: -style, in the manner of (Japanese-style, Western-style, Scandinavian-style)
presentation.defJa: そのような様式や趣であることを表す語。「和～」「洋～」など。
presentation.note: Read ふう as a suffix meaning in the style of; it suggests resemblance or flavor rather than authenticity, so 北欧風 means Scandinavian-inspired.

presentation.meaning: for the first time in (a period); after an interval of
presentation.defJa: それだけの時間がたって、再び同じことをすること。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana as ぶり after a time span, it implies the gap felt long, and 久しぶり is the everyday fixed form.

presentation.meaning: time(s), counter for repetitions (how many times something is done)
presentation.defJa: 同じことを行う回数を数える語。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned, conversational counter for repetitions (more common in speech and in Kansai than in formal writing, where 回 or 度 is preferred), and the reading shifts to いっぺん and なんべん.

presentation.meaning: dialect, regional way of speaking (as in Kansai dialect)
presentation.defJa: ある地方で使われている独特の話し方や言葉。
presentation.note: Attached to a place name it means that area's dialect and sounds more colloquial and affectionate than the neutral term 方言.

presentation.meaning: step, pace (counter for steps: a few steps, ten thousand steps)
presentation.defJa: 足を前に出す回数を数える語。
presentation.note: Read ほ or ぽ depending on the number (一歩 いっぽ, 三歩 さんぽ, 数歩 すうほ), and 一歩 is also widely used figuratively for a first step or small progress.

presentation.meaning: -ish, tending to, easily (forms adjectives: fickle, forgetful, childish, whitish)
presentation.defJa: そのような傾向や性質が強い様子を表す語。
presentation.note: Attaches with a small っ (忘れっぽい, 安っぽい) and is casual and often slightly negative; formal writing prefers ～がち or ～やすい for a tendency.

presentation.meaning: the one (side) that is more (in comparisons: A is better than B; it is better to do)
presentation.defJa: いくつかを比べたとき、そちら側であることを示す語。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana in this grammatical use; ～たほうがいい gives advice, while a dictionary form + ほうが states a general preference.

presentation.defJa: 何かに似ている様子や、そう見えることを表す言い方。
presentation.note: A conversational equivalent of ようだ that attaches directly to nouns without の; formal writing uses ようだ or のような instead.

presentation.meaning: for, intended for, aimed at (a target group or market)
presentation.defJa: ある相手や目的に合わせて作られていること。
presentation.note: Marks the intended audience or market (子ども向け, 輸出向け); compare 向き, which says something happens to suit someone rather than being designed for them.

presentation.meaning: counter for people (formal: two people, a capacity of twenty)
presentation.defJa: 人の数を数える、改まった言い方。
presentation.note: A formal counter for people, standard in notices, regulations, recruitment and service language (定員二十名, 三名様), where everyday speech uses 人.

presentation.meaning: person who has, owner of (in compounds: rich person, parent with children, strong person)
presentation.defJa: それを所有している人や、その性質をもつ人を表す語。
presentation.note: Usually written 持ち in compounds (金持ち, 子持ち, 力持ち), it describes a person by what they have, from money and children to traits or conditions like 花粉症持ち.

presentation.meaning: counter for questions or problems (on a test or quiz)
presentation.defJa: テストやクイズで出される課題の数を数える語。
presentation.note: Used for numbered questions on exams and quizzes (第三問, 十問中八問正解); for counting issues or problems in general, 件 or つ is used instead.

presentation.meaning: counter for nights (two consecutive nights; overnight)
presentation.defJa: 日が暮れてからの晩の数を数える語。
presentation.note: Read や in compounds like 二夜連続 and 一夜にして; it is somewhat literary or used in broadcasting and events, while ordinary counting of nights uses 晩 or 泊.

presentation.meaning: style, way, manner (one's own way, Japanese-style); school of a traditional art
presentation.defJa: その人や集団に特有のやり方や型。
presentation.note: As a suffix it marks a particular way of doing things (自己流, 日本流) or a traditional school of an art such as tea or flower arranging; 我流 implies an untrained, idiosyncratic method.

presentation.defJa: 何かを利用したり見たりするときに払うお金を表す語。
presentation.note: A suffix for set fees paid for a service or for use (入場料, 手数料, 授業料); compare ～代 for the price of goods or utilities and ～費 for categories of expense.

presentation.meaning: territory of, possession of (a country), as in British India, French territory
presentation.defJa: その国が支配している土地であることを表す語。
presentation.note: Attached to a country name it marks a territory or colony, mostly in historical and geopolitical writing; the standalone word for territory is 領土.

presentation.meaning: power of, ability (suffix: influence, concentration, imagination)
presentation.defJa: 物事を行ったり、ほかに働きかけたりする強さを表す語。「集中～」「想像～」など。
presentation.note: Read りょく after Sino-Japanese compounds (影響力, 集中力, 想像力) to name a capacity, while the native reading ちから is used on its own or in compounds like 底力.

presentation.meaning: theory, -ism, discourse on (theory of evolution, cultural criticism)
presentation.defJa: ある物事についての考え方や主張の体系を表す語。
presentation.note: As a suffix it names a theory, doctrine or essay on a topic (進化論, 日本文化論), and 精神論 is often used critically for relying on willpower instead of method.

presentation.defJa: 鳥やうさぎを数えるときに使う語。
presentation.note: Pronounced わ, ば or ぱ depending on the number (一羽 いちわ, 三羽 さんば, 六羽 ろっぱ); counting rabbits with it is a traditional usage, and today 匹 is more common for them.

presentation.defJa: 以前と同じで、少しも変化がない様子。
presentation.note: Neutral to slightly informal, it can sound fond or mildly exasperated depending on context; compare いつも通り, which stresses routine rather than lack of change over time.

presentation.defJa: はっきりしないようす。どちらとも受け取れること。
presentation.note: Written in kana or as 曖昧 (both kanji joined the jōyō list in 2010); a very common word for unclear answers, attitudes or memories, broader and less formal than 不明瞭.

presentation.meaning: accent (the pitch or stress pattern of a word); accent, highlight (in design)
presentation.defJa: 言葉を発音するときの、音の高さや強さの決まった配置。
presentation.note: In Japanese it usually means pitch accent; for a regional or foreign way of speaking なまり is more common, and in fashion アクセント means an eye-catching touch.

presentation.defJa: 眠いときや退屈なときに、思わず口を大きく開けて深く息を吸うこと。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana (the kanji 欠伸 is rare); あくびをかみ殺す, to stifle a yawn, is a frequent set phrase.

presentation.defJa: ある日や年のすぐあとの。次の。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary adnominal used only before time words such as 日, 朝 and 年; everyday speech prefers 次の日 or 翌朝.

presentation.meaning: to look after, to take charge of (someone or something entrusted); to keep in custody
presentation.defJa: 人からたのまれて、物や人を自分のところで守ったり世話したりする。
presentation.note: The receiving side of 預ける (to entrust); counter staff say お預かりします when taking your bag, card or payment.

presentation.meaning: to warm up, to get warm
presentation.defJa: 冷えていた体や物が、ほどよいあたたかさになる。
presentation.note: Intransitive partner of 温める; 温まる is used for bodies, food and feelings, while 暖まる is preferred for rooms and air.

presentation.defJa: いろいろな場所。ここやそこ。
presentation.note: Means the same as the more casual あちこち but sounds fuller and more measured, which suits narration and writing.
collocations: あちらこちらで見かける
あちらこちらに散らばる
あちらこちらを探し回る

presentation.meaning: fat, grease (of meat or fish); oil on the skin
presentation.defJa: 動物の肉や魚の身にふくまれる油分。また、皮膚からにじみ出る油。
presentation.note: 脂 is animal fat or grease, including oily skin, while 油 is liquid oil for cooking or machines; 脂がのる also describes a person at their peak.

presentation.meaning: to toast or roast lightly over a flame, to sear
presentation.defJa: 火に近づけて、表面を軽く焼く。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana (kanji 炙る or 焙る); it means exposing food briefly to a direct flame, a lighter touch than 焼く.

presentation.defJa: 毛糸などを棒針やかぎ針で編んで、衣類や小物を作ること。また、そうして作ったもの。
presentation.note: Normally written 編み物; it covers both the activity and the knitted items, while 手芸 is the wider category of handicrafts.

presentation.defJa: 本や文章を書いて、世に出す。
presentation.note: Written 著す in this sense, a formal word for authoring books; it is distinct from its homophones 表す (to express) and 現す (to reveal), and everyday speech uses 書く.

presentation.meaning: this and that, one thing or another; in various ways
