presentation.note: A neutral everyday word for the people living in a particular building or place, while 住民 is preferred for residents of an administrative area such as a town or city.

presentation.defJa: その時の体の具合。元気かどうかの状態。
presentation.note: Refers to one's day-to-day physical shape rather than long-term health (健康), so 体調を崩す means to feel unwell or fall ill for a while.

presentation.meaning: what (esp. something unusual or alarming); everything (with a following 'also' particle)
presentation.defJa: どんなこと。特に、何か変わったことや騒ぎ。
presentation.note: A more emphatic or formal 'what' than 何, usually implying surprise or alarm, and 何事も means 'anything and everything.'
collocations: 何事もなかったように

presentation.defJa: 数がとても多く、百の数倍にもなること。
presentation.note: Usually followed by a counter plus も (何百人も, 何百年も) to stress a large, unspecified number; 何千 and 何万 work the same way at larger scales.

presentation.meaning: who; what kind of person (often someone unknown or suspicious)
presentation.defJa: どういう人。正体のわからない人について言う。
presentation.note: Asks about someone's identity or true nature with a sense of mystery or suspicion, and 何者か is the standard news phrase for 'an unknown person.'

presentation.defJa: 大きな地震のあとに、その近くで続けて起こる地震。
presentation.note: A standard term in earthquake reporting, contrasted with 本震 (the main shock) and 前震 (a foreshock).

presentation.meaning: to build up; to create (something complete through sustained effort)
presentation.defJa: 時間や手間をかけて、ものを最後まで完成させる。
presentation.note: Stresses finishing something through long effort, unlike plain 作る, and it can also mean to fabricate, as in 話を作り上げる.

presentation.meaning: to produce; to create; to generate
presentation.defJa: 今までなかったものを、新しくこしらえる。生み出す。
presentation.note: Emphasizes bringing something new into existence, from goods to abstractions like jobs or an atmosphere, and is close in meaning to 生み出す.
collocations: 新しい価値を作り出す

presentation.meaning: operation; activation (of a machine or device)
presentation.defJa: 機械や装置が動いて、決められた働きをすること。
presentation.note: Used for machines, sensors and safety systems kicking in or functioning, and more technical than 動く, typical of manuals and news reports.

presentation.meaning: an average or normal year; usual (for the time of year)
presentation.defJa: いつもの年。また、毎年決まってそうであること。
presentation.note: Very frequent in weather, harvest and event reporting for comparison with a typical year, and more formal than いつもの年.

presentation.meaning: statement; testimony (to police or in court)
presentation.defJa: 事件の容疑者や証人が、警察や裁判所で事実について話すこと。また、その内容。
presentation.note: A legal and crime-news term for what a suspect or witness tells investigators, more procedural than 証言, which mainly means a witness's testimony in court.

presentation.defJa: 他人の権利などを不当におかし、そこなうこと。
presentation.note: Typically paired with rights, privacy or territory in legal and news contexts, whereas 侵入 refers to physically breaking into a place.

presentation.defJa: 大切なものを、よい状態のまま守り続けること。
presentation.note: Common in environmental and legal contexts (環境保全, 証拠保全), and close to 保護, though 保全 stresses keeping something intact over time.

presentation.meaning: security; safety (maintenance of public safety and order)
presentation.defJa: 社会や施設の安全と秩序を守ること。
presentation.note: A formal, institutional word found in compounds about facilities and transport (保安検査, 保安基準), whereas everyday speech prefers 安全 or 警備.

presentation.meaning: retention; holding (keeping something as it is)
presentation.defJa: ある物や状態を、そのまま持ち続けること。
presentation.note: A formal word for keeping data, records, titles or a state as it is (世界記録を保持する), whereas 保有 focuses on owning assets or resources.

presentation.meaning: possession; holding (of assets, licenses, weapons, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 財産や資格、権利などを自分のものとして持っていること。
presentation.note: A formal word for holding assets, shares, licenses or weapons, common in finance and policy news, and more official than 持つ; 所有 stresses legal ownership.

presentation.defJa: 一人だけで使う部屋。
presentation.note: Used for hospitals, restaurants, offices and karaoke where a room is for one person or one party, in contrast to 相部屋 or 大部屋 (shared rooms).

presentation.meaning: under the umbrella (of a parent company or organization); affiliated with
presentation.defJa: 大きな会社や組織の下に入り、その支配や指導を受けていること。
presentation.note: A business and news term for a subsidiary or affiliate under a larger group, also used for unions or factions under a larger organization.

presentation.meaning: to hurt (someone's feelings); to wound; to damage
presentation.defJa: 人の気持ちや体、物などをいためる。
presentation.note: Often used for emotional hurt, pride or reputation as well as physical damage, and pairs with the intransitive 傷つく (to get hurt).

presentation.meaning: injury; bodily harm (esp. in legal and insurance contexts)
presentation.defJa: 体にけがをさせること。また、そのけが。
presentation.note: A formal legal and insurance term (傷害罪, 傷害保険) where everyday speech just says けが; do not confuse it with 障害 (disability, obstacle), which has the same reading.

presentation.meaning: a little while ago; just now
presentation.defJa: 少し前。「さっき」の丁寧な言い方。
presentation.note: A polite, formal equivalent of さっき used in business, announcements and broadcasting, with 後ほど as its counterpart meaning 'later.'
collocations: 先ほど申し上げた通り

presentation.meaning: taking the lead (by scoring first); preemption; seizing the initiative
presentation.defJa: 相手より先に行動して、有利な立場に立つこと。特に、試合で先に点を取ること。
presentation.note: Most common in sports reporting for scoring first (先制点, 先制ゴール), and in military or political contexts it means a preemptive move (先制攻撃).

presentation.meaning: starting (in a game), esp. as the starting pitcher; setting off ahead of others
presentation.defJa: 試合の始めから出場すること。また、ほかより先に出かけること。
presentation.note: In sports it marks the starting lineup or starting pitcher (先発投手), while elsewhere it means going on ahead, as in an advance party (先発隊) or brand-name drugs (先発医薬品).

presentation.meaning: to be the first to do something; to lead the way (ahead of others)
presentation.defJa: ほかの人やものより先に物事を行う。
presentation.note: Almost always appears as ～に先駆けて ('ahead of ...'), a formal pattern frequent in news about firsts and product launches.

presentation.defJa: 名誉なことで、ほこらしく思うこと。
presentation.note: Typically used humbly about oneself in formal speech (光栄です, 光栄に存じます), whereas 名誉 is the more general noun for honor or prestige.

presentation.defJa: 一つの政党の内部。その政党の中。
presentation.note: Used in political reporting for matters inside a single party (党内対立, 党内手続き), as opposed to dealings between parties such as 与野党間.

presentation.defJa: 政党のいちばん上に立つ代表者。
presentation.note: The general term for the head of a political party; individual parties may formally title their leader 総裁, 代表 or 委員長, but news reports group them all as 党首.

presentation.meaning: entry; onset (of a season or period, esp. in compounds); attendance or turnout
presentation.defJa: ある季節や時期が始まること。また、会場などに人が集まる具合。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone except in phrases like 客の入りがいい (a good turnout); it mostly appears as the second element of compounds such as 梅雨入り, 仲間入り and 日の入り.

presentation.defJa: 建物や場所などへ入るための所。
presentation.note: The everyday word for the way into a place, also used figuratively for the threshold of a field or stage of life; signs often write it 入口.

presentation.meaning: to get into; to work one's way deep inside
presentation.defJa: 中のほうまで深く入っていく。
presentation.note: Stresses getting deep inside or into a narrow or unexpected place, often uninvited, whereas plain 入る is neutral; it can also mean becoming absorbed in something (役に入り込む).

presentation.defJa: 野球チームや劇団などの集まりに加わり、その一員になること。
presentation.note: Used for joining a team, troupe or corps (球団, 劇団, 楽団, 消防団), whereas 入社 is for companies and 入会 for clubs and associations.

presentation.meaning: moving in (to a home); taking up residence
presentation.defJa: 新しい家や部屋に移り住むこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for moving into a dwelling, typical of property listings and news (入居者募集, 即入居可); in conversation people usually say 引っ越す or 住み始める.
collocations: 老人ホームに入居する

presentation.meaning: the whole area; the entire region
presentation.defJa: ある地域や範囲のすべての部分。
presentation.note: Common in news and weather reports for an entire geographical area (市内全域, 関東全域); 全体 is broader and not limited to physical space.

presentation.meaning: the full picture; the whole of something
presentation.defJa: ものごとの全体の姿や内容。
presentation.note: A formal news word for the whole picture of something previously hidden or only partly known, almost always with 明らかになる or 解明する; 全体像 is a slightly less formal near-synonym.

presentation.defJa: 火事で建物などがすっかり焼けてしまうこと。
presentation.note: The standard fire-report term for a building burned to the ground, contrasted with 半焼 (half burned); in casual speech people say 丸焼け.

presentation.meaning: all of the United States; nationwide (US)
presentation.defJa: アメリカ合衆国の全体。
presentation.note: Means the whole of the United States (米 = America), familiar from headlines and ad copy such as 全米が泣いた; it does not mean the whole American continent.

presentation.defJa: 鉄道やバスなどの路線のすべての区間。
presentation.note: Used for an entire railway, bus or road route, especially in service announcements (全線開通, 全線不通); in military contexts it means the whole front line.

presentation.defJa: ものの端から端までの長さ。
presentation.note: Used for the end-to-end length of objects, animals, bridges, rivers or vehicles, typically followed by a figure; 長さ is the plain general word.

presentation.defJa: すべての面。また、ある事柄のすべてにわたること。
presentation.note: As a noun it means the whole surface (壁の全面), but it most often works as a prefix-like element meaning total or across-the-board (全面戦争, 全面的), the opposite of 一部.

presentation.defJa: 刑事事件で、公開の法廷で行われる裁判の手続き。
presentation.note: The formal legal term for a criminal trial session held in open court, constant in crime news; 裁判 is the general everyday word covering civil and criminal cases.

presentation.defJa: 隠しごとや不正がなく、正しく公平であること。
presentation.note: Formal and somewhat dated outside fixed phrases such as 公明正大 (fair and above-board) and 公明選挙 campaigns; in news it is also the short name of the 公明党 party.

presentation.defJa: 国や自治体など、おおやけに関わるさま。
presentation.note: Means relating to the state or public bodies, the opposite of 私的; 公共 stresses things shared by society such as facilities, while 公的 stresses official or governmental status.

presentation.defJa: 社会全体のためになる利益。
presentation.note: A formal word for the good of society as a whole, the opposite of 私益 (private gain); common in law, journalism ethics and the names of nonprofit bodies (公益財団法人).

presentation.meaning: official announcement (esp. of a national election)
presentation.defJa: 国などが、決めたことを広く一般に知らせること。特に選挙の始まりを正式に知らせること。
presentation.note: In news it chiefly means the official proclamation that starts a national election campaign (local elections use 告示 instead), and it also appears in 公示地価, officially published land prices.

presentation.defJa: 国や自治体がお金を出して作った、公共の事業を行う法人。
presentation.note: Refers to a state- or municipality-funded corporation running a public service; the national ones were privatized, but the word survives in local bodies such as 住宅供給公社 and 道路公社.

presentation.defJa: 選挙などで、政党や候補者が人々に対して約束すること。また、その約束。
presentation.note: A promise made publicly to voters, especially by a candidate or party; 約束 is the general word, and a broken pledge is called 公約違反.

presentation.defJa: 多くの人が見たり使ったりできるようにすること。
presentation.note: Covers releasing films, data, software or opening places to the public; 発表 means announcing, while 公開 means actually making something open or viewable (its opposite is 非公開).

presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の団体がいっしょに行事などを開くこと。
presentation.note: Used for events jointly organized by two or more bodies, usually in the pattern AとBの共催; 主催 is the main organizer and 後援 a supporter that lends its name.

presentation.defJa: 一つのものを、二人以上で持ったり使ったりすること。
presentation.note: Means sharing ownership or use of something with others, from data and files to experiences and values; in law it means co-ownership, and the katakana シェア is a casual equivalent.

presentation.meaning: joint struggle; joining forces (against a common opponent)
presentation.defJa: 二つ以上の団体が力を合わせて、共通の相手とたたかうこと。
presentation.note: Implies separate groups such as parties or unions joining forces against a common opponent, a word of political and labor news; 協力 is neutral cooperation without the sense of a fight.

presentation.defJa: ものの中のほう。また、ある線や境目より中の部分。
presentation.note: The everyday word for the inner side of something, the opposite of 外側; 内部 is more formal and refers to the interior of an organization or structure.

presentation.defJa: 国の内部の政治や行政に関する仕事。
presentation.note: Now mostly historical, referring to Japan's prewar Home Ministry (内務省) or to the interior ministries of other countries; the opposite is 外務 (foreign affairs).

presentation.defJa: 野球で、四つのベースを結んだ線の中とその近く。また、そこを守る選手。
presentation.note: Baseball term for the infield, also used for the infielders as a group and for the seats along the baselines (内野席); the opposite is 外野.

presentation.defJa: 人の心の中。性格や気持ちなど、外から見えない部分。
presentation.note: Most often refers to a person's inner life, character or feelings as opposed to outward appearance (外見, 外面); it can also mean the literal inner surface of an object.

presentation.defJa: もう一度。ふたたび。
presentation.note: A more formal, written equivalent of もう一度 or 再び, common in notices, error messages and business writing (再度ご確認ください).

presentation.defJa: 止まっていたことを、また始めること。
presentation.note: Means starting something again after a pause, from trains and talks to business; do not confuse it with the homophone 再会 (meeting again).

presentation.defJa: 冬の時期。冬の間。
presentation.note: A formal or technical word for the winter season used in schedules, sports and notices (冬季休業, 冬季五輪); 冬 is the everyday word.

presentation.defJa: 船が港を出ていくこと。
presentation.note: Used for ships leaving port, the opposite of 入港; the homophone 出航 (also しゅっこう) stresses setting out on a voyage and is also used for aircraft.

presentation.meaning: outbreak of fire; a fire starting (in a building)
presentation.defJa: 建物などから火が出て、火事が起こること。
presentation.note: A news-report term focused on the moment and point where a fire starts, whereas 火災 or 火事 names the fire itself.

presentation.defJa: 生産者や倉庫などから、商品を市場や店へ送り出すこと。
presentation.note: Used for commercial goods leaving a farm, factory or warehouse for market, while 発送 is the general word for sending any parcel.

presentation.defJa: 事業などのために、お金を出すこと。
presentation.note: Means putting up capital in return for a stake in a company or project, whereas 投資 is any investment made for returns and 融資 is lending money.

presentation.meaning: running in a race; being entered as a starter
presentation.defJa: 競馬や競走などのレースに出ること。
presentation.note: Used for horses, cyclists or runners lining up to start a race (出走馬, 駅伝の出走メンバー), whereas 出場 is the general word for taking part in a tournament or match.

presentation.meaning: appearing in person (at a police station, court, etc.); turning oneself in
presentation.defJa: 呼び出しなどを受けて、警察や役所などに自分から出向くこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for presenting oneself at a police station, court or government office, often under summons, whereas 自首 specifically means confessing to a crime before being identified.

presentation.meaning: running for office; entering an election as a candidate
presentation.defJa: 選挙に候補者として出ること。
presentation.note: The standard journalistic word for entering an election race, whereas 立候補 is the formal act of registering as a candidate.

presentation.defJa: 包丁やはさみなど、物を切るための刃がついた道具。
presentation.note: An umbrella term for any bladed tool such as knives, scissors or sickles, common both in craft contexts and in crime reports, while ナイフ means a knife specifically.

presentation.defJa: 数字の後につけて、何分という時間の長さを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Attached to a number to stress a span of time, whereas plain 分 can mark either a clock time or a duration; the reading of 分 shifts to ぷん after some numbers, as in 三十分間 (さんじゅっぷんかん).

presentation.defJa: ある状態から別の状態に変えること。
presentation.note: Covers both mechanical switching of systems, screens or contracts and the mental act of resetting one's mood, as in 切り替えが早い "quick to move on", while 転換 is a more formal word for a larger change of direction.

presentation.meaning: to switch (over); to change (from one thing to another)
presentation.defJa: それまでのものをやめて、別のものに変える。
presentation.note: A transitive verb for a clean switchover between distinct systems, modes or plans, whereas 変える is the general word for any change.

presentation.meaning: to separate; to detach; to cut off (from)
presentation.defJa: つながっているものを分けて、別々にする。
presentation.note: Stresses cutting a physical or logical connection, and is often used figuratively as in 切り離して考える "to consider separately", whereas 分ける is the neutral word for dividing.
collocations: 現実から切り離された

presentation.defJa: 物を断ち切ること。また、つながりを切ること。
presentation.note: A formal, technical word for cutting through cables, steel or limbs or for breaking a connection such as 回線の切断, while 切る is the everyday verb.

presentation.meaning: the first (holder of a post, in a line); founder
presentation.defJa: ある家や地位、系統などで、最初の人やもの。
presentation.note: Marks the first in a succession of office holders, a family line or a product series, as opposed to 二代目 or 三代目, while 創業者 means specifically the founder of a business.

presentation.meaning: the first time; first installment (of a series)
presentation.defJa: 何回か続くもののうち、最初の一回。
presentation.note: Used for the first instance of something that continues, such as a broadcast, payment or service (初回無料 "first time free"), whereas 最初 is the general word for first.

presentation.defJa: 夏の始めのころ。だいたい五月から六月ごろ。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary seasonal word for roughly May to early June, frequent in weather reports and letter greetings, while 夏の初め is the plain everyday paraphrase.

presentation.meaning: first match (in a tournament or series)
presentation.defJa: 大会などで最初に行う試合。
presentation.note: A sports-journalism word for a team's first match in a tournament; the homophone 緒戦 originally means the opening battle of a war and is sometimes used in sports in the same way.

presentation.meaning: first day; opening day (of a show, exhibition, tournament)
presentation.defJa: 興行や行事などが始まる最初の日。
presentation.note: Means the opening day of a run, exhibition, sale or sumo tournament (初日を出す "to score a first win"); note that 初日の出 is read はつひので, "the first sunrise of the year".

presentation.defJa: ある物事や時代が始まって間もないころ。
presentation.note: Covers the early stretch of a process, era or illness (初期の作品 "early works", 初期化 "reset to defaults"), whereas 最初 points to the very first moment.

presentation.meaning: beginning (of a century, decade or year)
presentation.defJa: ある時代や年などの、始まりのころ。
presentation.note: A written word for the opening part of a century, decade or year, whereas 初め is the everyday equivalent and 初期 suggests a longer early period.

presentation.defJa: 調べた結果、はっきりとわかること。
presentation.note: Frequent in news for facts that come to light through investigation (身元が判明した "the identity was established"), while わかる is the everyday verb and 明らかになる a slightly softer written alternative.

presentation.meaning: first half; early part (e.g. of one's twenties)
presentation.defJa: 全体を二つに分けたときの、前の半分。
presentation.note: Divides a period, game, book or age bracket into halves and is paired with 後半, as in 三十代前半 "early thirties", whereas 初め simply marks the beginning.

presentation.defJa: 物事に対して積極的で、よい方向に考えようとする様子。
presentation.note: Means positive or constructive in attitude, but in business and politics 前向きに検討します is a polite and often noncommittal promise to consider something; ポジティブ is the more casual loanword.

presentation.meaning: last time; the previous occasion (of a recurring event)
presentation.defJa: 何度か行われるもののうち、今回のすぐ前の回。
presentation.note: Refers to the previous occurrence of a recurring meeting, survey, election or episode, whereas 前 alone is vaguer and 先回 is an older, less common equivalent.

presentation.meaning: the previous year; the preceding year
presentation.defJa: ある年の、一つ前の年。
presentation.note: Common in statistics and news for the year before a given year (前年比 "year-on-year"), whereas 去年 and 昨年 mean last year counted from the present.

presentation.defJa: 進んでいく方向。自分の前の方。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal spatial word common in traffic, announcements and technical writing (前方不注意 "failure to watch the road ahead"), whereas 前 is the everyday word.

presentation.defJa: ある日の、一つ前の日。
presentation.note: Means the day before a particular event or date (試合の前日), whereas 昨日 means yesterday counted from today.

presentation.defJa: 暖かい空気と冷たい空気の境目が地上と交わる線。また、戦いや活動の最も先の場所。
presentation.note: In everyday news it most often means a weather front, and by extension the front line of a war or field (研究の最前線 "the cutting edge of research"), whereas 戦線 refers specifically to a battle line.

presentation.meaning: front; forefront (often figurative: to put something front and center)
presentation.defJa: 物の前の面。また、人目につく表の部分。
presentation.note: Literally the front face of a building or object, but most often used figuratively in 前面に出す or 前面に押し出す "to put at the forefront", while 正面 is the face one looks at directly.

presentation.defJa: 新しく物事をつくり出すこと。
presentation.note: A formal word common in policy and business writing for generating jobs, value or industries (雇用創出), whereas 創造 stresses original creative work.

presentation.defJa: 新しく事業や商売を始めること。
presentation.note: Evokes a founder starting an enterprise and appears often in phrases marking a company's age (創業百年の老舗), whereas 設立 is the neutral legal term for establishing a company or organization.

presentation.meaning: founding; establishment (of an institution, system, fund, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 学校や組織、制度などを新しくつくり始めること。
presentation.note: A formal word for founding institutions, funds or systems for the first time; 設立 is the more general, often legal term for setting up companies and organizations.

presentation.defJa: 社会や組織のために長く尽くし、立派な働きをしたこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for long, dedicated service to a community or organization, mostly seen in compounds like 功労者 and 功労賞; 功績 focuses on the concrete achievement itself.
collocations: 長年の功労をたたえる

presentation.meaning: joining (an organization, alliance or treaty); membership; affiliation
presentation.defJa: 団体や組織、条約などに仲間として加わること。
presentation.note: Used for formally joining an organization, alliance or treaty as a member (加盟国, 加盟店); 参加 is the general word for taking part in an event or activity.

presentation.meaning: efficacy; beneficial effect (of a medicine, hot spring, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 薬や温泉などが体に与える、よいはたらき。
presentation.note: Typically refers to the beneficial effects claimed for medicines, hot springs or health products, as on labels (効能書き); 効果 is the broader everyday word for any effect or result.

presentation.meaning: video (esp. online or digital); video clip
presentation.defJa: インターネットなどで見る、動きのある映像。
presentation.note: The standard modern word for online or digital videos; ビデオ sounds slightly dated or refers to recordings, and 映像 is the broader term for any moving image or footage.

presentation.defJa: 北と東のちょうど中間の方角。
presentation.note: A standard compass term in weather reports and geography; as in English the north element comes first, while the reversed 東北 usually refers to the Tohoku region.

presentation.defJa: 赤道から北へ向かって測った緯度。
presentation.note: A technical geographical term used with degrees in maps, news and science writing; its counterpart is 南緯, and longitude is given with 東経 or 西経.

presentation.defJa: 北と西のちょうど中間の方角。
presentation.note: A neutral compass term common in weather reports and directions; the reversed 西北 is literary, surviving in set phrases such as 都の西北 and in the sixteen-point compass name 西北西.

presentation.meaning: northern part; the north (of a country or region)
presentation.defJa: ある地域や国の中で、北のほうの部分。
presentation.note: A neutral term for the northern part of a country, prefecture or city, common in news and weather reports; 北方 instead means the direction north or lands lying to the north.

presentation.defJa: 病気の治療や予防に使う薬。また、医術と薬剤。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone; it mostly appears in compounds such as 医薬品 (pharmaceuticals), 医薬部外品 (quasi-drugs) and 医薬分業, giving it a formal, regulatory tone compared with everyday 薬.

presentation.defJa: 自分の名前を明かさないこと。
presentation.note: Means keeping one's name hidden, as with anonymous posts, donations or sources (匿名希望, 'name withheld'); 無記名 refers more narrowly to a form or ballot with no name written on it.

presentation.defJa: 一年の半分。六か月ほどの期間。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a six-month period, often in 半年ぶり ('for the first time in six months'); 半期 is the business and accounting term for a half-year term.

presentation.meaning: half (of a number of people or things)
presentation.defJa: 全体の数の半分。
presentation.note: A neutral term common in surveys and news (半数以上, 半数近く); compare 過半数, 'a majority (more than half)', which is the key word in votes and elections.

presentation.meaning: half of the body (one side, or the upper or lower half)
presentation.defJa: 体の左右または上下のどちらか半分。
presentation.note: Refers to one half of the body, either left or right (右半身のまひ) or upper or lower (上半身, 下半身); 半身浴 is a popular bathing style in which only the lower body is immersed, up to just below the chest.

presentation.defJa: 台の中央にネットを張り、小さな球をラケットで打ち合う競技。
presentation.note: The standard word for table tennis; ピンポン is a casual or old-fashioned alternative used mostly for the recreational game.

presentation.defJa: 行事や催しの目的に賛成し、お金や品物を出して手助けすること。
presentation.note: Used when companies or groups back an event with money or goods and are credited as 協賛 on posters; 後援 implies lending one's name and endorsement (often by public bodies), while 主催 is the organizer.

presentation.defJa: 南と東のちょうど中間の方角。
presentation.note: The standard compass term in weather reports and astronomy; note the on-reading なん, while 南 alone is みなみ. The reversed 東南 survives in names such as 東南アジア and in the compass point 東南東.

presentation.meaning: southern sea(s); the seas to the south
presentation.defJa: 南のほうにある海。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary word for warm southern seas, evoking remote tropical islands (南海の孤島, 南海の楽園). In the news it appears most often in 南海トラフ, the undersea trough feared for future megaquakes, where 南海 comes from the old regional name 南海道 rather than this general sense.

presentation.defJa: 南と西のちょうど中間の方角。
presentation.note: A neutral compass term; in housing ads 南西向き describes a room facing southwest, and 南西諸島 is the name of the island chain stretching from Kyushu toward Taiwan.

presentation.meaning: southern part; the south (of a country or region)
presentation.defJa: ある国や地域の中で、南のほうの部分。
presentation.note: A neutral term for the southern part of a country or region, very common in news and travel writing; 南方 instead points to the direction south or lands lying to the south.

presentation.defJa: 広くさまざまな物事に通じていること。また、動物・植物・鉱物など自然界のものを幅広く研究する学問。
presentation.note: Seldom used on its own today; it survives mainly in 博物館 (museum) and 博物学 (natural history), the older all-embracing study of plants, animals and minerals.

presentation.meaning: the same day; on that very day
presentation.defJa: ある物事が行われた、まさにその日のうち。
presentation.note: A formal word meaning 'on the very same day', typical of official or commercial contexts such as 即日開票 and 即日発送; 当日 simply means 'that day' without the sense of immediate action.

presentation.defJa: 時間をおかず、すぐその場で行うこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for 'immediate, without delay', common in technical, financial and diplomatic language (即時停戦, 即時決済); everyday speech would use すぐ, and ただちに is the formal adverb.

presentation.meaning: welfare; well-being (as in employee benefits or public health)
presentation.defJa: 人々の暮らしや健康を豊かにし、よりよくすること。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone; it appears mostly in institutional compounds such as 福利厚生 (employee benefits), 厚生労働省 and 厚生年金, whereas 福祉 is the general word for social welfare.

presentation.defJa: 民事裁判や行政裁判で、裁判所に訴えを起こした側の人。
presentation.note: The legal term for the party who brings a civil or administrative lawsuit, opposite 被告; in criminal cases the accusing side is the prosecutor (検察官), not the 原告.

presentation.defJa: 原子力を使って電気をつくる施設。
presentation.note: The everyday abbreviation of 原子力発電所 (or 原子力発電), used constantly in news and public debate, while the full form appears in official documents.

presentation.defJa: 規則や決まりをきびしく守り、少しの乱れも許さない様子。
presentation.note: Describes strictness that rigorously follows rules or standards, used for people (厳格な父) and procedures (厳格な審査); 厳しい is the broader everyday word, and 厳格 sounds more formal.

presentation.defJa: 心が引きしまるほど、おごそかで真剣な様子。
presentation.note: Describes the solemn, dignified atmosphere of ceremonies or memorials, and 厳粛に受け止める means taking something with grave seriousness; it differs from 厳格, which is about strictness.

presentation.meaning: joining a competition or contest; entering a war
presentation.defJa: 戦争や試合、競争などに加わること。
presentation.note: Originally 'entering a war', it is now widely used figuratively for joining a competition, market battle or game (開発競争に参戦); 参加 is the neutral word with no sense of contest.

presentation.meaning: visiting a shrine or temple to worship
presentation.defJa: 神社や寺に行って、神や仏を拝むこと。
presentation.note: The standard word for visiting a shrine or temple to pray; お参り is the softer everyday equivalent, while 参詣 is more literary.

presentation.meaning: participation (in a project or policy, from the planning stage)
presentation.defJa: 計画や事業に、その立案の段階から加わること。
presentation.note: More formal than 参加: 参画 implies joining in the planning and decision-making of a project or policy rather than merely taking part, and is common in official and business writing.

presentation.meaning: House of Councillors (the upper house of Japan's Diet)
presentation.defJa: 参議院を短くした言い方。日本の国会の二つの議院のうち、任期が六年のほう。
presentation.note: The standard newspaper abbreviation of 参議院, paired with 衆院 for the lower house; in headlines and news copy it is far more common than the full name.

presentation.meaning: recording (of a program); inclusion (in a book or album)
presentation.defJa: 番組などを録音・録画すること。また、本やアルバムなどに入れること。
presentation.note: Used both for recording a broadcast in advance (as opposed to 生放送, a live broadcast) and for including pieces in a book, album or collection; for capturing sound or video in general, 録音 and 録画 are more common.
collocations: アルバムに収録された曲

presentation.meaning: to compile; to pull together (opinions, a report, etc.)
presentation.defJa: ばらばらの意見や資料を集めて、一つに整理する。
presentation.note: Stresses gathering scattered input and organizing it into one agreed document or position, typical of business and government reports; まとめる alone is the broader everyday verb.
collocations: 報告書を取りまとめる

presentation.defJa: 問題を解決しようとして、熱心に行う活動。
presentation.note: A staple of news and corporate writing for a deliberate effort or program to tackle an issue; in sumo the same word, usually written 取組 without okurigana, means a bout.

presentation.meaning: obtaining; acquisition (of a qualification, right, leave, property, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 資格や権利、物などを手に入れること。
presentation.note: A formal word for acquiring something through an official procedure, such as a license, a right, leave or property; in everyday speech 取る is used instead (資格を取る).

presentation.meaning: receiving (a signal, message, email, etc.); reception
presentation.defJa: 電波や電話、メールなどの信号を受け取ること。
presentation.note: The formal counterpart of 送信 (sending), used for signals, broadcasts and messages; in casual talk people more often say メールが届く or 来る.

presentation.meaning: receiving an order (for goods or work)
presentation.defJa: 客や取引先から、品物や仕事の注文を受けること。
presentation.note: A business term for the seller's side of an order, the opposite of 発注 (placing an order), common in economic news and company reports.

presentation.meaning: winning a prize; receiving an award
presentation.defJa: コンクールや審査などで認められ、賞をもらうこと。
presentation.note: Used for winning a prize or award, often with the award's name (芥川賞を受賞); do not confuse it with the homophone 授賞, which is the act of conferring the award.
collocations: ノーベル賞を受賞する

presentation.meaning: account (at a bank or securities firm)
presentation.defJa: 銀行や証券会社などで利用者ごとに設けられ、お金の出し入れや取引が記録されるもの。
presentation.note: The standard word for an account at a bank or securities firm, with 口座を開設する as the formal phrase for opening one; for online services the loanword アカウント is used instead.

presentation.defJa: 国会を開くために、議員を呼び集めること。
presentation.note: The official word for convening the national Diet; convening a local assembly is written with the homophone 招集. Historically 召集 also meant a military call-up (召集令状).

presentation.defJa: これまでの歴史の中。記録が残っている範囲で。
presentation.note: Almost always fused with a superlative or 'first' in news headlines (史上初, 史上最大); 歴史上 is the plainer, more neutral form.

presentation.defJa: 右のほう。右に当たる部分。
presentation.note: A plain, concrete word for the right-hand side of something; 右手 can also mean 'on the right' as seen from where one stands, as in tour-guide commentary (右手に見えますのは…).

presentation.meaning: command; commander (in compounds for headquarters and commanding officer)
presentation.defJa: 軍隊などで、部隊を指揮して命令を出すこと。また、その役の人。
presentation.note: Today it appears mostly in compounds such as 司令官, 司令部 and the figurative 司令塔 (control tower; a team's playmaker), while a single order or instruction is usually written 指令.

presentation.defJa: 敵と味方が出会って戦うこと。特に、昔の武士どうしの戦い。
presentation.note: Refers mainly to historical battles between armies, especially of samurai, and survives in playful compounds like 雪合戦 (snowball fight) and 歌合戦 (song contest); for modern warfare 戦闘 or 戦い is used.

presentation.defJa: 法律に反していないこと。法律で認められていること。
presentation.note: The formal opposite of 違法 (illegal), often used as 合法的 (lawful, by legal means) or 合法化 (legalization); 適法 is the more technical legal term for 'in conformity with the law'.

presentation.meaning: likewise; similarly; in the same way
presentation.defJa: 前に述べたことと同様に。
presentation.note: A slightly formal adverb meaning 'in the same way', common in writing and news reports (同じく東京に住む男性); in conversation 同じように or simply も sounds more natural.

presentation.meaning: the said party; the same (political) party
presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その政党。また、同じ政党。
presentation.note: A news-writing reference word meaning 'that party', used to avoid repeating a party name already mentioned; like 同国, 同省 and 同県, it is rarely heard in conversation.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その国。
presentation.note: Newspaper shorthand for 'that country' after a nation has been named; in speech people say その国 or repeat the name.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その月。また、同じ月。
presentation.note: Used in news and reports to point back to a month just mentioned or to compare like-for-like periods, as in 前年同月比 (compared with the same month a year earlier); 同じ月 is the everyday phrasing.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その学校。また、同じ学校。
presentation.note: A formal reference word for a school already named, standard in news reports; in everyday talk people say その学校 or the school's short name.

presentation.defJa: 得点が相手と等しいこと。
presentation.note: Means the scores are level, either mid-game (同点に追いつく, to equalize) or at the end, whereas 引き分け refers specifically to a drawn result.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その町。
presentation.note: Newspaper shorthand for a town already named, parallel to 同市 for cities and 同村 for villages; in conversation people say その町.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その中央省庁。
presentation.note: Refers back to a government ministry already named in the article (財務省, 厚生労働省 and so on), and is strictly a written, journalistic form.

presentation.defJa: 前に話に出た、その県。また、同じ県。
presentation.note: A journalistic reference word for a prefecture already named; in speech people simply repeat the prefecture's name or say その県.

presentation.meaning: to give one's name as; to claim to be
presentation.defJa: 自分の名前や身分を相手に言う。また、そうであると言う。
presentation.note: Besides simply stating one's name, it often means 'to call oneself' or 'to claim to be' a role or title, which is why 〜を名乗る男 is a stock phrase in fraud reports.

presentation.meaning: name (under which something is held or issued, e.g. on a deed, account or published work)
presentation.defJa: 書類や作品などに、持ち主や責任者として記される名前。
presentation.note: The name under which something is legally held or officially issued, such as property, an account or a creative work; 名前 is the everyday word, while 名義 stresses the formal, recorded name.

presentation.defJa: 物がどちらの方を向いているかということ。方向。
presentation.note: The concrete sense is the direction something faces (南向き, 横向き); as a suffix it can also mean 'suited for' (初心者向き), which overlaps with 向け (aimed at).

presentation.defJa: 疑いをかけられた事実を、認めずに打ち消すこと。
presentation.note: Used mainly in criminal news for denying an accusation (容疑を否認), the opposite of 認める; 否定 is the general word for denying or negating anything.

presentation.meaning: accusation; exposing wrongdoing (as in whistleblowing or a criminal complaint)
presentation.defJa: 悪い行いや犯罪を明らかにして、責任を問うよう訴えること。
presentation.note: In legal usage a 告発 is a criminal complaint filed by a third party, while one filed by the victim is a 告訴; in news it also broadly means publicly exposing wrongdoing.

presentation.meaning: informing someone (of serious news such as a diagnosis); notification, announcement
presentation.defJa: 大切なことを相手に知らせること。特に、病名などを本人に伝えること。
presentation.note: Used for formally telling someone serious news such as a diagnosis (がん告知), for legal disclosure duties (告知義務 in insurance and property deals) and for announcing events (告知ポスター); routine official notices are usually 通知.

presentation.meaning: official public notice (by a government body); formal announcement of an election
presentation.defJa: 国や役所などが、決まったことを広く一般に知らせること。
presentation.note: Bureaucratic word for formal notices issued by public authorities; in election news, local and by-elections are 告示 while national general elections are 公示.

presentation.meaning: anniversary (counter for years since an event)
presentation.defJa: ある出来事から数えて、ちょうど何年目にあたるかを表す言葉。記念の年に使う。
presentation.note: Attached to a number for celebratory anniversaries (十周年, 五十周年); for deaths and disasters it is avoided in favor of 一周忌, 三回忌 or simply 震災から十五年.

presentation.meaning: making something widely known; common knowledge
presentation.defJa: 多くの人に広く知らせること。また、広く知られていること。
presentation.note: Common in office and official language (周知徹底をお願いします); as 周知の it means 'well-known', as in 周知のとおり 'as everyone knows'.

presentation.meaning: appeal; call (to the public to do something)
presentation.defJa: 多くの人に、ある行動をとるよう求めること。
presentation.note: Typical in news for public appeals by governments, companies or groups (避難の呼びかけ); softer and less official than 要請.

presentation.meaning: to call on (people) to do something; to appeal; to call out to
presentation.defJa: 人々に、ある行動をとるように声をかけて求める。
presentation.note: Most often used in news for public appeals (注意を呼びかける); the literal sense of calling out to a person nearby is less common in writing.

presentation.meaning: name something is commonly called by; popular name
presentation.defJa: ふだん人々がそのものを呼ぶときに使う名前。
presentation.note: Everyday word for the name actually used in speech, as opposed to an official 名称 or the formal 呼称.

presentation.meaning: designation; name (by which something is referred to)
presentation.defJa: ある物や人を指すときの、名前や言い方。
presentation.note: Formal word used in law, administration and journalism for what something is called; 呼び名 is the everyday counterpart.

presentation.defJa: 人や物に名前をつけること。
presentation.note: Formal word for officially giving a name, as to a new species, element, ship or facility (命名権 'naming rights'); everyday speech says 名前をつける.

presentation.defJa: 人の死を悲しみ、心からいたむこと。
presentation.note: Very formal and almost always in the fixed phrase 哀悼の意 in official statements and news, whereas 追悼 refers to the act or ceremony of remembering the dead.
collocations: 謹んで哀悼の意を表します

presentation.defJa: 商業と工業をまとめていう言葉。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds naming business bodies and policy areas (商工会議所 'chamber of commerce', 商工業者); it is rarely used on its own.

presentation.defJa: 自分の商品やサービスを他と区別するために使う、名前やマーク。
presentation.note: Legal term (商標権 'trademark right'); in everyday talk people tend to say ブランド名 or ロゴ instead.

presentation.meaning: raising awareness; public education (to change attitudes or behavior)
presentation.defJa: 人々が知らなかったことに気づき、正しく理解するよう教え導くこと。
presentation.note: Common in public-campaign language (啓発活動, 啓発ポスター) and in 自己啓発 'self-improvement'; in the passive (～に啓発される) it means to be inspired or stimulated by someone's ideas, a sense still in everyday use. Enlightenment in the historical sense is 啓蒙.

presentation.defJa: 人々の注意や関心、意識などを呼び起こすこと。
presentation.note: Formal, used mostly with abstract objects such as 注意, 関心, 議論 or 世論; 注意喚起 is a stock phrase for official warnings.

presentation.meaning: to suffer (a defeat); (formal) to drink, to smoke
presentation.defJa: 負けなどのよくない結果を受ける。また、飲んだり吸ったりする。
presentation.note: In modern Japanese mostly found in sports and election news with nouns of defeat (敗北, 惨敗, 苦杯); the original sense of drinking or smoking survives mainly in 喫茶 and 喫煙.

presentation.meaning: activity; the workings (of life, nature, society)
presentation.defJa: 生きていくためや、物事を続けていくために、くり返し行われていること。
presentation.note: A literary, slightly elevated word for the ongoing activity of life or nature, common in essays and documentaries; 活動 is the neutral, more concrete counterpart.

presentation.defJa: お金をもうけること。利益を得ることを目的にすること。
presentation.note: Formal and legal in tone, typically in 営利目的 or 非営利 (non-profit); it describes the purpose of an organization or act rather than the profit itself (利益).

presentation.defJa: 東西南北のすべての方向。また、まわり全体。
presentation.note: Usually describes being surrounded on all sides (四方を海に囲まれた国); 四方八方 is the emphatic 'in every direction', and the reading よも is archaic or poetic.

presentation.defJa: 百を四つ合わせた数。
presentation.note: Always read よんひゃく, never しひゃく; in horizontal modern text the number is usually written in Arabic numerals (400).

presentation.meaning: to turn; to rotate; to go around
presentation.defJa: 軸を中心にして、ぐるぐると動く。また、あちこちを順に訪ねる。
presentation.note: Basic verb with many extended uses (目が回る 'be dizzy', 手が回らない 'have no time to deal with', 各地を回る 'tour'); 回転する is the technical word for mechanical rotation.

presentation.defJa: よくないことが起こらないように、前もってさけること。
presentation.note: Formal and common in news and business (ストを回避, リスク回避); 避ける is the everyday verb, and 回避 often implies averting something that seemed imminent.

presentation.defJa: いくつもの国。多くの国。
presentation.note: Plural formed by reduplication that simply means 'many countries'; it reads softer and more descriptive than the formal 諸国 or 各国 'each country'.

presentation.defJa: ひとつの国の範囲の中。
presentation.note: Neutral everyday word, the opposite of 国外 or 海外; 国内外 'at home and abroad' is a common set phrase in news.

presentation.defJa: 国が直接、事業などを経営すること。
presentation.note: Describes enterprises run by the state (国営テレビ in news about other countries); 国有 stresses state ownership, while 公営 covers operation by local governments.

presentation.defJa: その国が持っている土地全体。
presentation.note: Refers to a country's land as a physical and administrative whole, common in geography and policy (国土開発); 領土 stresses sovereignty over territory.

presentation.defJa: その国の外。よその国。
presentation.note: More formal and legal-sounding than 海外, typical in phrases like 国外退去 'deportation' and 国外への流出; 海外 is the everyday word for going abroad.

presentation.defJa: 国全体の政治。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 県政 and 市政 (prefectural and municipal government); used in news about national elections and legislators.

presentation.defJa: 植物が育つ地面の土。また、物事が生まれ育つもとになる環境。
presentation.note: Technical word for soil in science and agriculture (土壌汚染), and widely used figuratively for conditions that foster something (いじめを生む土壌); 土 is the everyday word.

presentation.defJa: 一週間のうち、金曜の次で日曜の前の日。
presentation.note: Short form of 土曜日, very common in speech and schedules; 土日 means 'the weekend'.

presentation.meaning: earth and sand; soil and rock debris
presentation.defJa: 土と砂。特に、大雨などで崩れたり流れたりする土や石。
presentation.note: Used mainly in disaster and construction contexts (土砂災害警戒情報); unlike 土壌, it means loose earth as a mass or debris rather than soil as a growing medium.

presentation.defJa: 相手に大きな差をつけて勝つこと。
presentation.note: Used in election and sports reporting for a win by a wide margin; the opposite of 辛勝 (a narrow win), and on the losing side 惨敗 or 完敗.

presentation.defJa: その土地に住んでいること。
presentation.note: A formal word typical of forms, profiles and news (東京在住の会社員); in conversation people simply say 住んでいる.

presentation.defJa: 以前からその場所にあること。また、昔から行われてきたこと。
presentation.note: Appears mostly in compounds: 在来種 (native species, opposed to 外来種) and 在来線 (conventional rail lines, as opposed to the shinkansen).

presentation.defJa: 外国に一定の期間とどまって住むこと。
presentation.note: An administrative term for a foreigner's stay in a country (在留資格, or 在留邦人 for Japanese nationals abroad), more official than 在住 or 滞在.

presentation.meaning: being enrolled; being on the register (of a school, team or company)
presentation.defJa: 学校や団体に名前が登録されていて、その一員であること。
presentation.note: Stresses being on the official roll of a school, company or team rather than actually attending (在籍しているが休学中).

presentation.defJa: 地面の上。また、地球の表面。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 地下 (underground) and 上空 (the sky); in broadcasting it appears as 地上波 (terrestrial TV).

presentation.defJa: 土の中。地面の下。
presentation.note: Means inside the soil itself, whereas 地下 suggests a space below the surface such as a basement or subway.

presentation.defJa: 地方検察庁を短くした言い方。犯罪を調べて裁判にかけるかどうかを決める役所。
presentation.note: News abbreviation of 地方検察庁; reports put the city first (東京地検, 大阪地検) and pair it with 送検 and 起訴.

presentation.defJa: 地方裁判所を短くした言い方。多くの裁判が最初に行われる所。
presentation.note: News shorthand for 地方裁判所, the court of first instance for most cases; an appeal goes to the 高裁 (high court).

presentation.meaning: to take charge of, conduct (a task such as command, the baton or the pen)
presentation.defJa: 仕事や役目を引き受けて行う。また、指揮などをする。
presentation.note: A formal spelling of とる used with set objects such as 指揮, 筆, 教鞭 and 政務, meaning to take charge of or carry out a task rather than to grab something.

presentation.meaning: execution, carrying out (a budget, law, sentence)
presentation.defJa: 決められたことを、実際に行うこと。
presentation.note: Formal word for carrying out something already decided, such as a budget, law, sentence or court order; 実行 is the general everyday word.

presentation.defJa: 時間をかけて、力や性質などを少しずつ育てる。
presentation.note: Used for slowly building up abilities, values or relationships over time (長年培った経験); 育てる is the plain word for raising children or plants.

presentation.meaning: notification, alarm (mainly in compounds such as fire alarm)
presentation.defJa: 知らせること。危険などを人に伝えること。
presentation.note: Today it survives mainly in names of alarm devices such as 火災報知器, while 通知 or 知らせ cover notification in ordinary use.

presentation.defJa: 神社や寺の、垣などで囲まれた敷地の中。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to the enclosed grounds of a shrine or temple; the premises of a school or company are 敷地 or 構内.

presentation.defJa: すっかり壊れて、だめになること。
presentation.note: A dramatic word for total wipeout, seen most often as 壊滅的 in disaster and war reporting; 破壊 names the act of destroying, while 壊滅 names the resulting ruin.

presentation.defJa: 声を出して、がんばっている人を励ますこと。
presentation.note: Means cheering voiced aloud for athletes or candidates; 応援 is broader and covers any kind of support, including silent help.

presentation.defJa: ほかと比べて特にすぐれている点。また、品物を渡してお金をもらうこと。
presentation.note: In everyday and business Japanese it most often means a product's selling point (〜が売りだ); in finance it means selling, as opposed to 買い.

presentation.defJa: 売るために店などに出してある品物。
presentation.note: Basic meaning is goods offered for sale, and 〜を売り物にする extends it to a feature something trades on; 商品 is the neutral business term.

presentation.defJa: 土地や会社の一部などを売って手放すこと。
presentation.note: Formal business and legal word for selling off assets such as land, shares or a whole division, usually in one large transaction; 販売 is selling goods to customers.

presentation.defJa: 夏の季節。夏の間。
presentation.note: A formal written word used in notices and official names (夏季休業, 夏季五輪), while 夏 is the everyday word; 夏期 is used for a fixed summer term such as 夏期講習.

presentation.defJa: 夕方から夜にかけて食べる食事。
presentation.note: Neutral, slightly formal word for the evening meal; 晩ご飯 and 夕飯 are more conversational, and ディナー suggests a special or restaurant meal.

presentation.defJa: 物の、外に向いている面や部分。
presentation.note: Everyday word for the outer side or surface of something, paired with 内側; 外部 is more abstract and formal, often meaning outside an organization.

presentation.defJa: 外国との交渉や付き合いに関する国の仕事。
presentation.note: Almost always appears inside a compound such as 外務省 or 外務大臣; the general idea of diplomacy or foreign policy is 外交.

presentation.defJa: 数や量がたくさんあること。また、大部分。
presentation.note: The noun form of 多い, used before nouns as 多くの (多くの人) and on its own as a subject (多くは); it is a little more written than たくさん.

presentation.defJa: 数や量、程度がとても大きいこと。
presentation.note: Formal word for a huge amount of something abstract such as influence, contribution, damage or effort, almost always as 多大な; 大きな is the plain everyday equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 数が多いこと。また、全体の中で数の多いほう。
presentation.note: A formal counterpart of たくさん, common in news (多数の死傷者) and in voting contexts where it means the majority, as in 賛成多数 and 多数派.

presentation.defJa: よくないことが、何度も続けて起こること。
presentation.note: Used for incidents that keep occurring, such as accidents, crimes or illness, and frequent in headlines; it almost always describes unwelcome events.

presentation.defJa: いろいろな方面にわたること。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone: it appears in 多角的 (from many angles), 多角化 (business diversification) and 多角形 (polygon).

presentation.defJa: お金の量がとても大きいこと。
presentation.note: Used only for sums of money (多額の負債), whereas 多大 covers abstract things like influence or effort; 高額 stresses a high price or a large single payment.

presentation.defJa: 面積や人口が大きく、世界に強い影響力を持つ国。
presentation.note: Often forms compounds naming the field of dominance (経済大国, 人口大国); 強国 stresses military or political strength, while 大国 suggests overall size and influence.

presentation.defJa: 形や規模がふつうより大きいこと。
presentation.note: Works like a prefix for things classed as large in size or scale (大型車, 大型台風, 大型連休) and pairs with 中型 and 小型; it sorts by size category, whereas 大きな simply describes.

presentation.defJa: 大きくてよく響く声。
presentation.note: Names a loud or raised voice and appears mostly in set patterns like 大声で〜 and 大声を出す; 大きな声 is the plainer descriptive phrase.

presentation.defJa: 同じ業界の中で、特に規模が大きい会社。
presentation.note: A business-news word for the leading firms in a sector, often attached directly to nouns (大手銀行, 大手三社); the castle-gate sense is historical.

presentation.defJa: 戦いや試合で、ひどく負けること。
presentation.note: Stronger than 敗北 or 負け, implying a lopsided loss; 大敗を喫する is the set newspaper phrase for elections, battles and matches.

presentation.defJa: いくつかある賞の中で、いちばん上の賞。
presentation.note: Names the top award of a contest or prize and often appears in award titles; グランプリ is a common loanword equivalent.

presentation.meaning: large quantity; mass (as in mass production)
presentation.defJa: 数や量がとても多いこと。
presentation.note: A neutral written word for large quantities, common in compounds like 大量生産 and 大量消費; 多量 is a stiffer near-synonym.

presentation.defJa: 量が多く、激しく降る雨。
presentation.note: The standard weather-report word for heavy rainfall; 豪雨 is a stronger, more formal term for torrential rain.

presentation.defJa: 部屋の上のほうを覆っている面。
presentation.note: The everyday word for a room's ceiling; in market talk it also means a price peak, and 天井知らず describes prices rising without limit.

presentation.defJa: 試合などで、相手に点を取られること。また、その点。
presentation.note: A sports-reporting term for points or goals conceded, the opposite of 得点; figuratively it also means a blunder that costs a politician or company standing.

presentation.defJa: ふつうでは考えられない、不思議な出来事。
presentation.note: Used both for religious miracles and, very often, for astonishing real-life outcomes; the adverb 奇跡的に (miraculously) is especially common in news.

presentation.defJa: 物事に取りかかること。また、その最初の段階。
presentation.note: Written 始め when the sense is starting an activity, as in 仕事始め (first workday of the year) and 手始めに (to begin with); 初め is the usual spelling for the earliest point in time (年の初め, 初めのうち), though usage overlaps.

presentation.meaning: start-up (of a machine or project); launch
presentation.defJa: 機械や計画などが動き始めること。
presentation.note: A formal word for an engine or a project getting underway, common in headlines (新体制始動); 開始 is more neutral and 発足 is used for founding organizations.
collocations: プロジェクトが始動する

presentation.meaning: to entrust; to leave (a matter) to
presentation.defJa: 物事の判断や処理を、ほかの人に任せる。
presentation.note: More formal and weighty than 任せる, often used for entrusting a decision, fate or authority; 身を委ねる means to give oneself over to something.

presentation.defJa: 学校。特に、幼稚園から大学までをまとめて運営する私立の学校など。
presentation.note: Somewhat warmer or more literary than 学校, often seen in private school names and in set words like 学園祭 and 学園もの (school-life stories).

presentation.defJa: 学校。特に、専門的な学問や技術を教える教育機関の名前に使われる。
presentation.note: Mainly appears in the names of academies, seminaries and specialist schools; in ordinary talk people simply say 学校.

presentation.defJa: 心配や苦しみがなく、穏やかなようす。
presentation.note: A gentle, somewhat literary word for inner calm, also used of a peaceful death (安らかに眠る, rest in peace); 穏やか is broader and more everyday.

presentation.defJa: 無事でいるかどうかということ。
presentation.note: A formal news word used mainly after disasters or accidents, as in 安否確認 (checking whether people are safe); it covers both safety and its opposite.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、打者が塁に出られるように打った当たり。ヒット。
presentation.note: A formal scoring term for a base hit, common in newspaper box scores; in conversation people usually say ヒット.

presentation.defJa: 野球などで、相手に一点も与えずに試合を終えること。
presentation.note: Mainly a baseball term for a shutout, also used in other sports and figuratively for completely shutting down an opponent.

presentation.meaning: government secretariat (as in Chief Cabinet Secretary)
presentation.defJa: 内閣や役所で、全体の調整や事務を受け持つ部署。
presentation.note: Almost always appears in compounds for government secretariats, above all 官房長官 (Chief Cabinet Secretary), the government's chief spokesperson.

presentation.meaning: official residence (esp. the Prime Minister's Office)
presentation.defJa: 大臣など地位の高い役人のために、国が用意した住まいや仕事の建物。
presentation.note: Usually refers to the Prime Minister's Office (首相官邸), and in political reporting 官邸 alone stands for the prime minister and their inner circle (官邸主導); the residence where the prime minister actually lives is 公邸.

presentation.meaning: constant (in science or math); fixed number (of seats, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 決まっていて変わらない数や値。
presentation.note: In science it means a constant value, while in politics and administration it means a fixed number of seats or posts (議員定数); 定員 is the everyday word for capacity.

presentation.defJa: 流行に関係なく、いつもよく売れたり使われたりする物。
presentation.note: A casual but widely used media and shopping word for a reliable classic or go-to choice; it is far more colloquial than 標準.

presentation.defJa: 執行猶予がつかず、実際に刑務所に入らなければならない刑。
presentation.note: A legal-news term that contrasts with 執行猶予 (suspended sentence); a 実刑判決 means the defendant will actually be imprisoned.

presentation.defJa: 実際に行う、具体的な仕事。
presentation.note: Contrasts practical day-to-day work with theory or study, and is common in job listings as 実務経験 (hands-on experience).

presentation.defJa: 農業や工業、商業など、生産や売り買いにかかわる仕事。
presentation.note: A formal word for the world of business and industry, seen mostly in 実業家 (businessperson, entrepreneur) and 実業界 (the business world).

presentation.meaning: substance; essence; real (adjusted, as opposed to nominal)
presentation.defJa: 見かけではなく、中身や本当の性質。
presentation.note: Contrasts substance with appearance or nominal value (名目), as in 実質賃金 (real wages); 実質的に means effectively or in practice.

presentation.defJa: 判決や重大な事実を、相手に正式に告げること。
presentation.note: A grave, formal word for officially pronouncing a verdict or fateful news, such as a court sentence or a terminal diagnosis; 告知 is softer.

presentation.defJa: 人々の前で、誓いの言葉を正式に述べること。
presentation.note: A formal word for a public oath, heard in court, at inaugurations and in the athletes' oath (選手宣誓) at sports events; 誓う is the everyday verb.

presentation.defJa: 部屋や建物の中。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly formal word for indoors, common in compounds like 室内温度; 屋内 refers more broadly to the inside of a building as opposed to outdoors.

presentation.meaning: premises; a residence (esp. in police searches of a home or office)
presentation.defJa: 人が住んでいる家や建物。住まい。
presentation.note: Rarely used on its own today; it survives mainly in legal and news compounds like 家宅捜索, while 住宅 or 住居 are the ordinary words for a dwelling.

presentation.defJa: 冷蔵庫や洗濯機、テレビなど、家庭で使う電気製品。
presentation.note: A clipped form of 家庭用電気製品 used constantly in retail and business news; 白物家電 means major household appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners.

presentation.defJa: 罪を犯したのではないかという疑い。
presentation.note: A formal police and news term for the specific charge against someone, whereas 疑い is the general everyday word for suspicion or doubt.
collocations: 詐欺の容疑で逮捕する

presentation.defJa: よいとは言えないことでも、認めて受け入れること。
presentation.note: Often implies grudging acceptance of something one might otherwise oppose, unlike the neutral, formal 承認 (official approval).

presentation.meaning: playing against (an opponent); a match; facing
presentation.defJa: 相手と向かい合って、試合や勝負をすること。
presentation.note: The standard word for meeting an opponent in sports or games (including video games); do not confuse it with 大戦, the same reading, meaning a great war.

presentation.defJa: 社長を補佐して、会社の業務全体を管理する役員。取締役の役職の一つ。
presentation.note: In a typical Japanese company hierarchy the 専務 ranks below the president (and any vice presidents) and above the 常務; in associations and foundations the equivalent post is 専務理事.

presentation.defJa: 同じ種類のものの中で、形や大きさが小さいこと。
presentation.note: Describes the size class of a kind of object such as cars, dogs or devices, whereas 小さい is the general adjective; the opposite is 大型.

presentation.defJa: 六歳から十二歳の子どもが通う、義務教育の最初の段階の学校。
presentation.note: Almost never stands alone today; it appears in compounds like 小学校 and 小学生 and in grade names such as 小学三年.

presentation.defJa: 数が少ないこと。全体の中で人数の少ないほうの集まり。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 多数 and is common in political and social contexts; do not confuse it with 小数, the same reading, meaning a decimal fraction.

presentation.meaning: entering service (of a plane or ship on a route)
presentation.defJa: 船や飛行機が、決まった路線で運航を始めること。
presentation.note: A news term for a ship or airline beginning regular service on a route, narrower than 運航, which covers operating flights or voyages in general.

presentation.meaning: efforts; endeavor (on behalf of a cause or others)
presentation.defJa: ある目的のために、力をつくして努力すること。
presentation.note: A formal word often used to credit or thank others for their efforts, as in ご尽力いただき, and more ceremonious than 努力.

presentation.meaning: to put on or wear (shoes, socks, trousers, skirts)
presentation.defJa: 靴や靴下、ズボンなどを、足や下半身に身につける。
presentation.note: Used only for footwear and clothing worn below the waist; upper-body clothes take 着る and hats take かぶる.

presentation.defJa: 山と山にはさまれた所。山の中の土地。
presentation.note: Read さんかん in news and weather reports, especially in 山間部; in literary writing the same characters are often read やまあい.

presentation.defJa: 体の左側にある腕。
presentation.note: Read ひだりうで for the body part; in baseball reporting the same characters are read さわん and mean a left-handed pitcher.

presentation.defJa: 体が並外れて大きい人。また、ある分野で特に優れた業績を残した偉大な人。
presentation.note: Besides literal giants of myth, it is common in praise of towering figures (知の巨人), and in sports news it often refers to the Yomiuri Giants.

presentation.meaning: injunction; prohibition; suspension (esp. by court order)
presentation.defJa: 裁判所などが、ある行為をやめさせたり、させないようにしたりすること。
presentation.note: A legal and news term for a court-ordered halt to publication, operations or sales, more formal and binding than 中止.

presentation.meaning: to drag into; to involve (in an accident or trouble); to catch up in
presentation.defJa: 関係のない人を、事故や争いなどの中に引き入れる。
presentation.note: Most often used in the passive (巻き込まれる) for being caught up in accidents or disputes, though in business talk 周囲を巻き込む positively means getting others on board.

presentation.meaning: within the city; in the city
presentation.defJa: その市の区域の中。
presentation.note: A neutral administrative word for within city limits, as in 市内在住 (residing in the city); its counterpart is 市外, and 都内 is used for Tokyo.

presentation.defJa: 市の行政をまとめる最高責任者。選挙で選ばれる。
presentation.note: The elected head of a city; towns and villages have a 町長 or 村長, and prefectures a 知事.

presentation.defJa: 外国から自分の国へ帰ること。
presentation.note: Used for returning to one's home country; for going back to one's hometown within Japan the normal word is 帰省.

presentation.meaning: return (from a distant or dangerous place); repatriation
presentation.defJa: 遠い場所や危険な場所から、もとの所へ戻ってくること。
presentation.note: More formal than 帰る and used for returns from space, war or disaster zones (as in 帰還困難区域), implying a long or perilous absence.

presentation.defJa: 社長を補佐して、日常の業務を執行する役員。一般に専務の下に置かれる。
presentation.note: In a typical Japanese company the 常務 ranks below the 専務 and oversees day-to-day operations; the rarer sense 'routine business' survives mostly in legal texts.

presentation.defJa: 職場で定められた通常の勤務時間を通して勤めること。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 非常勤 (part-time or visiting) and is common in job ads and in institutions such as hospitals and universities.

presentation.defJa: 範囲が大きく、いろいろなものにわたっている様子。
presentation.note: Typically describes the range of people, knowledge or activities (幅広い層), whereas 広い more often refers to physical space.

presentation.defJa: 天候や作物の出来などが例年並みである年。気象では過去三十年の平均値を指す。また、うるう年でない年。
presentation.note: In weather reports it means the thirty-year climatological average (平年並み is 'about normal'); on the calendar it also means a non-leap year, the opposite of うるう年.

presentation.defJa: カエルのように手足を左右に広げて、水をかいて進む泳ぎ方。
presentation.note: One of the four competitive strokes, alongside 自由形 (freestyle), 背泳ぎ (backstroke) and バタフライ (butterfly).

presentation.defJa: 同一平面上の二本の直線、または二つの平面が、どこまで延ばしても交わらないこと。
presentation.note: Used for geometric or spatial parallels and in the idiom 平行線をたどる (talks remain deadlocked); for things happening at the same time, 並行 is the standard modern spelling.

presentation.meaning: within the year; before the year is out
presentation.defJa: その年が終わるまでの間。今年のうち。
presentation.note: A common news phrase for deadlines; 年内にも signals that something may happen as early as before the year ends.

presentation.meaning: beginning of the year; New Year period
presentation.defJa: 年の初めのころ。新しい年が始まったばかりの時期。
presentation.note: Most often heard in the set phrase 年末年始; 年始 alone can also mean New Year's visits, while 年初 is the drier word used in economic reports.

presentation.defJa: 一年の終わりのころ。十二月の終わりの時期。
presentation.note: Refers to the last weeks of December, a busy season associated with house cleaning, year-end gifts and 年末調整 (year-end tax adjustment).

presentation.defJa: ある程度年をとっていること。また、その人。
presentation.note: A polite, softer way to refer to older people than 老人 or 高齢者; 同年配 means "of about the same age."

presentation.defJa: 仕事をやめた後や老後などに、毎年決まって支払われるお金。
presentation.note: In the news it usually means the public pension system (公的年金), and a pensioner is 年金受給者.

presentation.meaning: organizer (of a party or gathering); executive secretary (of an organization)
presentation.defJa: 会や集まりの準備や世話をする役の人。
presentation.note: In daily life it is the person who organizes a drinking party or reunion; in politics 幹事長 is a party's secretary-general.

presentation.defJa: 現実にはないことを、あるかのように心に思い描くこと。
presentation.note: Often used critically of beliefs that don't match reality (幻想を抱く, 幻想が崩れる), while the adjective 幻想的 describes something dreamlike and beautiful.

presentation.defJa: 役所の仕事をするための建物。
presentation.note: Used for buildings housing public offices such as a city hall (市庁舎) or prefectural office (県庁舎); a private company's building is 社屋 or 本社ビル.

presentation.defJa: 広い範囲にわたる地域。
presentation.note: A formal compound used in administration, disaster and weather news (広域停電, 広域連合), more technical than 広い地域.

presentation.defJa: 組織の活動や情報を、広く一般の人々に知らせること。
presentation.note: Covers an organization's official communication with the public (広報部 = PR department), whereas 宣伝 leans toward advertising to sell something.

presentation.meaning: early stage; opening phase (of a game, contest or campaign)
presentation.defJa: 試合や物事が始まってまだ間もない段階。
presentation.note: Originally a go and shogi term, it is now common in sports and election coverage, alongside 中盤 (middle stage) and 終盤 (final stage).

presentation.defJa: 商品を売ったりサービスを提供したりするための建物や場所。
presentation.note: A business-register word for stores, frequent in corporate and economic news (新規店舗, 店舗展開), where everyday speech would simply say 店.

presentation.meaning: storefront; in stores (at the point of sale)
presentation.defJa: 店の前の部分や、商品を並べて売っている場所。
presentation.note: In news, 店頭に並ぶ means a product goes on sale in shops, and 店頭価格 is the retail price shoppers actually see.

presentation.defJa: 木や石、池などを使って美しく造った、広い庭。
presentation.note: Refers to a designed, often large and formal garden (日本庭園); an ordinary family yard is just 庭.

presentation.defJa: 船や大きな建物などをつくること。
presentation.note: Used mainly for ships and large structures, especially in 建造物; 建設 is the general word for building roads, facilities and infrastructure.

presentation.defJa: 決まった形式で行われる、改まった行事。
presentation.note: A formal word for official or commemorative ceremonies such as anniversaries and openings; 式 alone is used for personal events like weddings and graduations.

presentation.meaning: to take over (duties or work); to inherit, carry on
presentation.defJa: 前の人がしていた仕事や役目などを受けて、続けて行う。
presentation.note: Common in workplaces for handovers (the noun is 引き継ぎ), and also used for carrying on a tradition or family business.

presentation.meaning: hitting hard; a heavy blow (also a hard hit in baseball)
presentation.defJa: 体の一部を強くぶつけること。また、強く打つこと。
presentation.note: In news it usually describes accidents (頭を強打して意識不明), while in baseball 強打 and 強打者 refer to powerful hitting.

presentation.defJa: とても強いこと。また、強くて有名なチームや選手。
presentation.note: Common in sports reporting for teams or schools with a strong track record (強豪校), more neutral than 強敵, which means a formidable opponent you face.

presentation.defJa: 激しく吹く風。
presentation.note: A weather-report word (強風注意報 = high wind advisory); in casual speech people tend to say 風が強い.

presentation.defJa: ものごとが始まったばかりのころ。はじめ。
presentation.note: More formal than 最初, and often implies a contrast with how things later turned out (当初の予定より遅れる).

presentation.meaning: this place; here (where the speaker or writer is)
presentation.defJa: 話し手や書き手が今いる土地。この土地。
presentation.note: Formal and written, typical of letters and correspondents' reports; with ご it gives the common ご当地 ("of this locality"), as in ご当地グルメ.

presentation.defJa: その問題を扱う責任と権限をもつ役所や機関。
presentation.note: A news word for the official body responsible for a matter, often left unnamed or combined with a field (捜査当局 = investigators, 金融当局 = financial regulators).

presentation.meaning: our company; this company (said by its own staff)
presentation.defJa: 自分が勤めている会社を、改まって言うことば。
presentation.note: Used in formal company communications; 弊社 is humbler when speaking to customers, while 御社 or 貴社 refers to the other party's company.

presentation.meaning: for the time being; immediate, pressing (of a problem at hand)
presentation.defJa: さしあたって今のところ。しばらくの間。
presentation.note: As an adverb it means "for the time being" and is very common in announcements; as a noun modifier (当面の課題) it means the immediate problem at hand.

presentation.defJa: ものの形やありさま。
presentation.note: A technical, written word for the physical shape of objects, common in science and product descriptions (形状記憶合金 = shape-memory alloy), where everyday speech uses 形.

presentation.defJa: 何かが行われたり起きたりしたことを示す、あとに残ったしるし。
presentation.note: Typically used for evidence that an action took place (荒らされた形跡, 使われた形跡), whereas 痕跡 stresses the physical marks or remnants left behind.

presentation.meaning: executive; board member; officer (of an organization)
presentation.defJa: 会社や団体の運営に責任をもつ、上の立場の人。
presentation.note: In companies it means directors and executive officers, but it is also used for officers of PTAs, neighborhood associations and clubs.

presentation.meaning: coming and going; traffic (of people or vehicles)
presentation.defJa: 人や車が行ったり来たりすること。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary word for the flow of people or goods, also used in news for cross-border travel (国境の往来), whereas 交通 is the neutral word for traffic.

presentation.defJa: いつでも動けるように準備をして、その時を待つこと。
presentation.note: Implies readiness to act on instruction, as with emergency crews or 自宅待機 (staying home on standby); 待機児童 means children on waiting lists for daycare.

presentation.defJa: その時代よりあとの時代。また、あとの時代の人々。
presentation.note: A formal word for the ages that follow, typical in 後世に名を残す or 後世に伝える; read ごせ, the same characters mean the afterlife in Buddhist usage.

presentation.defJa: 前の人に代わって、その役目や地位につくこと。また、その人。
presentation.note: Refers to the person who takes over a specific post, the opposite of 前任 (predecessor); 後継者 is broader, suggesting an heir to a business or legacy.

presentation.defJa: 全体を二つに分けたときの、あとの方。
presentation.note: The everyday opposite of 前半; with ages and periods it means "late," as in 三十代後半 (late thirties) or 二十世紀後半.

presentation.meaning: backing, support; a push (encouragement that helps something move forward)
presentation.defJa: うしろから押すように、人や物事がうまく進むよう助けること。
presentation.note: An everyday and journalistic word for support or encouragement that pushes something forward, often in the passive 〜に後押しされる; it is more vivid and less formal than 支援 or 後援.
collocations: 追い風に後押しされる

presentation.meaning: support, backing (official sponsorship of an event or person)
presentation.defJa: 行事や活動を、名前を貸したりお金を出したりして、うしろから支えること。
presentation.note: A formal word for institutional backing that lends a name or funds to an event (as on posters reading 後援：〇〇市), whereas 協賛 suggests corporate financial sponsorship and 後援会 is a politician's or athlete's support association.

presentation.defJa: うしろのほう。進む方向とは反対の側。
presentation.note: The formal, spatial counterpart of 前方, used in news, transport and military contexts (後方支援 'logistical support'); in conversation people usually just say 後ろ.

presentation.defJa: 前の人のあとを受けついで、その仕事や地位を続けること。また、その人。
presentation.note: Mostly met in compounds such as 後継者 'successor' and 後継機 'successor model'; it is more formal than 跡継ぎ, which carries a family or household flavor.

presentation.meaning: votes obtained, vote count (in an election)
presentation.defJa: 選挙で、候補者や政党が投票によって得た票。また、その数。
presentation.note: The standard election-reporting term for the votes a candidate or party receives, typically with 数 or 率; it differs from 投票, which is the act of casting a vote.

presentation.defJa: こわれたり失われたりしたものを、もとの形や状態にもどすこと。
presentation.note: Used for rebuilding lost buildings, artifacts or faces from evidence and, in IT, for recovering deleted data; 修復 instead stresses repairing damage to something that still exists.

presentation.meaning: return, comeback (to a former position or activity)
presentation.defJa: いちど離れた場所や仕事、状態に、もう一度もどること。
presentation.note: A neutral word for going back to a previous post, activity or condition (職場復帰, 社会復帰); カムバック is the casual loanword, while 復活 suggests revival after something was lost.

presentation.defJa: 人の気持ちや期待、求めに対して、それにふさわしい行動をする。
presentation.note: Written 応える when responding through action to expectations, requests or cheers, whereas 答える is answering a question; こたえる (also written 応える or 堪える) can also mean that something takes a toll, as in 寒さが身にこたえる.

presentation.defJa: 呼びかけや問いに対して、こたえること。また、その返事。
presentation.note: A formal or technical word for a reply, common with machines, radios and systems (応答がない 'no response') and in 質疑応答 'Q&A session'; 返事 is the everyday personal word.

presentation.defJa: 速度がはやいこと。また、主な駅にだけ止まる電車。
presentation.note: On Japanese railways 快速 is a rapid service that skips some stations but usually needs no extra fare, unlike 特急; in the general sense of 'high speed' it survives in words like 快速船.

presentation.meaning: mind (as in keeping something in mind)
presentation.defJa: 心の中。考えの中にあること。
presentation.note: Almost always appears in 念頭に置く 'to bear in mind' or 念頭にある／ない, and is more formal and written than 頭に入れる.

presentation.defJa: 心の中で感じたり考えたりしていること。気持ち。
presentation.note: Covers a wide range from feelings and wishes (感謝の思い) to experiences (つらい思いをする), and is warmer and more emotional than 考え, which is purely intellectual.

presentation.meaning: to make up one's mind, take the plunge (esp. in the te-form); to give up on
presentation.defJa: 迷いを捨てて、心を決める。また、きっぱりあきらめる。
presentation.note: Most often seen as the adverbial 思い切って 'boldly, taking the plunge' or as 思い切った 'bold, drastic'; the plain verb in the sense of giving something up now appears mainly in the negative (思い切れない 'can't let it go').

presentation.defJa: 病気が急に起こり、早く進むこと。
presentation.note: A medical term for illnesses that come on suddenly and progress fast, the opposite of 慢性 'chronic', attached directly to disease names.

presentation.defJa: 体に傷を負うこと。また、その傷。
presentation.note: The everyday word for an injury from an accident rather than an illness; newspapers and NHK write it けが, as in this passage, while 怪我 is common in books and set phrases. 負傷 is the formal news equivalent, and 怪我の功名 means a lucky result of a mistake.

presentation.defJa: こわがりながら、びくびくして物事をするようす。
presentation.note: Describes doing something cautiously while afraid, typically with verbs like 近づく, 尋ねる or のぞき込む; it is a little more literary than びくびく, which stresses the trembling feeling itself.

presentation.defJa: 決まった時期に、いつも同じように行われること。また、その行事。
presentation.note: Used for events or practices that recur at a fixed time (毎年恒例の花火大会); 慣例 is similar but stresses an established precedent or unwritten rule rather than a familiar recurring event.

presentation.meaning: to suffer from (an illness), be ill with
presentation.defJa: 病気にかかって苦しむ。
presentation.note: A formal or literary verb for suffering from an illness, usually a lasting one (持病を患う); in conversation people say 病気にかかる or 〜を抱えている.

presentation.meaning: malicious, vicious (of deliberate wrongdoing); of poor quality
presentation.defJa: たちが悪いこと。わざと人に害を与えるような、ひどいやり方であること。
presentation.note: Common in news for deliberate, harmful wrongdoing (悪質商法, 悪質な運転) and occasionally for poor-quality goods; it is stronger and more formal than ひどい.

presentation.defJa: 心が痛んで、泣きたくなるようなつらい気持ち。
presentation.note: The noun form of 悲しい, used for deep sorrow especially over a loss, as in the literary 悲しみに暮れる 'be lost in grief'; 哀しみ is a poetic spelling.

presentation.defJa: 物事をやりとげようとする、元気で前向きな気持ち。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for spirit or morale that today appears most often in set phrases such as 意気投合 'hit it off' and 意気揚々 'triumphantly'; 士気 is the more standard word for a group's morale.

presentation.defJa: 人や物をとても大切に思い、好きだと感じる。
presentation.note: A godan variant of 愛する that shares many of its forms (愛して, 愛される); as a distinct form it survives mainly in songs, poetry and set phrases such as 愛すべき 'lovable'.

presentation.defJa: 親しみをこめて呼ぶ、本名とは別の呼び名。
presentation.note: Used for affectionate nicknames of people, animals, trains, buildings and the like, often chosen by public vote; あだ名 is the casual word for a personal nickname and can be teasing.

presentation.defJa: 罪をおかした人を刑務所に入れ、決められた作業をさせる刑罰。
presentation.note: Long the standard term in sentencing news (懲役3年の判決), but since June 2025 it and 禁錮 have been replaced by the unified 拘禁刑, though the former penalties still apply to offenses committed before the change.

presentation.defJa: むずかしい物事を、最後まできちんとやり終える。
presentation.note: Stresses carrying a large, difficult undertaking through to completion, often with 偉業 or 快挙; やり遂げる is the more colloquial equivalent, and 達成する is more neutral and takes goals or figures as objects.

presentation.defJa: 自分の。自分たちの。
presentation.note: A formal adnominal meaning 'our/my' that is mostly frozen in phrases like 我が国 (officials' 'our country'), 我が家 'our home' and 我が社; outside such set phrases, ordinary speech uses 私たちの or 自分の.

presentation.defJa: 戦争が終わった後の時期。日本では特に第二次世界大戦の後を指す。
presentation.note: In Japan it refers by default to the period after 1945 (戦後80年, 戦後最大の不況); 終戦 is the end of the war itself and 戦前 the prewar era.

presentation.defJa: 目的を達成するための、長い目で見た全体的な計画や方法。
presentation.note: Originally military but now used mainly for long-term plans in business and politics; 戦術 'tactics' refers to the concrete methods used within a 戦略.

presentation.defJa: 試合や戦いで、勝ったり負けたりした結果の記録。
presentation.note: Refers to a cumulative win-loss record in sports, board games or war; 成績 is the broader word for results or grades of any kind.

presentation.defJa: 必要とすること。特に、ある事をするのに必要な時間や費用。
presentation.note: A formal word meaning 'required' that is almost always met in compounds such as 所要時間 'time required'; it should not be confused with its homophone 所用 'business, errand'.

presentation.defJa: 機械ではなく、人が自分の手で作ること。また、そうして作ったもの。
presentation.note: Used for both crafts and home cooking and stresses personal care and warmth; 手製 is a slightly more formal near-synonym.

presentation.defJa: 犯罪や不正を行うときのやり方。
presentation.note: Almost always negative and typical of news reports on crimes and scams; a neutral "method" would be 方法 or やり方.

presentation.defJa: 仕事や作業をするのが速くて、要領がいい様子。
presentation.note: Describes skilled speed in handling a task and is often used adverbially as 手早く; 素早い is broader and covers any quick movement.

presentation.defJa: 相手に直接、手から手へ物を渡す。
presentation.note: Stresses passing something hand to hand in person, in contrast to plain 渡す or sending it by mail (郵送する).

presentation.meaning: hands and feet; limbs; (fig.) someone who works as another's loyal helper
presentation.defJa: 手と足。また、人の言うとおりに働く者のたとえ。
presentation.note: Everyday word in the literal sense; as 手足となる or 手足のように使う it means serving as someone's loyal instrument.

presentation.meaning: launch (of a rocket or satellite); wrap party after an event or project
presentation.defJa: ロケットや花火などを空高く上げること。また、仕事や行事を終えた後に開く慰労の会。
presentation.note: Besides launches, 打ち上げ very commonly means the celebration held after finishing a project, performance or event (打ち上げに行く).

presentation.meaning: to launch; to shoot up (fireworks, rockets)
presentation.defJa: 花火やロケットなどを、空の高いところへ勢いよく上げる。
presentation.note: Used for fireworks, rockets and balls hit high; in the passive (浜に打ち上げられる) it also describes things washed ashore by waves.

presentation.meaning: to set forth; to come out with (a policy or plan); to print out
presentation.defJa: 考えや計画などを、はっきりと人々に示す。
presentation.note: In news it overwhelmingly means to announce a clear policy or stance; the older senses "emboss" and "print out" are now much rarer.
