presentation.defJa: 続けていたことを途中でやめて、終わりにすること。
presentation.note: Implies a decision to stop something before its natural end, as with TV series, manga serials, negotiations or aid; 終了 is a neutral "end".

presentation.meaning: batter's box; turn at bat; plate appearance
presentation.defJa: 野球で、打者がボールを打つために立つ場所。また、打つ順番が回ってくること。
presentation.note: Also counts plate appearances (三打席連続ヒット) and is used figuratively for getting one's chance to perform.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、打者がヒットを打った割合。
presentation.note: A baseball term, sometimes used figuratively in business or media for a success rate, such as a forecaster's track record.

presentation.meaning: batting lineup (as a whole); a team's hitting
presentation.defJa: 野球で、チームの打者全体の並び。また、その攻撃力。
presentation.note: Refers to a team's hitters collectively and their offensive power, whereas 打順 is the specific batting order.

presentation.defJa: 野球やクリケットで、ボールを打つ役の選手。
presentation.note: The standard term in baseball reporting and also used for cricket batsmen; バッター is the more casual loanword.

presentation.meaning: to restrain; to hold back (emotions); to keep (costs etc.) down
presentation.defJa: 気持ちや勢い、量などが大きくならないように止めておく。
presentation.note: Also common for keeping prices, costs or an outbreak in check (コストを抑える); distinguish it from 押さえる, which means to physically press down or secure.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、打者に向かってボールを投げる役の選手。
presentation.note: The standard term in news and formal writing; ピッチャー is the everyday loanword.

presentation.meaning: post (on social media); submission (to a newspaper or magazine)
presentation.defJa: 新聞や雑誌、インターネットなどに、自分の文章や写真を送って載せてもらうこと。
presentation.note: Originally meant sending a letter or article to a publication; today it is the standard word for posting online.

presentation.defJa: これからやりたいことについての、心の中の計画や決意。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word typically voiced at ceremonies, on taking up a post or at New Year; 目標 is a plainer "goal".

presentation.meaning: conflict (with a law or rule); contravention; running afoul of
presentation.defJa: 法律や規則などに反すること。
presentation.note: A formal legal and news word, more technical and less accusatory than 違反, often paired with おそれがある to flag a possible violation.
collocations: 抵触するおそれがある

presentation.defJa: 人に強く働きかけて、自分の思うとおりにさせようとする力。
presentation.note: Mostly heard in set phrases about how forceful someone is; do not confuse it with the homophone 推し (one's favorite idol or character).

presentation.defJa: お金を借りるとき、返せなくなった場合に備えて差し出すもの。また、確かさを保証するもの。
presentation.note: Beyond finance, it is now widely used in business and policy writing to mean "ensure" or "guarantee" (品質を担保する).

presentation.meaning: time; beat; meter (in music); the moment (that something happens)
presentation.defJa: 音楽で、音の強弱がくり返される一定のリズム。
presentation.note: Besides musical time, ～した拍子に very commonly means "the moment (something accidental happened)"; in compounds it often becomes びょうし (手拍子, 三拍子).

presentation.meaning: to refuse; to reject; to decline
presentation.defJa: 相手の求めや申し出を受け入れないで、断る。
presentation.note: More formal and written than 断る, used for firmly refusing demands or for barriers that keep people out (人を拒む険しい山).

presentation.defJa: 大会や会議、施設などを、自分たちの土地に呼び寄せようとすること。
presentation.note: Typical of campaigns to attract the Olympics, expos or international conferences; 誘致 is close but more common for factories and companies.

presentation.meaning: to take out (of a place); to bring up (a topic)
presentation.defJa: 物を、もとの場所から外へ持って出る。また、話題などを出す。
presentation.note: Often implies removing something that should stay put, such as data or documents; it also commonly means bringing up an old issue in conversation (昔の話を持ち出す).

presentation.meaning: natural flavor; distinctive quality or character
presentation.defJa: そのものが本来備えている味。また、人や物が持つ独特のよさ。
presentation.note: Often extended to people, as when a player or actor shows their 持ち味 (signature strengths); 個性 is broader and less evaluative.

presentation.meaning: to take home; to bring back
presentation.defJa: 物を自分の家や元の場所へ持って帰る。
presentation.note: In business, 持ち帰って検討します is a polite way of deferring a decision; the noun お持ち帰り is the standard word for takeout.

presentation.meaning: to bring in; to carry in
presentation.defJa: 物を、ある場所の中へ持って入る。
presentation.note: Also used figuratively for taking a matter into a new arena (延長戦に持ち込む, 法廷に持ち込む).

presentation.meaning: to be popular (esp. with the opposite sex); to be able to hold or have
presentation.defJa: 異性や周りの人から好かれて、人気がある。
presentation.note: In the "popular" sense it is usually written in kana (もてる, casually モテる); in kanji it mostly appears in 持てる力 (all the strength one has) or as the potential form of 持つ.

presentation.defJa: ある役目や仕事に、特定の人の名前を挙げて選ぶこと。
presentation.note: Used for singling out a specific person, from the prime minister in the Diet to draft picks or calling on someone in a meeting; 任命 is the formal act of appointment.

presentation.defJa: 物事の状態や程度を判断するときの目安となるもの。
presentation.note: A formal word common in economics and statistics; 目安 is the everyday word for a rough guide.

presentation.defJa: 何をどうするように、相手に言いつけること。
presentation.note: Neutral and very common at work for directions from someone in charge; 指図 sounds bossier and 命令 is a formal order.

presentation.meaning: to shake off; to pull away from (a pursuer or rival)
presentation.defJa: しつこく追ってくるものを引き離して、逃れる。
presentation.note: Used for pulling away from pursuers or rivals and, figuratively, for shaking off doubts or opposition, as in 迷いを振り切る.

presentation.meaning: to view (in a certain way); to perceive; to grasp
presentation.defJa: 物事をある見方で受け止める。また、特徴や本質をしっかりつかむ。
presentation.note: 捉える is the usual spelling for grasping meaning, images or someone's heart, while 捕らえる is preferred for physically catching a person or animal.

presentation.meaning: conferment; awarding (of a degree, honor, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 学位や賞などを、正式に与えること。
presentation.note: Formal word for an institution officially conferring degrees, medals or licenses; everyday speech would simply say 渡す or あげる.

presentation.defJa: 優れた人や作品に、賞を与えること。
presentation.note: This is the giver's side of an award (授賞式, 授賞理由); do not confuse it with the homophone 受賞, the winner receiving the prize.

presentation.defJa: 調べたり利用したりするために、必要なものを取り集めること。
presentation.note: Common for collecting samples, fingerprints or specimens and for gathering plants or minerals from nature; more technical than 集める or 採る.

presentation.defJa: まだよくわかっていない場所や物を、詳しく調べること。
presentation.note: Used for systematic scientific or technical exploration such as space probes and resource surveys, unlike 探検, which suggests adventurous exploration by people.

presentation.defJa: 力が近く、勝ち負けがなかなか決まらない試合や争い。
presentation.note: Common in sports and election reporting; 激戦 stresses how fierce a fight is, while 接戦 stresses how small the margin is.

presentation.defJa: 第一審の判決に不服なとき、上の裁判所に裁判のやり直しを求めること。
presentation.note: Specifically an appeal from a first-instance ruling to a higher court; a further appeal to the Supreme Court is 上告, and 上訴 covers both.

presentation.meaning: to recommend; to back (someone for a position)
presentation.defJa: ある人や物をふさわしいと考えて、ほかの人にすすめる。
presentation.note: Written 推す in the sense of recommending or backing someone, distinct from 押す (push); its noun 推し is now everyday slang for one's favorite idol or character.

presentation.defJa: 裁判所に訴えを起こすこと。
presentation.note: Newspaper-style word for filing a lawsuit or formal complaint; in conversation people say 訴える or 裁判を起こす.
collocations: 損害賠償を求めて提訴する

presentation.defJa: 物や体の一部が傷ついたり壊れたりすること。
presentation.note: Used for physical damage to objects, structures or body tissue, whereas 損害 refers to the resulting loss, often financial.

presentation.defJa: 建物などが壊れること。また、壊すこと。
presentation.note: Refers to buildings or property being broken or destroyed, common in disaster reports and in the legal term 器物損壊 (property damage).

presentation.meaning: transport; conveyance (esp. of patients to hospital)
presentation.defJa: 人や物を、ある場所へ運び送ること。
presentation.note: Common in news for carrying patients to hospital (救急搬送) and in logistics for moving goods; more formal than 運ぶ.

presentation.defJa: 飛行機や船などに乗り込むこと。
presentation.note: Used for boarding aircraft and sometimes ships; for trains and buses the word is 乗車.

presentation.defJa: 機械や乗り物に、装置や機能を組み込むこと。
presentation.note: Common in tech and product writing for a device being equipped with a function or component, as well as for loading cargo or weapons.

presentation.defJa: 置いてある物や建物などを取り除くこと。
presentation.note: Removing objects or structures from a place, typical of official actions like clearing bikes, signs or barricades; 除去 is used for removing substances such as stains or toxins.

presentation.defJa: 一度出した意見や発言、書類などを取り下げること。
presentation.note: Formally taking back a statement, proposal, paper or application; in news about officials' gaffes it is often paired with 謝罪.

presentation.defJa: 制度や規則などを、すっかりなくしてしまうこと。
presentation.note: Abolishing systems, rules or barriers such as tariffs, regulations or discrimination; 廃止 is the more general word for doing away with something.

presentation.meaning: fielding (a candidate); backing someone for a post
presentation.defJa: ある人を支えて、選挙の候補者や高い地位に立てること。
presentation.note: Political-news word for a party fielding or backing a candidate; the candidate is said to be 擁立される.

presentation.defJa: 代金や料金などのお金を払うこと。
presentation.note: Everyday noun for paying bills or charges; at a shop or restaurant counter the polite word is お会計.

presentation.defJa: 困っている人や活動に力を貸して、助けること。
presentation.note: Broad, slightly formal word for support given to people, regions or projects; 援助 leans toward material or financial aid.

presentation.defJa: 本部から分かれて、各地に置かれた事務所や組織。
presentation.note: Used for branches of organizations such as unions, associations, parties or clubs; a company's branch office is usually 支社 or 支店.

presentation.defJa: 物事を進めるうえでの、さまたげ。
presentation.note: Formal word, usually in set phrases such as 支障をきたす or 支障が出る; the softer 差し支え appears in polite phrases like 差し支えなければ.

presentation.meaning: election held when terms expire; seats being up for election
presentation.defJa: 任期が終わったときに、もう一度選挙をして選び直すこと。
presentation.note: Electing anew when terms expire, as with half the upper house every three years or a board's officers; 改選議席 is a standard news term.

presentation.meaning: to emit; to give off (light); to fire
presentation.defJa: 光やにおいなどを外へ出す。また、矢や弾を撃ち出す。
presentation.note: Somewhat literary but common in writing for emitting light or smells and firing arrows, and in sports reporting for hitting (ヒットを放つ).

presentation.defJa: テレビで番組や映画を流すこと。
presentation.note: Specifically broadcasting on television, often films, dramas or sports; 放送 is the broader term that also covers radio.

presentation.defJa: 持っている権利や責任などを、自分から捨てること。
presentation.note: Formal word for giving up rights, duties or property, as in 相続放棄 (renouncing an inheritance) or 育児放棄 (child neglect).

presentation.defJa: わざと建物などに火をつけること。
presentation.note: Legal and news word for deliberately setting a fire; a fire caused by negligence is 失火, and 火事 is the everyday word for any fire.

presentation.defJa: 牛や馬などを牧場に放して、自由に草を食べさせること。
presentation.note: Letting livestock graze freely outdoors, in contrast to 舎飼い, raising them in barns.

presentation.defJa: 内閣が法律を実施するために定める命令。
presentation.note: A formal legal term for orders the cabinet issues to implement a law, ranking above ministerial ordinances (省令); also seen in 政令指定都市 for designated major cities.

presentation.meaning: government affairs; official duties of state
presentation.defJa: 国や政府の政治上の仕事。
presentation.note: A formal, news-register word for a leader's official governmental duties, typical in phrases like 政務に復帰する or titles such as 政務官; for ordinary work use 仕事 or 職務.

presentation.defJa: 政治家などが活動する政治の世界。
presentation.note: Refers to politics as a social sphere or community of politicians, as in 政界入り or 政界再編, whereas 政治 means the activity of governing itself.

presentation.defJa: 危険な状態にある人を助け出すこと。
presentation.note: Emphasizes pulling someone out of a trapped or dangerous situation such as rubble, a sinking ship or a hostage-taking, whereas 救助 is the broader word for rescue work in general.

presentation.defJa: 急な病気やけがの人に、すぐに手当てをすること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds about emergency medical response such as 救急車, 救急外来 and 救急箱, rather than standing alone.

presentation.meaning: being defeated and eliminated (from a competition)
presentation.defJa: 試合や戦いに負けて、勝ち進めなくなること。
presentation.note: Used in sports and competitions for being knocked out of a tournament, usually with the round named, as in 初戦で敗退; 負ける is the plain verb for losing a single game.

presentation.defJa: 学校などで子どもや学生を教える職員。
presentation.note: An official, administrative word for teachers as staff, common in statistics, policy and phrases like 教員免許, while 先生 is the everyday term of address.

presentation.defJa: 学問や技術などを人に教える人。先生。
presentation.note: A neutral word for a teacher as a profession or role, also used figuratively in 反面教師; people call their own teachers 先生 rather than 教師.

presentation.meaning: teaching and school staff; faculty and staff
presentation.defJa: 学校で働く先生と、事務などを担当する職員。
presentation.note: Covers both teachers and non-teaching school staff such as clerks, and appears mainly in official announcements and news reports.

presentation.defJa: 幼稚園や小・中・高校などで、免許を持って子どもを教える教員の正式な職名。
presentation.note: An official job title for licensed teachers at kindergartens and schools up to high school, frequent in news reports (中学校の男性教諭), and not used for university teachers.

presentation.meaning: in great numbers; a great many
presentation.defJa: 数がとても多いようす。たくさん。
presentation.note: A slightly formal written expression often used as 数多くの + noun, more literary than たくさん.

presentation.meaning: education (as in the former Ministry of Education, 1871-2001)
presentation.defJa: 教育や学問、文化に関する行政。また、その仕事を担った国の役所。
presentation.note: Now survives mainly in the names 文部省 (before 2001) and 文部科学省 (often shortened to 文科省), so you will meet it in historical and education-policy texts.

presentation.defJa: 地下の割れ目に沿って地層がずれた所。
presentation.note: Primarily a geological term (活断層 = active fault, 断層帯 = fault zone); occasionally used figuratively for a gap or rift between groups, as in 世代間の断層.

presentation.meaning: giving up; abandoning (a plan or hope)
presentation.defJa: 望みや計画をきっぱりあきらめること。
presentation.note: A formal word for reluctantly giving up a plan or hope, common in news (進学を断念), and weightier than the everyday あきらめる.
collocations: 断念を余儀なくされる

presentation.meaning: intermittence; occurring on and off (mostly in the adverb form, intermittently)
presentation.defJa: 途切れたり続いたりを繰り返すこと。
presentation.note: Almost always appears as 断続的に or 断続的な, describing rain, shaking or noise that stops and starts; contrast 継続 (continuous).

presentation.defJa: 新しく作られた作品。
presentation.note: Used for new creative works such as films, novels, games and fashion collections, and also for new menu items or sweets.

presentation.defJa: 新しくつくられた政党。
presentation.note: A news term for a newly formed political party, typically paired with 結成 or 旗揚げ.

presentation.defJa: 今までとは違う新しい型や形式。
presentation.note: Describes a new model or type of a product, vehicle or virus (新型コロナ), focusing on design or specification rather than mere newness as with 新しい.

presentation.defJa: 新しく始まる年。年の初め。
presentation.note: A slightly formal word used in greetings and events (新年会, 新年のあいさつ), while 正月 refers to the holiday period itself.

presentation.meaning: new (newly started or added, as a customer, business or branch)
presentation.defJa: 新しく何かを始めること。また、新しく加わるもの。
presentation.note: A business and administrative word for something newly added or started, as in 新規顧客, 新規登録 and 新規出店, rather than new in the general sense of 新しい.

presentation.meaning: establishing; setting up (a new facility or organization)
presentation.defJa: 施設や組織などを新しくつくること。
presentation.note: A formal word for setting up a new institution, department, route or facility, often contrasted with 増設, which means adding more of something that already exists.

presentation.defJa: 行政などが問題に対して実行する計画や対策。
presentation.note: A bureaucratic word for concrete measures carried out by government or organizations; close to 政策 but more about implementation, and sometimes also read せさく.

presentation.defJa: 旅をしている人。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary or nostalgic word for a traveler or wayfarer, while 旅行者 and 観光客 are the neutral modern terms.

presentation.defJa: 毎日。一日一日。
presentation.note: Means days or daily life, often with a reflective tone (忙しい日々を送る), and also works adverbially as in 日々努力する.

presentation.defJa: 毎日発行すること。また、そのような新聞など。
presentation.note: Used for publications issued every day, mostly in 日刊紙 and newspaper titles; compare 週刊 (weekly) and 月刊 (monthly).

presentation.defJa: 毎日の仕事や出来事をまとめた報告。
presentation.note: A workplace word for the daily report employees submit, and it also appears in the names of newspapers.

presentation.defJa: 土曜の次の日。多くの人が仕事や学校を休む日。
presentation.note: A shorter, very common alternative to 日曜日, frequent in compounds like 日曜大工 and on schedules.

presentation.defJa: 太陽が地平線の下に沈むこと。日の入り。
presentation.note: A written, formal word for sunset used in news, weather reports and timetables (日没後), while 日の入り is the plainer term and 夕日 is the setting sun itself.

presentation.meaning: Japan and the United States; Japan-US
presentation.defJa: 日本とアメリカ。
presentation.note: A news abbreviation combining 日本 and 米国 for relations and comparisons (日米関係, 日米首脳会談), on the same pattern as 日中 and 日韓.

presentation.defJa: 日本人の血筋を引いていること。また、企業などが日本の資本や系統に属すること。
presentation.note: Describes people or companies of Japanese origin abroad (日系人, 日系企業), with generations counted as 日系二世, 三世 and so on.

presentation.defJa: 日本と韓国。また、その二つの国の間のこと。
presentation.note: A compact compound used mainly in news and diplomacy; the order 日韓 reflects the Japanese viewpoint, while Korean media write 韓日.

presentation.meaning: right after; just at the start of
presentation.defJa: ある事が始まって間もないころ。また、急いですぐに。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns like 入社 or 新年 it means "right at the start of" and often hints that something happened sooner than expected; on its own, 早々に means "promptly."

presentation.defJa: ある時刻や時期よりも前に。また、時間をかけずに、すぐに。
presentation.note: The adverb form of 早い (early in time); the homophone 速く refers to speed, so 早く起きる is about the hour while 速く走る is about pace.

presentation.defJa: 朝のとても早い時間。夜が明けて間もないころ。
presentation.note: A slightly formal word for the hours around dawn, common in news and schedules; in conversation people more often say 朝早く.

presentation.defJa: 物事のはじめのほうの時期。
presentation.note: A formal Sino-Japanese word used in medicine, business and policy (早期発見, 早期退職); everyday speech would say 早いうちに.

presentation.meaning: promotion; rise in rank or status
presentation.defJa: 地位や等級などが上がること。
presentation.note: Means moving up a rank, grade or league; 昇進 is used mainly for a person's job title, while 昇格 also applies to teams, organizations and official status.
collocations: 一部リーグに昇格する

presentation.defJa: はっきりと言い切ること。
presentation.note: Typical of political and business reporting, very often in the negative pattern 明言を避ける; do not confuse it with the homophone 名言, a famous saying.

presentation.defJa: はっきりとわかるように書くこと。
presentation.note: A formal word found in contracts, rules and official documents, usually in the passive 明記されている; 記載 just means "recorded," while 明記 stresses that something is spelled out explicitly.

presentation.defJa: その時の市場での値段。
presentation.note: Seen both on menus ("market price") and in finance, where 時価総額 means market capitalization; 定価 by contrast is a fixed list price.

presentation.defJa: 時間の流れの中の、ある一点。
presentation.note: Very common in news and business for "as of" a date (～の時点で, 現時点では); unlike 時期, which is a span, 時点 marks a single point.

presentation.defJa: 正式に決まるまで、とりあえず仮に決めておくこと。
presentation.note: A formal word usually seen as 暫定的 or in compounds like 暫定首位; it is close to 仮, but sounds more official and implies that a final decision will follow.

presentation.defJa: 人に乱暴な力をふるうこと。
presentation.note: A legal and news term for physical assault; 暴力 is the general word for violence, while 暴行 names a specific violent act, often as a criminal charge.

presentation.defJa: 古いものを新しくすること。また、期限を延ばすこと。
presentation.note: Covers updating software and websites, renewing contracts or licenses, and breaking records (記録を更新する); アップデート is the loanword used mostly for software.

presentation.meaning: online post or comment; written note or entry
presentation.defJa: インターネットの掲示板などに投稿した文章。また、本や書類の余白などに書き入れた文字。
presentation.note: Common for posts and comments on online forums and social media; it can also mean notes written in the margins of a book (教科書の書き込み).

presentation.meaning: to write in; to fill in; to post (online)
presentation.defJa: 用紙の空欄や手帳、余白などに文字を書き入れる。また、ネットの掲示板などに文章を投稿する。
presentation.note: Implies writing into a particular space such as a form, planner or margin, and also posting on an online board; plain 書く lacks this sense of filling something in.

presentation.meaning: secretary (of a council or organization); clerk
presentation.defJa: 会議の記録や文書の作成を担当する役。また、その人。
presentation.note: Refers to the secretary role in councils, unions and parties (書記長 = general secretary); a company's personal or executive assistant is 秘書, not 書記.

presentation.defJa: 数がいちばん多いこと。
presentation.note: A news staple, especially in 過去最多 (an all-time high in number); it counts quantities, whereas 最大 refers to size or degree.

presentation.defJa: 大きさや程度などがいちばん小さいこと。
presentation.note: Covers both physical size and degree, most often in 最小限 (to a minimum, as in 被害を最小限に抑える); 最少, with a different kanji, is used for the smallest number.

presentation.defJa: いちばん悪いこと。これ以上ないほど悪いこと。
presentation.note: Used both formally (最悪の事態, 最悪の場合) and as a casual exclamation meaning "the worst!"; its opposite is 最善 in formal use or 最高 in casual speech.

presentation.defJa: いちばん新しいこと。
presentation.note: A neutral, very common word for "latest" in news, ads and technology (最新モデル); 最近 means "recently" and describes time rather than things.

presentation.defJa: 命が終わるとき。死にぎわ。
presentation.note: Written 最期, it refers only to the end of a life and carries a solemn tone; the homophone 最後 simply means "last."

presentation.defJa: 距離や時間などがいちばん短いこと。
presentation.note: Used for distance and time alike (最短距離, 最短で三日); in shopping and delivery, 最短で means "at the earliest."

presentation.defJa: 長さや期間などがいちばん長いこと。
presentation.note: Used for both length and duration (最長の川, 過去最長の連休); in news it often marks records, as in 過去最長.

presentation.defJa: 一週間のうち、日曜の次の日。
presentation.note: A shortened form of 月曜日, common in schedules, timetables and speech (月曜から, 月曜休み).

presentation.defJa: 体や環境などに害があること。
presentation.note: A formal word used in science, regulation and news (有害物質, 有害図書); its opposite is 無害, and the everyday equivalent is 体に悪い.

presentation.defJa: たくさんの木。あちこちに生えている木。
presentation.note: A descriptive, slightly literary plural of 木 used for scenery; 樹木 is the more technical word for trees in general.

presentation.defJa: 木についている葉。また、散った葉。
presentation.note: Usually read このは; it has a gentle, literary feel, while 葉っぱ is casual and 落ち葉 means leaves that have already fallen.
collocations: 木の葉のように揺れる

presentation.defJa: 一週間のうち、水曜の次の日。
presentation.note: A shortened form of 木曜日 used in speech, schedules and shop signs such as 木曜定休 (closed on Thursdays).

presentation.defJa: 建物などを木で作ること。また、そうして作ったもの。
presentation.note: Common in real estate and architecture (木造住宅, 木造アパート), contrasting with steel or concrete construction; for smaller wooden objects like furniture, 木製 is used instead.

presentation.defJa: 夜がまだ明けきらないころ。夜中から明け方までの時間。
presentation.note: A news and weather term for roughly midnight to 3 a.m.; it is earlier and darker than 早朝, which refers to the time around and just after sunrise.
collocations: 深夜から未明にかけて

presentation.meaning: attempt (at a crime) that was not carried through; attempted (offense)
presentation.defJa: 犯罪などをしようとして、最後までやり遂げられなかったこと。
presentation.note: Mostly appears attached to offense names in legal and news language, such as 殺人未遂 and 強盗未遂, and contrasts with 既遂 (a completed offense).

presentation.meaning: this matter; the matter at hand
presentation.defJa: 今、話題や問題になっている、この事柄。
presentation.note: A formal word used in business documents, press releases and legal texts for the matter under discussion; in conversation people say この件.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、打者が立ち、走者が最後に戻ってくる場所。ホームベース。
presentation.note: In modern use it almost always means home plate in baseball (as in 本塁打, home run); the older sense of a main fortress survives mainly in historical writing.

presentation.defJa: 活動や生活の中心となる大事な場所。
presentation.note: Used for the central base of an organization, army or sports team (本拠を置く, 本拠地), and sounds weightier than 拠点, which can be any one of several bases.

presentation.defJa: きょう。改まった場面で使う言い方。
presentation.note: A formal equivalent of きょう used in announcements, signs and business speech; it sounds stiff in casual conversation.
collocations: 本日はお越しいただき

presentation.defJa: 会社の中心になる事務所。支店や工場をまとめる所。
presentation.note: The standard word for a company's headquarters, contrasted with 支社 (branch office) and 支店 (branch store).

presentation.meaning: main line (of a railway); main lanes (of a road)
presentation.defJa: 鉄道や道路で、中心となる主要な路線。支線などに対して言う。
presentation.note: Used for the trunk line of a railway (often in line names like 東海道本線) and for the through lanes of an expressway as opposed to its ramps.

presentation.defJa: 都道府県や市町村が、議会で決めて定める決まり。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to rules enacted by local governments, as distinct from national 法律 and from the internal rules of an organization (規則, 規定).

presentation.defJa: イギリスのグリニッジを通る経線を0度とし、そこから東へ180度まで測った経度。
presentation.note: Almost always followed by a number and often paired with 北緯 or 南緯 to give coordinates; its opposite is 西経 (west longitude).

presentation.meaning: eastern part; the east (of a region or country)
presentation.defJa: ある地域の中で、東のほうの部分。
presentation.note: A neutral geographic term attached to regions or countries (県東部, アフリカ東部), forming a set with 西部, 南部 and 北部.

presentation.meaning: framework (of a plan, system or agreement); frame
presentation.defJa: 物事を進めるときの、基本となる全体の形や仕組み。
presentation.note: Common in policy and academic writing for the overall structure of an agreement or system; 仕組み focuses more on how something works internally.
collocations: 既存の枠組みにとらわれない

presentation.defJa: すぐれた働きが認められて、世の中からほめたたえられること。
presentation.note: A formal word for public honor conferred by society or an institution, often through awards; 名誉 overlaps but also covers personal reputation and dignity (名誉を傷つける).

presentation.defJa: 会社の株を持っていて、その会社の持ち主の一人である人。
presentation.note: Standard term in business and financial news; 株主優待 refers to the perks such as goods or discounts that Japanese companies give individual shareholders.

presentation.defJa: 株を売り買いするときの値段。
presentation.note: Appears constantly in economic news with verbs of movement such as 上がる, 急落する and 回復する; a stock index is 株価指数.

presentation.meaning: matter or item to be dealt with; (business) deal, job
presentation.defJa: 取り上げて処理しなければならない事柄や仕事。
presentation.note: In business Japanese it often means a concrete job, deal or project to be handled, while 議題 is strictly an item on a meeting's agenda.

presentation.meaning: infarction (blockage of blood flow causing tissue death); blockage
presentation.defJa: 血管が詰まって血が流れなくなり、その先の組織が死んでしまうこと。
presentation.note: Almost always met in medical compounds such as 心筋梗塞 and 脳梗塞; the general sense of 'blockage' is rare outside medicine.

presentation.defJa: 調べて、含まれている物質や隠れている物を見つけ出すこと。
presentation.note: A technical-sounding verbal noun for finding substances, signals or errors through testing or sensors; 発見 is broader and covers discoveries of any kind.
collocations: 基準値を超えて検出される

presentation.defJa: 犯罪を調べて、裁判所に訴えるかどうかを決める国の機関。
presentation.note: Refers both to the prosecution as an institution and to prosecutors collectively, often as 検察側 opposite 弁護側 in a trial; an individual prosecutor is 検察官 or 検事.

presentation.meaning: search (on the internet or in a database); looking up
presentation.defJa: 本やデータ、インターネットの中から、必要な情報を探し出すこと。
presentation.note: The standard word for searching databases and the internet (ネットで検索する); for looking for a lost object or person, 探す or 捜索 is used instead.
collocations: キーワードで検索する

presentation.meaning: height, peak, extreme (of a feeling or state)
presentation.defJa: 物事がそれ以上はないというところまで達した状態。
presentation.note: A literary noun used mostly in the pattern Nの極み to express an extreme of emotion or state, as in 痛恨の極み in formal statements; 頂点 is more neutral for a peak or top.

presentation.meaning: to enjoy; to take pleasure in
presentation.defJa: 好きなことをして、うれしく満ち足りた気持ちになる。
presentation.note: Takes a direct object (旅行を楽しむ), unlike the adjective 楽しい, and suggests actively savoring an activity rather than something simply being fun.

presentation.defJa: 音楽の作品。特に、歌や演奏のための一つ一つの曲。
presentation.note: A slightly formal, industry-flavored word for a piece of music, common in news and credits (楽曲提供); in conversation people simply say 曲.

presentation.defJa: 物事のだいたいの内容をまとめたもの。
presentation.note: A common written word for the broad outline of a plan, event or document; 要約 is a condensed summary of a specific text.

presentation.meaning: premises; grounds; inside (a station, campus, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 建物や施設の、囲いの中の場所。敷地の内側。
presentation.note: Used for the enclosed grounds of a facility such as a station, school or factory, often on signs (構内禁煙); 敷地 refers to the plot of land itself.

presentation.meaning: building, construction (of a system, relationship, theory, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 組み立てて、しっかりした形のものを作り上げること。
presentation.note: A formal word used more for systems, networks, relationships and theories than for physical buildings, where 建設 or 建築 is usual.

presentation.defJa: 海面からはかった土地の高さ。
presentation.note: Measures the height of land above sea level; 海抜 is a near-synonym often used for low-lying areas, while 高度 is the altitude of aircraft or objects in the air.

presentation.meaning: airframe, body of an aircraft; the aircraft itself
presentation.defJa: 飛行機などの、エンジンを除いた本体の部分。また、飛行機そのもの。
presentation.note: Refers to the body of an aircraft and by extension the aircraft itself (also drones or robots), common in aviation news; 胴体 is specifically the fuselage.

presentation.defJa: 機械や器具などの道具をまとめて言う言葉。
presentation.note: A collective term for machines and instruments, frequent in compounds like 医療機器 and 電子機器; 機械 tends to suggest larger machinery with moving parts.

presentation.meaning: captain (of an aircraft); pilot in command
presentation.defJa: 飛行機の操縦と、乗っている人全員の安全に責任を持つ一番上の操縦士。
presentation.note: The pilot in command of an aircraft, contrasted with 副操縦士 (first officer); the equivalent on a ship is 船長.

presentation.meaning: next time; the next session or episode
presentation.defJa: この次のとき。次に行われる回。
presentation.note: Refers to the next occurrence of something held in rounds, such as meetings, episodes or classes; for a vague 'next time' in conversation, 今度 or この次 is more natural.

presentation.defJa: 今の期間や代のすぐ後に来るもの。次に就く人や、次に出る製品などを指す。
presentation.note: A formal, prefix-like noun placed before roles or products (次期社長, 次期OS); 来期 refers to the next term, season or fiscal period.

presentation.defJa: 歌をうたうこと。特に、技術や表現の面から見た歌い方。
presentation.note: A formal Sino-Japanese term used in reviews, music education and competitions, most often in compounds like 歌唱力; in everyday speech people simply say 歌う or 歌.

presentation.defJa: 何代にもわたって続いてきた、それぞれの代。これまでのすべての代。
presentation.note: Used for records and lineages across successive holders of a role (歴代の社長, 歴代最高); 代々 leans toward family succession and inherited tradition.

presentation.defJa: 人が亡くなること。報道などで使う改まった言い方。
presentation.note: A neutral, formal word typical of news reports and obituaries; 逝去 is the respectful form for someone esteemed, while 死亡 is the clinical or legal term.

presentation.defJa: 人や動物が死ぬことになった原因。
presentation.note: A matter-of-fact term from forensics, medicine and news reporting; 死亡原因 is the longer, more official equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 死んだ人。亡くなった人。
presentation.note: Common in disaster and accident reports (死者・行方不明者) as well as religious contexts; 故人 is the gentler word for a particular person who has died.

presentation.meaning: rush; flood (of people, orders or requests)
presentation.defJa: 多くの人や物が、一度に一か所へ押し寄せること。
presentation.note: Describes requests, orders or crowds pouring in all at once and is typical of news; despite the 殺 kanji it has nothing to do with killing.
collocations: 問い合わせが殺到する

presentation.defJa: 人の命をわざと奪うこと。
presentation.note: A formal term used in news and legal reports for deliberately killing a person; everyday speech uses 殺す.

presentation.meaning: the mother's body (in pregnancy or childbirth); parent organization
presentation.defJa: 子どもを宿したり産んだりする母親のからだ。また、ある組織を生み出したもとの団体。
presentation.note: In medicine it means the pregnant or postpartum woman's body as distinct from the fetus; in politics and business it also means a parent organization or support base (支持母体).

presentation.defJa: そのたびごとに。どの回も必ず。
presentation.note: A neutral everyday word for something that happens on every occasion of a recurring event; いつも is broader and need not refer to distinct occasions.

presentation.meaning: civil matters (as opposed to criminal); civil case
presentation.defJa: 個人や会社どうしの、お金や権利をめぐる争いにかかわる事柄。
presentation.note: Always contrasted with 刑事 (criminal matters) and found mostly in compounds like 民事訴訟 in legal writing and the news.

presentation.defJa: それまで分からなかったことに、見たり感じたりして思い当たる。
presentation.note: An everyday verb for noticing or realizing something, also written 気付く; 分かる stresses understanding, while 気づく stresses the moment awareness arrives.

presentation.defJa: 裁判で、検察官が被告人に与えるべき刑の重さを裁判所に求めること。
presentation.note: A courtroom term for the prosecution's demand, reported in the news before the verdict; the sentence the court actually hands down comes in the 判決. For crimes committed since June 2025, prison terms are reported as 拘禁刑 instead of 懲役.

presentation.defJa: 公務員などが立場を利用して、不正にお金や利益を得ること。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to abuse of public office, typically bribery by officials; 賄賂 is the bribe itself and 不正 is a broader word for wrongdoing.

presentation.defJa: 最終的な勝ち負けを決めるための戦いや試合。
presentation.note: Used for a final, deciding contest in sports, elections and war; 決勝 is the standard word for the final round of a tournament.

presentation.defJa: 人と同じように、権利を持ったり契約を結んだりすることが法律で認められた団体や会社。
presentation.note: A legal and tax term for any entity with legal personality, including companies, schools and nonprofits (学校法人, NPO法人); 会社 is the everyday word for a business.

presentation.defJa: 国会が定めた法律と、国や自治体が定めた命令や規則をまとめて呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: An umbrella term covering statutes together with cabinet orders and ministerial rules, common in compliance language (法令遵守 = compliance); 法律 refers specifically to acts passed by the Diet.

presentation.meaning: legal; from the standpoint of law
presentation.defJa: 法律にもとづいているようす。法律の立場から見たようす。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns to mean "legal" in the sense of under or by the law (法的拘束力, 法的手段); 合法的 means "lawful" specifically.

presentation.defJa: 物質が反応を起こしたり、はたらきを示したりする力。また、その度合い。
presentation.note: A technical term in chemistry and biology; in everyday and business language it appears mostly in 活性化 (revitalization), as in 地域の活性化.

presentation.meaning: outflow; leak (of data, liquid, people or money)
presentation.defJa: 液体や情報、人などが外へ流れ出ること。
presentation.note: Used literally for liquids and figuratively for data, talent and money leaving where they belong; 漏洩 is a more formal and specific word for information leaks.

presentation.meaning: to float; to come to mind
presentation.defJa: 水面や空中に、沈まずにとどまっている。また、考えや姿が心に現れる。
presentation.note: Intransitive; besides physical floating it very often means an idea or image coming to mind (思い浮かぶ), while the transitive counterpart is 浮かべる.

presentation.meaning: emerging (of a plan, issue or suspicion); surfacing
presentation.defJa: 水の中から水面に上がってくること。また、隠れていたものや新しい案が表に出てくること。
presentation.note: Literally used for submarines and divers rising to the surface, but in the news it most often means a plan, suspicion or candidate coming to light, or a team climbing the standings.

presentation.defJa: 海のうち、ある決まった範囲。
presentation.note: A neutral technical or news term for a defined stretch of sea; 水域 is broader and can include lakes and rivers, while 領海 means territorial waters specifically.

presentation.defJa: 海の底。
presentation.note: A plain, common word for the sea floor used in science, engineering and news; 海の底 is the softer native-Japanese phrasing.

presentation.defJa: 海の水。塩分を含んでいる。
presentation.note: The standard neutral word for seawater; 塩水 means any salt water, and 海水浴 (sea bathing) is a very common compound.

presentation.defJa: 海での戦いや国の守りを受け持つ軍隊。
presentation.note: Used for any country's navy or for Japan's prewar navy; Japan's present-day maritime force is officially called 海上自衛隊, not 海軍.

presentation.meaning: flooding; inundation (water getting into buildings or land)
presentation.defJa: 建物や土地、船などに水が入りこむこと。
presentation.note: Common in disaster news for water entering buildings, land or ships (床上浸水, 床下浸水); 洪水 refers to the flood itself rather than the water getting in.

presentation.defJa: あったものが、すっかりなくなること。
presentation.note: A formal word for something ceasing to exist entirely, used of languages, species, rights and even relationships (自然消滅); 消失 stresses vanishing from sight or being lost.

presentation.defJa: 火事などの火を消すこと。
presentation.note: A practical term for firefighting seen on signs and in news (消火栓, 消火活動); 鎮火 means the fire is out.

presentation.meaning: contamination; getting mixed in (of a foreign substance)
presentation.defJa: あるものの中に、本来入るべきでない別のものがまじって入ること。
presentation.note: In the news it usually refers to something unwanted getting into food or medicine (異物混入); 混合 is the neutral word for deliberately mixing things together.

presentation.defJa: メールや書類に、ほかのファイルや資料を付け加えること。
presentation.note: Standard in business email and forms (添付ファイル = attachment); 同封 is used instead for enclosing items in a physical envelope.

presentation.defJa: 税金の額を少なくすること。
presentation.note: A news and policy term, the opposite of 増税 (tax increase); 免税 means full exemption rather than a reduction.

presentation.defJa: 速さを落とすこと。また、勢いが弱まること。
presentation.note: Used both for vehicles slowing down and, very often in economic news, for a slowing economy (景気減速); the opposite is 加速.

presentation.defJa: 決められた期間がすべて終わること。
presentation.note: A formal word for a fixed period such as a term of office, contract, patent or sentence running its full course (任期満了 is the most common compound); in conversation people say 契約が切れる, and 期限切れ is used for things like passports or food past their date.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、一塁・二塁・三塁のすべてに走者がいる状態。
presentation.note: A baseball term heard constantly in broadcasts; 満塁ホームラン (grand slam) is the most familiar compound.

presentation.defJa: 地面や氷、水の上などを、すべるように進むこと。特に、飛行機が離着陸の際に地上を走ること。
presentation.note: Most often met in aviation (滑走路 = runway) and in skating or skiing; it suggests smooth, controlled sliding across a surface, unlike everyday 滑る, which often means slipping.

presentation.defJa: 一週間のうち、月曜の次の日。
presentation.note: A clipped form of 火曜日 common in schedules, notices and casual speech; the single kanji 火 is used in calendars and timetables.

presentation.meaning: online firestorm (of criticism); going up in flames
presentation.defJa: 建物などが燃え上がること。また、インターネット上で批判が一気に集まること。
presentation.note: Literally a large building going up in flames, but today it most often means an online storm of criticism; 批判が殺到する is a more neutral news phrasing.

presentation.defJa: 人がいないこと。住んでいる人や働いている人がいないこと。
presentation.note: Means that no person is present, living or working there (無人駅, 無人島, 無人の部屋); for vehicles and aircraft it corresponds to unmanned or driverless.

presentation.defJa: お金や見返りを受け取らないこと。ただであること。
presentation.note: A formal word for free of charge common in official and business contexts (無償化); 無料 is the everyday word, and 無償 can also mean done without expecting any reward.

presentation.meaning: indefinite; for life (as in life imprisonment)
presentation.defJa: 期間がはっきり決まっていないこと。終わりの時期を定めないこと。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds: 無期懲役 (life imprisonment) in crime news and 無期雇用 (open-ended employment) in labor contexts; since the June 2025 penal reform, sentences for newer crimes are worded 無期拘禁刑. 無期限 is the general word for indefinite.

presentation.defJa: 仕事についていないこと。また、その人。
presentation.note: A neutral, factual label for having no job, common on forms and in crime reports (自称無職); 失業中 stresses having lost a job and looking for work.

presentation.meaning: property (real estate for rent or sale)
presentation.defJa: 売ったり貸したりする土地や建物。また、品物。
presentation.note: In everyday use it almost always means a piece of real estate for rent or sale; in legal contexts it can refer to any item of property.

presentation.meaning: specially set up (for an event); special installation
presentation.defJa: ある目的のために、その時だけ特別に設けること。
presentation.note: Used for something set up specially and usually temporarily for an event (特設会場, 特設サイト); its opposite is 常設, permanently installed.

presentation.defJa: 罪になる悪い行い。また、それを行うこと。
presentation.note: The standard term in crime reporting for the act itself (犯行時刻, 犯行の動機); 犯罪 refers to crime as a category or to an offense in general.

presentation.meaning: still active (in one's job or sport); active service
presentation.defJa: 今も実際にその仕事や活動を続けていること。また、その人。
presentation.note: Means still actively working, competing or serving (現役引退 = retirement); for students, 現役 means entering university straight from high school, as opposed to 浪人.

presentation.defJa: 今ついている仕事や役職。また、今その役職についている人。
presentation.note: In election reporting it means the incumbent (現職対新人); it also describes someone's present job, as in 現職の警察官 (a serving police officer).

presentation.defJa: プロ野球のチームを持ち、運営する団体。
presentation.note: Refers to a professional baseball club as an organization or business; チーム is the more general word for the players on the field.

presentation.defJa: 野球をするためのグラウンドと観客席がある施設。
presentation.note: Specifically a baseball ground (also 野球場); 競技場 or スタジアム is used for other sports such as soccer or athletics.

presentation.defJa: 法人や団体で、その運営について決めたり実行したりする役の人。
presentation.note: A board member of a non-profit body such as a foundation, school corporation or association; in a company the equivalent is 取締役.

presentation.meaning: to create; to produce; to bring into being
presentation.defJa: 今までになかった新しいものを作り出す。
presentation.note: Used for bringing something new into existence, such as ideas, value, profit or jobs; it sounds more creative and dynamic than plain 作る.
collocations: 新しいアイデアを生み出す

presentation.meaning: to give rise to; to produce; to give birth
presentation.defJa: 新しく物事を起こしたり作り出したりする。また、子や卵をこの世に出す。
presentation.note: In the figurative sense (誤解を生む, 利益を生む) 生む is the standard spelling, while for giving birth or laying eggs 産む is now the usual kanji.

presentation.meaning: during one's lifetime (of someone now dead)
presentation.defJa: 亡くなった人が、まだ生きていたとき。
presentation.note: Refers to the lifetime of someone who has already died, common in news and obituaries (故人が生前…); 生前整理 means sorting out one's belongings while still alive.

presentation.defJa: 新しくものができること。また、作り出すこと。
presentation.note: A formal or technical word for generating or forming something (化合物の生成, 生成AI); in everyday speech 作る or 作り出す is more natural.

presentation.defJa: 物事がどこから来たのか、どのようにして始まったのかということ。
presentation.note: Very often used as ～に由来する (derives from) when explaining names, words and customs; 起源 focuses more on the historical starting point itself.

presentation.defJa: 男の子ども。
presentation.note: A formal word for a boy used in news reports and official documents; in everyday speech people say 男の子, and 日本男児 is a set phrase meaning a true Japanese man.

presentation.defJa: 男の人と女の人。
presentation.note: A neutral, formal pairing used in statistics, law and set phrases (男女共同参画, 老若男女); 男と女 sounds more blunt or literary.

presentation.meaning: screen (of a phone, TV or computer)
presentation.defJa: テレビやパソコン、スマートフォンなどで、映像や文字が映る部分。
presentation.note: Covers any display surface (TV, computer, phone) and the picture shown on it; スクリーン is used more for cinema or projection screens.

presentation.defJa: 長い名前を短くした呼び方。
presentation.note: A formal word for the shortened name of an organization, law or product; 略語 refers to abbreviated words in general.

presentation.meaning: nth place or position (in a ranking or order)
presentation.defJa: 数字の後に付けて、順番や順位が何番目であるかを表す言葉。
presentation.note: Almost always attached to a number (一番手, 二番手) for the person or company holding that place in an order or ranking; in textiles it also indicates yarn count.

presentation.defJa: 本当かどうか信じきれない気持ち。また、悪いことをしたのではないかと思われること。
presentation.note: In news it most often means suspicion of a crime, as in ～の疑いで逮捕, whereas 疑問 is a neutral question one has about something.

presentation.defJa: 本当かどうか信用できず、はっきりしない様子。
presentation.note: A fairly formal, written word for claims, figures or motives whose truth is in question; the colloquial あやしい adds a stronger sense that something is fishy.

presentation.meaning: to give off, emit (light, sound, heat); to utter, issue
presentation.defJa: 光や音、においなどを外に出す。また、言葉や命令などを外に向けて出す。
presentation.note: A formal, written verb for emitting light, sound, heat or words and for issuing warnings; in conversation 出す or 言う is more usual.

presentation.meaning: official issuance (of an order, warning or appointment)
presentation.defJa: 国や自治体、会社などが、命令や警報などを公式に出すこと。
presentation.note: Used for orders, warnings and personnel appointments formally issued by an authority, whereas 発表 is the broader word for announcing information.
collocations: 緊急事態宣言を発令する

presentation.defJa: 情報や意見、電波などを外に向けて送り出すこと。
presentation.note: Originally the transmission of a signal or message, it is now widely used for actively putting information or opinions out to the public, as in 情報発信 and 発信力.
collocations: メッセージを発信する

presentation.defJa: 品物や仕事を、ほかの会社や業者に注文すること。
presentation.note: A business term for placing an order with a supplier or contractor, the counterpart of 受注 (receiving an order); 注文 is the everyday word.

presentation.defJa: 病気などで体温がふだんより高くなること。また、物が熱を出すこと。
presentation.note: A medical and news word for running a fever, also used for heat produced by devices or chemical reactions; in conversation 熱が出る is more common.

presentation.defJa: 電車や飛行機、船などが出発したり到着したりすること。
presentation.note: Refers to the departures and arrivals of trains, buses, flights or ships and is typical of timetables and travel notices, as in 空港を発着する便 or 東京駅発着のツアー.

presentation.defJa: 隠していた悪いことや秘密が、人に知られること。
presentation.note: Used almost exclusively for wrongdoing or secrets that come to light, such as 不正が発覚する, unlike the neutral 発見 (discovery).

presentation.meaning: taking the mound, pitching (in a game)
presentation.defJa: 野球で、投手として試合に出て投げること。
presentation.note: A baseball term for a pitcher entering a game, also used figuratively in politics and media for someone stepping into a role, such as a new minister or news anchor.

presentation.meaning: appointment or promotion (of capable people to important posts)
presentation.defJa: 能力のある人を選んで、大切な地位や役目につけること。
presentation.note: A formal word for selecting someone on merit for an important post, common in HR and politics; 任命 focuses on the act of appointing and 昇進 on rising in rank.
collocations: 若手を積極的に登用する

presentation.meaning: clean slate, back to square one (of a scrapped plan); blank paper
presentation.defJa: 何も書いていない紙。また、計画などを取りやめて、何もなかった状態に戻すこと。
presentation.note: Literally blank paper, such as an empty answer sheet, but in news it most often appears figuratively in 白紙に戻す or 白紙撤回 for scrapping a plan entirely.

presentation.defJa: 農業をして暮らす人。特に、昔の農民を指すことが多い。
presentation.note: Mainly heard today in historical contexts such as 百姓一揆; applied to modern farmers it can sound dated or even disparaging, so 農家 is the neutral choice.

presentation.defJa: 天皇の妻。
presentation.note: The title of the emperor's wife, almost always followed by 陛下 or さま in news; an empress dowager is 皇太后, and a woman who reigns in her own right is 女帝.

presentation.defJa: 天皇の位を継ぐことが決まっている、天皇の息子。
presentation.note: The heir who is the emperor's son, also used for foreign crown princes; an heir who is not the emperor's son, such as a brother, is instead called 皇嗣.

presentation.defJa: 野球で、走者が投手の投球のすきをついて、安打などによらずに次の塁へ進むこと。
presentation.note: A baseball term for a stolen base; 盗塁を決める means to steal successfully, while 盗塁阻止 refers to the catcher throwing the runner out.

presentation.meaning: to liven up, build excitement for (an event or mood); to heap up
presentation.defJa: その場の雰囲気や人々の気持ちを、にぎやかで活気のあるものにする。
presentation.note: In everyday use it means to liven up an event, mood or conversation, while the literal heaping-up sense is rarer; the intransitive partner is 盛り上がる.

presentation.meaning: to include, incorporate (in a plan, bill or document)
presentation.defJa: 計画や文書などの中に、ある内容を入れる。
presentation.note: Common in news and business for including items in a plan, bill, budget or document; 含める is the plainer, more general verb.

presentation.defJa: 会社や役所の仕事やお金の使い方が正しいかどうかを、調べて確かめること。
presentation.note: A formal term for an official audit or inspection of accounts or operations; 検査 is a broader word for any inspection or test.

presentation.defJa: 事件や事故などが起きるところを、その場で実際に見ること。
presentation.note: Used for seeing an incident, crime, accident or animal with one's own eyes, especially in news and police contexts; 見かける is the casual everyday equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 人の注意をいちばん引く中心的なもの。また、目の玉。
presentation.note: Literally the eyeball, but in news and advertising it usually means the star attraction or headline item, as in 目玉商品; 呼び物 is a close, slightly more formal synonym.

presentation.meaning: prefectural (established and run by a prefecture)
presentation.defJa: 県がお金を出してつくり、運営していること。
presentation.note: Marks facilities set up and run by a prefecture, parallel to 市立 (municipal), 国立 (national) and 私立 (private).

presentation.defJa: 本当のことか、うそのことか。
presentation.note: A formal, written word for whether something is true or false, often in 真偽のほどは定かではない; in speech people simply say 本当かどうか.

presentation.defJa: 夏の中で、いちばん暑い時期。
presentation.note: Means the height of summer; 真夏日 is the meteorological term for a day reaching 30°C or more, and 猛暑日 for 35°C or more.

presentation.meaning: wearing (a uniform, helmet, seat belt, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 服や帽子、ベルトなどを身につけること。
presentation.note: A formal word used in rules, notices and news for wearing uniforms, helmets, seat belts or masks; everyday speech uses 着る, かぶる or する depending on the item.
collocations: シートベルトを着用する

presentation.meaning: to twinkle, flicker (of stars or lights); to blink
presentation.defJa: 星や明かりが、ちらちらと光る。また、まばたきをする。
presentation.note: A literary verb for stars or lights twinkling, most often met in the set phrase 瞬く間に (in the blink of an eye); 輝く lacks the flickering image.

presentation.meaning: to get to know each other; to become acquainted
presentation.defJa: 人と人とが出会って、互いのことを知るようになる。
presentation.note: Means two people meeting and becoming acquainted, usually with と or with で for the place; 出会う stresses the moment of meeting and often has a romantic or fateful ring.
collocations: 仕事を通じて知り合う

presentation.meaning: to become known, be found out
presentation.defJa: 隠していたことなどが、ほかの人にわかってしまう。
presentation.note: As a main verb it means to become known, often of something one wanted to hide, but it is far more common in fixed expressions like 名の知れた and 気心の知れた, and it is the source of かもしれない.

presentation.meaning: being well known (almost always in the compound for name recognition)
presentation.defJa: 世の中に名前がよく知られていること。
presentation.note: Rarely used on its own today, it appears almost entirely in 知名度 (name recognition); the older 知名人 is now uncommon, and 有名 is the everyday word for famous.

presentation.defJa: 会社の中。また、その会社の内部の人や組織。
presentation.note: A common business word for anything inside one's own company, as in 社内会議 or 社内規定; its opposite is 社外, and it should not be confused with the homophone 車内 (inside a vehicle).

presentation.defJa: 会社に勤めて働いている人。
presentation.note: Everyday word for a company's staff; 従業員 is broader (anyone employed at a workplace, including part-timers), and 会社員 names one's occupation as a company employee.
collocations: 正社員として採用される

presentation.defJa: 人の幸せやめでたいことを喜び、心から祝うこと。
presentation.note: Warmer and more solemn than 祝う, used for weddings, births and religious blessings, and often in the passive 祝福される or 祝福を受ける.

presentation.meaning: major Shinto shrine (esp. one connected with the imperial family)
presentation.defJa: 皇室とかかわりの深い、格の高い神社。
presentation.note: A title reserved for top-ranking shrines such as Ise and Meiji; the generic word is 神社, and 神宮 on its own often means the Ise shrine.

presentation.defJa: してはいけないと決めて、させないようにする。
presentation.note: Formal written verb found in laws, rules and notices; 禁じる is the more common modern form, and in speech people usually say 禁止する or ～してはいけない.

presentation.meaning: to move; to transfer (something or someone to another place)
presentation.defJa: ものや人、場所などを別のところへ動かす。
presentation.note: Transitive partner of 移る; besides physical moving it is common in 実行に移す (put into action), and in 風邪をうつす (pass on a cold) it is usually written in kana.

presentation.meaning: transplant (of an organ or tissue); transplanting (a plant)
presentation.defJa: 臓器や組織を、ほかの人の体などに移し入れること。また、植物を別の場所に植えかえること。
presentation.note: In the news it overwhelmingly means organ or tissue transplantation; with plants it means replanting seedlings, and it is also used for transplanting a system or custom and, in computing, for porting software.

presentation.meaning: transfer (to another team, club or agency)
presentation.defJa: 選手などが、所属するチームや会社を変えること。
presentation.note: Standard in sports and entertainment for changing teams, clubs or agencies; an ordinary employee changing jobs is 転職.

presentation.defJa: 税金の種類や集め方などについての国の仕組み。
presentation.note: Frequent in economic and political news, above all in 税制改正 (the annual tax reform); 税金 is the tax itself, 税制 the rules that govern it.

presentation.meaning: event (in a sports competition); item, category
presentation.defJa: 競技会などで行われる、競技の一つ一つの種類。
presentation.note: Usually the individual events of a sports meet or the Olympics; 競技 is the sport itself (swimming), 種目 an event within it (100m freestyle).

presentation.meaning: to build up (effort, experience); to pile up
presentation.defJa: ものを上へ重ねていく。また、努力や経験を少しずつ増やしていく。
presentation.note: Used literally for stacking objects but more often figuratively for steadily accumulating effort, experience or results; the noun 積み重ね is just as common.

presentation.meaning: positiveness; proactiveness (rarely used on its own)
presentation.defJa: 自分から進んで物事に取り組むこと。
presentation.note: Almost never used alone: it appears in 積極的 (proactive), 積極性 and 積極策, and its opposite is 消極.

presentation.meaning: investigation; getting to the bottom of (a cause or the truth)
presentation.defJa: 物事の原因や本当のことを、深く調べてはっきりさせること。
presentation.note: Formal word for getting to the bottom of a cause or the truth, above all in 原因究明 and 真相究明 after accidents, failures and scandals; for clearing up scientific mechanisms or mysteries, 解明 is the usual word.

presentation.meaning: blank; vacuum, gap (a period in which nothing happens)
presentation.defJa: 何も書かれていない部分。また、何も行われない期間や状態。
presentation.note: Literally blank space on a page, but in the news it often means a vacuum or gap, as in 政治の空白 (political vacuum) or a gap on a résumé.

presentation.defJa: 暴力や脅しを使わずに、他人の物を盗むこと。
presentation.note: Legal and journalistic term for theft; in conversation people say 盗む or 泥棒, and 強盗 is robbery involving violence or threats.
collocations: 窃盗の疑いで逮捕される

presentation.meaning: to launch; to set up (a company or project)
presentation.defJa: 新しい会社や計画などを始める。
presentation.note: Common in business for founding companies or launching projects and in computing for starting up a machine or app; 設立する is the formal legal word for founding a company.
collocations: プロジェクトを立ち上げる
パソコンを立ち上げる

presentation.defJa: ある場所や区域の中に入ること。
presentation.note: Mostly seen on signs and in official contexts, especially 立ち入り禁止 (no entry) and 立ち入り検査 (on-site inspection); in conversation you would simply say 入る.

presentation.defJa: 憲法を定め、それに基づいて国を治めること。
presentation.note: Used almost only in compounds such as 立憲主義 and 立憲君主制 in political and historical writing; it also appears in the name of a major opposition party.

presentation.defJa: 計画や案を考えて作ること。
presentation.note: Formal word for drawing up plans, policies or strategies; 立案 is the drafting stage, while 策定 stresses officially settling the final plan.

presentation.defJa: とてもすばらしく、見事なようす。
presentation.note: Very common praise for people, buildings, achievements and conduct, carrying a sense of dignity or admirable scale that the lighter すごい lacks.

presentation.defJa: 泳ぐ速さを争う競技。
presentation.note: The sport of racing in a pool, as distinct from 水泳 (swimming in general) and from diving or artistic swimming.

presentation.meaning: race (of speed, e.g. running or horses)
presentation.defJa: 決まった距離を走って、速さを争うこと。
presentation.note: Specifically a race of speed; do not confuse it with the homophone 競争 (competition in general).

presentation.defJa: いちばん大切なこと。また、順番のはじめ。
presentation.note: Besides ordinal use (第一回), it marks top priority as in 安全第一 or 健康第一, and in speech 第一、… means "for one thing, …".

presentation.defJa: 問いに対して返すことば。また、問題を解いて出た結果。
presentation.note: Everyday word for both a reply and the solution to a problem; 回答 is more formal (answers to surveys or inquiries) and 解答 is used for exam solutions.

presentation.meaning: formulation; drawing up (a plan, policy or guideline)
presentation.defJa: 政策や計画などを考えて、正式に決めること。
presentation.note: Officialese used by governments and companies for drawing up formal plans, guidelines or standards; rarely heard in casual speech.

presentation.defJa: 役所や会社などが受け持っている区域の中。
presentation.note: News term for the area an office, police station, utility or railway is responsible for; 管轄 is the authority itself, 管内 the area inside it.

presentation.defJa: 飛行機の離着陸や飛行を、指示を出して安全に管理すること。また、国などが強制的に制限すること。
presentation.note: Today mostly means air traffic control; historically it also meant state control, as in 報道管制 (news blackout) and 灯火管制 (wartime blackout).

presentation.meaning: district; jurisdictional region (of a national agency)
presentation.defJa: 役所などが仕事を受け持つために分けた区域。
presentation.note: Formal administrative term for the regional divisions of national agencies such as the Coast Guard, the weather service and the police.

presentation.defJa: 物事の区切りとなる大事な時。もとは竹や木のふしのところ。
presentation.note: Often used for anniversaries and life stages, as in 創業百年の節目; literally the node of a bamboo stalk or a knot in wood.

presentation.defJa: アメリカの軍隊。
presentation.note: Standard news abbreviation in which 米 stands for America; 在日米軍 refers specifically to US forces stationed in Japan.

presentation.meaning: affiliated group (of companies or stations), network; series
presentation.defJa: つながりのある会社やものの集まり。また、順に並んだもののつながり。
presentation.note: In business and media it means an affiliated group (the keiretsu of companies, TV networks); in data contexts it appears in 時系列 (time series).

presentation.defJa: とても感じがよく、心がひかれる様子。
presentation.note: Expresses charm and appeal rather than excellence (すばらしい), and is common in conversation and lifestyle writing; it is often written すてき in kana.

presentation.defJa: 全体の中の、細かい部分。
presentation.note: Common in writing about craft, design and plans, and refers to the small physical or structural parts of a whole, whereas 詳細 means detailed information.

presentation.defJa: 幅がせまくて、長さがある様子。
presentation.note: A plain descriptive word for shape used for rooms, islands, vegetables and more; ほっそりした instead suggests a slim, graceful figure.

presentation.meaning: to end; to come to an end; to finish
presentation.defJa: 続いていたことが、そこで止まって最後になる。
presentation.note: Intransitive (something ends), with 終える as the transitive counterpart; after a verb stem it means to finish doing, as in 読み終わる.

presentation.defJa: 試合や物事が、終わりに近づいた段階。
presentation.note: Originally a go and shogi term, it is now widely used for the late stage of games, elections, seasons and projects, alongside 序盤 and 中盤.

presentation.defJa: いくつかのものを合わせて、一つのまとまりにしたもの。
presentation.note: An everyday word for combinations of colors, foods, ingredients or parts; in sports news it also means the tournament draw, as in 対戦の組み合わせ.

presentation.defJa: いくつかの部門や仕事をまとめて、全体を管理すること。
presentation.note: A business and administrative word for having overall charge of several units, broader than 管理; the similar-looking 総括 more often means summing up or reviewing.

presentation.defJa: 絵を中心にして、短い文で物語などを表した子ども向けの本。
presentation.note: Mainly means illustrated books for young children, though picture books for adults are a recognized genre; 漫画 is the separate comic form.

presentation.defJa: 望みがまったくなくなり、あきらめてしまうこと。
presentation.note: A strong word for a total loss of hope; 絶望的 is used more loosely for situations that look hopeless, while 失望 is milder disappointment in someone or something.

presentation.meaning: pitching change; relieving the pitcher with another
presentation.defJa: 野球で、試合の途中で投手を代えて、次の投手に投げさせること。
presentation.note: A baseball term common in sports reporting; 継投策 refers to a manager's bullpen plan, and its opposite is 完投, a complete game by one pitcher.

presentation.defJa: 政治や社会の古い仕組みを改め、すべてを新しくすること。
presentation.note: Almost always evokes the Meiji Restoration; in modern politics it appears in party names and slogans calling for sweeping reform, and it sounds grander than 改革.

presentation.defJa: 会社や団体で、全体にかかわる事務をまとめて行う仕事。また、その部署。
presentation.note: In companies it names the department handling administration, facilities and internal events, roughly "general affairs" or "admin"; 総務省 is the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications.

presentation.defJa: 全部を合わせた数。
presentation.note: A neutral written word for the total count of people or things; 総額 is a total amount of money, and 合計 is any sum.

presentation.defJa: 内閣の長である首相を指す呼び方。
presentation.note: Short for 内閣総理大臣 and common in speech and broadcast news; 首相 is the usual headline word, while 総理 often appears in direct address and quotes.

presentation.meaning: governor (of a central bank); president (of a party or large organization)
presentation.defJa: 大きな組織や政党などで、いちばん上に立って全体をまとめる人。
presentation.note: The title for the head of certain large bodies such as the Bank of Japan or the Liberal Democratic Party, whose 総裁選 picks the party leader; ordinary companies use 社長 instead.

presentation.defJa: 一部の大学などで、組織全体をまとめる最高責任者。
presentation.note: Used for the heads of certain, mostly older and larger, universities in place of 学長, and in 事務総長 it means secretary-general, as of the United Nations.

presentation.defJa: お金を全部合わせた金額。
presentation.note: Always refers to money and is standard in news and business, whereas 合計 is any sum; 総額表示 is the rule that prices must be shown including tax.

presentation.defJa: 草や木の葉のような色。
presentation.note: A plain, concrete color word; 緑 alone can also mean greenery or vegetation, whereas 緑色 refers strictly to the hue.

presentation.meaning: conclusion (of a treaty or contract); signing
presentation.defJa: 条約や契約などを、正式に結ぶこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for treaties, agreements and contracts in news and legal documents; in conversation people simply say 契約を結ぶ.

presentation.defJa: いくつかのものを集めて、一つのまとまりに組み立てること。
presentation.note: Used for putting together lineups, budgets, teams and trains; 構成 focuses on how parts make up a whole, while 編成 stresses assembling units into an organized set.

presentation.defJa: 法律に違反した人に、罰として国が払わせるお金。
presentation.note: Strictly a criminal penalty imposed by a court, distinct from the administrative 反則金 for traffic tickets; casually it is used for any money paid as a penalty.

presentation.meaning: the following year; the next year
presentation.defJa: ある年の、次の年。
presentation.note: Refers to the year after a point in the past or in a narrative, whereas 来年 means next year counted from now; it is typical of written and news style.

presentation.meaning: the next day; the following day
presentation.defJa: ある日の、次の日。
presentation.note: Means the day after a given day, while 明日 means tomorrow counted from today; it is common in news, schedules and instructions.

presentation.defJa: ある夜が明けた、次の日の朝。
presentation.note: A slightly written-style word for the morning after a given night, also read よくちょう in formal use; in conversation 次の朝 is more common.

presentation.meaning: deterioration with age; being old and worn-out (of buildings or equipment)
presentation.defJa: 建物や設備などが、古くなって傷み、役に立たなくなること。
presentation.note: In modern use it almost always describes buildings, infrastructure or equipment, mostly in the compound 老朽化; applied to people it sounds old-fashioned and harsh.

presentation.meaning: to catch (what is said); to make out
presentation.defJa: 人の話や音を注意して聞き、内容をはっきりつかむ。
presentation.note: Stresses successfully catching sounds or words and is very common in the potential 聞き取れる; the noun 聞き取り also means a listening test or an interview survey.

presentation.defJa: 関係のある人から、事情や意見などを聞くこと。
presentation.note: A formal word common in police news (事情聴取) and administrative procedure (意見聴取); it also means listening to broadcasts, as in 聴取率 for radio ratings.

presentation.meaning: professional function; occupational role and ability
presentation.defJa: その仕事に就く人が果たす役割や、仕事をするための能力。
presentation.note: A formal word for the function or capabilities of an occupation, common in HR and professional contexts such as 職能給 (skill-based pay); 職務 refers to specific assigned duties instead.

presentation.meaning: supporting the education of promising young people (esp. through scholarships)
presentation.defJa: すぐれた若者を育てること。特に、学費を援助して学ばせること。
presentation.note: Found mostly in the names of scholarship bodies and funds, such as the former 日本育英会; in everyday speech people simply say 奨学金.

presentation.defJa: 細菌やウイルスなどが原因で、肺が炎症を起こす病気。
presentation.note: The standard medical and everyday term; 肺炎球菌ワクチン is widely recommended for older adults, and 誤嚥性肺炎 (aspiration pneumonia) is a frequent phrase in elderly care.

presentation.meaning: dropping out; falling behind (and leaving a group, race or program)
presentation.defJa: 仲間や集団についていけず、途中で抜けてしまうこと。
presentation.note: Common in news about races, title contests, courses and training programs and implies failing to keep up; 中退 is the formal term for leaving school, and 脱落 can also mean something coming loose and falling off, as in 部品の脱落.

presentation.defJa: そのもの。ほかと切り離して、それだけを取り上げていう語。
presentation.note: Placed right after a noun (計画自体, 言葉自体) to single out the thing itself rather than its details or effects; do not confuse it with the homophone 事態, meaning situation.

presentation.defJa: 自分の力や価値を信じる気持ち。
presentation.note: Means confidence in oneself, whereas trust in other people or things is 信頼; 自身 (oneself) is a different word with the same reading.

presentation.meaning: one's own home or business; home-produced, own-use (in compounds)
presentation.defJa: 自分の家や店。また、自分のところで作ったり使ったりすること。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone today; it mostly appears as the first part of compounds such as 自家製 and 自家用, meaning made or used by oneself rather than bought or commercial.

presentation.meaning: spontaneity; acting of one's own accord (adjectival form: voluntary, spontaneous)
presentation.defJa: 人に言われたり強いられたりせず、自分から進んで行うこと。
presentation.note: Almost always met as 自発的 or 自発性 and stresses that the impulse comes from within, while 自主的 stresses independence from outside control; in grammar it also names the spontaneous use of れる and られる, as in 思い出される.

presentation.defJa: 自分が勤めている会社。また、話題になっている会社そのもの。
presentation.note: Standard business word for one's own company or the company under discussion, contrasted with 他社; 弊社 is the humble form used when speaking to clients.

presentation.defJa: 周りの状況を考えて、自分から行動や活動を控えること。
presentation.note: Implies refraining out of social pressure or consideration for others rather than because of a legal ban, and was heard constantly during the pandemic in phrases like 外出自粛.

presentation.meaning: lethal; fatal (mostly in compounds, e.g. lethal dose)
presentation.defJa: 死に至らせること。命を奪うほどであること。
presentation.note: A technical written word found almost only in compounds in medical, scientific and legal contexts; in everyday speech people say 命に関わる instead.

presentation.meaning: younger members (of a group or profession); up-and-coming people
presentation.defJa: ある集団や職業の中で、年が若く経験の浅い人。
presentation.note: Refers to the younger members within a particular field or organization, often with a sense of rising talent, while 若者 means young people in society at large.

presentation.defJa: 年の若い人。特に十代後半から二十代くらいの人。
presentation.note: The general word for young people as a social group, frequent in news and trend pieces, whereas 若手 means the junior members of a specific field.

presentation.meaning: to calm down; to compose oneself
presentation.defJa: 興奮やあせりがおさまって、心が静かになる。
presentation.note: Covers people calming down as well as situations settling and settling into a new place, and the form 落ち着いた also describes a subdued color or atmosphere.

presentation.meaning: to drop; to lose (something by dropping it)
presentation.defJa: 物を上から下へ移す。また、気づかないうちに持ち物をなくす。
presentation.note: The basic transitive partner of 落ちる, with many extended uses such as lowering speed (スピードを落とす), failing a course (単位を落とす) and removing dirt (汚れを落とす).

presentation.defJa: 一人の演者が座ったまま、こっけいな話を語って聞かせる日本の伝統的な話芸。
presentation.note: Performed in small variety theaters called 寄席; a performer is a 落語家 or 噺家, and a story typically ends with a punchline called the オチ or サゲ.

presentation.meaning: losing an election; failing to be selected
presentation.defJa: 選挙で選ばれないこと。また、コンクールなどで選ばれないこと。
presentation.note: The opposite of 当選; besides elections it is also used for failing to be chosen in contests, lotteries and juried exhibitions.

presentation.defJa: 亡くなった人を送るために行う儀式。
presentation.note: More formal than お葬式 and standard in news and official notices, while 告別式 refers specifically to the farewell ceremony part.

presentation.defJa: 事実ではないことを、本当であるかのように見せかけること。うそ。
presentation.note: A formal, legal-sounding word used in news and official documents (虚偽の説明, 虚偽表示); in conversation people simply say うそ.

presentation.defJa: 日本の国会を構成する二つの議院のうち、任期が四年で解散のある方。
presentation.note: Newspaper abbreviation of 衆議院, especially common in headlines and compounds like 衆院選, just as the upper house is shortened to 参院.

presentation.meaning: exercise (of a right or power); use (of force)
presentation.defJa: 権利や権力、力などを実際に使うこと。
presentation.note: A formal word used with rights, authority and force (権利, 権限, 武力); for ordinary tools or methods, 使用 or 使う is used instead.

presentation.defJa: 体や環境を清潔にして、病気を防ぎ健康を守ること。
presentation.note: Covers both personal hygiene and public sanitation (衛生的 means hygienic, 不衛生 unsanitary); do not confuse it with the homophone 衛星, meaning satellite.

presentation.defJa: よい行いや優れた成績を、公の場でほめたたえること。
presentation.note: Used for formal recognition by an organization, usually with a certificate or ceremony, whereas 称賛 is praise in general without any official act.

presentation.meaning: expression or declaration (of an opinion, intention, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 自分の考えや態度を、はっきりと人々に示すこと。
presentation.note: Typically takes objects such as 意向, 意思, 反対 or 支持 and appears in political and business news, while 発表 is the broader word for announcing information.

presentation.defJa: 裁判で訴えられた側の人。
presentation.note: Legally 被告 is the defendant in a civil suit and 被告人 the accused in a criminal case, but news media use 被告 for both, often as a title after a name.

presentation.meaning: being hit by a disaster; suffering damage (from an earthquake, flood, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 地震や台風、洪水などの災害で被害を受けること。
presentation.note: Used for people, places and buildings struck by natural disasters, mainly in news, whereas 被害 is the broader word for any damage or harm.

presentation.defJa: 争いや問題について、立場のある人や機関が判断を下して決めること。
presentation.note: A formal word for a binding decision by an authority such as an arbitrator, commission or court, whereas an individual referee's call in a game is usually 判定.

presentation.defJa: 元のものと同じものを、もう一つ作ること。また、そうして作ったもの。
presentation.note: A formal or legal word for copying works, documents, data or artworks; コピー is the everyday equivalent, and 複写 refers specifically to copying documents.

presentation.meaning: west side; (in politics) the West, Western countries
presentation.defJa: ある場所や物を基準にして、日の沈む方角にあたる部分。
presentation.note: Literally the west side of something, but in international news 西側, as in 西側諸国, means the Western bloc of the United States and its allies.

presentation.meaning: western part (of a country or region)
presentation.defJa: ある国や地域の中で、西のほうにある部分。
presentation.note: Used in news and geography for the western region of a country (アメリカ西部, and 西部劇 for Western films), whereas 西側 tends to mean the west side of a particular place or the political West.

presentation.defJa: あることを行ったり認められたりするために、必要な条件。
presentation.note: A formal word for conditions that must be met, common in job ads, laws and contracts; for the business you have come to see someone about, 用件 is the usual spelling.

presentation.meaning: to gaze at; to stare at
presentation.defJa: 目を離さずに、じっと見続ける。
presentation.note: Implies a long, fixed and often intent look and is also used figuratively for facing reality or oneself, while にらむ adds hostility and 眺める is a relaxed look at a wide view.

presentation.meaning: to find; to discover (value, meaning, a solution)
presentation.defJa: 探したり考えたりした結果、価値や答えなどを見つける。
presentation.note: A written, somewhat literary verb used mostly with abstract objects like value, meaning or a way out, whereas 見つける is the everyday word for finding physical things.

presentation.meaning: to lose sight of (a goal, oneself, a person)
presentation.defJa: 追っていたものや目指していた目標が、どこにあるか分からなくなる。
presentation.note: Used literally for losing someone in a crowd and figuratively for losing one's goals or sense of self; 自分を見失う is a very common set phrase.

presentation.meaning: to watch over; to keep a caring eye on
presentation.defJa: 何かあればすぐ助けられるように、そばで気をつけて様子を見る。
presentation.note: Implies caring, protective attention without interfering, unlike 監視する, which suggests surveillance or suspicion.

presentation.meaning: review; reconsideration and revision (of a plan or system)
presentation.defJa: 一度決めたことや作ったものを、もう一度調べて改めること。
presentation.note: Very common in news for reviewing and revising policies or plans; the verb 見直す can also mean to see someone in a new, better light.

presentation.meaning: knowledge and experience gained firsthand; what one has seen and heard
presentation.defJa: 実際に見たり聞いたりして得た知識や経験。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal, written word for knowledge gained firsthand, especially through travel; 見聞を広める is the standard phrase for broadening one's horizons.

presentation.meaning: to anticipate; to expect; to estimate; to see promise in (someone)
presentation.defJa: これから先どうなるかを前もって予想し、計算に入れる。
presentation.note: Common in business and economic news for forecasts, where the passive 見込まれる is especially frequent; with a person as object it means to see promise in them.

presentation.defJa: 目が向いている方向。また、他人から向けられるまなざし。
presentation.note: Refers to the direction of one's gaze and often to how others look at you, as in 冷たい視線 or 周囲の視線を気にする.

presentation.defJa: テレビや動画などを見たり聞いたりすること。
presentation.note: A formal word used mainly for watching broadcasts and videos; everyday speech usually just says 見る.

presentation.defJa: 親と、その子ども。父や母と子のつながり。
presentation.note: Covers any parent-child pair; 親子連れ means a parent out with a child, and the word is used metaphorically too, as in 親子会社 (parent and subsidiary companies).

presentation.defJa: 血のつながりや結婚によってつながっている人々。
presentation.note: More formal than 親戚, typical of legal documents, ceremonies and news reports, and usually refers to relatives as a group.

presentation.meaning: watching a game or match; spectating
presentation.defJa: スポーツの試合などを見て楽しむこと。
presentation.note: Used for watching sports or games such as go and shogi, whereas 鑑賞 is for appreciating art, films or music.

presentation.defJa: 役目や地位から、その人をやめさせること。
presentation.note: Means removing someone from a post, typically by a board or organization; unlike 辞任 (resigning), the decision is made by others.

presentation.defJa: 建物や機械など、組み立てられたものをばらばらにすること。また、組織を分解してなくすこと。
presentation.note: Literally dismantling buildings or machines, and also used for breaking up organizations, as in 組織の解体 or the postwar 財閥解体.

presentation.defJa: よく分かっていなかった事実や原因、仕組みを調べてはっきりさせること。
presentation.note: A formal word frequent in science and news; 解決 means solving a problem, while 解明 means making something unknown understood.

presentation.defJa: 細かく分けて調べ、その仕組みや性質を明らかにすること。
presentation.note: A technical word for systematic analysis of data, images or genes; 分析 is the broader, more everyday word for analysis.

presentation.meaning: to pronounce (a sentence); to formally announce (a decision) to someone
presentation.defJa: 決まったことを、相手に正式にはっきり伝える。
presentation.note: Used for formally announcing a decision, above all a court handing down a sentence, but also for orders such as a dismissal or eviction.

presentation.defJa: 外国の人が日本をおとずれること。
presentation.note: A formal news word for a foreigner's visit to Japan, from tourists to heads of state; parallel words for trips abroad include 訪米 and 訪中.

presentation.defJa: 株や債券など、お金に関する権利を示す書類。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds about investment such as 証券会社 and 証券取引所, rather than for a single paper certificate.

presentation.meaning: deliberation; conference (by a jury or council)
presentation.defJa: 集まって意見を出し合い、物事を決めるために話し合うこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for deliberation by a body such as a jury or council; outside the courts it appears mostly in 評議会 and 評議員.

presentation.defJa: 条件に合っているかを調べ、正式に認めること。
presentation.note: An official body checking that someone or something meets set criteria and formally recognizing it, as with qualifications, care needs or workplace injuries (要介護認定, 労災認定); 承認 is closer to approving a request.

presentation.defJa: 話して聞かせること。また、物語を声に出して伝える話し方。
presentation.note: Refers to the act or style of narrating, as in a storyteller's delivery or a film's voice-over; 語り口 means one's manner of telling.

presentation.defJa: 本や新聞、雑誌などを読む人。
presentation.note: The standard word for the readership of a publication; 読み手 is a softer, more personal alternative.

presentation.defJa: 馬や犬などの動物を、目的に合わせて訓練すること。
presentation.note: Mostly used for training racehorses and performing animals; for pets, しつけ or トレーニング is the usual word.

presentation.defJa: 必要なお金や物を集めてそろえること。
presentation.note: Common in business news for raising funds or procuring materials and parts; 入手 simply means obtaining something, without the sense of organized sourcing.

presentation.defJa: ある地域に集まっている、たくさんの島々。
presentation.note: Usually part of the name of a group of islands; 列島 is used for islands strung out in a long chain, as in 日本列島.

presentation.defJa: 自分の悪かったことを認めて、相手にあやまること。
