presentation.note: The standard name for pediatrics and pediatric clinics, seen on hospital signs; 小児 is a formal word for young children used mostly in medical terms.

presentation.defJa: 人に雇われて、家の仕事や店の仕事をする人。
presentation.note: Now sounds old-fashioned for household servants; in legal and corporate texts it means an employee as distinct from a company officer (使用人兼務役員), while everyday speech prefers 従業員 or 社員.

presentation.defJa: 物事に向かう、燃えるように強い気持ち。
presentation.note: Stronger and more emotional than 熱意 (earnest zeal); 情熱 suggests a burning passion, often for art, love or a life's work.

presentation.defJa: 国と国との間で、文書によって結ぶ正式な約束。
presentation.note: A formal written agreement between states; 協定 is often used for narrower or more technical agreements, and 同盟 specifically means an alliance.

presentation.defJa: 戦いや試合で、相手に勝つこと。
presentation.note: More formal than 勝ち; standard in news and sports reporting, often with 収める or 飾る (初勝利を飾る).

presentation.meaning: landing, coming ashore; (of a typhoon) landfall
presentation.defJa: 海から陸に上がること。台風が陸地に達すること。
presentation.note: Besides people landing from ships, it is the standard news word for a typhoon making landfall, and is used figuratively for a foreign brand or trend arriving in Japan.

presentation.defJa: 液体を熱して気体にし、それを冷やして再び液体として集めること。
presentation.note: 蒸溜 is the older spelling, still favored by whisky and shochu makers (蒸溜所); in general writing and science the standard form is 蒸留.

presentation.defJa: ある範囲や対象に入れないで、外すこと。
presentation.note: A formal, document-style word for leaving something out of a set or rule; 排除 is stronger and implies actively removing something unwanted.

presentation.defJa: 役所や学校、病院などの組織に勤めて、仕事をする人。
presentation.note: Used for staff of public bodies, schools, hospitals and other organizations, whereas 社員 refers to employees of a company.

presentation.defJa: 仕事として、その人が責任を持って行うべき務め。
presentation.note: A formal word for the duties attached to a position, common in legal and official texts; 業務 refers more to the work operations themselves.

presentation.meaning: you all, ladies and gentlemen (address to a group)
presentation.defJa: 大勢の人に向かって呼びかける言葉。主に男性が、同輩や目下の人たちに対して改まって使う。
presentation.note: An old-fashioned, mostly male form of address used by a senior speaker such as a teacher, commander or speechmaker to a group; みなさん is the neutral modern equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 車や電車が、すぐに止まれるくらいの遅い速さで進むこと。
presentation.note: A traffic and railway term for proceeding slowly enough to stop at once; in everyday conversation people simply say ゆっくり走る.

presentation.defJa: 人や物がどこにあるか、どこにいるかということ。
presentation.note: A formal word for where someone or something is; 居場所 is the everyday equivalent for people, and 責任の所在 (where responsibility lies) is a frequent abstract use.

presentation.meaning: possession (having on one's person or in one's keeping)
presentation.defJa: 物を身につけたり、手元に持っていたりすること。
presentation.note: A legal and official word for having something on one's person or in one's keeping, especially regulated items (銃の所持, 所持品検査); 所有 means legal ownership of property.

presentation.meaning: belonging to, being attached to (an organization)
presentation.defJa: 団体や組織の一員として、その中に加わっていること。
presentation.note: The neutral word for membership in an organization, team or department (～に所属する); 属する is broader and also covers abstract categories.

presentation.defJa: 前もって決められていること。
presentation.note: Almost always used as 所定の before a noun in official notices and forms, and sounds more formal than 決められた.

presentation.defJa: 働いたり財産を運用したりして得たお金。収入から必要な経費を引いたもの。
presentation.note: 所得 is income after necessary expenses and is the word used in tax and statistics, while 収入 is the gross money coming in.

presentation.defJa: 本が最初に出版されたときの版。
presentation.note: The first printing or edition of a book; collectors prize it, and a phrase like 初版三千部 gives the size of the first print run.

presentation.defJa: 本の内容を紹介し、その価値や問題点を論じる文章。
presentation.note: A review specifically of a book, typically in newspapers and magazines; 批評 is criticism of any work, and レビュー is the casual online equivalent.

presentation.meaning: disposal, getting rid of; disciplinary action
presentation.defJa: いらない物を捨てたり売ったりして片付けること。また、規則を破った人を罰すること。
presentation.note: In daily life it means getting rid of things you no longer need; in the news it often means official punishment, as in 停学処分 or 懲戒処分.

presentation.defJa: 特別な地位や財産を持たない、ごく普通の人々。
presentation.note: Common people as opposed to the elite or wealthy, with a warm, down-to-earth tone, especially in 庶民的 (homey, unpretentious); 一般市民 is more neutral.

presentation.defJa: 会社や役所で、どの専門業務にも分類されない、こまごまとした一般の事務。
presentation.note: An office term for miscellaneous administrative tasks; 総務 is the broader general-affairs department, while 庶務 often names a section or role within it.

presentation.defJa: 物事をはっきりさせるために、くわしく確かめること。また、その結果。
presentation.note: In news reports 調べによると means "according to investigators"; in literary Japanese the same word can also mean a melody or strain of music.

presentation.defJa: 人の助けを借りずに、自分の力で生活したり物事を決めたりすること。
presentation.note: Standing on one's own feet economically or emotionally; 独立 stresses separating from a parent body or country, as in 独立国 or 独立して店を開く.

presentation.defJa: 文字で書き残すこと。書きとめること。
presentation.note: A more formal, written-style alternative to 書く, typical in documents (以下に記す) and in historical or literary writing about recording things.

presentation.defJa: 上の立場の者から、下の者や機械に出される命令。
presentation.note: An order issued from a command center, headquarters or controller, common in military, emergency and space contexts; 命令 is the general word for any order.

presentation.defJa: 名詞の後について、そのことに向かう気持ちや思いを表す。
presentation.note: Forms compounds naming a mental disposition or attitude (好奇心 curiosity, 向上心 drive to improve, 警戒心 wariness); in Sino-Japanese compounds like these it is read しん, while native compounds such as 親心 or 下心 use ごころ.

presentation.defJa: 戦いのために兵を並べた形。また、軍がとどまる場所。
presentation.note: Literally a battle formation or camp; in modern Japanese it survives in idioms like 背水の陣 and as a suffix for a group, as in 報道陣 (press corps) or 首脳陣 (leadership).

presentation.defJa: その人らしさを形づくる、考え方や性質のまとまり。人としての品位。
presentation.note: Refers to a person's whole character as a moral and psychological being, often with an ethical tone (人格者 = person of fine character); 性格 is everyday temperament.

presentation.defJa: 結婚して間もないこと。また、その人たち。
presentation.note: Used for the period just after marriage, most often in compounds like 新婚旅行 (honeymoon) and the colloquial 新婚さん (newlyweds).

presentation.defJa: 礼儀正しく、教養と品位のある男性。
presentation.note: Refers to a well-mannered, cultured man; 紳士的 means gentlemanly, and in shops 紳士 labels men's goods (紳士服, 紳士用) as the counterpart of 婦人.

presentation.defJa: うそや見せかけではない、本当のこと。
presentation.note: 真実 is the truth as opposed to lies or appearances and often carries moral or emotional weight, while 事実 is a neutral, verifiable fact.

presentation.defJa: ある宗教を信じ、その教えに従っている人。
presentation.note: Primarily a religious term; in casual speech it is also used half-jokingly for fanatical fans of a brand or person, where it can sound mocking.

presentation.defJa: 心の中にある気持ちや思い。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for someone's inner feelings, common in news and literature when sympathizing with others (被害者の心情); it is more personal than 感情, which means emotion in general.

presentation.defJa: 新しくその仲間や職場に加わった人。
presentation.note: Used broadly for newcomers in companies, sports, entertainment and the arts (新人歌手, 新人王), while 新入社員 refers specifically to a new company employee.

presentation.defJa: 人間のからだ。特に、その構造や仕組みを問題にするときに使う。
presentation.note: A scientific or technical term for the human body as an object of study or exposure (人体に無害); in everyday contexts people simply say 体.

presentation.defJa: 建物を新しく建てること。また、建てたばかりの建物。
presentation.note: Used for newly constructed houses and buildings, especially in real estate (新築物件), and contrasts with 中古 (pre-owned); 建築 means construction or architecture in general.

presentation.meaning: double suicide (of lovers or family); (fig.) going down together with
presentation.defJa: 愛し合う二人などが、一緒に自分の命を絶つこと。
presentation.note: Usually refers to lovers or family members dying together, in news and Edo literature; figuratively 会社と心中する means sticking with something to the bitter end, and the same kanji read しんちゅう mean one's inner feelings.

presentation.defJa: 物事が前へ進み、新しい段階に広がっていくこと。
presentation.note: Used for situations, negotiations, research and relationships moving to a new stage, often in news; 進歩 instead stresses improvement in quality or level.

presentation.meaning: temple; sanctuary (esp. of an ancient or non-Buddhist religion)
presentation.defJa: 神をまつるための建物。特に古代ギリシャなどのものを指すことが多い。
presentation.note: Typically used for temples of ancient or Western religions such as Greek, Roman or Egyptian ones; a Shinto shrine is 神社 and a Buddhist temple is 寺.

presentation.meaning: rate of progress; pace (of study or work)
presentation.defJa: 学習や作業がどのくらい先まで進んでいるかという度合い。
presentation.note: Mostly used in school and project contexts for how far along a planned course of work is (授業の進度); 進歩 means improvement and 進展 means development of a situation.

presentation.defJa: その年に学校へ入ったばかりの学生や生徒。
presentation.note: Covers newly enrolled students at any level from elementary school to university; for company recruits the equivalent is 新入社員.

presentation.meaning: confidence; trust (placed in someone entrusted with a role)
presentation.defJa: 相手を信じて、仕事や役目を任せること。
presentation.note: A formal political and organizational term for confidence formally placed in a leader or body, as in votes of confidence; 信頼 is the everyday word for trust between people.

presentation.defJa: 人間の知恵では簡単に説明できない、不思議なこと。
presentation.note: Carries a sense of awe at something profound or sacred, as with nature or life (宇宙の神秘), while 謎 is simply an unsolved puzzle; the adjective 神秘的 is very common.

presentation.defJa: 国を形づくっている一般の人々。
presentation.note: A somewhat dated, political word found in historical texts and in names such as 中華人民共和国; modern Japanese usually says 国民 or 市民 for citizens.
collocations: 人民の、人民による、人民のための

presentation.meaning: medical examination and treatment; medical care
presentation.defJa: 医者が患者を調べて、病気やけがの手当てをすること。
presentation.note: Covers both diagnosis and treatment and appears on clinic signs and in health-policy news (診療報酬, 休日診療); 診察 refers only to the examination itself.

presentation.defJa: 川の水が流れ出るもと。また、水道などの水を取るもと。
presentation.note: Used both for a river's headwaters and for the supply sources of drinking water (水源地, 水源の確保); 源流 refers specifically to the uppermost reaches of a river.

presentation.defJa: トランペットや笛などの管楽器に息を吹き込んで鳴らすこと。
presentation.note: Almost always met in the compound 吹奏楽 (wind band music) and in school club names; on its own it appears in formal ceremonial contexts such as playing the national anthem.

presentation.defJa: 水を引き入れて、稲を育てる田。
presentation.note: A slightly formal or technical word used in agriculture and geography; in everyday speech people say 田んぼ, and 水田 contrasts with 畑 (dry fields).

presentation.defJa: わかっている事実をもとに、まだわからないことを考えて導き出すこと。
presentation.note: Strongly associated with detective work and mystery fiction (推理ドラマ); 推測 is a looser guess and 推論 is formal logical inference.

presentation.defJa: 一、二、三のように、ものの数や順番を表すことば。
presentation.note: A grammatical term used in linguistics and language teaching; it is distinct from 助数詞, the counter suffixes such as 本 or 枚 that attach to it.
collocations: 数詞に助数詞をつける

presentation.meaning: to install; to fix in place (equipment)
presentation.defJa: 機械や設備などを、動かないように決まった場所にしっかり取り付ける。
presentation.note: Used for heavy equipment fixed in a set place, such as machinery, air conditioners or safes; 取り付ける is broader and also covers small parts, while 設置する is the more formal equivalent.

presentation.meaning: to set firmly in place; to make (something) the core or basis of
presentation.defJa: 物を動かないようにしっかりと置く。また、人や物事を大事な位置や地位に置く。
presentation.note: Physically it means setting something firmly in place, but it is most often used figuratively, as in 柱に据える, 腰を据える (to settle down to something seriously) and installing someone in a post.

presentation.defJa: 苦しい状況の中で、気持ちを楽にしてくれるもの。また、困っている人を助けること。
presentation.note: Besides literal rescue or religious salvation, it is very common in せめてもの救い or 唯一の救い, the one consoling point in a bad situation.
collocations: 救いの手を差し伸べる

presentation.defJa: 体も心も元気で、丈夫なようす。
presentation.note: A warm, slightly literary word often used for children's growth and in wishes or greetings (健やかにお過ごしください); 健康 is the neutral everyday noun.

presentation.defJa: 洗ったあとの物や口の中を、きれいな水で軽く洗って汚れや洗剤を落とす。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; it means rinsing with clean water after washing, while 洗う means washing more generally, and the same verb written 雪ぐ means clearing one's name (汚名をすすぐ).

presentation.meaning: progress; advance (of work, a clock, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 物事が前へ進むこと。また、その度合い。
presentation.note: A soft everyday noun from 進む, most common in 進み具合 (how things are coming along); formal writing prefers 進捗 or 進行.

presentation.meaning: hem (of a kimono, skirt, etc.); (trouser) cuff
presentation.defJa: 着物やスカート、ズボンなどの、いちばん下の端の部分。
presentation.note: Refers to the bottom edge of clothing and, by extension, the lower slopes of a mountain (裾野); 裾上げ is the everyday word for having trousers hemmed.

presentation.defJa: 動きや判断がとても速い。
presentation.note: Describes quick physical movement or reaction (素早く逃げる); 速い refers to speed in general, while 素早い stresses agility and promptness of response.

presentation.meaning: to listen intently (of the ears); to make clear; to look prim or unconcerned
presentation.defJa: 耳や心を一つのことに集中させる。また、にごりをなくしてすきとおらせる。気取ったり、平気なふりをしたりする。
presentation.note: Most often met in 耳を澄ます 'listen closely'; 澄ました顔 describes someone looking prim or nonchalant, and 清ます is a rare variant spelling.

presentation.defJa: にごった水などを、すきとおった状態にする。
presentation.note: A rare variant spelling of 澄ます, seen mainly in older writing about making water or other liquids clear; modern texts almost always use 澄ます.

presentation.meaning: to make do with; to finish, get done
presentation.defJa: 物事を終わらせる。また、ほかのもので間に合わせる。
presentation.note: 済ます and 済ませる mean the same, with 済ませる now more common in speech; ～で済ます often implies settling for something simpler or cheaper.

presentation.defJa: ものとものが強くふれ合って動き、こすられる。
presentation.note: Used for friction between surfaces, as in 靴擦れ 'shoe sore'; it can also mean becoming worldly or jaded, usually written in kana (すれた人). The same kanji read こすれる is the more everyday word for physical rubbing.

presentation.defJa: 植物などが芽を出して育っていくこと。
presentation.note: In modern usage 生育 is preferred for plants, while 成育 is used more for animals and children growing to maturity, though the line is blurry.

presentation.defJa: 動物や子どもが育って大きくなること。
presentation.note: 成育 stresses growing up to maturity and is used mainly of animals, fish and children, whereas 生育 is the usual word for plants; newspapers generally follow this split.

presentation.defJa: 努力や仕事によって得られた、よい結果。
presentation.note: The standard word for concrete achievements in work and research; 結果 is neutral and can be good or bad, while 成果 implies something gained through effort.

presentation.defJa: 問題に対する正しい答え。また、正しい判断。
presentation.note: Literally the correct answer to a question, but in conversation 正解だった often means 'it was the right call'; 正答 is a more formal exam term.

presentation.defJa: 人として守るべき正しい道理。
presentation.note: A weighty word for justice or righteousness in moral and political discussion; 正義感 'sense of justice' is the most frequent everyday compound, while 公正 means fairness in procedure.

presentation.defJa: 暮らしを立てていくための手段や収入。
presentation.note: Almost always appears in 生計を立てる 'make a living'; it is more formal than 暮らし and focuses on the means of earning one's keep.

presentation.defJa: 国を治める権力。また、それを持つ政府。
presentation.note: Refers to the governing administration or the hold on political power; 政府 is the government as an institution, while 政権 highlights who holds power and for how long.

presentation.defJa: 明るい星をつないで、動物や人などの形に見立てたもの。
presentation.note: Means constellation in astronomy, but in everyday talk it often refers to one's zodiac sign, as in 星座占い 'horoscope'.

presentation.defJa: 決まりや約束を破った者に罰を与えること。特に、国際的なルールに反した国に対して、ほかの国々が経済的な圧力などを加えること。
presentation.note: Today most often means sanctions between countries, as in 経済制裁 'economic sanctions'; it also covers penalties an organization imposes on a rule-breaker, and is more formal than 罰.

presentation.defJa: 動かずに、じっと止まっていること。
presentation.note: A technical-sounding word for being motionless, common in physics, broadcasting and 静止画 'still image'; in daily speech people simply say 止まっている.

presentation.defJa: うそがなく、まじめで真心があるようす。
presentation.note: Praises honesty combined with good faith toward others; 正直 is simply 'not lying', while 誠実 implies sincere, reliable conduct over time.

presentation.defJa: 果物がよく熟すこと。また、人や物事が十分に育つこと。
presentation.note: Used for fruit ripening and for people, societies or markets reaching full development; in business 成熟市場 means a market with little room left to grow.

presentation.defJa: 夢や希望にあふれた若い時期。
presentation.note: A nostalgic word for the springtime of youth, typically the teens and early twenties; it carries emotional overtones that the neutral 若い頃 lacks.

presentation.defJa: けがれがなく、清らかで素直なようす。
presentation.note: Describes a pure, innocent image and today appears mostly in entertainment talk such as 清純派女優, often with a slightly dated or ironic ring.

presentation.defJa: キリスト教の教えをまとめた書物。
presentation.note: Refers to the Bible; 旧約 and 新約 distinguish the Old and New Testaments. For the figurative 'bible' of a field, Japanese uses バイブル, not 聖書.

presentation.defJa: 変わったところがなく、ふつうの状態であること。
presentation.note: Means normal in the sense of functioning properly, common in medicine and machinery; 普通 is broader 'ordinary', and 異常 is the direct opposite.

presentation.meaning: to win, gain control of; to restrain
presentation.defJa: 相手をおさえて自分の思うようにする。また、勝ちを得る。
presentation.note: In news it typically means winning a contest or gaining control (選挙を制する), while the older sense of holding someone back survives in phrases like 相手を制する.

presentation.defJa: きちんと順序よく並び、乱れのないようす。
presentation.note: Describes things neatly in order and is used as 整然と or 整然とした rather than with な; 理路整然 'logically coherent' is a common four-character compound.

presentation.meaning: purity and impurity; good and bad
presentation.defJa: 清らかなことと、にごったこと。善と悪。
presentation.note: Rare on its own and met almost exclusively in the idiom 清濁併せ呑む 'to accept good and bad alike', said approvingly of broad-minded leaders, sometimes with a hint of moral compromise.

presentation.meaning: enactment, establishment (of a law or rule)
presentation.defJa: 法律や規則などを新しく定めること。
presentation.note: Used for formally enacting laws, rules or official days; 制定 is the act of establishing them, whereas 施行 means putting them into force.

presentation.defJa: 動きや変化がなく、止まっているようす。
presentation.note: A technical word meaning static or unchanging, used in IT, physics and art criticism, and almost always contrasted with 動的 'dynamic'.

presentation.defJa: 鉄鉱石から鉄をつくること。
presentation.note: Refers to iron and steel making as an industry; 鉄鋼 is the broader term for iron and steel products, and 製鉄所 is a steelworks.

presentation.defJa: 税金の計算や取り立てなどを行う国の役所。
presentation.note: The local branch of the National Tax Agency where individuals file returns and get tax advice; city offices handle local residence tax instead.

presentation.defJa: 自由な行動や働きをおさえる条件。
presentation.note: Means a condition that restricts freedom, common in business, engineering and law; 制限 is a set limit on quantity or action, while 制約 stresses conditions that hem one in.

presentation.meaning: influence, power; an influential group or force
presentation.defJa: 人や集団が、ほかを動かしたり従わせたりする力。また、その力を持つ集団。
presentation.note: Used for the sway of groups, factions, nations or companies, and in weather reports for a typhoon's strength (勢力を保ったまま); 権力 is formal authority, while 勢力 is the influence a group actually holds.

presentation.meaning: to hurry (someone), to rush; to press someone to act quickly
presentation.defJa: 早くするように、人をうながす。
presentation.note: A conversational verb with a slightly negative feel for pressing someone else to hurry; 催促する is more formal and is used for demands such as a payment or a reply.

presentation.meaning: (my) son (humble or familiar, used by a parent)
presentation.defJa: 親が自分の息子を、へりくだったり親しみをこめたりして言う言葉。
presentation.note: An old-fashioned word a parent, usually a father, uses for his own son, heard from older men and in period dramas and normally written in kana or as 倅; 息子 is the neutral word.
collocations: せがれに跡を継がせる

presentation.defJa: 立場や役目のうえで、果たさなければならない務め。
presentation.note: A formal word for a duty that comes with a role or position, typical of editorials and official statements; 義務 leans toward legal or rule-based requirements, while 責務 stresses moral responsibility.

presentation.meaning: flattery; an insincere compliment (almost always with the polite prefix o-)
presentation.defJa: 相手を喜ばせるために言う、本心からではないほめ言葉。
presentation.note: Almost always used as お世辞; the set phrase お世辞にも～ない means "even being generous, one couldn't call it ~."
collocations: お世辞にもうまいとは言えない

presentation.defJa: 同じ家に住み、生計を一緒にしている人々のまとまり。
presentation.note: An administrative and statistical term used for censuses, taxes and benefits; 家庭 is the warmer everyday word for a family and home life.

presentation.defJa: ほぼ同じころに生まれ、同じ時代を経験してきた人々。
presentation.note: Used for age cohorts of people and also for product generations (第三世代); 時代 is a period of history, not the people who live through it.

presentation.defJa: 治療のために、体の一部をメスで切り開くこと。
presentation.note: A medical term for a surgical cut, heard mostly in hospitals and health news; 帝王切開 (caesarean section) is the phrase everyone knows.

presentation.meaning: settings, configuration; setting up (a goal, price or condition)
presentation.defJa: 目的に合わせて、機械や条件などをあらかじめ決めておくこと。
presentation.note: In everyday tech use it means device or app settings, in planning it means fixing a target, price or deadline (目標設定), and in fiction it means a story's setting; 設置 is physically installing equipment.

presentation.defJa: よく話して、相手に考えや行動を変えてもらうこと。
presentation.note: Means winning someone over with talk and reasons, often patiently; 説明 only explains, while 説得 aims to change the other person's mind or actions, and 説得力 (persuasiveness) is very common.

presentation.meaning: out of print; discontinuation of publication
presentation.defJa: 本などの出版をやめて、もう新しく刷らないこと。
presentation.note: Means a publisher has stopped printing a title for good; 品切れ only means stock has run out, with a reprint still possible.

presentation.defJa: 会社や団体、学校などを新しくつくること。
presentation.note: Used for founding organizations such as companies, schools and foundations; 創立 has a more commemorative feel (創立百周年), and 建設 is for physical construction.

presentation.defJa: 相手に向かって、積極的にしかけていくこと。
presentation.note: The noun form of 攻める, common in sports, shogi and business (攻めの経営, an aggressive management style); 攻撃 is the general word for an attack of any kind, while 攻め often names an attitude or style of play (攻めの姿勢).

presentation.defJa: 社会の多くの人々が持っている、共通の意見。
presentation.note: Read both せろん and よろん, with よろん more common today, especially on television; it is the standard word in political news, while 民意 stresses the will of the voters.

presentation.defJa: 病気やけがが、すっかり治ること。
presentation.note: Means being completely cured and often appears in greetings and letters such as 全快祝い; 回復 can be partial, and 完治 is the more clinical term.

presentation.defJa: 宗教の教えを、人々に広めること。
presentation.note: Mostly used for Christian missionary work, especially in 宣教師 (missionary); 布教 is the general word for spreading any religion, including Buddhism.

presentation.meaning: war damage; destruction caused by war
presentation.defJa: 戦争によって受けた被害。
presentation.note: A historical term mostly used for the damage Japanese cities suffered in World War II, as in 戦災復興 (postwar reconstruction); 戦禍 is a more literary word for the ravages of war.

presentation.meaning: specializing in (a subject); studying one field exclusively
presentation.defJa: 一つの分野だけを、特に集中して学ぶこと。
presentation.note: A formal word seen in course names and in 専修学校 (vocational schools); 専攻 is the far more common word for one's major.

presentation.defJa: 戦いや試合で、勝つための具体的なやり方。
presentation.note: Refers to the concrete methods used in a particular battle, game or campaign; 戦略 is the broader long-term strategy that tactics serve.

presentation.defJa: 水の中にもぐること。
presentation.note: A somewhat technical word used for submarines (潜水艦), research dives and animal behavior; everyday speech says もぐる, and recreational diving is ダイビング.

presentation.meaning: predecessor (the previous head of a family business or household); the previous generation
presentation.defJa: 今の主人の一つ前の主人。また、前の代。
presentation.note: Typically refers to the previous head of a shop, family, company or stage-name lineage, often one's own parent; 前任者 is the neutral word for whoever held a post before.

presentation.defJa: このあいだ。少し前のある日。
presentation.note: A polite, somewhat formal word for "the other day," common in business letters and greetings; 先日 is the neutral standard and この間 the casual equivalent.
collocations: 先だっては失礼いたしました
先だってお送りした資料

presentation.meaning: arriving first; first come (as in first come, first served)
presentation.defJa: ほかより先に着くこと。また、着いた順番。
presentation.note: Mostly seen in notices and ads, as in 先着順 (first come, first served) or 先着〇名様, rather than for literally arriving first.

presentation.defJa: 武器を使って、敵と戦うこと。
presentation.note: Refers to actual armed fighting between forces, as in news reports; 戦争 is the war as a whole, while 戦闘 is the combat itself.

presentation.defJa: 人に気づかれないように、こっそり中に入りこむこと。
presentation.note: Used for undercover police work and reporting as well as for spies; 侵入 means entering without permission, usually illegally.

presentation.defJa: 人や荷物を運ぶ船をまとめて言う、かたい言葉。
presentation.note: A formal, collective term used in law, shipping and news reports; in conversation people simply say 船.

presentation.meaning: exclusive use; (something) reserved for a particular person or purpose
presentation.defJa: 決まった人や目的のためだけに使うこと。
presentation.note: Usually attached to a noun as ～専用, meaning "reserved for ~," on signs and products; its opposite is 共用 (shared use), and 兼用 means serving two purposes.

presentation.meaning: fighting strength; (of staff or players) a capable, contributing member
presentation.defJa: 戦いや仕事で、実際に役に立つ力。また、その力となる人。
presentation.note: Originally military, it is now common in business and sports for people who actually contribute, as in 即戦力 (someone useful from day one) and 戦力外通告 (being released from a team).

presentation.defJa: 以前にあった、同じような例。
presentation.note: Common in bureaucratic and business talk, especially 前例がない as a reason to refuse something new and 前例のない (unprecedented); 判例 is a legal precedent set by a court.

presentation.defJa: 団体や会社の全員、またはその代表が集まって、大事なことを決める会議。
presentation.note: Used for formal plenary meetings of a whole organization, such as a company's shareholders or the UN; unlike 会議, it implies the entire membership convenes with decision-making authority.

presentation.meaning: launch of a periodical; founding of a newspaper or magazine
presentation.defJa: 新聞や雑誌などを新しく出し始めること。
presentation.note: Specific to periodicals such as newspapers and magazines; for books the word is 刊行 or 出版, and the opposite of 創刊 is 廃刊 (discontinued) or 休刊 (suspended).

presentation.meaning: assorted non-timber trees; mixed woodland trees
presentation.defJa: 材木としてはあまり価値がない、いろいろな種類の木。
presentation.note: Refers to mixed trees of little timber value and is heard most often in 雑木林 (a mixed, coppiced woodland); the reading ざつぼく also exists, but ぞうき is standard, especially in 雑木林.

presentation.defJa: 非常に急いで物事をしなければならないようす。
presentation.note: A formal word common in official statements and news, stronger than 急いで; the traditional reading is さっきゅう, but そうきゅう is now widely used and accepted.

presentation.defJa: 人や設備などを増やして、力をより強くすること。
presentation.note: Used for boosting capacity or strength (troops, staff, equipment, infrastructure), often in news; 強化 means strengthening in general, while 増強 implies adding more units or resources.

presentation.defJa: お金を遠くにいる相手に送ること。
presentation.note: A neutral, business-like term for sending money by bank or app; 仕送り is the warmer everyday word for regular money sent to family or to a student.

presentation.defJa: 車や電車などが走ること。
presentation.note: A technical-sounding word for vehicles moving under power, common in traffic news and car specifications; for people running, use 走る or ランニング instead.

presentation.defJa: いくつかのものを一つにまとめること。
presentation.note: Means bringing separate elements together into a whole and is extremely common in compounds like 総合病院 and 総合的; 統合 instead means merging organizations or systems into a single unit.

presentation.defJa: 国のお金の出し入れを担当した大臣の、かつての呼び名。
presentation.note: A short form of 大蔵大臣 used until the ministry was reorganized in 2001; the title is now 財務大臣 (財務相), so 蔵相 appears mostly in historical writing.

presentation.defJa: 体の調子や力などが、前よりも増して良くなること。また、そうすること。
presentation.note: Typically paired with health, appetite or welfare (健康増進, 福祉の増進) in formal and public-health language; unlike 増加, a neutral rise in quantity, 増進 implies improvement.

presentation.defJa: ほかのものと比べたり、関係づけたりして、はじめて成り立つこと。
presentation.note: Contrasted with 絶対 (absolute) and mostly used in compounds like 相対的 and 相対評価; in academic and news writing 相対的に often means 'comparatively' or 'in relative terms.'

presentation.defJa: 規模が大きく、立派で堂々としているようす。
presentation.note: Describes things grand in scale and spirit, such as landscapes, plans or stories; 雄大 is used mainly for natural scenery, while 壮大 extends to human projects and narratives.

presentation.defJa: 多くの人が騒いで、世の中が混乱すること。もめごと。
presentation.note: Covers anything from a riot to a media-fueled fuss or an internal feud (お家騒動); it is broader and milder than 暴動, which specifically means a violent riot.

presentation.defJa: 目的のために必要な道具を身に着けたり、取り付けたりすること。また、その道具。
presentation.note: Refers to gear carried by people or fitted to vehicles for a purpose, from climbers to cars (標準装備); 設備 is used instead for equipment installed in a building or facility.

presentation.defJa: 学校や会社などの組織を、新しくつくること。
presentation.note: Used for founding organizations such as schools, companies and associations, often in anniversary phrases; 設立 is the more legal and administrative term, and 創業 is specific to starting a business.

presentation.meaning: to conform to; to be in line with
presentation.defJa: ある物事にぴったり合う。ずれないように合わせる。
presentation.note: A formal written verb used almost always in the pattern ～に即した or ～に即して; it differs from 則する (to follow rules or precedent) by stressing a close fit with concrete reality.

presentation.defJa: 物事のいくつかある面のうちの一つ。また、物の横の面。
presentation.note: Literally the side of an object, but most often used abstractly for one aspect of an issue; it is close to 面 but sounds more analytical, as in 経済的な側面.

presentation.meaning: to harm; to spoil; to impair
presentation.defJa: 物事の状態や価値を悪くする。傷つける。
presentation.note: Usually written 損なう today, with 損う an older variant spelling; it is a formal word for damaging abstract things like health, trust or beauty, and as a suffix (言い損なう, 乗り損なう) it means to fail to do something.

presentation.meaning: upbringing; being raised (in a place); growth
presentation.defJa: 大きくなること。また、子どものころにどんな家庭や土地で暮らしたかということ。
presentation.note: Attached to places (都会育ち, 東京育ち) it means raised there, and on its own it often means upbringing or breeding, as in 育ちがいい; for plants it simply means growth.

presentation.defJa: 相手への思いやりや温かさが感じられないようす。冷たい。
presentation.note: Usually written 素っ気ない; it describes curt, cold replies and also plain, unadorned things like a 素っ気ない部屋, and it is milder than 冷淡, which implies coldness.

presentation.meaning: the other way (as in turning one's face away)
presentation.defJa: 正面ではない、よその方向。
presentation.note: Written almost always in kana and used mainly in the idiom そっぽを向く, meaning to look away or, figuratively, to ignore or reject something; the kanji 外方 is rarely seen.
collocations: 客にそっぽを向かれる

presentation.defJa: 必要な道具や設備を、決まった場所に置いて、いつでも使えるようにする。
presentation.note: Implies providing something at a set location for use, as in 備え付けの家具 (furniture provided with a room); 備える alone is broader and also means to prepare for something.

presentation.meaning: to be endowed with; to be equipped with
presentation.defJa: 能力や性質、設備などが、もともと身についている。または、そろっている。
presentation.note: Normally written 備わる, with 具わる a less common variant that stresses being fully endowed; it is the intransitive counterpart of 備える and often describes innate abilities or built-in features.

presentation.defJa: 山や建物などが、まわりより目立って高く立っている。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana, it describes mountains or tall buildings rising impressively above their surroundings and is common in descriptive writing; そびえ立つ is an emphatic compound.

presentation.defJa: 飾り気がなく、自然のままであるようす。また、考え方が単純であるようす。
presentation.note: Positive when describing plain, unpretentious food, crafts or people, while 素朴な疑問 means a simple or naive question; 質素 instead stresses frugal living.

presentation.meaning: to be dyed; to be tinged
presentation.defJa: 色がしみこんで、その色になる。また、考えや習慣などの影響を受ける。
presentation.note: The intransitive counterpart of 染める; besides literal coloring it is used for being tinged by sunsets or emotions and, figuratively, for being influenced by bad ways, as in 悪に染まる.

presentation.defJa: 布や髪などに色をしみこませて、その色にする。
presentation.note: The transitive verb for dyeing cloth or hair; figuratively it appears in phrases like 頬を染める (to blush) and 手を染める (to get involved in something, usually shady).

presentation.defJa: 形や色、柄などが同じであること。また、必要なものがすべて集まった一組。
presentation.note: Often used with the honorific お (お揃い) for matching clothes or items among friends and couples, and as a suffix in words like 粒揃い (uniformly excellent) and 一揃い (a full set).

presentation.defJa: お金や物などを失って、損をすること。
presentation.note: A formal word for financial or material loss in business and news writing, more formal than the everyday 損.

presentation.defJa: 状況や相手の求めに合わせて、ふさわしい行動をとること。
presentation.note: Extremely common in news and business for handling a problem or request; it also means compatibility, as in 〜に対応した機種, so context decides the sense.

presentation.defJa: 生き物の体の一部が、小さくなったり働きを失ったりすること。
presentation.note: Used in biology for organs that shrink or lose function, and figuratively for skills or institutions going backward; it is often contrasted with 進化, but evolutionary loss of an organ is itself a form of 進化.

presentation.defJa: ほとんどの場合。だいたい。
presentation.note: A neutral, slightly conversational adverb close to たいてい; as a noun in 大概にしろ it is a scolding "that's enough".

presentation.defJa: 身長や体重、骨組みなどから見た、体全体のつくり。
presentation.note: Refers to the build or frame of a body (height, weight, bone structure), while 体力 is physical strength and stamina.

presentation.defJa: 非常に多くのお金。
presentation.note: A plain, everyday word for a big sum of money; 巨額 is the more formal word used for corporate or public sums.

presentation.defJa: 二つの立場の者が向かい合い、勝ち負けをはっきりさせること。
presentation.note: Suggests a head-to-head clash that settles who wins, common in sports, games and political headlines; 対立 is an ongoing opposition without a decisive showdown.

presentation.defJa: 実際に自分でやってみたり、その場に身を置いたりして感じること。
presentation.note: Emphasizes something lived through personally and physically, whereas 経験 is broader and includes knowledge or skill accumulated over time.

presentation.defJa: 相手に負けないように、張り合って争うこと。
presentation.note: Means standing up to or competing against a rival, usually as に対抗する; 反抗 instead implies defiance toward authority such as parents or superiors.

presentation.defJa: 害を与えるものを打ち負かしたり、取り除いたりすること。
presentation.note: Used for wiping out pests, monsters or social evils, with a folktale ring in 鬼退治; 駆除 is the more technical word for pest control.

presentation.defJa: 社会の大部分をしめる、ふつうの人々。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for ordinary people as a mass, common in compounds like 大衆文化 and 大衆食堂; 民衆 has a more political sense of the people versus their rulers.

presentation.defJa: 勤めていた会社や役所などを辞めること。
presentation.note: Covers both retirement and resigning from a job; 辞職 is used for stepping down from public office, and 退社 can also just mean leaving the office for the day.

presentation.defJa: 作品や催しなどに名前をつけること。
presentation.note: A formal verb used almost always in the pattern 〜と題する or 〜と題した to introduce the title of a lecture, book, exhibition or article.

presentation.defJa: 二人が向かい合って、あるテーマについて話し合うこと。
presentation.note: Usually a published or broadcast conversation between two people, as in magazines; 鼎談 is the three-person version and 会談 is a formal meeting between officials.

presentation.defJa: 二つのものの間に、上下や優劣の差がないこと。
presentation.note: Stresses equal standing between parties in a relationship or negotiation, whereas 平等 refers to equal treatment of everyone under a rule or principle.

presentation.defJa: 決められた期限までに、税金や料金などを払わないでいること。
presentation.note: A formal word for falling behind on obligatory payments such as taxes, rent or fees, typical of legal and administrative contexts; 未払い is the more neutral "unpaid".

presentation.defJa: 二つのものを並べて、違いをはっきりさせること。
presentation.note: Focuses on setting two things side by side to bring out their differences, while 比較 is the general word for comparing that may also look at similarities.

presentation.meaning: voluminous; (of a book or report) very long, in many volumes
presentation.defJa: 書物などの分量がとても多いこと。
presentation.note: Literary and mostly used as 大部の〜 for very long books or reports; the dictionary sense "the greater part" is rare, and modern Japanese says 大部分 for it. When read だいぶ, 大部 is an older spelling of 大分 (quite).

presentation.defJa: 食べ物が消化されたあと、おしりから出されるもの。
presentation.note: A neutral, somewhat clinical word for feces, paired with 小便 (urine); doctors usually just say 便, and children say うんち.

presentation.defJa: 本人に代わって、その人の考えや気持ちを述べること。
presentation.note: Means voicing someone else's views or feelings on their behalf, as in 住民の声を代弁する; it is also used loosely when a song or character says what many people feel.

presentation.defJa: あることが実現するのを、心から待ち望むこと。
presentation.note: Almost always used attributively as 待望の〜 for something people have long hoped for, such as a sequel, a first win or a first child; unlike 期待の (promising, much anticipated), it stresses how eagerly people have been waiting.

presentation.meaning: script (for a play, film or broadcast)
presentation.defJa: 演劇や映画、放送などで、せりふや動きを書いたもの。
presentation.note: The working script for plays, films and broadcasts, including lines and directions; 脚本 is the more literary term for the written work, and 台本どおり also describes events that feel staged.

presentation.defJa: しなければならないことを、なまけてしないこと。
presentation.note: A strong, critical word for failing to do one's duty, typical of news and official criticism; 油断 is a lack of vigilance rather than neglect of duty.

presentation.defJa: 人と人とが、実際に顔を合わせること。
presentation.note: Today often contrasts in-person settings with online ones, as in 対面授業 or 対面販売; 初対面 means meeting someone for the first time.

presentation.defJa: 本来のものの代わりに、別のものを使うこと。
presentation.note: Means making do with a substitute item in place of the proper one, typically 〜で代用する; 代理 is used for a person acting on someone's behalf.

presentation.defJa: 体を動かしたり、病気に負けずにいたりするための体の力。
presentation.note: Covers both physical strength and stamina or resistance to illness, while 筋力 is muscular strength alone and 体格 is body build.

presentation.defJa: 向かい合って話し合うこと。また、互いの考えを理解しようとする話し合い。
presentation.note: Implies a two-way exchange aimed at mutual understanding, common in diplomacy, education and AI; 会話 is ordinary everyday conversation.

presentation.meaning: to die out; to come to an end
presentation.defJa: 続いてきたものが、すっかりなくなること。
presentation.note: Describes something that has continued, such as a lineage, tradition or species, coming to an end; in the negative 〜が絶えない it means "never ceases", as in 笑いが絶えない家庭.

presentation.meaning: to be cut off; to cease (of contact, news or supply)
presentation.defJa: つながっていたものが途中で切れて、続かなくなること。
presentation.note: A rare spelling of 絶える, found in older writing for a link such as contact, news or supply being cut off (消息が断える); modern writing uses 絶える, as in the passage, or 途絶える.

presentation.meaning: open-air fire, bonfire (of wood or leaves)
presentation.defJa: 屋外で落ち葉や木の枝を燃やすこと。また、その火。
presentation.note: Usually written 焚き火 today; it is a small outdoor wood fire for warmth or cooking, whereas キャンプファイヤー suggests a large organized camp fire.

presentation.defJa: やり方や技術が上手で、よく工夫されている様子。
presentation.note: Praises skill and ingenuity but often carries a hint of cunning, as in 言葉巧みにだます; 上手 is the plainer, neutral word.

presentation.defJa: 物の長さ、特に衣服の上から下までの長さ。また、背の高さ。
presentation.note: Used for the length of garments and, in set phrases like 身の丈に合った, for one's stature or means; 長さ is the general word for length.

presentation.defJa: 強く打つこと。また、物事が受ける大きな損害やダメージ。
presentation.note: In news it usually means serious damage to an economy, industry or organization; in baseball it means batting, as in 打撃陣.

presentation.defJa: 交渉で、両者が互いに譲り合って話をまとめること。
presentation.note: Used for labor, trade or diplomatic negotiations ending in a compromise deal; 合意 is broader and does not necessarily imply concessions on both sides.

presentation.meaning: poor work, dud, flop (of a creative work)
presentation.defJa: 出来がよくない、つまらない作品。
presentation.note: A blunt critical label for a worthless novel, film or artwork; 失敗作 is softer and points to failure rather than low quality.

presentation.defJa: 賛成する人が多い意見に決めるやり方。
presentation.note: Common in schools, meetings and politics; it contrasts with 全会一致 (unanimity), and critics warn of the tyranny of the majority (多数派の横暴).

presentation.defJa: 困っている人に力を貸すこと。手伝い。
presentation.note: The plain noun from 助ける, covering anything from a helping hand to a rescue; 援助 and 支援 are more formal and imply organized aid.

presentation.meaning: to be engaged in, to be involved in (a job or field)
presentation.defJa: ある仕事や物事に関係して、それを行う。
presentation.note: A formal verb for taking part in work or a field over time (～に携わる); 関わる is broader and can also mean getting mixed up in something.

presentation.meaning: to leave, to walk away (from a place)
presentation.defJa: その場所を離れて、どこかへ行ってしまう。
presentation.note: Means leaving a place, often quietly or for good; 去る alone is more literary, and 走り去る specifies running or driving off.

presentation.meaning: to stop by, to drop in (on the way somewhere)
presentation.defJa: 目的地へ行く途中で、ある場所にちょっと寄る。
presentation.note: Means stopping somewhere briefly on the way to another destination; 寄る is the more casual equivalent.

presentation.meaning: holding or carrying (a child) in one's arms
presentation.defJa: 子どもなどを両腕でかかえて持つこと。主に幼児に対して使う言葉。
presentation.note: An affectionate, child-centered word for holding a small child or pet in one's arms; おんぶ is carrying on the back, and 抱く is the neutral verb.

presentation.meaning: skillful, fluent (with words); in good health
presentation.defJa: 技や話し方がうまい様子。また、体が丈夫で元気な様子。
presentation.note: Somewhat old-fashioned; praises fluency or skill (口が達者 can mean glib) and, in phrases like お達者で, robust health.

presentation.defJa: 目標や目的を最後までやりとげること。
presentation.note: Used for reaching a set target or goal; 成就 is literary and used for wishes, while 実現 stresses turning an idea into reality.

presentation.defJa: 所属している団体や組織から抜けること。
presentation.note: Leaving an organization, band, alliance or treaty one belonged to; 退会 is used for clubs and memberships, and 離脱 for breaking away from a bloc or group.

presentation.meaning: to pay on someone's behalf (to be repaid later)
presentation.defJa: ほかの人が払うべきお金を、一時的に代わりに払う。
presentation.note: Paying for someone with the expectation of being repaid; おごる means paying with no repayment expected.

presentation.meaning: public stance, official position (as opposed to true feelings)
presentation.defJa: 人前で示す表向きの考えや方針。本当の気持ちとは別のもの。
presentation.note: Paired with 本音 (true feelings), it is the socially acceptable position one presents; in carpentry it also names the framework-raising ceremony of a new house.

presentation.meaning: to offer, to present (to a deity or superior); to set someone on a pedestal
presentation.defJa: 神や目上の人に物を差し上げる。また、うやまって高い地位にすえる。
presentation.note: A formal, old-fashioned humble verb for presenting something to a deity or superior; in modern speech it can also mean putting someone on a pedestal, close to 祭り上げる.

presentation.defJa: 目的語をとり、人や物に直接働きかける動作を表す動詞。目的語は多くの場合「を」で示される。
presentation.note: Grammar term: a 他動詞 takes a direct object (usually marked by を), while its paired 自動詞 does not, as in 開ける versus 開く.

presentation.meaning: to finally reach, to make it to (after a hard journey)
presentation.defJa: 苦労しながら進んで、やっと目的の場所に着く。
presentation.note: Stresses arriving only after effort or difficulty, and is also used for reaching a conclusion or answer; 辿 is outside the standard kanji list, so newspapers and most modern prose write たどり着く.

presentation.meaning: to follow (a path); to trace (memories, a course of events)
presentation.defJa: 道や筋に沿って進む。また、記憶や物事の流れを順に追っていく。
presentation.note: Means following a path or tracing something step by step, and in news often appears in 一途を辿る (keep heading in one direction, usually for the worse); usually written たどる in modern prose.

presentation.meaning: to bundle, to tie up; to lead, to hold (a group) together
presentation.defJa: 細長い物をひとまとめにしてくくる。また、集団をまとめて率いる。
presentation.note: Literally tying things into a bundle (髪を束ねる), and figuratively leading and holding a group together (チームを束ねる), close to まとめる.

presentation.meaning: on the other hand; the other side
presentation.defJa: もう一つの方向や面。また、前の内容とは別の面を示すときに使う言葉。
presentation.note: A written, formal connective (他方、他方で) for introducing a contrasting aspect, stiffer than 一方 and much stiffer than でも.

presentation.defJa: 用事や仕事が多くて、とても忙しいこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for being very busy, common in news and in polite set phrases such as ご多忙のところ; 忙しい is the everyday adjective.

presentation.meaning: (archaic honorific) to grant, to bestow; as an auxiliary after a verb, shows respect (imperative form tamae)
presentation.defJa: 「与える」「くださる」の古い尊敬語。動詞について、その動作をする人への敬意を表す。
presentation.note: Survives mainly in prayers and classical-style text (～給え) and in the dated, superior-to-subordinate imperative ～たまえ, which is usually written in kana.

presentation.meaning: gathering place, hangout (mostly in compounds); pool, accumulation
presentation.defJa: 水や物が集まっている所。また、人がよく集まる場所。
presentation.note: Rarely used alone; it mostly appears in compounds like 溜まり場 (hangout), 水溜まり (puddle) and 吹き溜まり (drift; a place where the unwanted end up). 溜 is on the standard kanji list, though newspapers write たまり場 and 水たまり.

presentation.meaning: to receive (humble), to be granted; to grant, to bestow (honorific)
presentation.defJa: 目上の人から物や好意をもらうことを、へりくだって言う語。また、目上の人が与えること。
presentation.note: Very formal; in modern use it is mostly the humble 'receive' in business letters and speeches (ご支援を賜り), more deferential than いただく.

presentation.defJa: いろいろな種類や形があること。
presentation.note: A formal word for variety, common in discussions of culture, society and biology (生物多様性); いろいろ is the casual equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 張っていたものがゆるんで垂れ下がること。また、気持ちのゆるみ。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; in beauty and health articles it means sagging skin, while 気のたるみ means slack discipline, close to the more common 気の緩み.

presentation.meaning: to slacken, sag; to become lax
presentation.defJa: 張っていたものがゆるんで下がる。また、気持ちが引き締まらずだらける。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; it describes ropes, wires or skin sagging, and たるんでいる is a stock scolding for a lax attitude, blunter than 気が緩む.

presentation.meaning: to drip; to hang down, droop
presentation.defJa: 物の先が下の方へ下がる。また、水などがしずくになって落ちる。
presentation.note: Used intransitively for liquid dripping or things hanging down; the transitive 垂らす means to let something drip or dangle, and the transitive use 頭を垂れる means to bow one's head humbly.

presentation.defJa: けが人や病人を寝かせたまま運ぶための道具。
presentation.note: The standard word for a medical stretcher, common in news about sports injuries, accidents and disaster drills.

presentation.defJa: 気が短く、すぐに怒ったりいらいらしたりすること。
presentation.note: Describes being impatient and quick to anger; 短気を起こす means to lose one's temper, and the proverb 短気は損気 warns that a hot temper costs you.

presentation.defJa: 多くの人が同じ目的のために心を一つにしてまとまること。
presentation.note: Unity of a group acting toward a shared goal, typical of unions, teams and communities; 協力 is cooperation, whereas 団結 stresses a group bonding into one.

presentation.defJa: ほかと比べて、はっきりと差があるようす。また、きっぱりと態度を決めるようす。
presentation.note: In everyday speech it intensifies comparisons, meaning 'by far' (断然安い, 断然こっち), while the older sense 'resolutely' survives in phrases like 断然拒否する.

presentation.defJa: ダイヤモンドや石炭などをつくる元素の一つ。記号はC。
presentation.note: The element carbon, very common in climate and energy news through compounds like 二酸化炭素 and 脱炭素.

presentation.defJa: 二年または三年で卒業する大学。短期大学の略。
presentation.note: Clipped form of 短期大学 and the usual way to say it in speech and writing; graduates are often described as 短大卒.

presentation.defJa: 変化がなく、同じことのくり返しで、面白みがないこと。
presentation.note: Describes the thing itself as monotonous or lacking variety (work, scenery, a melody), whereas 退屈 names the boredom one feels.

presentation.defJa: ほかと組まずに、ただ一人、または一つだけであること。
presentation.note: A formal word for doing something alone or independently, frequent in news (単独インタビュー, 単独首位, 単独過半数); for people in daily talk, 一人で is the plain equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 夫のこと。また、店の主人や客などを親しんで呼ぶ言葉。
presentation.note: A casual word a wife uses for her own husband (うちの旦那) or for someone else's (旦那さん); it is more familiar than 夫 and less old-fashioned than 主人.

presentation.defJa: 波長が短く、遠くまで届く電波。主に海外向けの放送に使う。
presentation.note: A technical broadcasting term contrasted with 中波 (AM) and 長波; outside radio enthusiasts it mostly appears in 短波放送 and 短波ラジオ.

presentation.defJa: 筋肉や血などをつくる栄養素の一つ。肉や魚、豆に多く含まれる。
presentation.note: The kanji 蛋白質 is rare today: newspapers write たんぱく質, and science or fitness media write タンパク質.

presentation.defJa: 物を切ったときに現れる面。切り口。
presentation.note: Literally a cut surface or cross section (断面図); figuratively it means a revealing slice of something, as in 社会の一断面.

presentation.defJa: 外から押されても、もとの形にもどろうとする力。
presentation.note: Physical springiness of skin, rubber, noodles or soles; the derived 弾力的 means flexible in applying rules or policy.

presentation.defJa: 社会の秩序が保たれ、安全に暮らせる状態。
presentation.note: Refers to how safe an area is from crime; 治安がいい/悪い is the standard way to say a place is safe or dangerous.

presentation.meaning: to make different, to change; to strain (a muscle)
presentation.defJa: ほかと同じにならないように変える。また、筋などをひねって痛める。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal transitive partner of 違う, seen in phrases such as 色を違える and 筋を違える (strain a muscle); everyday speech prefers 変える or 分ける, and in 約束を違える (break a promise) the kanji is usually read たがえる.

presentation.defJa: 牛や豚、鶏などの家畜を育て、肉や卵、乳などを生産する産業。
presentation.note: Covers raising cattle, pigs and poultry for meat, milk and eggs; it appears in agricultural policy and economic news, often as 畜産農家.

presentation.defJa: 山や川、平野など、土地の表面の形やようす。
presentation.note: Refers to the physical shape of the land surface (mountains, valleys, coastlines); 地理 is geography as a subject, while 地形 is the lay of the land itself.

presentation.defJa: 母親の体から出る、子を育てるための白い液体。また、それを出す胸の部分。
presentation.note: Read ちち in native phrases such as 乳を搾る and 乳を飲ませる, but にゅう in compounds like 牛乳 and 乳製品; for human milk, 母乳 is more usual.

presentation.defJa: 息ができなくなり、苦しくなること。また、そのために死ぬこと。
presentation.note: Being unable to breathe, often fatally, as with food stuck in the throat; figuratively 窒息しそうな describes a stifling atmosphere.

presentation.defJa: 知識や知恵に関係するようす。また、教養があって頭がよさそうなようす。
presentation.note: Means intellectual, common in compounds like 知的好奇心 and 知的財産; calling a person 知的 suggests a cultivated air rather than plain cleverness (頭がいい).

presentation.defJa: 物に色をつけること。
presentation.note: Artificial coloring of food or materials, often seen on labels as 着色料 or 無着色.

presentation.defJa: 席に座ること。
presentation.note: A formal word for sitting down, used in announcements and ceremonies (ご着席ください); in conversation people simply say 座る.

presentation.defJa: 特に注意して見ること。目をつけること。
presentation.note: Singling out a particular point as worth examining, common in research and business writing; 注目 is attention more broadly, including public attention.

presentation.defJa: 飛行機などが空から地上に降りること。
presentation.note: Landing of an aircraft or spacecraft; the opposite is 離陸 (takeoff), and 着水 is landing on water.

presentation.defJa: 工事を始めること。
presentation.note: The start of construction work, a fixed term in news about buildings and infrastructure, contrasted with 完成 or 竣工 (completion).

presentation.defJa: 家族が食事をしたりくつろいだりする部屋。
presentation.note: A traditional family room for meals and TV; お茶の間 has come to mean ordinary households as a TV audience, as in お茶の間の人気者.

presentation.defJa: 客を招いて抹茶をたて、もてなす作法。茶道。
presentation.note: An older, more literary name for the tea ceremony, favored in historical and aesthetic writing; 茶道 is the everyday term.

presentation.defJa: 空中で体を前や後ろにくるりと一回転させること。飛行機が空中で縦に円を描くこと。
presentation.note: Used for both a gymnast's flip and an aircraft's loop; とんぼ返り can also mean a somersault, but today it mostly means a quick there-and-back trip.

presentation.meaning: (live) broadcast, relay; relaying via an intermediate point
presentation.defJa: 現場の様子を放送局を通して伝えること。また、間に入って受け渡しをすること。
presentation.note: In everyday use it mostly means a live broadcast or a link-up to a remote location, while in technical contexts it means relaying signals, data or goods through an intermediate point.

presentation.defJa: 山のふもとと頂上の間の、なかほどのあたり。
presentation.note: Refers to the middle stretch of a mountain's slope, between the foot (ふもと) and the summit (山頂), and occasionally of a cliff or hillside (崖の中腹); it is not used for the middle of ordinary objects.

presentation.defJa: 対立するどちらの側にも味方せず、かたよらない立場をとること。
presentation.note: Means taking neither side in a dispute, whether said of a person, a medium or a state (中立国); 公平 is about treating sides equally, while 中立 stresses standing apart from them.

presentation.defJa: 酸とアルカリがまざって、互いの性質を打ち消し合うこと。また、反対の働きで効果を弱めること。
presentation.note: A chemistry term for acid and alkali cancelling each other out, also used for neutralizing poisons or odors and, figuratively, for offsetting an effect; 相殺 is the more abstract word for cancelling out.

presentation.defJa: 人や団体の名前のあとにつけて、その人たちが書いた本であることを表す語。
presentation.note: Attached to an author's name in book credits, reviews and bibliographies, in contrast to 編 for an editor and 訳 for a translator; in speech people say 〇〇が書いた instead.

presentation.defJa: 胃の先につながっていて、食べ物の栄養や水分を吸収する細長い器官。
presentation.note: The everyday and medical word for the intestines (大腸, 小腸); はらわた is a more literary or visceral word for guts, and お腹 is used for vague stomach complaints.

presentation.defJa: 四枚の美しい羽を持ち、昼間に飛んで花のみつを吸う虫。
presentation.note: Often written in katakana チョウ in science writing and called ちょうちょ in children's speech; the idiom 蝶よ花よ describes doting on a daughter.

presentation.defJa: ほかの語の前について、程度がふつうを大きく上回ることを表す語。
presentation.note: As a formal prefix it means beyond or extremely (超高速, 超大国); in casual speech it is also used on its own as an intensifier, as in 超おいしい, which sounds youthful and is avoided in formal writing.

presentation.defJa: 国や団体の代表が、約束を正式に認めて文書に名前を書くこと。
presentation.note: Used for the formal signing of treaties and agreements between states or large organizations, while 署名 is the general word for putting one's signature on any document.

presentation.defJa: 音を聞き取る感覚。耳で音を感じる働き。
presentation.note: The formal or scientific term for the sense of hearing, paired with 視覚 and 嗅覚; in everyday talk people simply say 耳がいい.

presentation.meaning: director-general, head (of a government agency); secretary
presentation.defJa: 庁など国の機関で、いちばん上の地位にある人。
presentation.note: Title for the head of a government agency (庁), as in 気象庁長官, and of a few other offices such as 官房長官, the Chief Cabinet Secretary; the head of a ministry (省) is 大臣.

presentation.defJa: 大学などで講義を聞くこと。
presentation.note: Means attending lectures, usually as a non-degree auditor (聴講生) who earns no credit, whereas 受講 is the general word for taking a course, often for credit or a certificate.

presentation.defJa: 医者が胸などに当てて、心臓や肺の音を聞くための器具。
presentation.note: The standard word for a stethoscope, almost always used with 当てる for placing it on the body; the act of listening with it is 聴診.
collocations: 聴診器で胸の音を聞く

presentation.defJa: 争っている人たちの間に第三者が入り、話し合いで解決できるよう助けること。
presentation.note: A legal and diplomatic term for a third party helping disputing sides reach agreement; in 仲裁 (arbitration) the third party's decision is usually binding, whereas in 調停 the parties themselves must agree.

presentation.defJa: 同じものが二つ以上重なること。同じことがくり返し出てくること。
presentation.note: The standard reading is ちょうふく, though じゅうふく is now widely heard and accepted; it is a neutral written word for unwanted overlap, where ダブる is the casual equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 小説や映画などで、話が長く、規模の大きな作品。
presentation.note: Describes long works of fiction or film and contrasts with 短編 for short works, with 中編 in between; on its own it usually means a full-length novel.

presentation.defJa: 食べ物の材料に手を加えて、食べられるように作ること。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for preparing food, common in professional, institutional and packaging contexts (調理師, 調理済み); 料理 is the everyday word and also refers to the dish itself.

presentation.defJa: いくつかのものがうまく釣り合って、全体としてまとまっていること。
presentation.note: Means things fitting together pleasingly, for colors, music, society or nature; バランス is more about proportion, while 調和 stresses a harmonious whole.

presentation.defJa: 困ったことや大変な事態に、じかに出会うこと。
presentation.note: Almost always used as ～に直面する with problems, crises or harsh realities; 向き合う implies actively confronting something, whereas 直面する simply means being faced with it.

presentation.defJa: その人が書いて出版した本。
presentation.note: Refers to a book someone has written, used when talking about an author's works (著書に～がある); 作品 is broader and covers fiction, art and film, while 本 is the plain word.

presentation.defJa: お金をためること。また、ためたお金。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for saving and accumulated savings, common in economics and policy (貯蓄率); 貯金 is the everyday word, especially for money kept in a bank or piggy bank.

presentation.defJa: ほうきで掃き集めたごみを受けて、すくい取るための道具。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana (ちりとり or ちり取り) and usually paired with ほうき, since the kanji 塵 for dust is rare in everyday writing.
collocations: ちりとりでごみを集める

presentation.defJa: 働いたことに対して、雇い主から支払われるお金。
presentation.note: The formal, economic term for wages, used in labor law and statistics (最低賃金, 賃金格差); 給料 and 給与 are the everyday and administrative words for one's pay.

presentation.defJa: 液体の中にまじっている細かいものが、底に沈んでたまること。
presentation.note: A scientific term for particles settling out of a liquid, used in chemistry and water treatment; in literary writing it can describe feelings or fatigue that settle and build up, though 沈む and たまる are the everyday verbs.

presentation.defJa: 船などが水の中に沈んで、見えなくなること。
presentation.note: The standard word for a ship going down; in casual speech it is also used jokingly for a traveler who stays put far longer than planned or someone who drops off after drinking, while 沈む is the general verb for anything sinking.

presentation.defJa: 何も言わずに黙っていること。話し声がなく、静かな状態。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for silence, especially someone choosing not to speak (沈黙を守る); 静けさ describes a quiet atmosphere rather than a person keeping silent.

presentation.defJa: 人に見せるために、品物を並べておくこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for arranging goods or exhibits for people to see, used in retail and museums (陳列棚, 陳列ケース); 並べる is the everyday verb and 展示 stresses showing items for viewing rather than for sale.

presentation.meaning: pressing (someone) over responsibility, grilling; close inquiry
presentation.defJa: 悪いことや責任を、どこまでも問いただして明らかにしようとすること。
presentation.note: Means pressing someone hard over wrongdoing or responsibility (責任を追及する); do not confuse it with 追求 (pursuing a goal such as profit or happiness) or 追究 (inquiring deeply into truth), all read ついきゅう.

presentation.defJa: 動くものや逃げるものの後を追いかけ、その行方を調べ続けること。
presentation.note: Used both for physical pursuit, as when police chase a suspect, and for tracking over time, as in 追跡調査 (follow-up study) or package tracking; more formal than 追いかける.

presentation.meaning: to spend (time, money, effort); to devote
presentation.defJa: 時間やお金、力などを、ある目的のためにたくさん使うこと。
presentation.note: More formal and written than 使う, it implies pouring a large amount of time, money or effort into something, sometimes with a hint that the amount was excessive.

presentation.meaning: crash (of an aircraft); fall from a height
presentation.defJa: 飛行機などが、高い所から落ちること。
presentation.note: Typically used for aircraft, drones or people falling from heights; 落下 is the neutral word for objects dropping, while 墜落 implies an accident or loss of control.

presentation.defJa: 心に強く、深くしみるように感じるさま。
presentation.note: Almost always appears as 痛切に感じる or 痛切に思う in writing or formal speech, describing a realization that hits hard, often about one's own shortcomings or a painful lesson.

presentation.defJa: 歩くときに体を支えるため、手に持って使う細長い棒。
presentation.note: The verb used with it is つく (杖をつく), and the proverb 転ばぬ先の杖 (a cane before you fall) means taking precautions in advance; newspapers often write the word in kana.

presentation.meaning: use; how something (especially money) is used
presentation.defJa: お金や物を、何にどのように使うかということ。
presentation.note: An everyday word for how something, especially money or an object, is put to use; 用途 is the more formal or technical equivalent.

presentation.meaning: to serve (a lord, master or deity)
presentation.defJa: 目上の人のそばにいて、その人のために働くこと。
presentation.note: Implies serving a lord, deity or household in a hierarchical relationship; for ordinary employment, 勤める or 働く is used instead.

presentation.meaning: to govern; to be in charge of (a function)
presentation.defJa: ある仕事や働きを受け持ち、まとめて管理すること。
presentation.note: A formal, literary verb for presiding over a function, common in science writing about organs and brain regions and in mythology (天候を司る神), whereas everyday speech uses 担当する or 担う.

presentation.defJa: ほんの少しの、短い時間。
presentation.note: Also written 束の間; it stresses how short a pleasant interval is, and ～もつかの間 means something good ended almost as soon as it began.

presentation.defJa: ありふれていて、新しさや面白みがないさま。
presentation.note: Normally written 月並み and mildly critical, though 月並みな言い方ですが is a humble preface before saying something conventional but sincere; ありきたり is the more colloquial near-synonym.
collocations: 月並みな言い方ですが

presentation.defJa: 二つのものをつなぎ合わせた所。
presentation.note: Usually written 継ぎ目, it is the physical line or point where two pieces meet, and 継ぎ目のない (seamless) is common in product descriptions.

presentation.meaning: make; construction; how something is made
presentation.defJa: 物ができあがった状態や、その組み立て方。
presentation.note: Refers to how products, clothing or the body are made or put together; 造り is preferred for buildings and other large structures.
collocations: 作りがしっかりしている

presentation.defJa: 建物などの組み立て方や、全体の構え。
presentation.note: Used mainly for buildings, ships and other large structures, and also for brewing (酒造り); お造り on a restaurant menu means sashimi.

presentation.defJa: 破れたり傷んだりした所を直すこと。
presentation.note: Literally mending clothes or nets by hand, it also means keeping up appearances (体裁を繕う), and the compound 取り繕う means to smooth over or cover up a situation.

presentation.defJa: すでにあるものに、さらに別のものを足すこと。
presentation.note: Used for adding a remark, explanation or item to something already said or made; 加える alone is broader, while 付け加える stresses an addition tacked on at the end.

presentation.defJa: 中が空になっている、細長くて丸い形のもの。
presentation.note: A native word for any hollow cylinder, from bamboo sections to poster tubes; 管 suggests a pipe that carries something, and 筒抜け (lit. straight through the tube) means secrets leaking out.

presentation.meaning: to nudge or prod (someone into action); to poke
presentation.defJa: 指先などで軽く何度も押すこと。また、何かをするように人をせかすこと。
presentation.note: A colloquial, emphatic form of つつく, normally written 突っつく or in kana; it means poking lightly and repeatedly, and figuratively prodding someone to act or picking at faults.

presentation.meaning: to show respect; (in the te-form) respectfully, humbly
presentation.defJa: 相手を敬い、へりくだった気持ちで物事を行うこと。
presentation.note: Today it appears almost only as 謹んで in formal greetings, condolences and acceptances; the homophone 慎む means to refrain or be cautious (酒を慎む), so keep the two apart.
collocations: 謹んでお悔やみ申し上げます
謹んで新年のお慶びを申し上げます
謹んでお受けいたします

presentation.meaning: to feel tight (of skin); to stiffen; to brace
presentation.defJa: 皮膚などが引っぱられたように固くなること。また、強く押して支えること。
presentation.note: Covers physical stiffening or bracing (腕を突っ張る) and skin feeling tight, and figuratively stubbornly holding one's ground; 突っ張り is also a sumo thrusting technique and older slang for a rebellious teenager.

presentation.meaning: to be fit for (a role); to be able to fill a position
presentation.defJa: 与えられた役目や仕事を、きちんと果たすことができる。
presentation.note: Usually appears in doubts or negatives such as 私に務まるだろうか or とても務まらない; it asks whether someone is capable of a role, while 務める means actually serving in it.

presentation.defJa: 働きに通っている会社や役所など。
presentation.note: A neutral word for where someone is employed, common on forms and in conversation; 勤務先 is the more formal written equivalent, and 職場 focuses on the workplace itself.

presentation.meaning: deliberately; making an effort to; as far as possible
presentation.defJa: できるだけそうなるように、意識して力を入れるさま。
presentation.note: An adverb describing deliberate self-control in how one behaves, often masking true feelings (努めて冷静に); more formal than できるだけ.
collocations: 努めて冷静に振る舞う

presentation.defJa: 地震などで海底が大きく動いたとき、陸に押し寄せる高い波。
presentation.note: The everyday and official word, also borrowed into English; 高潮 (storm surge) is a different phenomenon caused by typhoons and low pressure.

presentation.defJa: 口の中に自然にわいてくる液体。
presentation.note: The everyday word for spit, read つばき in older or literary style; 唾液 is the scientific term, and 固唾をのむ (かたずをのむ) means to hold one's breath in suspense.

presentation.defJa: 小さな声で、ひとりごとのように言うこと。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; it means saying something quietly, mostly to oneself, and since around 2010 つぶやき has also meant a short social media post.

presentation.defJa: 口が小さく胴がふくらんだ、焼き物などの入れ物。
presentation.note: 壷 is a common variant of 壺 and newspapers often write つぼ; the same word also means an acupuncture point or the crux of a matter (つぼを押さえる), and 思うつぼ means exactly what someone schemed for.

presentation.defJa: 花が咲く前の、まだ開いていない状態のもの。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana as つぼみ; it is also used figuratively for a young person whose talent has yet to bloom.

presentation.meaning: to stretch in a line; to range (of mountains, etc.)
presentation.defJa: いくつものものが、列のように長く続いて並ぶこと。
presentation.note: An intransitive verb for things lined up continuously, such as mountains, islands or houses, and also for belonging to a lineage or group (名家に連なる); its transitive partner is 連ねる.

presentation.meaning: to line up; to put (names) on a list
presentation.defJa: いくつものものを、列になるように並べること。また、仲間の一人として名前を並べること。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 連なる; 名を連ねる (to be listed among members or sponsors) and 軒を連ねる (of shops, to line a street) are its most frequent uses.

presentation.defJa: 寺などにつるしてある、大きな金属のかね。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to the large bronze bell hung in a temple belfry and struck with a wooden beam; in conversation people usually just say 鐘, and 梵鐘 is the formal or art-historical term.

presentation.meaning: hanging strap (for standing passengers on trains and buses)
presentation.defJa: 電車やバスで、立っている客がつかまるために天井からさげてある輪。
presentation.note: Newspapers often write it つり革; it means the hanging hand straps on trains and buses, whereas 手すり is a fixed handrail.

presentation.meaning: appearances, how something looks to others; format, presentation
presentation.defJa: 他人から見たときの様子や見え。また、文書などの形式。
presentation.note: 体裁 is about outward form and how things look to others, often with a hint of hollowness, while 見栄 stresses showing off beyond one's means.

presentation.meaning: presenting, putting forward (terms, a proposal); showing (an ID or document)
presentation.defJa: 相手に見せること。また、案や条件を出して示すこと。
presentation.note: 提示 is the formal word for putting forward terms or showing a document on request, whereas 提出 means handing something over to be kept, such as a report.

presentation.meaning: set meal (a fixed menu of main dish, rice or bread, and sides)
presentation.defJa: 主菜にご飯や汁物などが組み合わされた、決まった献立の料理。
presentation.note: 定食 is the everyday Japanese set meal built around rice and soup, and travel writers borrow it for similar fixed meals abroad such as the Indian thali.

presentation.defJa: 広くて立派な家。大きな屋敷。
presentation.note: 邸宅 is a formal, written word for a grand private house, close to 屋敷 but without its traditional, estate-like feel.

presentation.defJa: 会社などで、ある年齢になったら退職すると決められていること。また、その年齢。
presentation.note: 定年 is the fixed age at which an employer requires you to retire, while 引退 is a broader word for stepping away from active work or competition.

presentation.defJa: 川や海の水があふれないように、土やコンクリートで高く築いたもの。
presentation.note: 堤防 is the general and official term for a levee or seawall, while 土手 is the everyday word for a grassy earthen bank, often used for walking.

presentation.meaning: being too late (to save or fix something)
presentation.defJa: 処置や対策をするのが遅くて、もう間に合わないこと。
presentation.note: 手遅れ is used when a remedy or treatment comes too late to help, often of illness or damage, while 遅刻 simply means arriving late for a set time.

presentation.meaning: to handle, to work on (a project); to be the one who produces it
presentation.defJa: 自分で直接その仕事をする。また、作品や事業を担当して作り上げる。
presentation.note: 手掛ける stresses personally taking on and producing a piece of work, such as an architect's buildings or a director's films, whereas 担当する simply means being assigned to it.

presentation.meaning: number of moves or punches (in a game or bout); trouble, bother
presentation.defJa: 将棋や囲碁の着手の回数や、ボクシングで打つパンチの数。また、手間。
presentation.note: Read てかず, it usually means the count of moves or punches; in the polite sense of trouble, as in お手数をおかけします, the word is almost always read てすう.

presentation.meaning: as appropriate, as needed; at one's own discretion
presentation.defJa: その場の状況に合わせて、ちょうどよいように行うようす。
presentation.note: 適宜 is a formal word common in instructions and notices, close to 必要に応じて, and leaves the timing or amount to the reader's judgment.

presentation.meaning: to come across, to run into (by chance)
presentation.defJa: 思いがけず、ばったり人や物に会う。
presentation.note: 出くわす is a conversational word for an unexpected, often unwelcome encounter, more colloquial than 遭遇する and more sudden than 出会う.

presentation.defJa: 物事を行うときの、決まった順序や段取り。
presentation.note: 手順 is the ordered sequence of steps for doing something, while 手続き is an administrative procedure such as filing forms.

presentation.defJa: 犯人などの両手首にはめて、自由に動かせないようにする金属の輪。
presentation.note: 手錠 is the standard word in news reports, almost always in the phrase 手錠をかける, while 手かせ is an older word for wooden or historical shackles.

presentation.meaning: close at hand, within reach; readily available
presentation.defJa: すぐ手が届くほど近いこと。また、身近でありふれていること。
presentation.note: 手近 describes something physically within reach or readily available, and in the sense of familiar it overlaps with 身近, which is far more common for things close to daily life.

presentation.meaning: iron and steel (as an industry or material)
presentation.defJa: 鉄と、鉄から作られる鋼をまとめていう言葉。また、それを作る産業。
presentation.note: 鉄鋼 is the term for the steel industry and its products in economic news, while 鋼 (はがね) names the material itself in a more literary or craft sense.

presentation.meaning: to devote oneself wholly to (a role or stance); to stick to thoroughly
presentation.defJa: 一つの態度や役割を最後まで貫く。それだけに打ち込む。
presentation.note: 徹する means committing to a single role or stance without straying, often a self-effacing one, whereas 専念する is about concentrating one's effort on a task.

presentation.meaning: horizontal bar (in gymnastics or playgrounds); iron bar
presentation.defJa: 二本の柱の間に鉄の棒を横に渡した運動用の器具。また、鉄でできた棒。
presentation.note: In everyday speech 鉄棒 almost always means the playground or gymnastics horizontal bar; for a crowbar or plain iron rod people more often say バール or 鉄の棒.

presentation.meaning: fresh start, starting over; coming again another time
presentation.defJa: 一度やめて、最初からやり直すこと。また、改めて来ること。
presentation.note: 出直し implies going back to the starting point after a setback, as in 出直し選挙, while やり直し is the plainer word for simply redoing something.

presentation.defJa: 手を握ったときに内側になる面。手首から指の付け根までの部分。
presentation.note: 掌 is the literary kanji spelling of てのひら, often written 手のひら in everyday text, and appears in the idiom 掌を返す, to do an abrupt about-face.

presentation.meaning: arranging, making arrangements (for transport, rooms, etc.); police search for a wanted person
presentation.defJa: 必要な物や人を前もってそろえ、準備すること。また、警察が犯人を探すために指示を出すこと。
presentation.note: 手配 is the practical arranging of tickets, rooms, vehicles or staff, and in police contexts 指名手配 means a wanted notice for a named suspect.

presentation.defJa: 物事を行うために、前もって決めておく順序や段取り。
presentation.note: Usually written 手はず in newspapers, it suggests a prearranged plan with roles assigned, close to 段取り, which leans more toward the workflow itself.

presentation.meaning: guide, handbook; guidance, leading someone in
presentation.defJa: 物事のやり方をわかりやすく教えるための本や案内。また、導くこと。
presentation.note: Usually written 手引き, it means a practical how-to guide or manual, and with する it can also mean letting someone in, including acting as an inside accomplice to a crime.

presentation.meaning: model, example to follow; copybook (for calligraphy)
presentation.defJa: 見習うべきよい例。また、習字などで写すために書かれたもの。
presentation.note: 手本 is a good example to imitate, whether a person's conduct or a calligraphy model, whereas 見本 is a sample that shows what a product looks like.

presentation.meaning: advance preparations, arrangements; hand-cranked (of a device)
presentation.defJa: 物事がうまく運ぶように、前もって準備しておくこと。
presentation.note: 手回し most often appears as 手回しがいい, praising someone who gets things ready well ahead of time, and in a separate literal sense it describes hand-cranked devices such as radios.

presentation.meaning: at hand, on hand (money or items); the area around one's hands
presentation.defJa: 手の届く近いところ。また、自分の所にあるお金や物。
presentation.note: 手元 refers to what is within one's reach or in one's possession, and in finance 手元資金 means cash a company has on hand, a sense that 手近 does not carry.

presentation.meaning: to reflect (sunlight or heat), to throw back light
presentation.defJa: 光や熱が物の表面に当たって、はね返る。また、はね返す。
presentation.note: 照り返す is used for sunlight or heat bouncing off surfaces such as water, snow or pavement, and its noun 照り返し is common in heat reports, while 反射する is the neutral technical term.

presentation.meaning: dividing up the work, splitting a task among people
presentation.defJa: 一つの仕事を何人かで分けて受け持つこと。
presentation.note: 手分け is almost always used as 手分けして plus a verb for a group sharing out a job on the spot, while 分担 sounds more formal and planned.

presentation.defJa: 空。また、人の力を超えて世界を動かしていると考えられたもの。
presentation.note: 天 carries a sense of fate or providence beyond the literal sky, as in 天に任せる, whereas 空 is the everyday word for the physical sky.

presentation.meaning: countryside; rural area of fields and farmland
presentation.defJa: 田や畑が広がる、いなかの土地。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary word that evokes fields and farmland, typically in 田園風景; the everyday word 田舎 is broader and can carry a nuance of "backwater" that 田園 lacks.

presentation.meaning: the whole country; the realm (as something to be ruled)
presentation.defJa: 国全体。また、その国を治める力。
presentation.note: Historically the realm under heaven that a ruler sought to control, hence 天下を取る and 天下統一; in modern Japanese it survives mostly in idioms such as 天下一品 (the best in the land) and かかあ天下 (a wife who rules the house).

presentation.meaning: turnaround; revolution (a fundamental reversal, e.g. in thinking); U-turn
presentation.defJa: 回って向きを変えること。また、考え方などが大きく変わること。
presentation.note: A formal word for turning round: on road signs it means a U-turn (転回禁止), and in essays it describes a fundamental reversal of perspective, whereas a shift in policy is usually called 転換.

presentation.defJa: 休みの日が二日以上続くこと。また、その休み。
presentation.note: Refers to two or more days off in a row, especially stretches of public holidays such as Golden Week; 連休明け (the day work resumes) is a common set phrase in the news.

presentation.meaning: those people; the gang, that bunch (familiar)
presentation.defJa: 仲間や、ある集まりの人たちを、くだけて言う言葉。
presentation.note: An informal word for a group of people ("that lot, the gang"); said of one's own friends it sounds affectionate, but about outsiders it often sounds dismissive, and it is never polite.

presentation.defJa: いくつかの州や国が集まって、一つにまとまった国家。
presentation.note: Used for federal states such as the US, Germany or Russia (ロシア連邦) and in compounds like 連邦政府; 連合 by contrast suggests a looser union of bodies that remain separate.

presentation.defJa: 同じ目的を持つ団体や人が、力を合わせるためにつくる組織。
presentation.note: Common in the names of sports bodies and associations and in the historical 国際連盟 (League of Nations); 協会 is a similar word for an association but does not stress that it is made up of member organizations.

presentation.defJa: 何かをするために使う体の力や手間。
presentation.note: Refers to the effort or labor a task costs and often pairs with 時間 or 費用; it is more matter-of-fact than 努力, which praises someone's striving.

presentation.defJa: 意見を出し合って、物事について話し合うこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for public or institutional debate that is common in the news; it is close to 議論, but 論議 more often describes an issue being argued over in society (論議を呼ぶ) than a single conversation.

presentation.defJa: 太陽などの恒星のまわりを回る、大きな天体。
presentation.note: The standard scientific term for a planet; 星 is the everyday word for any star or heavenly body, while 恒星 specifically means a star that shines by its own light.

presentation.defJa: 季節によって、遠く離れた土地へすむ場所を移す鳥。
presentation.note: Literally a bird that migrates with the seasons, it is also used figuratively for a person who keeps moving from place to place or job to job, as in 政界の渡り鳥.

presentation.defJa: 悪かったと思う気持ちを伝えて、許してもらおうとすること。
presentation.note: Usually appears with the polite prefix as お詫び in formal apologies and company notices (お詫び申し上げます); 謝罪 is the more neutral term used when reporting that someone apologized.

presentation.meaning: Japanese text (as opposed to Western-alphabet text)
presentation.defJa: 日本語で書かれた文章。
