presentation.note: A somewhat technical word used in translation exercises (和文英訳) and typography, where it contrasts with 欧文; in ordinary contexts people simply say 日本語の文章.

presentation.defJa: 稲や麦の実を取ったあとに残る、かわいた茎。
presentation.note: Newspapers usually write it in kana as わら because the kanji is outside the standard list; it appears in the idiom 藁にもすがる (to clutch at straws) and in 藁ぶき (thatched with straw).

presentation.meaning: tenth; ten percent (e.g. three tenths = 30 percent)
presentation.defJa: 全体を十に分けたうちの一つを単位として、比率を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Counts in units of ten percent and is very common in news and everyday talk (三割引き = 30 percent off); in this traditional system 分 is one percent, so 三割五分 means 35 percent.

presentation.defJa: 全体をいくつかに分けて、それぞれに配ること。また、配られた量。
presentation.note: Common in business and administration for budgets, quotas and tasks; in running text it is usually written 割り当て with okurigana, while the compact 割当 appears in official terms such as 割当額.

presentation.meaning: to cut in (a line); to butt in
presentation.defJa: 順番や列、人の話などの間に、無理に入っていく。
presentation.note: Covers cutting into a line or traffic and butting into a conversation, always implying pushing in without permission; it is normally written 割り込む with okurigana.

presentation.defJa: 悪いことをする人。また、悪いと見なされる人。
presentation.note: A plain, slightly childlike word for a bad guy, often used in 悪者にする (to make someone the scapegoat); 悪人 is more formal and morally weighted.

presentation.meaning: to make good progress; to go well (of work)
presentation.defJa: 仕事や勉強などが、順調に進む。
presentation.note: Used of work or study moving along smoothly, with the task as subject and often in the negative (はかどらない); newspapers write it in kana because the reading はかどる is not in the official kanji list, and it is more colloquial than 進捗する.

presentation.meaning: annulment; reversal (of a court ruling); destruction (of documents)
presentation.defJa: 決まったことや判決などを取り消すこと。また、書類などを捨てること。
presentation.note: A formal word for canceling agreements, overturning a lower court's ruling and destroying documents or data; 廃棄 instead means disposing of physical waste or goods.

presentation.meaning: to strip off; to tear off (bark, skin, a covering)
presentation.defJa: 表面をおおっているものを、むりに取り去る。
presentation.note: Means to strip away a covering such as bark, skin or bedding, and figuratively to unmask someone (化けの皮を剥ぐ); 剥がす is the more everyday verb for peeling off stickers, tape or posters.

presentation.meaning: weak; flimsy (of grounds, evidence or will)
presentation.defJa: 弱くて、しっかりしていないようす。特に、根拠や意志について言う。
presentation.note: A formal word used mostly of arguments, evidence or willpower (根拠が薄弱, 意志薄弱); for physical frailty you would use 弱い or 虚弱 instead.

presentation.defJa: 隠していたことや自分の悪いことを、正直に話すこと。
presentation.note: An everyday word for owning up to something you had kept hidden, from crimes to small embarrassing truths; 自白 is the legal term for a suspect's confession.

presentation.defJa: 中に火薬などをつめ、爆発させて物をこわす兵器。
presentation.note: Literally a bomb, it is also used figuratively, as in 爆弾発言 (a bombshell remark) or 爆弾を抱える (to live with a ticking time bomb, such as a chronic health problem).

presentation.defJa: 火薬などを爆発させて、物をこわすこと。
presentation.note: Refers to deliberately blowing something up, whether in demolition, mining or an attack; 爆発 is the more general word for any explosion, including accidental ones.

presentation.defJa: 隠されていた秘密や悪いことを、人々の前に明らかにすること。
presentation.note: Implies exposing something someone wanted hidden, often a scandal, and carries a sensational tone; 公表 is the neutral word for making something public officially.

presentation.meaning: to strive; to work hard at
presentation.defJa: 目標に向かって、一生懸命に努力する。
presentation.note: A positive, somewhat formal verb for applying oneself diligently, almost always with に (練習に励む); 頑張る is the everyday conversational equivalent.

presentation.meaning: to peel off; to come off (of paint or coating)
presentation.defJa: 表面にぬったものや、はってあったものが、取れて落ちる。
presentation.note: The intransitive partner of 剥ぐ, used of paint, plating or nail polish wearing off, and figuratively in メッキが剥げる (a false front is exposed); do not confuse it with 禿げる (to go bald), which has the same reading.

presentation.meaning: to take the form of; to transform oneself (into)
presentation.defJa: ほかのものの姿に変わる。また、姿を変えて人をだます。
presentation.note: Traditionally used of foxes, raccoon dogs and ghosts taking on another shape; in modern colloquial use it also means to change dramatically, as in 大化けする (to turn into a big success) or 文字化け (garbled characters).

presentation.defJa: 名誉や体面が傷ついて、きまりが悪く思うこと。また、そう思うような行いや事柄。
presentation.note: A core word for shame or disgrace, frequent in set phrases like 恥をかく (to embarrass oneself) and 恥を知れ (have you no shame?); 恥ずかしい is the adjective for feeling embarrassed.

presentation.meaning: to be bashful, to act shy (out of modesty)
presentation.defJa: 恥ずかしそうな様子を見せる。照れて、控えめにふるまう。
presentation.note: Literary and descriptive, often used of a young woman's shy, modest manner; the noun 恥じらい is common, whereas 恥じる means to feel real shame.

presentation.defJa: 自分の行いや欠点を恥ずかしいと思う。
presentation.note: More formal than the everyday 恥ずかしいと思う; the negative pattern ～に恥じない means 'worthy of, living up to' (e.g. 名に恥じない活躍).

presentation.meaning: acting as a go-between, bridging (two parties)
presentation.defJa: 人や組織の間に立って、つながりをつくること。仲立ち。
presentation.note: Figurative and very common in news and business writing; 仲介 sounds more formal or commercial (brokering a deal), while 橋渡し stresses building a connection.

presentation.defJa: 物が壊れたり傷ついたりすること。
presentation.note: Used of physical objects such as goods, equipment or buildings, often in notices and reports; 損傷 is broader and also covers bodies and organs.

presentation.defJa: 靴や靴下などを何も履いていない足。また、その状態。
presentation.note: Everyday word; the idiom ～も裸足で逃げ出す means 'to put even (a professional) to shame', as in プロも裸足で逃げ出す腕前.

presentation.meaning: to fulfill, to carry out (a role, duty, promise)
presentation.defJa: やるべきことや目的を、最後までやりとげる。
presentation.note: Takes abstract objects such as 役割, 責任, 義務 or 目的 and is very frequent in news; 遂げる is more literary and stresses reaching a hard-won goal.

presentation.defJa: ミツバチが花の蜜を集めて巣にためた、甘くてとろりとした食べ物。
presentation.note: Packaging and recipes very often write it in kana as はちみつ; ハニー appears mainly in brand names and loanword compounds.

presentation.defJa: 悪いことをした人に、こらしめとして与える苦しみや不利益。
presentation.note: Read ばつ for punishment imposed by people; read ばち in 罰が当たる, divine retribution for wrongdoing.

presentation.defJa: 子どもや動物の体が育って、大きくなっていくこと。
presentation.note: Mainly about the bodily growth of children and animals; 成長 is the broad everyday word, and plants usually take 生育.

presentation.defJa: 植物の種から芽が出ること。
presentation.note: Technical-sounding but common in gardening and on food labels (発芽玄米); everyday speech says 芽が出る.

presentation.meaning: remark, statement; speaking up (in a meeting, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 会議や公の場で、意見や考えを口に出して述べること。また、その言葉。
presentation.note: Refers to remarks made in a public or formal setting such as meetings, interviews or parliament; casual talk is just 話 or 言ったこと.

presentation.meaning: occurrence, outbreak (of an incident, disease, etc.)
presentation.defJa: 事件や病気、自然現象などが新たに起こること。
presentation.note: Standard in news reports for accidents, disasters and outbreaks; more formal than 起こる, and it is not used for planned events.

presentation.meaning: to tailor, to make (clothes); to turn (something) into
presentation.defJa: 布を裁って縫い、着物や洋服を作る。また、ある形のものに作り上げる。
presentation.note: Literally about tailoring clothes, but often used figuratively as ～に仕立てる, 'to fashion into' (a story into a drama, or someone into a culprit).

presentation.defJa: 新しい品物を買うときに、それまで使っていた品物を店に引き取ってもらい、代金の一部にあてること。
presentation.note: Specifically means handing in an old item as partial payment for a new one from the same seller, unlike 買い取り, a straight purchase of your goods.

presentation.meaning: waning, decline (of a trend); dying down (of a fire)
presentation.defJa: 勢いが弱まること。また、火の勢いが衰えること。
presentation.note: Almost always in the pattern 下火になる for booms, epidemics or protests losing momentum; the literal fire sense survives mainly in reports of blazes.

presentation.meaning: one's parents' home, the family home one grew up in
presentation.defJa: 自分が生まれ育った家。結婚した人にとっては、生まれた家族の住む家。
presentation.note: The parental home seen from someone who has left it (often a married person); 自宅 is the home you currently live in.

presentation.defJa: 決まりに反したり、条件を満たさなかったりして、資格を失うこと。
presentation.note: Formal in sports and exams, but in speech ～として失格 bluntly judges someone unfit for a role, as in the title 人間失格.

presentation.meaning: downfall, losing one's position of power
presentation.defJa: 失敗や争いのために、それまでの地位や立場を失うこと。
presentation.note: Used of politicians and powerful figures being ousted, typically through scandal or rivals; 辞任 is a resignation, while 失脚 implies a fall from power.

presentation.defJa: 会社を起こしたり経営したりして、事業を手がける人。
presentation.note: Suggests someone who founds or runs businesses, usually with some stature, weightier than the generic 会社員 or ビジネスマン.
collocations: 実業家として成功する

presentation.defJa: 礼儀や生活の習慣を、子どもや動物に教えて身につけさせること。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana as しつけ; covers both children's manners and pet training, and in sewing also means basting stitches.

presentation.defJa: 礼儀や生活の習慣を教えこんで、身につけさせる。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; often appears in the passive (厳しくしつけられた) when people recall their upbringing, and is more domestic than 訓練する.

presentation.defJa: 考えや知識を、実際の行動に移すこと。
presentation.note: Stresses carrying out ideas or principles in real life, often paired with 理論; 練習 is practice as rehearsal to improve a skill.

presentation.meaning: actual state, real conditions (of a situation)
presentation.defJa: 外からは見えにくい、物事の本当の姿やありさま。
presentation.note: Common in news and policy writing for the real conditions behind appearances or official figures; the homophone 実体 means substance or the entity itself.

presentation.defJa: 体の働きなどの調子がくずれ、うまく働かなくなること。
presentation.note: Rarely used on its own; it mostly appears in medical compounds such as 栄養失調 and 自律神経失調症.

presentation.defJa: 他人が自分より恵まれていることをうらやみ、ねたむ気持ち。
presentation.note: Covers both romantic jealousy and envy of others' success, with a stronger, more negative edge than うらやましい.

presentation.meaning: rotation (of a celestial body on its axis)
presentation.defJa: 天体が、自分の中心を通る軸のまわりを回ること。
presentation.note: Rotation on an object's own axis, contrasted with 公転 (revolving around another body); do not confuse it with the homophones 辞典 and 事典.

presentation.defJa: 言葉づかいやふるまいが、落ち着いていて上品なさま。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana and used mostly of women, now often with the prefix お (おしとやか); it can sound old-fashioned or gendered in modern use.

presentation.meaning: to wilt, to shrivel (of vegetables, flowers, skin)
presentation.defJa: 水分がなくなって、しおれたり、しわが寄ったりする。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; close to しおれる (drooping from lack of water), but しなびる stresses drying out and shriveling and can also describe aged skin.

presentation.defJa: 人の大便と小便。
presentation.note: Formal administrative term, usually written し尿 because 屎 is not a common-use kanji (し尿処理施設); it belongs to official, historical and news writing and is not used in conversation.

presentation.defJa: 土地を持っている人。特に、その土地を人に貸している人。
presentation.note: An owner of land, not of an apartment building (that is 大家 or 家主); in historical contexts it contrasts with tenant farmers, 小作人.

presentation.meaning: to surpass, to outdo; to endure (heat, hardship)
presentation.defJa: ほかのものを上回る。また、苦しい状態になんとか耐えて切り抜ける。
presentation.note: In the 'surpass' sense it is a written word for performance, records or popularity (～を凌ぐ人気), while in the 'endure' sense it is usually written in kana, as in 暑さをしのぐ or 急場をしのぐ.

presentation.defJa: 庭や公園などの地面をおおうように植える、背の低い草。
presentation.note: 芝 is the grass itself, while 芝生 (しばふ) usually means the lawn as an area, as in 芝生に入らないでください; 芝 appears more in compounds such as 人工芝 and 天然芝.

presentation.meaning: the first train (or bus) of the day; starting point of a line
presentation.defJa: その日、いちばん最初に出る電車やバス。また、電車やバスがその駅を起点として運行を始めること。
presentation.note: 始発 is the first service of the day (or the station where a line starts), the opposite of 終電 (the last train); 始発で帰る means staying out all night and going home on the first train.

presentation.meaning: ear, nose and throat (ENT) clinic; otolaryngology
presentation.defJa: 耳・鼻・のどの病気を専門に診る医療の分野。また、その病院。
presentation.note: 耳鼻科 is the everyday short form of 耳鼻咽喉科 (じびいんこうか), the official name you will see on hospital signs.

presentation.defJa: 会社や学校のものではなく、個人が自分で持っているもの。
presentation.note: 私物 contrasts personal belongings with things owned by an employer or organization, and 私物化 is a critical word for treating public or shared things as one's own.

presentation.defJa: 法律にもとづいて争いを裁き、罪を判断する国のはたらき。
presentation.note: 司法 is the formal word for the judicial branch as one of the three powers (alongside 立法 and 行政), common in news and legal writing rather than everyday talk.

presentation.meaning: dealing with, disposing of, cleaning up; (sorry) outcome
presentation.defJa: 物事のあとかたづけをしたり、きちんと処理したりすること。
presentation.note: 始末 means dealing with something so it causes no further trouble (火の始末, ゴミの始末), and in この始末だ it describes a deplorable outcome; 始末に負えない means 'unmanageable'.

presentation.defJa: 自分が住んでいる、または生まれ育った土地。その地域。
presentation.note: 地元 is the everyday word for 'the local area' or one's hometown, warmer and more casual than 現地 (the place in question) or 郷里 (a literary word for one's birthplace).

presentation.meaning: a little less than, just under (after a number)
presentation.defJa: 数や量を表す言葉のあとについて、それより少し少ないことを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to a number, ～弱 means 'slightly under' and pairs with ～強 'slightly over', so 一時間弱 is a bit less than an hour; in 震度5弱 it instead marks the lower of two grades of an intensity level.

presentation.defJa: 人と人とが集まって付き合うこと。世間での付き合い。
presentation.note: 社交 refers to socializing as a social activity and is most often met in compounds such as 社交的 (outgoing) and 社交辞令 (polite pleasantries not meant literally).

presentation.defJa: 会社が社員を住まわせるために持っている、または借りている住宅。
presentation.note: 社宅 is housing provided by an employer, often at low rent, and differs from 寮 (りょう), which usually means dormitory-style rooms for single employees or students.

presentation.defJa: 数や量、程度がわずかであるようす。少し。
presentation.note: 若干 is a slightly formal 'a little, somewhat', common in news and reports (若干の変更, 募集若干名 'a few openings'), and in casual speech it is also used as a softer 'kind of'.

presentation.defJa: 長い棹に三本の糸を張り、ばちではじいて鳴らす日本の弦楽器。
presentation.note: 三味線 is the three-stringed plucked lute of Japanese traditional music, and the idiom 三味線を弾く figuratively means to say things to put someone off the scent.

presentation.defJa: 小さな石が細かく集まったもの。道や庭に敷く。
presentation.note: 砂利 is the everyday word for gravel or pebbles used on paths and railway beds, and 玉砂利 refers to the rounded stones laid at shrines and in gardens.

presentation.meaning: to be stylish, smart; to make a witty joke
presentation.defJa: 気がきいていて、あか抜けている。また、気のきいた冗談を言う。
presentation.note: 洒落る is mostly used in the forms 洒落た and 洒落ている to mean 'stylish' or 'smart', often written in kana as しゃれた, and the related noun お洒落 (おしゃれ) is the everyday word for being fashionable.

presentation.defJa: 国や公共団体ではなく、個人や企業がものや土地を持つこと。
presentation.note: 私有 is a formal word for private ownership, used mainly in compounds like 私有地 (private land) and 私有財産, and contrasts with 公有 or 国有.

presentation.defJa: 仏教の流派の名前のあとにつけて、その教えを受けつぐ集まりを表す。
presentation.note: ～宗 names a Buddhist sect or school (浄土宗, 日蓮宗, 禅宗), and the general word for a sect or denomination is 宗派 (しゅうは).

presentation.meaning: pursuit of learning, study (esp. in the compound for 'school trip')
presentation.defJa: 学問を学び、身につけること。
presentation.note: On its own 修学 is a formal word for pursuing studies, but in daily life it almost always appears in 修学旅行, the overnight class trip taken in elementary, junior high and high school.

presentation.defJa: 同じことがくり返し起こるとき、一回りするのにかかる一定の時間。
presentation.note: 周期 is a technical-leaning word for a regular cycle or period in science and nature (公転周期, 周期表), whereas サイクル is the looser everyday loanword.

presentation.meaning: House of Representatives (lower house of the Japanese Diet)
presentation.defJa: 日本の国会を形づくる二つの議院のうち、任期が四年で解散があるほう。
presentation.note: 衆議院 is the lower house of Japan's Diet and is often shortened to 衆院 in headlines, while the upper house is 参議院 (参院).

presentation.defJa: 仕事につくこと。また、決められた時間に仕事をすること。
presentation.note: 就業 is a formal, administrative word for being in work or working hours (就業規則 'company work rules'), whereas 就職 means landing a job and 就労 stresses the act of labor, often in legal contexts.

presentation.defJa: 会社や店などにやとわれて、そこで働いている人。
presentation.note: 従業員 is the neutral word for the people a business employs, while 社員 refers to company staff (often regular employees) and 職員 is used for public bodies, schools and hospitals.

presentation.defJa: いくつもの数を寄せ集めて、合計を出すこと。
presentation.note: 集計 is adding up many individual figures into totals (votes, survey answers, sales), a common word in news and business, while 合計 is the resulting sum itself.

presentation.defJa: 不意に相手をおそって攻めること。
presentation.note: 襲撃 is a sudden, deliberate attack on a person or place, common in news and history writing, and is more specific than the general 攻撃 (attack, offense).

presentation.defJa: 大学院で決められた課程を終えた人に与えられる学位。博士の一つ前の段階。
presentation.note: 修士 is the master's level, between 学士 (bachelor's) and 博士 (doctorate), and students often refer to their year as 修士一年 or simply M1.

presentation.defJa: 二本の道が十の字の形に交わっているところ。
presentation.note: 十字路 is a slightly literary word for a crossroads that also works figuratively (人生の十字路), whereas 交差点 is the everyday term for a road intersection with traffic.

presentation.defJa: 会社や学校、役所などの門で、出入りする人を確かめ、建物を守る仕事をする人。
presentation.note: 守衛 is a guard stationed at the entrance of a company, school or public building, a somewhat old-fashioned word compared with 警備員, the general term for security staff.

presentation.defJa: 映画や劇などで、いちばん中心となる役を演じること。
presentation.note: 主演 means starring in the lead role of a film, play or drama, while 出演 is simply appearing in one and 助演 is a supporting role.

presentation.meaning: cram school, private after-school tutoring school
presentation.defJa: 学校の授業とは別に、子どもに勉強を教える民間の教室。
presentation.note: 塾 usually means a private after-school or cram school (学習塾, 進学塾), though in historical contexts it can also denote a private academy of the Edo period.

presentation.defJa: めでたいことを喜び、祝うこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for official celebrations, ceremonies and parties marking an achievement; in everyday speech people simply say お祝い.

presentation.defJa: 生まれる前から決まっていて、変えることのできない運命。
presentation.note: Heavier and more literary than 運命, it implies a destiny fixed from birth that cannot be escaped, as in 宿命のライバル for a lifelong rival.

presentation.defJa: 編み物や刺しゅうなど、手先を使って小物を作ること。
presentation.note: Refers to small-scale crafts with fabric, thread and yarn done as a hobby, whereas 工芸 means traditional craft art such as pottery or lacquerware.

presentation.meaning: hosting or organizing (an event); being the organizer
presentation.defJa: 中心になって会やイベントを開くこと。
presentation.note: Means to host an event as the body chiefly responsible for it, as distinct from 共催 (co-hosting) and 後援 (lending support or patronage); English notices sometimes render it as 'sponsored by', but funding an event is 協賛.

presentation.meaning: news gathering; reporting; interviewing (for a story)
presentation.defJa: 記事や番組を作るために、人に話を聞いたり現場を調べたりすること。
presentation.note: The standard journalism term for gathering material for an article or broadcast; interviewees describe being interviewed as 取材を受ける.

presentation.defJa: いろいろな種類があること。さまざま。
presentation.note: A stiff written word found in reports and official documents, usually as 種々の; in ordinary speech いろいろ or さまざま are used instead.

presentation.defJa: 毎日の食事の中心になる食べ物。米やパンなど。
presentation.note: Means the starchy base of a meal such as rice, bread or noodles, in contrast to おかず or 副食, the side dishes.

presentation.defJa: 物語や劇の中心となって活躍する人物。
presentation.note: Used for the main character of novels, films, dramas and games, and figuratively in phrases like 自分の人生の主人公 (the protagonist of one's own life).

presentation.meaning: appearance (in a show, film or play); performing
presentation.defJa: 映画やテレビ、舞台などに出て演じたり話したりすること。
presentation.note: Covers appearing in any broadcast, film, play or event, whereas 主演 specifically means playing the leading role.

presentation.defJa: 血が体の外や中に流れ出ること。
presentation.note: The everyday and medical term for bleeding; in retail it is also used figuratively for selling at a loss, as in 出血大サービス.

presentation.defJa: それまでなかったものが、新しくあらわれること。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal word for something new appearing or emerging, used for inventions, species, phenomena or rivals; 登場 is softer and more common for products and people.

presentation.defJa: 子どもを産むこと。
presentation.note: The standard neutral term in medical, administrative and everyday contexts; お産 is a softer, more conversational word.

presentation.meaning: going to the office; coming in to work
presentation.defJa: 勤めている会社に行くこと。
presentation.note: Means physically going in to one's company, while 出勤 is broader and covers any workplace, such as a hospital, shop or factory.

presentation.defJa: 子どもが生まれること。
presentation.note: A formal word for birth used in statistics and official documents such as 出生届 and 出生率; しゅっしょう is the reading preferred in official usage, though しゅっせい is also widely heard.

presentation.defJa: ほんのわずかな量。
presentation.note: A technical-sounding word for trace or minute quantities, common in science, food safety and environmental reporting.

presentation.defJa: 昼に食べる食事。ひるごはん。
presentation.note: A casual, somewhat masculine word for lunch; 昼ご飯 is the neutral everyday form and 昼食 the formal one.

presentation.defJa: 一方が二倍、三倍になると、もう一方も同じ割合で増えること。
presentation.note: Used in math and in everyday reasoning for two quantities rising or falling together, usually as Aに比例する; 反比例 means inverse proportion.

presentation.defJa: 貧しくて、生活に必要なものが足りない状態。
presentation.note: A formal, analytical word for poverty as a social problem, used in policy and news; 貧乏 is the everyday, personal word for being poor.

presentation.defJa: 品物のよしあしの程度。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to the quality of goods and products; 質 is broader, and クオリティ is a trendier loanword often used in advertising.

presentation.defJa: 中身や量が乏しくて、見劣りがするようす。
presentation.note: Describes something as meager or feeble in size, substance or content, usually with a critical tone, and applies to bodies, facilities, arguments or vocabulary.

presentation.defJa: 同じ作物や家畜の中で、性質や形の違いによって分けた種類。
presentation.note: Used for cultivated varieties of crops and breeds of livestock or pets, as in 品種改良 (selective breeding); 種類 is the general word for kind.

presentation.defJa: お金がなくて、暮らしが苦しいこと。
presentation.note: The everyday, personal word for being broke or poor, often used humorously about oneself; 貧困 is the formal term for poverty as a social issue.

presentation.defJa: 思いがけないこと。予想していないときに急に起こること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears as the adverb 不意に or in 不意を突かれる (be caught off guard); it is slightly more literary than 突然 or 急に.

presentation.defJa: 手紙や袋などの口を閉じること。また、その閉じたところ。
presentation.note: Refers to the seal or closure of an envelope or package and appears mostly in set phrases like 封を切る; the related verb 封じる means to seal off or block.

presentation.defJa: 風の力で羽根を回し、その力を利用するしかけ。
presentation.note: Read ふうしゃ for windmills and wind turbines, while the same kanji read かざぐるま means a toy pinwheel.

presentation.defJa: その土地に昔から伝わる、暮らしの中のならわし。
presentation.note: Refers to customs handed down within a region or community, whereas 習慣 leans toward individual habits and 慣習 toward established social convention.

presentation.meaning: manners and customs (of a period or place); (colloquial) the sex industry
presentation.defJa: ある時代や地域の人々の、暮らし方やならわし。
presentation.note: In historical and academic writing it means the lifestyle and customs of a period, but in everyday modern speech it usually refers to the sex industry, so context matters.

presentation.meaning: natural environment and climate (of a region)
presentation.defJa: その土地の気候や地形、土などの自然のようす。
presentation.note: Covers a region's climate, soil and landscape as they shape life and culture, and is also used figuratively for an organization's culture, as in 企業風土.

presentation.defJa: 会社などで、自分の下について働く人。
presentation.note: The everyday workplace word for people under one's supervision, paired with 上司 (boss); some companies now prefer softer terms like メンバー.

presentation.defJa: 悪いことが起こりそうで、縁起が悪いようす。
presentation.note: Describes signs or things thought to bring bad luck, such as numbers, dreams or black cats; 縁起が悪い is the more conversational equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 食器やテーブルをふくための小さな布。
presentation.note: An everyday household word for a small cloth used on dishes or tables; 雑巾 is the rougher cloth for floors and is never used on dishes.

presentation.defJa: 二つ以上のものが合わさって、一つになること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds like 複合施設 or the adjective 複合的 ('multifaceted') in fairly formal writing; 混合 stresses physically mixing things, whereas 複合 stresses combined functions or factors.

presentation.meaning: face mask, covering the face; anonymity, being undercover
presentation.defJa: 顔を隠すために布などで覆うこと。また、正体を明かさないこと。
presentation.note: Literally a cloth over the face, common in crime reports, and also used figuratively for 'undercover' or 'anonymous', as in 覆面パトカー (unmarked police car) or 覆面作家 (anonymous writer).

presentation.meaning: to swell; to become full (of the stomach)
presentation.defJa: 中に空気や物が入って外側にふくらむ。また、おなかがいっぱいになる。
presentation.note: Intransitive; compared with 膨らむ, which is neutral and often figurative (夢が膨らむ), it tends to suggest bulging or bloating, and it can also mean 'to sulk'. The compound 膨れ上がる is common in news for costs or crowds ballooning.

presentation.defJa: 世の中のお金の動きが悪く、商売がうまくいかない状態。
presentation.note: A more everyday, conversational word than 不況; it can also describe a gloomy look or mood, as in 不景気な顔をする.

presentation.meaning: to be absorbed in; to indulge in
presentation.defJa: ほかのことを忘れて、一つのことに夢中になる。
presentation.note: A literary verb taking に for activities one gets lost in (reading, thought, pleasure); compared with 没頭する it can carry a hint of self-indulgence, and it is often written in kana as ふける.

presentation.defJa: 年をとって、見た目や体が年寄りらしくなる。
presentation.note: Describes visibly growing old, especially in appearance (老けて見える, 老け顔); 年をとる is the neutral 'get older', while 老化 is the technical noun for biological aging.

presentation.defJa: 国や政府が、決めたことを広く一般に知らせること。
presentation.note: A formal, official word now heard mostly in 宣戦布告 (declaration of war), which is also used figuratively for an open challenge to a rival; ordinary announcements use 発表, and a new law is promulgated with 公布.

presentation.defJa: その場所、特に自分の家にいないこと。
presentation.note: A slightly formal word for being away, common in delivery notices (不在票) and phone logs (不在着信); 留守 is the everyday word for being out of the house, while 不在 also covers abstract absence, as in リーダー不在.

presentation.defJa: 相手をばかにして、名誉や誇りを傷つけること。
presentation.note: A strong, fairly formal word for deliberately demeaning someone, used in legal and news contexts (侮辱罪); 悪口 is everyday badmouthing, while 侮辱 stresses an attack on a person's dignity.

presentation.defJa: 様子がおかしく、あやしいと感じられること。
presentation.note: Common in news and safety notices (不審者, 不審物); it is more formal than あやしい and describes something that raises doubts rather than proven wrongdoing.

presentation.defJa: 戦うために武器を身につけたり、備えたりすること。
presentation.note: Used in news about conflict and security (武装勢力 'armed group', 武装解除 'disarmament'); it also appears figuratively in 理論武装, arming oneself with arguments.

presentation.defJa: 調子が悪く、本来の力が出せない状態。
presentation.note: Covers people, machines and markets alike (エンジンの不調, 心身の不調); in sports news it is the standard word for a slump, the opposite of 好調.

presentation.defJa: 一度なくなったり弱まったりしたものが、もう一度元の状態に戻ること。
presentation.note: A versatile, positive word for something coming back (a fashion, a team, a service, a rebooted show); 復興 is used for rebuilding a region after disaster, and 復旧 for getting infrastructure working again.

presentation.defJa: 世の中の人々がさまざまに議論したり、批判したりすること。
presentation.note: Almost always appears in the set phrase 物議を醸す ('to cause a stir'), a written, journalistic expression implying criticism rather than neutral discussion (議論).

presentation.defJa: こわれたり止まったりした設備や交通などを、元の状態に戻すこと。
presentation.note: The standard news word for restoring power, rail lines, roads or systems after disasters and outages; unlike 復興 (rebuilding a whole community), 復旧 means getting things working again.

presentation.defJa: 生活や仕事、戦いなどに必要な品物。
presentation.note: A formal, collective word for supplies needed for daily life, relief or war (救援物資, 戦略物資); it is broader and more official-sounding than 品物 or 商品.

presentation.defJa: 仏の姿をかたどって作った像。
presentation.note: The general term for any Buddhist image, whether of a buddha or a bodhisattva; 大仏 refers specifically to a giant one, and 本尊 to the principal image of a temple.

presentation.defJa: 形があって、空間の中に存在する物。
presentation.note: A neutral scientific word for any physical thing with mass and shape, common in physics and in news about unidentified objects; 物 is the everyday word, while 物質 means the substance something is made of.

presentation.defJa: 液体が熱せられて、中から盛んに泡が出ること。
presentation.note: More technical-sounding than 沸く, and used both literally for liquids and figuratively for debates, prices or popularity surging (人気沸騰).

presentation.defJa: 道理や法律に合わず、正しくないこと。
presentation.note: A formal word common in legal and labor contexts (不当解雇 'wrongful dismissal', 不当表示 'misleading labeling'); it is stronger and more official than 不公平, which simply means unequal treatment.

presentation.defJa: 世間や利用者からの評判が悪いこと。
presentation.note: Used for products, policies or performances that are poorly received, typically in 不評を買う; it is the opposite of 好評 and milder than 悪評, which suggests notoriety.

presentation.meaning: to take into account; to build on (facts, lessons)
presentation.defJa: ある事実や考えをもとにして、物事を考えたり決めたりする。
presentation.note: A formal verb used almost always as 〜を踏まえて in reports, speeches and meetings; it is more formal than 〜をもとに and implies carefully weighing the premise rather than merely referring to it.

presentation.meaning: to step into; to go deeper into (a matter or someone's affairs)
presentation.defJa: ある場所や問題の中に、さらに深く入っていく。
presentation.note: Literally 'step in', it is very common figuratively for going further than usual (踏み込んだ議論 'a frank, in-depth discussion') and also for police raiding a place; 立ち入る similarly means to intrude but sounds more formal.

presentation.defJa: はっきりと分からないこと。
presentation.note: A concise written word often attached to nouns in news and forms (原因不明, 年齢不明); in speech people more often say よく分からない.

presentation.defJa: 全体をいくつかに分けたときの、一つ一つのまとまり。
presentation.note: Used for divisions of a company or organization and for categories in a contest (長編部門で受賞); 部署 is narrower, meaning the specific office or team one works in.

presentation.meaning: to look back on; to reflect on; to turn around
presentation.defJa: 過ぎたことを思い出して、もう一度考える。また、後ろを見る。
presentation.note: Used both literally for turning to look behind and, very commonly, for reviewing past events (一年を振り返る); unlike 反省する it is neutral and does not imply admitting fault.

presentation.defJa: 物事の一番はじめの段階。すごろくで出発する所。
presentation.note: Originally the starting square of the board game sugoroku, it is used almost always in 振り出しに戻る ('back to square one'), implying a setback; 出発点 is the neutral word for a starting point.
collocations: 交渉が振り出しに戻る

presentation.defJa: 品質や状態がよくないこと。また、行いの悪い若者。
presentation.note: In modern usage it mostly means 'defective' or 'in poor condition' (不良品, 接続不良, 体調不良); used alone of a person it means a delinquent youth, a somewhat dated, colloquial sense.

presentation.defJa: 水などの中にある物を、上に押し上げようとする力。
presentation.note: A physics term also used in everyday talk about swimming, boats and balloons; it means only the upward push from a fluid, unlike 揚力, the lift generated by a wing.

presentation.defJa: 軍隊や武器を使って相手を押さえつける力。
presentation.note: A formal word common in news and diplomacy, especially in 武力行使 and 武力衝突; it stresses the actual use of armed force, whereas 軍事力 refers to military capability as a whole.

presentation.meaning: to make (one's voice, body, etc.) tremble; to quiver
presentation.defJa: 体や声などを小刻みにゆらす。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 震える, typically taking a voice or body part as its object to show strong emotion such as grief, anger or fear.

presentation.defJa: 歴史や芸術の面で価値が高く、守って後の時代に伝えるべきもの。
presentation.note: An administrative and journalistic term covering buildings, artworks and even intangible traditions protected by law; 重要文化財 and 国宝 are formal designation ranks within it.

presentation.defJa: 一か所に集めず、いくつかに分けて散らばらせること。
presentation.note: A neutral word for people, risk, data or traffic being spread out, as in 分散投資 or 分散型; its opposite is 集中.

presentation.defJa: 物質の性質を持つ最小のつぶ。いくつかの原子が結びついてできている。
presentation.note: In science it means molecule and in math numerator (paired with 分母); it can also mean an element within a group, as in 不満分子 (disgruntled elements).

presentation.defJa: 持っていた物をなくして、見つからなくなること。
presentation.note: More formal than なくす, it appears in official notices, police reports and company statements (顧客情報の紛失); in conversation people usually just say なくした.

presentation.meaning: gushing out; spewing; (of complaints or problems) bursting into the open
presentation.defJa: 中にたまっていた気体や液体などが、勢いよくふき出すこと。
presentation.note: Used literally for gas, steam, lava or water and very often figuratively in the news for complaints or problems erupting (批判が噴出する); 噴火 refers specifically to a volcanic eruption.

presentation.defJa: 文字で書き記して、記録や連絡のために残したもの。
presentation.note: A formal word for official or business writing (行政文書, 社内文書) seen as a record; 書類 is the everyday word for individual papers and forms.

presentation.meaning: sharing (of a task or cost); division of responsibilities
presentation.defJa: 一つの仕事や負担を、何人かで分けて受け持つこと。
presentation.note: Focuses on splitting a specific task, cost or responsibility among people (役割分担, 費用分担), whereas 分業 describes a system of specialized division of labor.

presentation.defJa: 力をふりしぼって、懸命にがんばること。
presentation.note: An admiring, slightly literary word for fighting hard against difficult odds, common in sports reports and news; 努力 is more neutral and lacks the sense of a hard battle.

presentation.defJa: 全体をいくつかに分けて、それぞれに配ること。
presentation.note: Used for handing out money, profits or resources to recipients, especially in economics and politics (所得の再分配); 配分 is close but stresses the allocation ratio.

presentation.defJa: 分数で、横線の下に書く数。
presentation.note: Literally the denominator of a fraction, it is also used figuratively in news and business for the base of a ratio, as in 分母が大きい (a large base population).

presentation.defJa: こなになったもの。細かいつぶの状態のもの。
presentation.note: A slightly technical word seen on product labels and in recipes (粉末緑茶, 粉末状); in everyday speech 粉 is more common.

presentation.defJa: 戦争で敵を攻撃するために使う道具や装置。
presentation.note: A formal word for weapons as military hardware, typical in news (核兵器, 化学兵器); 武器 is broader and includes arms carried by individuals, such as swords or guns.

presentation.meaning: being fed up; being at a loss (in the face of something unpleasant)
presentation.defJa: どうしようもなくて困りはてること。うんざりすること。
presentation.note: A slightly bookish verb-noun (閉口する) used with に for annoyances one can do nothing about, such as heat, noise or long speeches; the literal sense of shutting one's mouth is rarely meant today.

presentation.defJa: 軍隊に入って戦う人。
presentation.note: The standard neutral word for a soldier in news and history writing; 兵隊 is more colloquial, and 軍人 refers to military personnel as a profession, officers included.

presentation.defJa: 特に変わったことのない、いつもの状態。
presentation.note: A formal word most often heard in 平常通り (as usual) in announcements and news, and in 平常心 (composure); 普段 is the everyday equivalent.

presentation.meaning: square (as in square meter); square (of a number)
presentation.defJa: ある数にその数自身をかけること。また、長さの単位の前に付けて面積の単位を表す言葉。
presentation.note: Mostly seen in area units such as 平方メートル (often written ㎡) and in math as 平方根; for squaring a number, 二乗 is more common in everyday speech.

presentation.meaning: parallel (arrangement or processing); standing side by side
presentation.defJa: いくつかのものが横に並ぶこと。また、同時に進めること。
presentation.note: Used in computing (並列処理), electric circuits (the opposite of 直列) and grammar for items listed side by side; it differs from 平行, which means geometrically parallel lines.

presentation.meaning: being fed up; being sick of something
presentation.defJa: 同じことが続くなどして、すっかりいやになること。
presentation.note: A bookish verb-noun common in essays and columns for being thoroughly sick of something repetitive or overbearing, roughly a literary うんざりする; its old sense of recoiling in fear survives mainly in dictionaries.

presentation.meaning: to be far apart; to be distant (in space, time or views)
presentation.defJa: 二つのものの間の距離や違いが大きい。遠くはなれている。
presentation.note: A written-style verb, usually in the form 隔たっている, that stresses a gap or difference between two things; 離れる is the everyday word for physical distance.

presentation.defJa: 自分の失敗について理由を述べ、許してもらおうとすること。
presentation.note: More formal than 言い訳 and usually negative in tone, as in 弁解の余地がない (no excuse possible); 弁明 is used for a formal public explanation of one's position.

presentation.defJa: 社会や組織のしくみなどを、根本から大きく変えること。
presentation.note: Stronger and more formal than 変化, implying deep structural change to a system or organization; 改革 stresses deliberately reforming institutions or policies.

presentation.defJa: 借りたり取り上げたりしたものを、元の持ち主に戻すこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for returning territory, property or artifacts to their rightful owner, typical in diplomacy and law (領土返還); 返却 is the everyday word for returning borrowed items such as library books.

presentation.meaning: defense (especially legal); speaking up for someone
presentation.defJa: ある人の立場や言い分を説明して、その人をかばい守ること。
presentation.note: Used for legal defense and, more broadly, for speaking up in someone's favor; 自己弁護 (self-justification) has a critical tone, and 擁護 is preferred for defending ideas or rights.

presentation.meaning: paying for damage; compensation (for something broken or lost)
presentation.defJa: 相手に与えた損害を、お金や品物でつぐなうこと。
presentation.note: Used for paying for something you damaged or lost, typically in personal and everyday situations; 賠償 is the legal term for compensation on a larger scale, as in 損害賠償.

presentation.defJa: 聞かれたことや呼びかけに対して答えること。また、その答え。
presentation.note: Slightly more formal than 返事 and common in writing and business; 回答 is preferred for formal answers to surveys, inquiries or official questions.

presentation.defJa: 数や状態が上がったり下がったりして、変わること。
presentation.note: A formal word for numerical or structural change over time, such as prices, rates or climate; 変化 is the general word for any change, while 変動 suggests ups and downs.

presentation.meaning: public speaking, oratory (as in a speech contest); oral argument in court
presentation.defJa: 人々の前で、自分の意見を筋道立てて述べること。
presentation.note: Today it is mostly heard in 弁論大会 (school speech contests) and in court as 最終弁論 (closing argument); it means making a reasoned spoken case, unlike 討論, which is a debate between sides.

presentation.defJa: 稲や麦などの茎の先に、実や花がたくさん集まってついた部分。
presentation.note: Refers to the ear or head of grain plants such as rice, wheat and pampas grass; it often appears in the compound 稲穂 and in the proverb 実るほど頭を垂れる稲穂かな.

presentation.meaning: childcare; nursery care (of infants and young children)
presentation.defJa: 小さい子どもの世話をして、守り育てること。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to caring for and raising young children, especially in daycare settings; 育児 is parents' own child-rearing, while 保育 usually means care provided by facilities or professionals.

presentation.defJa: 国会などで話し合うために出される、新しい法律のもとになる案。
presentation.note: The standard news word for a draft law under debate in the legislature; once passed it becomes a 法律, and a budget bill is called 予算案 instead.

presentation.defJa: 外からの攻撃や害から、国や自分の立場を守ること。
presentation.note: Used for national defense in politics and news, and also for defending a title in sports; 防御 is more about guarding against an attack in a specific situation.

presentation.defJa: 火事が起きたり広がったりしないように防ぐこと。
presentation.note: Means preventing fires from starting or spreading, often seen in compounds such as 防火扉 and 防火訓練; 消火 is putting out a fire that has already started.

presentation.meaning: law (as a field of study); jurisprudence
presentation.defJa: 法律のしくみや考え方を研究する学問。
presentation.note: Refers to law as an academic discipline studied at university (法学部); 法律 means the laws themselves.

presentation.defJa: 王や将軍が家来に土地を与え、そのかわりに忠誠を誓わせる社会のしくみ。
presentation.note: Mostly used in compounds such as 封建制度 and 封建社会 for the historical system, and as 封建的 to criticize old-fashioned, hierarchical attitudes in families or workplaces.

presentation.defJa: 物事を行うときの、決まったやり方や形。
presentation.note: Refers to an established system or procedure for doing something, often in compounds such as 投票方式 or 決済方式; 方法 is the more general word for a way of doing something.

presentation.defJa: 熱や光などが、ある中心から四方へ出ていくこと。
presentation.note: A technical word for energy such as heat or light going out from a source, seen in 放射線 and 放射冷却; 放射状 also describes things spreading out in lines from a center.

presentation.defJa: ためていたものを、外へ出すこと。
presentation.note: Used for emitting energy or substances in science and also for releasing stockpiled goods onto the market.
collocations: エネルギーを放出する

presentation.meaning: to report (in the news); to inform
presentation.defJa: 新聞やテレビなどが、出来事を広く知らせる。
presentation.note: A written, journalistic verb for the media reporting something; 伝える is the more neutral everyday word, and 報ずる is an older, stiffer variant.

presentation.defJa: 新聞などが、出来事を世の中に知らせる。
presentation.note: A stiffer, more literary variant of 報じる found in older writing and formal set phrases such as 報ずるところによれば; in modern speech 報じる is far more common.
collocations: 新聞の報ずるところによれば

presentation.defJa: 綿や毛などの繊維から、糸をつくること。
presentation.note: Refers to the industrial process of spinning fibers such as cotton into yarn and is closely tied to the history of Japan's textile industry (紡績業); 織物 is the woven fabric itself.

presentation.defJa: 思いがけないことにあって、何もできずにぼんやりする様子。
presentation.note: Describes being stunned into blankness by shock or loss, typically in 呆然と立ち尽くす; 唖然 stresses being left speechless by surprise, often at something outrageous.

presentation.meaning: leaving something as it is; neglecting (a problem)
presentation.defJa: 手を加えたり片付けたりしないで、そのままにしておくこと。
presentation.note: Implies leaving something unattended that really needs attention, so it often carries a critical tone (放置自転車, 問題を放置する); そのままにする is the neutral everyday phrase.

presentation.defJa: 裁判を行う部屋や場所。
presentation.note: The room or setting where a trial takes place, and by extension legal proceedings themselves (法廷で争う); 裁判所 is the court as an institution or building.

presentation.meaning: reward; prize (for effort or good behavior)
presentation.defJa: よいことをしたり、がんばったりした人に与える品物やお金。
presentation.note: Almost always used with the honorific prefix as ご褒美, for a reward given for effort or good behavior, whether to children or to oneself; 報酬 is payment for work.

presentation.defJa: 非常に強く、激しく吹く風。
presentation.note: A weather term for violent winds, heard in forecasts such as 暴風警報 and 暴風域; 暴風雨 adds heavy rain, and 嵐 is the everyday word for a storm.

presentation.defJa: 死んだ人を墓などに納める。
presentation.note: A formal word for laying the dead to rest, and figuratively for hushing something up or ending a career (闇に葬る, 政治生命を葬る); 埋める is the plain word for burying an object in the ground.

presentation.meaning: to toss into; to throw into (carelessly)
presentation.defJa: 物を無造作に投げて、中に入れる。
presentation.note: A casual verb for tossing something quickly or carelessly into a container or space; 投げ込む stresses the throwing action more, while 放り込む suggests an offhand toss.

presentation.meaning: to abandon (a task) midway; to throw out
presentation.defJa: やりかけの仕事や責任を、途中で投げ捨ててしまう。
presentation.note: Means either throwing something or someone out or abandoning a task or responsibility halfway, with a critical tone in the latter sense; 投げ出す is a close synonym that also means to give up.

presentation.defJa: 人を殴ったり傷つけたりする、乱暴な力や行い。
presentation.note: The general word for physical violence, extended to verbal or psychological abuse as in 言葉の暴力; it typically pairs with the verb 振るう.

presentation.defJa: 温かさが逃げないように、温度を保つこと。
presentation.note: Means keeping something at a warm temperature and is common on appliances and products (炊飯器の保温, 保温ボトル); 保冷 is the opposite, keeping things cold.

presentation.defJa: 野生の鳥や獣、魚などをつかまえること。
presentation.note: A formal word for catching wild animals, whether they are kept alive or culled, used in news and local-government language; 捕まえる is the everyday verb, and 逮捕 is used for arresting people.

presentation.defJa: 足りなくなったものを、あとから付け加えて補うこと。
presentation.note: Means topping up something that is being used up, such as water, fuel or nutrients (水分補給, 燃料補給); 供給 is supplying goods or resources on a larger scale.

presentation.defJa: 弱いところに手を加えて、さらに丈夫にすること。
presentation.note: Means making something stronger by adding material or support, used for buildings and structures (耐震補強) and for teams adding players (戦力補強); 強化 is the broader word for strengthening in general.

presentation.defJa: ある目的のために、多くの人からお金を集めること。
presentation.note: Refers to collecting donations from the public for a cause, as in 街頭募金 and 募金箱; 寄付 is the act of giving money, seen from the donor's side.

presentation.defJa: プロテスタントの教会で礼拝を行い、信者を導く役目の人。
presentation.note: Used for Protestant clergy; a Catholic priest is 神父 and a Buddhist priest is 僧侶 or 住職.

presentation.defJa: 海でクジラをとること。
presentation.note: A neutral term common in news on fisheries and international politics; 商業捕鯨 (commercial whaling) contrasts with 調査捕鯨 (research whaling).

presentation.meaning: to go senile, become forgetful with age; to blur (of an image or color)
presentation.defJa: 年をとって、もの忘れがひどくなったり頭の働きが鈍くなったりする。
presentation.note: Colloquial and usually written ぼける or ボケる; it can sound blunt about older people, so formal and medical contexts use 認知症. The same verb also describes a photo or color going blurry, and the kanji spelling 惚ける can also be read とぼける, to play dumb.

presentation.defJa: 事故や病気などに備えて前もってお金を出し合い、損害を受けた人がお金を受け取れるしくみ。
presentation.note: Beyond insurance policies, 保険をかける is commonly used figuratively for hedging one's bets or keeping a backup plan.

presentation.defJa: 自分が卒業した、または通っていた学校。
presentation.note: Refers to any school one graduated from, not only a university, and carries a fond, slightly formal tone.

presentation.defJa: 自分が生まれ育った国。
presentation.note: Neutral and very common in 母国語; 祖国 is more emotional and patriotic, while 本国 stresses the home country in contrast to where one is now.

presentation.meaning: to come apart at the seams; (of buds) to begin to open
presentation.defJa: 縫い目の糸が切れて、ほどける。また、花のつぼみが少し開く。
presentation.note: Literally used for seams and stitching and poetically for buds starting to open; the noun 綻び often means a crack or flaw in a plan or organization.

presentation.meaning: dried ~ (dried in the sun or wind)
presentation.defJa: 日光や風に当てて乾かした～。
presentation.note: Attaches to foods dried in the sun or wind, mostly traditional items; industrially dried products are more often labeled 乾燥～, as in 乾燥わかめ.

presentation.defJa: 日光や風に当てて乾かすために、広げたりつるしたりしてあるもの。特に洗濯物。
presentation.note: A somewhat old-fashioned word; in everyday speech 洗濯物 is far more common for laundry, whether it is hanging up or not.

presentation.defJa: 古くからのやり方や制度を大切にし、急な変化を好まない立場。また、機械などを正常な状態に保つこと。
presentation.note: In politics it means conservatism (保守派, 保守党), while in engineering and IT it means keeping systems or equipment running, as in 保守点検.

presentation.defJa: 足りないところを助けて補うこと。
presentation.note: Often refers to financial help from public bodies (補助金); 援助 suggests aid to someone in need, while 支援 is broader support of any kind.

presentation.defJa: 道路の表面をアスファルトやコンクリートなどで固めること。
presentation.note: A standard word in civil engineering and the news; 未舗装 describes unpaved dirt roads.

presentation.defJa: 足りないところを付け加えて補うこと。
presentation.note: Adds missing information to make an explanation complete; 補充 instead means refilling something that has run short, such as stock or staff.
collocations: 前回の説明を補足する

presentation.defJa: 病気の症状が急に激しく起こること。
presentation.note: Used for sudden attacks of illness such as asthma, epilepsy or heart trouble; 発作的に figuratively means doing something on a sudden impulse.

presentation.meaning: rest and recuperation; a treat (for the eyes)
presentation.defJa: 心や体を休めて、健康を保ったり回復させたりすること。
presentation.note: A slightly formal word seen in 保養地 and company 保養所; 目の保養 is a common idiom for something pleasing to look at.

presentation.defJa: 戦争で敵に捕らえられた人。
presentation.note: The standard modern word; official documents from the early twentieth century often use the older term 俘虜.

presentation.defJa: 勢いを失って、すっかりなくなる。絶えてしまう。
presentation.note: Intransitive, used for nations, species, languages or cultures ceasing to exist; 滅ぶ is a variant form and 滅ぼす is the transitive partner.

presentation.defJa: すっかりなくしてしまう。また、だめにしてしまう。
presentation.note: Transitive; besides conquering nations it is common in the set phrase 身を滅ぼす, to ruin oneself through drink, gambling and the like.

presentation.meaning: authenticity; full scale (usually as full-scale, genuine or in earnest)
presentation.defJa: 正式なやり方にきちんと従っていること。また、物事が本来の規模や状態になること。
presentation.note: Rarely stands alone; it appears in 本格的 (genuine, full-scale), 本格化する (to get into full swing) and 本格派 (the real thing).

presentation.defJa: いくつかある建物のうち、中心となる建物。別館や新館に対していう。
presentation.note: Used for hotels, museums, schools and department stores in contrast to 新館 (new wing) or 別館 (annex).

presentation.defJa: 冗談ではなく、心からそう思っていること。真剣な気持ち。
presentation.note: Stresses truly meaning something rather than joking or holding back, whereas 真剣 describes an earnest, serious manner.

presentation.meaning: one's home country (as opposed to abroad or colonies)
presentation.defJa: その人や会社が属している国。外国から見た自分の国。
presentation.note: Emphasizes the home country in contrast to abroad or overseas territories, as in 本国に送還する; it is drier and more official than 母国 or 祖国.

presentation.meaning: main body (of a device); the thing itself
presentation.defJa: 機械などの中心となる部分。付属品を除いたもの。
presentation.note: Means the device itself as opposed to its accessories, and 本体価格 on price tags means the price before tax.

presentation.defJa: 心の中で本当に思っていること。
presentation.note: Almost always understood in contrast to 建前, the polite public position one presents to others.

presentation.defJa: 生き物が生まれつき持っている、教わらなくても自然に行動する力。
presentation.note: Refers to innate, unlearned behavior; 直感 is intuition, a sudden insight rather than an inborn drive.

presentation.meaning: main text; body (of a letter or email)
presentation.defJa: 文書や手紙で、題名や注などを除いた中心となる文章。
presentation.note: Refers to the main text as opposed to titles, notes or subject lines; in the study of classical texts it is sometimes read ほんもん.

presentation.defJa: 芸名やペンネームなどではない、戸籍上の名前。
presentation.note: Contrasts with 芸名, ペンネーム and 偽名; ほんめい is a less common alternative reading.

presentation.meaning: being buried underground; (natural resource) deposits, reserves
presentation.defJa: 地中に埋もれていること。特に、鉱物などの資源が地下に眠っていること。
presentation.note: Mostly appears in compounds: 埋蔵量 for natural-resource reserves, 埋蔵文化財 for archaeological remains, and 埋蔵金 for buried treasure.

presentation.meaning: to flutter, swirl (in the air); to dance
presentation.defJa: 花びらや雪などが空中をひらひらと飛ぶ。また、美しく体を動かして踊る。
presentation.note: Suggests graceful, flowing movement, both of traditional dance and of petals, snow or leaves in the air; 踊る is more rhythmic and energetic.

presentation.defJa: ちょうど上の位置。まっすぐ上。
presentation.note: More emphatic than plain 上, meaning exactly overhead; its opposite is 真下.

presentation.defJa: 催しの当日より前に、入場券などを売ること。
presentation.note: Usually written 前売り and most often met in 前売り券 (advance ticket), in contrast to 当日券 sold on the day of the event.

presentation.meaning: to entrust, to leave (a task) to someone
presentation.defJa: 仕事などをほかの人に頼んで、その人の判断でやらせる。
presentation.note: A slightly clipped, more colloquial variant of 任せる with the same meaning; 任せる is far more common in writing, but 任す survives in set phrases like 運を天に任す.

presentation.defJa: 勝負や議論で、相手に勝つ。
presentation.note: The transitive counterpart of 負ける, putting the beaten opponent in object position (相手を負かす); in everyday speech 勝つ with に is more common.

presentation.meaning: to be diverted (from worries); to slip into, blend into (a crowd)
presentation.defJa: ほかのことに心が向いて、つらさなどを一時忘れる。また、まわりの中に入って見分けがつかなくなる。
presentation.note: Covers both having one's mind taken off something (気が紛れる) and blending in until indistinguishable (人混みに紛れる); the transitive 紛らわす means to distract oneself on purpose.

presentation.defJa: うそや飾りのない、相手を思う気持ち。
presentation.note: A warm, slightly literary word for heartfelt sincerity toward others, typical in 真心を込めて; 誠意 is the more formal, business-like counterpart.

presentation.defJa: うそや偽りのない、まじめな心。また、本当のこと。
presentation.note: A literary, somewhat old-fashioned word that appears in modern prose mainly in set phrases like 誠を尽くす or 嘘か誠か, while 誠実 and 真実 handle everyday use.

presentation.defJa: 本当に。心から。改まった場面で使う言い方。
presentation.note: A formal intensifier used in apologies, thanks and official announcements; it is more ceremonious than 本当に and rarely heard in casual speech.
collocations: 誠に申し訳ございません
誠にありがとうございます

presentation.meaning: to surpass, to be superior to
presentation.defJa: ほかのものと比べて、それより上である。すぐれている。
presentation.note: Takes に for the thing surpassed and is common in set phrases like 聞きしに勝る and 健康に勝るものはない; 優れる describes excellence without an explicit comparison.

presentation.defJa: 数や割合のあとについて、それだけ多くなっていることを表す。
presentation.note: Attached to amounts or proportions, especially 割, to mean 'that much extra' in price and wage contexts; written as one noun, 割増 refers to the surcharge itself.

presentation.meaning: to mix in, to include; to exchange (words, views)
presentation.defJa: ほかのものを中に入れていっしょにする。また、言葉などをやりとりする。
presentation.note: Somewhat formal; used for weaving one element into another (冗談を交えて) or exchanging words or blows (言葉を交える), whereas 混ぜる is the everyday verb for physically mixing.
collocations: 身振り手振りを交えて

presentation.defJa: あるもののちょうど下。まっすぐ下の位置。
presentation.note: Stresses the point exactly beneath something and pairs with 真上 (directly above); 下 alone is vaguer and can mean anywhere lower.

presentation.defJa: 手術などのとき、薬を使って痛みを感じなくすること。
presentation.note: The standard medical term, used with かける for administering it and 切れる for it wearing off; 局所麻酔 and 全身麻酔 distinguish local from general anesthesia.

presentation.defJa: 時間と場所を決めておいて、人と会うこと。
presentation.note: The everyday word for meeting at an agreed time and place, used for friends, dates and business alike; 約束 refers to the promise itself rather than the meeting.

presentation.defJa: 早くその時が来てほしいと、楽しみにしている気持ちである。
presentation.note: Describes the time or event one is impatient for (春が待ち遠しい), whereas 楽しみだ focuses on the pleasure of anticipation itself.
collocations: 待ち遠しくてたまらない

presentation.meaning: to long for, to eagerly await
presentation.defJa: 早く実現することを強く願いながら、長い間待つ。
presentation.note: Stronger and more formal than 待つ, implying long, hopeful waiting for something important such as peace, a cure or a homecoming.

presentation.meaning: final stage, last years (of a period); terminal stage (of an illness)
presentation.defJa: ある時代や物事が終わりに近づいた時期。
presentation.note: Read まっき it means the closing phase of an era or the terminal stage of a disease; the reading まつご is the literary word for one's dying moments, as in 末期の水.

presentation.meaning: (split) right in two, into two equal halves
presentation.defJa: ちょうど半分ずつ、二つに分かれること。
presentation.note: An emphatic form of 二つ, used literally for cutting something cleanly in half and very often figuratively for opinion splitting evenly (世論が真っ二つに割れる).
collocations: 意見が真っ二つに分かれる

presentation.defJa: ばらばらでなく、全体が一つにそろっている状態。
presentation.note: Normally written in kana; it describes how well a group or a piece of writing holds together, while the sense of reaching a settlement belongs more to the verb まとまる (話がまとまる).

presentation.defJa: いくつかの内容を整理して、短く一つにしたもの。
presentation.note: Normally written in kana; it most often means a summary or wrap-up (今日のまとめ), and in compounds like まとめ買い it means doing something all at once.

presentation.defJa: 人を呼んで、来てもらうこと。
presentation.note: A formal noun from 招く, typically used in ～の招きで or ～の招きを受けて for official visits; 招待 is the standard word for an invitation to an event.

presentation.defJa: まぶたを素早く閉じて、すぐに開けること。
presentation.note: The everyday word for blinking, often written in kana; the same kanji 瞬き read またたき is used for the twinkling of stars or lights.
collocations: まばたきもせずに見つめる

presentation.meaning: paralysis; (of traffic or functions) being paralyzed, coming to a standstill
presentation.defJa: 体の一部が動かなくなること。また、交通などの働きが止まってしまうこと。
presentation.note: Used both medically and very often figuratively for systems grinding to a halt (交通麻痺, 機能が麻痺する); newspapers usually write it まひ because 痺 is not a jōyō kanji.

presentation.defJa: 目の上に、横に並んで生えている毛。
presentation.note: The basic word for eyebrow and the core of idioms of expression such as 眉をひそめる (to frown in disapproval); 眉毛 is the more colloquial everyday form.

presentation.defJa: 昔から遊びに使われてきた、丸くて弾む玉。
presentation.note: A traditional or literary word for a ball used in games such as 蹴鞠 and 手鞠; modern sports balls are ボール or 球.

presentation.defJa: 切ったり分けたりしないで、そのまま全部。
presentation.note: Casual and very common, used for food eaten whole or for taking something in its entirety (教科書を丸ごと覚える); 全部 is more neutral and does not stress keeping the thing intact.

presentation.meaning: a whole, fully (a full stretch of time or amount); plump
presentation.defJa: ある期間や量の全部。また、よく太っている様子。
presentation.note: Before quantities of time or money it stresses the full amount (丸々一週間), and with と it describes something plump and round (丸々と太った子犬); 丸ごと refers to an object kept whole.

presentation.meaning: to roll into a ball, to crumple; to curl up, hunch (one's back)
presentation.defJa: 形を丸くする。また、紙などをくしゃくしゃにして小さくする。
presentation.note: Covers rolling or crumpling something into a ball and curling the body (背中を丸める); 頭を丸める idiomatically means shaving one's head, often as a show of contrition, and 端数を丸める means rounding off numbers.

presentation.defJa: 全体がまるく光って見える月。
presentation.note: The standard word for the full moon in both science writing and poetry; it contrasts with 新月 (new moon) and 三日月 (crescent), while 名月 refers specifically to the admired harvest moon.

presentation.meaning: right in front, directly in front
presentation.defJa: ちょうど前。まっすぐ前の場所。
presentation.note: A colloquial, emphatic form of 前 meaning exactly in front of something; 目の前 often carries the sense of 'right before one's eyes', while 真ん前 stresses precise position.

presentation.defJa: どこから見ても、形がきれいにまるい。
presentation.note: An emphatic, conversational form of 丸い stressing a perfect circle, often used for eyes, the moon or plump faces; 真ん丸 alone works as a noun or na-adjective.

presentation.defJa: 少しのゆがみもなく、まるい様子。
presentation.note: An emphatic, vivid form of 丸い, normally written 真ん丸い or まん丸い; 真ん円い is a rare variant spelling.

presentation.meaning: noun-forming suffix: -ness, a taste or quality of (e.g. sweetness, bitterness, umami)
presentation.defJa: 形容詞の語幹や一部の名詞について、そうした性質や感じがあることを表す名詞を作る。甘い・苦いなど、舌で感じる感覚によく使う。
presentation.note: Attaches to adjective stems (甘み, 苦み) and some nouns (人間味, 現実味); unlike ～さ, which measures a degree (甘さ), ～み names a quality you actually sense. Newspapers usually write taste words in kana (甘み, 苦み), while 味 is kept in words like うま味, 人間味 and 現実味.

presentation.meaning: arranged marriage meeting; formal introduction with a view to marriage
presentation.defJa: 結婚を考える男女が、人の紹介で会うこと。
presentation.note: Usually said with polite お (お見合い); 見合い結婚 is the standard contrast to 恋愛結婚.

presentation.meaning: to overlook, to fail to notice
presentation.defJa: 注意して見ていたのに、大事な点に気づかずに過ぎてしまう。
presentation.note: 見落とす stresses failing to notice something that was in front of you while checking, whereas 見逃す can also mean deliberately letting something pass or missing a chance to watch.

presentation.defJa: 文明がまだ開けていないこと。また、土地などがまだ人の手で開かれていないこと。
presentation.note: Applied to peoples it now sounds dated and condescending, so modern writing mostly uses it for places or fields (未開の地), often alongside the related 未開拓.

presentation.defJa: 舌で甘さや苦さなどを感じ取る感覚。
presentation.note: The standard word for the sense of taste, one of the five senses; it also means seasonal delicacies, as in 秋の味覚. In casual talk about someone's palate people often say 舌 (舌が肥えている).

presentation.defJa: 木の根もとから上へのびる、太い中心の部分。
presentation.note: Mainly the trunk of a tree, but also used figuratively for the core of something; in compounds the kanji is read かん, as in 幹部 (executives) and 幹線 (trunk line).

presentation.defJa: まだ結婚していないこと。
presentation.note: A neutral, statistical word used in surveys and news; in conversation people say 独身, which can also include divorced people, while 未婚 means never married.

presentation.defJa: 経験や技術がまだ十分でないこと。また、果物などがまだ熟していないこと。
presentation.note: Used for skill and character (未熟者 is a common humble self-description) and literally for unripe fruit or premature babies (未熟児); 下手 is more casual and only about skill.

presentation.meaning: (with a negative) not the slightest bit, not at all; tiny particle
presentation.defJa: ごく小さなもの。打ち消しの言葉といっしょに使って、少しも、まったくという意味を表す。
presentation.note: In modern Japanese it appears mostly in 微塵も…ない, a stronger and more literary 少しも…ない, and in the cooking term みじん切り, which is usually written in kana.

presentation.defJa: 食べ物などに含まれている水分。しめりけ。
presentation.note: Common in cooking instructions (水気を切る, to drain); 水分 is the more technical, measurable term, while 湿気 refers to humidity in the air.

presentation.defJa: 自分の持ち物などを、得意になってわざと人に見せる。
presentation.note: Always disapproving: deliberately flaunting possessions so others will envy them; 自慢する is broader and can be done in words alone.
collocations: 新しい服を見せびらかす
腕時計を見せびらかす

presentation.meaning: show, spectacle, sideshow; object of public curiosity
presentation.defJa: 珍しいものや芸を人に見せて、料金を取る興行。また、人の好奇の目にさらされるもの。
presentation.note: Usually written 見世物; besides old-style sideshows it is used figuratively for being made a spectacle of (見世物にされる), which carries a sense of humiliation.

presentation.meaning: to meet, to satisfy (a condition or standard); to fill
presentation.defJa: 条件や基準などに、足りないところがないようにする。また、いっぱいにする。
presentation.note: Common in formal writing for meeting requirements (要件を満たす) and literally for filling a container or stomach; its intransitive counterpart is 満ちる.

presentation.meaning: to disturb, to disrupt, to throw into disorder
presentation.defJa: 整っている状態をくずして、ばらばらにする。
presentation.note: Transitive partner of 乱れる; common in set phrases like 和を乱す (to disrupt group harmony) and 風紀を乱す, usually with a disapproving tone.

presentation.meaning: to be disrupted, to fall into disorder
presentation.defJa: きちんとした状態が保てなくなり、まとまりがなくなる。
presentation.note: Intransitive partner of 乱す; very common in news about transport (ダイヤが乱れる) and for disordered hair, sleep or lifestyles.

presentation.defJa: まだ知られていないこと。
presentation.note: Formal and usually followed by の before a noun (未知の生物); 未知数 means an unknown quantity and is common for uncertain prospects.

presentation.meaning: to guide, to lead (to a result)
presentation.defJa: 人や物事を、ある方向や結果へ進むように案内する。
presentation.note: More formal than 案内する and often abstract: leading people or a team to a result (優勝に導く) or deriving a conclusion (結論を導き出す).

presentation.defJa: すきまなく、ぎっしりと集まること。
presentation.note: Used of buildings, people or plants packed closely together; during the pandemic it became familiar as one of the 三密 (密閉・密集・密接).

presentation.defJa: 一定の体積や面積の中に、ものがどれだけつまっているかの度合い。
presentation.note: A physics term that is also used widely for population (人口密度) and figuratively for how packed something is, as in 密度の濃い一日.

presentation.defJa: 仕事や品物にかかる費用などを、前もって計算して出すこと。また、その金額。
presentation.note: The standard business word for a price quote (the document is 見積書); 概算 is a rougher estimate and 予算 is the amount you plan to spend.

presentation.defJa: まだはっきり決まっていないこと。
presentation.note: Very common in notices and news (詳細は未定です); 未決 refers to matters still awaiting a decision, and 不定 means indefinite or irregular.

presentation.meaning: to regard as, to treat as, to deem
presentation.defJa: 実際はどうであれ、そうであると判断して扱う。
presentation.note: Usually written みなす in newspapers and legal texts, where it means treating something as true by rule regardless of fact; it is firmer and more official than 考える.
collocations: 同意したものとみなす

presentation.meaning: to follow someone's example, to learn by watching
presentation.defJa: よい手本を見て、そのとおりにまねをする。
presentation.note: Implies imitating a good model (見習うべき点); 真似る is neutral imitation, and the noun 見習い means an apprentice or trainee.

presentation.defJa: 服装や髪型など、人の外から見た様子。
presentation.note: Refers to one's overall dress and grooming as others see it; slightly more formal than 格好, while 服装 refers to the clothes alone.

presentation.defJa: 山のいちばん高いところ。また、高くつらなる山の部分。
presentation.note: A literary, scenic word for a mountain peak, often in the plural 峰々; 頂上 is the plain word for the summit, and 峰 can also mean the back edge of a blade.

presentation.meaning: one's circumstances, one's life story; one's lot or welfare
presentation.defJa: その人の境遇や、これまでの人生のこと。
presentation.note: Mostly heard in 身の上話 (one's life story) and 身の上相談 (a personal advice column); it is somewhat old-fashioned and personal, unlike the neutral 境遇.

presentation.meaning: to miss (seeing); to overlook; to let pass
presentation.defJa: 見る機会をのがす。また、気づかずに、あるいはわざと、そのままにしておく。
presentation.note: Covers missing a chance to watch something, failing to notice, and deliberately letting something go (今回だけは見逃す); 見落とす is only failing to notice during a check.

presentation.meaning: to judge (the right moment); to choose at one's discretion
presentation.defJa: ちょうどよい時やものを、よく考えて選ぶ。
presentation.note: Today mostly used with time words (頃合い, タイミング) for picking the right moment after watching the situation; the older sense of choosing suitable goods at one's discretion (品物を見計らう) is now rare.
collocations: タイミングを見計らう

presentation.defJa: 高い所などから遠くまで広く見わたせること。また、その景色。
presentation.note: Describes an open, unobstructed view from a vantage point, usually with いい or よい; 眺め is the more general word for a view and 景色 is the scenery itself.

presentation.defJa: 気持ちや考えを伝えるために、手や体を動かすこと。
presentation.note: A native word for bodily gestures in general, often doubled as 身振り手振り; it is close to ジェスチャー but sounds a little more written.

presentation.defJa: 心臓の動きにあわせて、血管が規則正しく打つこと。
presentation.note: The basic medical word for pulse; the idiom 脈がある also means there is still hope, often about romance or negotiations.

presentation.meaning: to look out over; to survey (a scene)
presentation.defJa: 高い所などから、広い範囲を遠くまで一度に見る。
presentation.note: Used for taking in a wide view at a glance; 見渡す限り means 'as far as the eye can see', and it also extends to surveying a field, as in 業界を見渡す.

presentation.defJa: 一般の家庭が自宅などを使って営む、小さな宿泊施設。
presentation.note: A small, family-run lodging typical of rural and coastal Japan, simpler and cheaper than a 旅館; it differs from 民泊, which means lodging in private homes, often arranged through online platforms.

presentation.defJa: 言葉や文化、歴史などを共有する人々の集まり。
presentation.note: Refers to a people defined by shared language, culture and descent, as in 少数民族; do not confuse it with the homophone 民俗, which means folk customs.

presentation.defJa: 昔から一般の人々の間に伝わってきた、暮らしの習慣や行事、信仰など。
presentation.note: Refers to the traditional customs, festivals and beliefs of ordinary people and appears mostly in compounds like 民俗学; it is a homophone of 民族 (ethnic group), so the kanji carry the meaning.

presentation.defJa: 行為や言葉に、価値や効果が何もないようす。
presentation.note: Stronger and more formal than 意味がない; it often passes judgment on efforts, arguments or rules as pointless.

presentation.defJa: 口数が少なく、あまりしゃべらない性格や態度。
presentation.note: Describes habitual quietness as a personality trait, neutral or even affectionate in tone, whereas 寡黙 is more literary and suggests dignified restraint.

presentation.meaning: son-in-law; man who marries into his wife's family
presentation.defJa: 娘の夫。また、結婚して妻の家に入る男性。
presentation.note: Means a daughter's husband from her family's point of view, and especially a man who joins his wife's household; it is the counterpart of 嫁.

presentation.defJa: 法的な効力や効き目がないこと。
presentation.note: A formal term for something lacking legal or practical force, common in law, elections (無効票) and technical settings; its opposite is 有効.

presentation.meaning: ending, conclusion (of a text or speech)
presentation.defJa: 文章や話、行事などの終わりの部分。
presentation.note: Used for the closing part of a speech, letter or event (結びの一番 is the last sumo bout of the day); in other contexts it can mean a knot or a rice ball, as in おむすび.

presentation.defJa: 人や物事の間にある、つながりや関係。
presentation.note: A neutral word for ties between people, groups or things, often with 強い or 深める; it is close to つながり but slightly more formal.

presentation.meaning: to be connected; to lead to (a result)
presentation.defJa: 二つ以上のものがつながる。また、ある結果につながる。
presentation.note: Intransitive, and often used for one thing leading to a result (成果に結び付く); 結び付ける is the transitive 'to link one thing to another', and both are also written 結びつく/結びつける.

presentation.meaning: to link, to connect (one thing to another)
presentation.defJa: あるものと別のものをつなげて、関係を持たせる。
presentation.note: Transitive counterpart of 結び付く, used for deliberately connecting efforts, ideas, or causes and results; 安易に結び付ける warns against jumping to conclusions.
collocations: 経験を仕事に結び付ける

presentation.defJa: 電線を使わず、電波で通信すること。
presentation.note: Covers both radio communication (無線機, アマチュア無線) and wireless technology such as wireless networks, though everyday tech talk often uses ワイヤレス instead.

presentation.defJa: お金や物を、役に立たないことに使ってしまうこと。
presentation.note: An everyday word for wasteful spending that also appears critically in the news as 税金の無駄遣い (waste of taxpayers' money); 浪費 is the more formal equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 前もって相手の許しを得たり、知らせたりしないこと。
presentation.note: Formal and common in notices and rules (無断転載禁止, 無断駐車), stressing that required permission or notice was not given.

presentation.defJa: 物事についての知識がないこと。
presentation.note: A fairly strong word that can sound judgmental about someone's lack of knowledge, unlike the neutral 知らない; 無知の知 is the standard rendering of Socratic ignorance.

presentation.meaning: messed up, in a shambles; absurd, unreasonable
presentation.defJa: 筋道が立たず、ひどく乱れているようす。
presentation.note: Colloquial and emphatic, usually written in kana; it describes things wrecked or in chaos and unreasonable behavior, and in casual speech it works as an intensifier like めちゃくちゃ.

presentation.defJa: 中身や意味がなく、何をしてもかいがないと感じるようす。
presentation.note: Expresses a hollow sense of futility or emptiness about effort or words that came to nothing; it is usually written in kana or as 虚しい, with 空しい a less frequent spelling.

presentation.defJa: 思いどおりにならず、ひどく悔しく残念に思うこと。
presentation.note: Stronger and more solemn than 残念, used for bitter regret over a defeat or an untimely death, as often in sports reporting; 無念を晴らす means to redeem or avenge it.

presentation.defJa: 仕事などをうまくこなす力がないこと。
presentation.note: A harsh, often insulting judgment of someone's ability, frequent in political criticism; its opposite is 有能.

presentation.defJa: よく考えずに、度を越して何かをするようす。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana, it criticizes doing something rashly or to excess without good reason, and is typical of advice and warnings in the pattern むやみに～しない.

presentation.defJa: 必要がないこと。役に立たないこと。
presentation.note: Formal, and frequent in set phrases such as 心配はご無用 ('no need to worry'), 問答無用 ('no arguments') and 天地無用 ('this side up') on parcels.

presentation.defJa: 色や質、調子などが一様でなく、ばらつきがあること。
presentation.note: Almost always written in kana (むら or ムラ); it covers physical unevenness such as patchy paint or dye and figurative inconsistency, as in 成績にむらがある.

presentation.defJa: たくさんの人や生き物が、一か所にびっしりと集まる。
presentation.note: Suggests a dense, often disorderly crowd of people, insects or animals; used figuratively it implies greed, as in 利権に群がる (to flock to vested interests).

presentation.defJa: 言うまでもなく。当然のことながら。
presentation.note: A somewhat formal, written equivalent of もちろん, common in essays and editorials, and also written in kana as むろん.
collocations: 無論それだけではない

presentation.defJa: その土地で作られたり、とれたりする、よく知られた産物。
presentation.note: Refers to a product a region is famous for, whether food or crafts; it is close to 特産, which stresses that something is produced there, while 名産 stresses its fame.

presentation.meaning: name (official name of a thing, body or place)
presentation.defJa: 物や組織、場所などにつけられた正式な呼び名。
presentation.note: A formal word for the name of an organization, product, facility or concept, not of a person, for which 名前 or 氏名 is used.

presentation.defJa: 矢や弾などが、ねらった目標に当たること。
presentation.note: Used for projectiles striking their target, such as arrows, bullets, missiles or a space probe; a hit in baseball is ヒット or 安打 instead.

presentation.defJa: はっきりしていて、わかりやすいこと。
presentation.note: A formal word for clarity of speech, writing or explanation; it sounds more written than はっきり and appears in set phrases like 簡潔明瞭 and its opposite 不明瞭.

presentation.defJa: はかりで量った物の重さ。
presentation.note: A slightly old-fashioned everyday word for the weight of goods or a person, heard at markets and in casual speech; 重さ is the neutral word and 重量 the technical one.

presentation.defJa: 自然や神などから与えられる、ありがたいもの。
presentation.note: Used for gifts of nature or providence such as rain, harvests and seafood; it sounds warmer and more grateful than 恩恵, which is drier and often used for benefits of systems or technology.

presentation.meaning: to give (money, food) out of charity or pity
presentation.defJa: 気の毒に思って、金や物を与える。
presentation.note: Means giving money or food out of pity, so it implies the giver stands above the receiver; the passive 恵まれる (to be blessed with) is far more common in everyday Japanese.

presentation.defJa: 驚くほどすばらしく、はっきりと目立っている。
presentation.note: Used in news and essays for striking progress, growth or achievement and almost always positive; usually spelled 目覚ましい today, and unlike 著しい it is not used for changes for the worse.

presentation.meaning: to wake up; to awaken (to something)
presentation.defJa: 眠りからさめる。また、ある物事に気づき、意識するようになる。
presentation.note: Slightly more literary than 起きる or 目が覚める, and also used figuratively for awakening to a talent, a cause or a sense of self (〜に目覚める).

presentation.meaning: (honorific) to like, be pleased with; to wear, eat, catch (a cold), etc.; (literary) to summon
presentation.defJa: 「着る」「食べる」「(風邪を)ひく」「(年を)とる」「呼び寄せる」などを、その動作をする人を敬って言う語。
presentation.note: An honorific verb that survives mainly in fixed phrases: お気に召す (to be to someone's liking), お召しになる (to wear), お年を召した (elderly) and お風邪を召す. The summoning sense lives on mainly in 天に召される (to pass away), and the related 召し上がる is the everyday honorific for eating.

presentation.defJa: 動物で、卵や子を産むほうの性。
presentation.note: Used for animals and plants, never for people (who are 女性 or 女), and in casual writing it is often spelled in katakana as メス.

presentation.meaning: look in one's eyes, expression of the eyes
presentation.defJa: 物を見るときの目のようす。
presentation.note: Describes the impression someone's eyes give, often a negative one (目つきが悪い); usually written 目つき, and different from 視線, which is simply the direction of a gaze.

presentation.defJa: 物事の見通しや、目指すところ。
presentation.note: Read めど and usually written めど in newspapers; it appears mostly in 目途が立つ (to have a prospect of) and 〜を目途に (aiming for, by about), and is vaguer than 目標. In government speech 目途 is sometimes read もくと.

presentation.defJa: 長さや量などを測るために、物差しや計器につけたしるし。
presentation.note: Refers to the graduated marks on rulers, gauges, dials and measuring cups; usually written 目盛り in everyday text, with 目盛 alone appearing mainly in technical writing.

presentation.meaning: visit, meeting (with someone in a hospital, facility or office)
presentation.defJa: 人をたずねて、直接会うこと。
presentation.note: Used for arranged visits or meetings, especially in hospitals, prisons and offices; 面接, by contrast, is an interview in which someone is evaluated, as for a job.

presentation.defJa: 義務や支払いなどを、しなくてもよいとすること。
presentation.note: A formal word used for fees, taxes, exams and duties in official contexts; it releases someone from an obligation entirely, whereas 減免 can also mean a partial reduction.

presentation.meaning: to face (onto), to look out on
presentation.defJa: 建物や土地などが、ある方向や場所に向いている。
presentation.note: Used mainly for buildings, rooms and towns facing a street, the sea or a direction, usually as 〜に面した; for facing a difficulty, 直面する is far more common.

presentation.defJa: 世間に対する名誉や体裁。
presentation.note: Concerns one's honor or standing in others' eyes, much like English 'face'; it is a little more formal than 顔 in 顔が立つ, and is also read めんもく, especially in 面目躍如.

presentation.defJa: あみの目のように各地を結ぶ仕組みや組織を表す語。
presentation.note: Attached to nouns to mean a network spread across an area, as in 交通網 or 情報網; it is read もう in these compounds, while the standalone noun 網 (a net) is read あみ.

presentation.meaning: to establish, set up, provide (rules, facilities, opportunities)
presentation.defJa: 新しく作ったり用意したりする。規則などを定める。
presentation.note: A formal verb for setting up facilities, opportunities, rules or a gathering (席を設ける), common in official and news writing; 作る is the everyday equivalent and 設置する is used more for physical installations.

presentation.meaning: to formally propose or request; to lodge (a protest)
presentation.defJa: 相手に対して、自分の意見や希望を正式に伝える。
presentation.note: A formal verb for officially conveying a protest, request or proposal to another party, typical of diplomacy and business; compare 申し出る, which is coming forward to offer or report something oneself.

presentation.defJa: 参加や購入などを希望して、相手に伝えること。また、その手続き。
presentation.note: The noun of 申し込む, used for applications, entries and subscriptions; the spelling 申込 without okurigana is standard on forms and in compounds like 申込書, while running text usually writes 申し込み.
collocations: 申し込みを受け付ける

presentation.defJa: 自分から進んで意見や希望を伝えること。また、その内容。
presentation.note: The noun of 申し出る, meaning an offer, request or report made on one's own initiative; written 申出 on official forms such as 申出書, but usually 申し出 in ordinary prose.

presentation.meaning: to come forward with (a request or offer); to report
presentation.defJa: 自分から進んで、希望や意見などを相手に伝える。
