presentation.note: Usually refers to speed reading as a trained technique (速読術); its counterpart in reading pedagogy is 精読, slow and careful reading.

presentation.meaning: the Allied Powers; the Allies (in the World Wars)
presentation.defJa: 第二次世界大戦などで、手を組んで共通の敵と戦った国々。
presentation.note: In history it chiefly means the Allied Powers of the World Wars; in World War II they opposed 枢軸国 (the Axis). The wartime Allies called themselves the 'United Nations' in English, the name the UN later inherited, while Japanese keeps the two apart as 連合国 and 国際連合.

presentation.defJa: 二つの語が合わさって一つの語になるとき、後ろの語の初めの音が濁ること。
presentation.note: A technical linguistics term; native speakers apply the pattern intuitively but rarely use the word outside grammar study or language teaching.

presentation.defJa: いくつもの州や国が集まって一つの国をつくり、中央と各州が権限を分け合う政治のしくみ。
presentation.note: A political-science term contrasted with 単一国家 or 中央集権; it comes up when discussing countries such as the United States, Germany or India.

presentation.defJa: 物事が鎖のように次々とつながって起こること。
presentation.note: Common in news and analysis for events that trigger one another (倒産の連鎖, 負の連鎖); 連続 means a mere succession without the cause-and-effect link.

presentation.defJa: 決まった家を持たず、牛や羊などを連れて草や水を求めて移り住む人々。
presentation.note: A neutral term in history and anthropology; 遊牧民族 stresses an ethnic group, while 遊牧民 refers to the people and their way of life.

presentation.defJa: 古い状態から新しい状態へと移り変わっていく途中の時期。
presentation.note: Used in essays and news for societies, industries or technologies caught mid-change; it is more formal than 移り変わりの時期.

presentation.meaning: overheating (of a market, boom or competition); overheating (of a machine)
presentation.defJa: 熱くなりすぎること。また、物事の勢いが度を越して激しくなること。
presentation.note: Used literally for engines and batteries and, very often in news, figuratively for markets, competition or media coverage that has gone too far.

presentation.defJa: 目標をやりとげたときに感じる満足した気持ち。
presentation.note: Very common in everyday talk, work and education; it names the feeling of having completed something, while 満足感 is broader satisfaction not tied to a goal.

presentation.defJa: はっきり言わずに、それとなく分かるように言うようす。
presentation.note: Describes indirect speech and is often neutral or mildly critical; 婉曲 is the more formal, written equivalent.

presentation.defJa: 直接のきっかけではないが、もとをたどると関わっている原因。
presentation.note: A formal word paired with 近因 (proximate cause); it is common in history writing and in analyses of accidents or conflicts.

presentation.meaning: expedition; military campaign (to a distant land)
presentation.defJa: 戦いや試合、調査などのために、遠くの土地まで出かけていくこと。
presentation.note: Historically a military campaign to distant lands; today it is also very common in sports for away games and overseas tours (海外遠征).

presentation.defJa: 体や頭にかける、多すぎも少なすぎもしないちょうどよい負担。
presentation.note: Common in fitness, health and learning contexts; 負荷 is more technical than 負担 and suggests a load deliberately applied for training.

presentation.defJa: たくさんの情報の中から、特定のものだけに意識を向けて処理する心の働き。
presentation.note: A cognitive-psychology term; in plain speech one would say 注意を絞る or 特定のことだけに気を配る.

presentation.defJa: 親の体や性質の特徴が、子どもや子孫に受けつがれること。
presentation.note: A neutral scientific and everyday word; 遺伝 is the process of inheritance, while 遺伝子 is the gene itself.

presentation.defJa: 人口が都会に集まり、町が広がって都会らしくなっていくこと。
presentation.note: A standard term in geography, history and social science; the suffix -化 marks a process, so it describes change over time rather than the state of being urban.

presentation.defJa: 貿易で黒字を出し、金や銀をたくわえることで国を豊かにしようとする経済の考え方。
presentation.note: A history and economics term usually discussed in contrast to 自由貿易 or 重農主義; in modern commentary it can be used to criticize protectionist trade policy.

presentation.defJa: 国のお金の価値を金の量と結びつけ、お金と金を決まった割合で交換できるようにする制度。
presentation.note: An economic-history term; today it appears mainly in discussions of the interwar period or of arguments against managed currency (管理通貨制度).
collocations: 金本位制から離脱する

presentation.defJa: 銀行などのお金を貸し借りするしくみが大きく乱れ、経済全体が混乱すること。
presentation.note: Broader than 通貨危機, it covers bank failures, credit freezes and market crashes; in Japan it often recalls 2008 (リーマン・ショック) or the bank failures of the late 1990s.
collocations: 金融危機を乗り越える

presentation.defJa: 生き方の手本となるような、すぐれた教えを含んだ短い言葉。
presentation.note: A somewhat literary word for a precious maxim; 格言 is the standard term, and 名言 means any memorable quotation attributed to a person.

presentation.defJa: 冷戦の時代に、ソ連側の東ヨーロッパと西側の国々とを分けていた厳しい境界のたとえ。
presentation.note: A Cold War metaphor translated from the English 'Iron Curtain'; 竹のカーテン was the parallel phrase used for China.
collocations: 鉄のカーテンが下りる
鉄のカーテンの向こう側
鉄のカーテンが崩れる

presentation.defJa: 会話や引用、目立たせたい語などを囲むのに使う、かぎの形をした記号。
presentation.note: The standard Japanese quotation marks; because the kanji 鉤 is rare, the word is usually written かぎ括弧 or かぎかっこ, and the doubled form is called 二重かぎ括弧.

presentation.defJa: 実際とはちがうものを、本当だと感じたり思いこんだりすること。
presentation.note: Used both for perceptual illusions and for mistaken beliefs (～と錯覚する); 幻覚, by contrast, is a hallucination with no real stimulus behind it.

presentation.defJa: 厳しい練習をくり返して、体や心を強くすること。
presentation.note: A formal word suggesting long, rigorous training of body or spirit, typical in martial arts and sports writing; 訓練 is more neutral and practical.

presentation.meaning: to hold the key (to); to be the decisive factor
presentation.defJa: ものごとがうまくいくかどうかを決める、大事な役割を受け持つ。
presentation.note: A common journalistic idiom for the decisive factor or person; 鍵となる is a close alternative that sounds slightly less vivid.

presentation.defJa: 理由や根拠を示して、ある考えが正しいことを筋道立てて明らかにすること。
presentation.note: Academic and formal, it stresses the logical chain of reasoning behind a claim, whereas 証明 is broader and is the standard word for a mathematical proof.

presentation.defJa: 筆者がある問題について自分の意見を述べ、理由を挙げて読み手を説得しようとする文章。
presentation.note: Mainly a school and exam genre label; it overlaps with 評論, which suggests critique of culture or society, while 説明文 simply explains facts without arguing a position.

presentation.meaning: tone or slant of an argument (especially of the press)
presentation.defJa: 新聞や評論などで、意見の述べ方や主張の方向性。
presentation.note: Typically used of newspapers, editorials and commentators to describe the slant of their arguments, not of a person's tone of voice, which is 口調.

presentation.defJa: 戦争をしていた国どうしが、戦争を終わらせて平和を回復するために結ぶ取り決め。
presentation.note: A historical and diplomatic term that emphasizes formally ending a state of war; 平和条約 is the more general word, as in the Japan-China Treaty of Peace and Friendship.

presentation.defJa: 国民が選挙で選んだ代表者が議会で話し合い、国の政治を決めるしくみ。
presentation.note: A formal political-science term for representative democracy through an elected legislature, contrasted with 直接民主主義, in which citizens decide matters directly.
collocations: 議会制民主主義を守る
議会制民主主義の根幹
議会制民主主義の危機

presentation.meaning: negative legacy; harmful inheritance from the past
presentation.defJa: 過去から受け継いだもののうち、後の時代に害や重荷となっているもの。
presentation.note: Common in journalism and history for harmful legacies such as war damage, pollution or debt; 負の世界遺産 refers to sites such as the Hiroshima Peace Memorial that record tragedy.

presentation.defJa: 国や自治体などの支出が収入を上回り、お金が足りない状態。
presentation.note: The standard economic and news term for a government budget shortfall; do not confuse it with 貿易赤字 (trade deficit) or with the accumulated public debt that deficits produce.

presentation.defJa: 物と物を直接交換するのではなく、お金を仲立ちにして売り買いが行われる経済。
presentation.note: A textbook term in history and economics, contrasted with 自給自足 (self-sufficiency) or 物々交換 (barter); it describes a society-wide shift rather than individual purchases.
collocations: 貨幣経済に組み込まれる

presentation.defJa: 元手となるお金や工場などを持ち、人をやとって事業を行い利益を得る人。
presentation.note: A term from economics and social history, often paired with 労働者 in Marxist contexts; 投資家 (investor) is the neutral modern word for someone who puts money into businesses.

presentation.defJa: 利益の一部を使わずに積み立て、次の生産のための元手を増やしていくこと。
presentation.note: An economics term used especially in development economics and Marxist theory, where 本源的蓄積 means primitive accumulation; in everyday speech people would say 資金をためる instead.

presentation.defJa: 生まれつき持っている性質や才能。ある仕事や役割に向いている性質。
presentation.note: Refers to deep-seated qualities and aptitude, often in a formal evaluative sense such as a politician's fitness for office being questioned, whereas 素質 leans toward raw natural talent.
collocations: リーダーとしての資質

presentation.defJa: 発表や説明の後に、聞き手が疑問を出し、話し手がそれに答えること。
presentation.note: A formal four-character compound for Q&A at meetings, press conferences and lectures; in meetings it is often shortened to 質疑, as in 質疑に移ります.

presentation.meaning: four-part structure of introduction, development, turn and conclusion
presentation.defJa: 文章や話の組み立て方で、始まり、展開、変化、まとめの四つの段階からなるもの。
presentation.note: A traditional structure taken from Chinese quatrains and widely taught in Japanese schools; the turn is a shift of angle rather than a Western-style climax, and business writing usually prefers putting the conclusion first.
collocations: 起承転結がはっきりしている

presentation.defJa: 経済力や軍事力が非常に大きく、世界全体に強い影響力を持つ国。
presentation.note: Used in news and history for countries with global reach, classically the US and the USSR and now often the US and China; 大国 alone just means a major power.

presentation.defJa: 物事が全体として進んでいく方向。世の中の大きな流れ。
presentation.note: A formal written word common in editorials for the overall direction of events; 傾向 is the everyday word for a tendency, while 趨勢 suggests a large current that is hard to resist.

presentation.defJa: 勢いよく進歩したり、大きく発展したりすること。
presentation.note: Positive and somewhat formal, common in news about companies, parties or athletes making a big leap; 進歩 is neutral, gradual progress, while 躍進 implies a sudden jump in standing.

presentation.defJa: 生まれた家によって社会での地位や役割が決まり、それを簡単に変えられないしくみ。
presentation.note: A historical and sociological term for hereditary class systems such as Edo Japan's or India's caste system (カースト制度), not for job ranks within a company.

presentation.defJa: 人や集団の間で意見や利害が合わず、争いやもめごとが起きること。
presentation.note: A written, fairly formal word for friction between people, groups or countries; 摩擦 is the more common news word, as in 貿易摩擦, while 軋轢 stresses grinding, strained relations.

presentation.defJa: 他国から攻撃されたときに互いに助け合うことなどを、国どうしで約束する取り決め。
presentation.note: A formal term in history and international politics; 同盟 alone can also mean non-military alliances or federations, so 軍事 makes the defense commitment explicit.
collocations: 軍事同盟から離脱する

presentation.defJa: 国どうしが互いに負けまいとして、武器や兵力を増やし合うこと。
presentation.note: Used in history and current affairs as the opposite of 軍縮 (disarmament), and now also applied loosely to technology rivalries such as the race to develop AI.
collocations: 軍拡競争に歯止めをかける

presentation.defJa: 国が持っている兵器や兵力を減らすこと。
presentation.note: Short for 軍備縮小, it is common in news and history as the counterpart of 軍拡, and 核軍縮 specifically means nuclear disarmament.

presentation.defJa: 物事の流れや方向が大きく変わるきっかけとなる時点。
presentation.note: Neutral and widely used in news and essays; 分岐点 stresses a fork between paths and 節目 a milestone, while 転換点 stresses a change of direction.

presentation.defJa: 国が特定の品物を外国へ売り出すことを制限すること。
presentation.note: Very common in economic news today, for example on semiconductors; 輸出禁止 means an outright ban, while 輸出規制 covers licensing, quotas and partial restrictions.

presentation.defJa: 1911年に中国で起こり、清の王朝をたおして共和国が生まれるきっかけとなった革命。
presentation.note: A proper noun named after the 辛亥 year of the sixty-year calendar cycle, and a standard item in Japanese world-history textbooks.

presentation.defJa: 土地の持ち主と耕す人の関係を改め、農民が自分の土地を持てるようにする制度の変更。
presentation.note: In Japanese history it usually means the 1946-1950 reform under the Allied occupation; 土地改革 is the broader term often used for other countries' land reforms.

presentation.defJa: 昔のヨーロッパなどで、領主の土地にしばりつけられ、自由に移り住めなかった農民。
presentation.note: A history term for European and Russian serfs, distinct from 奴隷 (slaves) and from Japanese 小作人 (tenant farmers), who rented land rather than being legally bound to it.

presentation.defJa: 歴史の時代の分け方の一つで、中世と近代の間の時期。
presentation.note: A historians' period label that in Japanese history roughly covers the Azuchi-Momoyama and Edo periods, distinct from 近代 (the modern era from Meiji) and 中世 (the medieval period).

presentation.defJa: 古い社会の仕組みを改め、工業や制度、考え方を新しい時代に合ったものにしていくこと。
presentation.note: Used in history and development discussions, often implying Western-style industrialization and institutions; it is also used for upgrading equipment, as in 設備の近代化.

presentation.meaning: working backward (from a goal or deadline); back-calculation
presentation.defJa: 終わりや目標の時点から、さかのぼって必要なことや時間を計算すること。
presentation.note: Originally a math term for inverse calculation, it is now very common in self-help and business writing for planning backward from a deadline or goal.
collocations: 締め切りから逆算する
逆算して計画を立てる

presentation.defJa: 外国との行き来や貿易を厳しく制限して、国を閉ざすこと。
presentation.note: Primarily a historical term for the Tokugawa policy (c. 1639-1854), but also used figuratively for any closed, inward-looking organization or market.

presentation.defJa: 長い間、脳の中に保たれ続ける記憶。
presentation.note: A psychology and neuroscience term contrasted with 短期記憶 (short-term memory) and ワーキングメモリ; common in popular science and study-skills writing.
collocations: 長期記憶に定着させる

presentation.meaning: opening the country (to foreign contact and trade)
presentation.defJa: 外国との交流や貿易を始めて、国を外に開くこと。
presentation.note: The historical counterpart of 鎖国, usually referring to Japan's opening in the 1850s; it is also used figuratively for opening markets or institutions to the outside world.

presentation.meaning: openness (to experience, one of the Big Five traits)
presentation.defJa: 新しい考えや経験を進んで受け入れようとする性質。
presentation.note: In psychology it names the Big Five trait (経験への開放性); in everyday use it can also mean the openness of a space or organization, while 開放感 is the feeling of openness.

presentation.defJa: 物事と物事の間の、ちょうどよい時間や距離。
presentation.note: Originally a martial-arts term for the distance between opponents, it now commonly means well-judged timing or a pause in speech, comedy and negotiation; 間 alone is close but more abstract.

presentation.defJa: 時間をあけながら、同じことを何度も繰り返して覚える学習法。
presentation.note: A technical term from learning science, often mentioned alongside 分散学習 (distributed practice); casual writing may instead say 間隔をあけた復習.
collocations: 間隔反復を取り入れる

presentation.defJa: 輸入品にかける税の率を、他国の同意なしに自分の国で決められる権利。
presentation.note: A textbook term in Japanese history, almost always paired with 治外法権 (extraterritoriality) as the two main grievances of the unequal treaties.

presentation.meaning: perfect unspoken coordination; being in sync without words
presentation.defJa: 言葉にしなくても、互いの気持ちや動きがぴったり合うこと。
presentation.note: An idiom associated with the open- and closed-mouthed guardian statues at temple gates, used approvingly of teams, partners or colleagues; it stresses timing in joint action, while 以心伝心 stresses minds understanding each other.

presentation.defJa: ありふれていて、新しさや面白みがないようす。
presentation.note: A literary, critical word for ideas or expressions worn out by overuse; it is harsher than ありきたり, and 陳腐化 is also used in business for technology becoming obsolete.

presentation.defJa: 勢いが盛んで、大いに栄えること。
presentation.note: A formal written word for the vigorous flourishing of a family, nation, art form or industry; close to 繁栄, but it emphasizes rising momentum rather than settled wealth.

presentation.defJa: 資本家と労働者のように、利害の対立する社会の集団どうしが争うこと。
presentation.note: A Marxist term used in history, politics and sociology; it sounds academic or ideological, and everyday talk about inequality more often uses 格差 or 対立.

presentation.defJa: 「ような」などを使わずに、あるものを別のものにたとえる表現。
presentation.note: A rhetoric and literature term contrasted with 直喩 (simile); メタファー is the more common everyday loanword, while 比喩 covers figurative language in general.

presentation.defJa: 特定の仲間うちだけで通じるように作られた言葉。
presentation.note: Refers to words deliberately obscure to outsiders, used by trades, criminals or the police; 業界用語 is the neutral term for professional jargon, while 隠語 implies secrecy.

presentation.defJa: 人の心を動かすほど、力強く上手に話すようす。
presentation.note: Praises forceful, persuasive speech, and in modern writing is very often figurative, as in データが事実を雄弁に物語る (the data speak volumes); 能弁 is similar but can suggest glibness.

presentation.meaning: to lose concentration; to let one's focus lapse
presentation.defJa: 一つのことに向けていた気持ちが続かなくなる。
presentation.note: Common in sports commentary and coaching, often in the negative (集中を切らさない); it is the transitive counterpart of the more casual 集中力が切れる.
collocations: 最後まで集中を切らさず

presentation.defJa: 個人が持っていた土地や仕事を、まとめて共同で管理する形に変えること。
presentation.note: In history it usually refers to the forced collectivization of farming in socialist states; elsewhere 集団化 can simply mean people forming into groups.

presentation.defJa: 多くの国が約束を結び、どこかの国が侵略をすれば皆で対応して平和を守る仕組み。
presentation.note: An international-relations term for security guaranteed by all members against an aggressor among them; it is distinct from 集団的自衛権 (the right of collective self-defense), a contrast often raised in Japanese political debate.
collocations: 集団安全保障の枠組み

presentation.defJa: 人が大勢集まったときに生まれる、一人のときとは違う考え方や行動の傾向。
presentation.note: Used in everyday and media writing for how a group sways individuals, usually with a negative tone (panic, conformity); 群集心理 is a near-synonym focused specifically on crowds.

presentation.meaning: miscellaneous chores; minor tasks at work
presentation.defJa: 本来の仕事以外の、こまごまとした仕事。
presentation.note: Refers to minor workplace tasks outside one's main job, often with a note of complaint; 雑用 is the more casual everyday word and can also cover household errands.

presentation.defJa: 集中しようとしているときに、心に浮かんでくる余計な考え。
presentation.note: Common in meditation, sports and study contexts for thoughts that disturb concentration; it is milder than 邪念, which implies wicked or impure thoughts.

presentation.meaning: dispersal; scattering (of a family or people)
presentation.defJa: まとまっていた家族や人々が、ばらばらに散ってしまうこと。
presentation.note: A written word for families or peoples being scattered apart, best known from 一家離散 and 離散家族; scholarly writing may use ディアスポラ for diasporas, and in mathematics 離散 means "discrete."
collocations: 離散を余儀なくされる

presentation.defJa: 戦争や迫害などのために、自分の国を離れて逃れてきた人々。
presentation.note: The standard word for refugees in news and law (難民条約); it contrasts with 移民 (migrants), and in casual coinages ～難民 describes people stranded without something, as in 買い物難民.

presentation.defJa: 内容が複雑で、理解するのがとても難しいようす。
presentation.note: A written word for texts, theories or art that are hard to grasp; it is more formal than わかりにくい and implies dense or esoteric content rather than simple difficulty.

presentation.defJa: 対立していた国どうしの関係が、少しずつやわらいでいくこと。
presentation.note: Literally the spring melting of snow (also written 雪どけ); in news it widely means the easing of tense relations between countries or rivals, a use that spread from the Soviet "Thaw" after 1953. 緊張緩和 is the formal equivalent and デタント the loanword.

presentation.defJa: どの大国の陣営にも加わらず、独立した立場をとること。
presentation.note: A Cold War term, mostly seen in 非同盟運動 (the Non-Aligned Movement) and 非同盟諸国; it differs from 中立 (neutrality), a broader legal stance not tied to the Cold War blocs.

presentation.meaning: euphonic sound change (in Japanese word forms)
presentation.defJa: 言いやすくするために、単語の一部の音が別の音に変わること。
presentation.note: A grammar term used in classical and modern Japanese linguistics and school grammar, covering four types: イ音便, ウ音便, 撥音便 and 促音便.

presentation.defJa: 人が話すときの音が、どのように作られ、伝わり、聞き取られるかを研究する学問。
presentation.note: The study of speech sounds as physical events (articulation, acoustics, perception), distinguished from 音韻論, which studies how sounds function as a system within a language.

presentation.defJa: ことばを発音するときの、ひとまとまりの音の単位。
presentation.note: A linguistics term for a unit of pronunciation; in Japanese it is often contrasted with 拍 or モーラ, since a word like 東京 has two syllables but four morae.

presentation.defJa: 文章を声に出して読むこと。
presentation.note: The everyday sense is reading aloud, the opposite of 黙読 (silent reading); it is distinct from 音読み (on-reading of kanji), though 音読 is occasionally used for that too.

presentation.defJa: ある言語の中で、音がどのように区別され、どんな仕組みで使われているかを研究する学問。
presentation.note: The branch of linguistics that studies sound systems and contrasts (phonemes, accent, morae), complementing 音声学, which studies the physical production of sounds.

presentation.defJa: 詩や言葉の、音の長さや強弱、数などが作るリズムのきまり。
presentation.note: A technical term from poetics and linguistics (prosody), more formal than リズム and used for the patterned sound structure of verse or speech.

presentation.defJa: 音の数や響きなどに一定のきまりを持たせて書いた文章。詩や和歌など。
presentation.note: Contrasts directly with 散文 (prose); 韻文 is the category term for metrical writing, while 詩 refers to poems as individual works.

presentation.meaning: feudal lord; lord of a domain
presentation.defJa: ある土地を自分のものとして治め、そこに住む人々を支配した人。
presentation.note: Used for lords of a domain in feudal Europe or Japan; for Japanese history, more specific terms such as 大名 or 荘園領主 are often preferred.

presentation.defJa: 国が支配する土地の範囲を広げていくこと。
presentation.note: A formal term in history and international politics, usually carrying a critical tone that implies conquest or aggression.

presentation.meaning: one's mind is clear and sharp
presentation.defJa: 頭がはっきりして、よく考えられる状態になる。
presentation.note: Describes a temporary state of mental clarity, and 頭が冴えて眠れない (too wide awake to sleep) is a very common use, unlike 頭がいい, which is a lasting trait.

presentation.meaning: quickness of mind; how fast one thinks
presentation.defJa: ものを考えたり判断したりする速さ。
presentation.note: Almost always paired with 速い or 鈍い/遅い, it refers to the speed of thinking rather than depth of knowledge.

presentation.defJa: ばらばらな考えや情報をまとめて、わかりやすくすること。
presentation.note: A casual everyday phrase; 頭の整理がつく means one's thoughts have fallen into place, close to 考えをまとめる but softer.

presentation.defJa: 意味がよく似ている言葉。
presentation.note: The standard term in linguistics and dictionaries; 同義語 implies identical meaning, while 類義語 covers words that are merely similar.

presentation.defJa: 急に大きく進んだり、伸びたりする様子。
presentation.note: Mostly used adverbially as 飛躍的に with verbs of growth or improvement in news and reports; stronger than 大幅に, it suggests a jump rather than steady increase.

presentation.defJa: こしょうなど、料理に香りや辛みをつける品物を遠い地域と売り買いすること。
presentation.note: A history term for the long-distance trade in pepper, cloves, nutmeg and the like linking Asia and Europe, central to accounts of the Age of Discovery.
collocations: 香辛料貿易を独占する

presentation.defJa: 同じ音や似た音の言葉をかけて言う、軽い冗談。
presentation.note: Usually written ダジャレ in modern text, it carries a corny, groan-worthy image often tied to おやじギャグ, unlike the neutral literary term 掛詞 for puns in classical poetry.

presentation.defJa: 馬に乗って移動し、家畜を飼いながら暮らす人々の集団。
presentation.note: A history term for mounted nomadic peoples such as the Scythians, Xiongnu and Mongols; in Japan it also evokes the debated 騎馬民族征服王朝説 theory of the state's origins.

presentation.meaning: gist; main framework (of a plan, argument or text)
presentation.defJa: 計画や文章などの、中心となる大事な部分や全体の組み立て。
presentation.note: A formal word common in news about policies and bills (骨子案), close to 要点 but stressing the structural skeleton rather than just the key points.

presentation.defJa: 音の高い低いの違いで、言葉の意味を区別するしくみ。
presentation.note: A linguistics term contrasted with 強弱アクセント (stress accent) as in English; in everyday speech people simply say アクセント.
collocations: 高低アクセントを持つ言語
高低アクセントの違い
東京式の高低アクセント

presentation.defJa: 第二次世界大戦のあと、日本の経済が毎年大きく伸び続けた時代。
presentation.note: Refers specifically to Japan's postwar boom, often shortened to 高度成長, and is frequently discussed together with its social costs such as pollution.
collocations: 高度経済成長を支える

presentation.defJa: 物の値段が急に大きく上がること。
presentation.note: A news word used almost exclusively for prices and costs, often as 高騰する; stronger than 値上がり and the opposite of 暴落 or 下落.

presentation.meaning: nasal g (the [ŋ] pronunciation of g-row sounds)
presentation.defJa: 言葉の途中などにあるガ行の音を、鼻にかけてやわらかく出す発音。
presentation.note: A phonetics term for the [ŋ] variant of the g-sound, traditionally taught to broadcasters and singers but fading from everyday speech.

presentation.defJa: 人間という種がすべて死に絶え、地上からいなくなること。
presentation.note: A dramatic compound used in debates on existential risk and in fiction; more technical writing may prefer 人類の絶滅 or 存亡リスク.

presentation.meaning: the Mantra of Light (an esoteric Buddhist mantra)
presentation.defJa: 大日如来に祈る密教の短い呪文で、唱えると罪が消えるとされるもの。
presentation.note: A specialized Buddhist term from the Shingon tradition; 真言 alone means mantra in general, while this name refers to one specific mantra linked to Mahavairocana.

presentation.defJa: 半導体を作るとき、ウエハーの上に回路を作り込むまでの段階。
presentation.note: Semiconductor-industry jargon paired with 後工程; in general manufacturing it can also simply mean the preceding step in a process.

presentation.defJa: 生き物の体が長い年月をかけて石のように固まること。また、考えや仕組みが古いまま変わらなくなること。
presentation.note: Literally a paleontology term, it is widely used figuratively for knowledge, rules or language habits that have stopped changing, as with fossilized errors in second-language learning.

presentation.meaning: circuit line width (feature size of a chip process)
presentation.defJa: 半導体の中に作り込む回路の、線の太さや細かさ。
presentation.note: Japanese news shorthand for a chip's process node, as in 回路線幅2ナノの半導体, even though modern node names no longer match any physical width.
collocations: 回路線幅2ナノメートルの半導体

presentation.defJa: 仏教の教えを記した経典や、その解説などをすべて集めたもの。
presentation.note: Also called 一切経, it refers mainly to the Chinese-language Buddhist canon but can also name the Pali and Tibetan canons, and appears in history and religious studies.

presentation.defJa: 大量の文章を学習し、人間のように文を読んだり書いたりできるAIの仕組み。
presentation.note: The standard Japanese term for LLM, often shortened to LLM in tech writing, while everyday talk tends to say 生成AI instead.
collocations: 大規模言語モデルを開発する
大規模言語モデルの活用
大規模言語モデルを搭載する

presentation.meaning: back-end process (assembly, packaging and testing of chips)
presentation.defJa: 半導体を作るとき、回路ができたウエハーを切り分けて包み、検査する段階。
presentation.note: Semiconductor jargon paired with 前工程, it has drawn new attention as advanced packaging becomes key to chip performance; in general manufacturing it means the following step in a line.

presentation.defJa: 半導体の回路などを、より細かく小さくしていくこと。
presentation.note: Chip-industry term for shrinking feature sizes; more technical than 小型化, which refers to making a whole device smaller.

presentation.defJa: 一九八六年に日本とアメリカの間で結ばれた、半導体の貿易についての取り決め。
presentation.note: A proper noun from 1980s trade-friction history, often cited in discussions of why Japan's chip industry declined and in today's economic-security debates.
collocations: 日米半導体協定を結ぶ
日米半導体協定の締結
日米半導体協定の影響

presentation.meaning: optimal stopping (choosing the best moment to act)
presentation.defJa: 次々に現れる選択肢の中で、いつ選ぶのをやめて決めれば一番よいかを考える問題。
presentation.note: A term from probability and decision theory, known to general readers through the 秘書問題 (secretary problem) and popular books on algorithms for everyday life.

presentation.defJa: 紫外線の中でも特に波長が短い光で、半導体に細かい回路を描くのに使われるもの。
presentation.note: Usually abbreviated EUV in Japanese news (EUV露光装置); the full kanji form appears in formal articles explaining the technology.
collocations: 極端紫外線リソグラフィー

presentation.meaning: generalization (applying learned patterns to new data)
presentation.defJa: 学んだことを、まだ見たことのない新しい例にもうまく当てはめられること。
presentation.note: A machine-learning term, as in 汎化性能 (generalization performance); psychology usually writes the homophone 般化 for stimulus generalization, and everyday speech says 一般化.

presentation.defJa: 煩悩がすべて消え、迷いや苦しみから解き放たれた安らかな境地。仏教の最終的な目標。
presentation.note: A Buddhist technical term, originally a sound transliteration of Sanskrit nirvana. 涅槃に入る is also a reverent way of saying the Buddha or a great monk died, and paintings of the Buddha's death (涅槃図) are hung at temples for the 涅槃会 memorial around 15 February.

presentation.defJa: 大量のデータから学び、文章や画像、音声などを新しく作り出す人工知能。
presentation.note: The standard media term since 2023 for ChatGPT-style tools that create new content, as opposed to AI that only classifies or predicts.

presentation.defJa: 画面に映す絵や映像のための計算を、高速でまとめて行う電子部品。英語の略称はGPU。
presentation.note: The formal newspaper rendering of GPU, often with GPU added in parentheses; in tech conversation people simply say GPU.
collocations: 画像処理半導体を確保する
画像処理半導体の需要

presentation.defJa: 大乗仏教の「空」の教えを短くまとめたお経。日本で最もよく読まれる経典の一つ。
presentation.note: Often shortened to 心経; it is the sutra most Japanese have heard chanted, used by Zen, Shingon and Tendai temples alike, though not by the Jodo Shinshu or Nichiren schools.

presentation.meaning: to sound the alarm; to warn publicly of a danger
presentation.defJa: 危険が迫っていることを人々に知らせ、注意を呼びかける。
presentation.note: A fixed expression built on the image of a fire bell, typical of news and editorials about experts warning society; it is stronger and more public than 注意を促す.
collocations: 温暖化に警鐘を鳴らす

presentation.meaning: yin-yang and the five phases (wood, fire, earth, metal, water)
presentation.defJa: 万物を陰と陽、そして木・火・土・金・水の五つの要素で説明する古代中国の思想。
presentation.note: Usually met as 陰陽五行説 in history and culture writing; the philosophy is normally read いんよう (おんみょう is also heard), while the Japanese divination practice built on it is usually おんみょう (陰陽道, 陰陽師).

presentation.meaning: exposure (to light), esp. in chip lithography
presentation.defJa: 光に反応する材料に光を当てること。写真の撮影や、半導体の回路を焼き付ける工程でいう。
presentation.note: In camera talk the exposure setting is usually called 露出 (as in 露出補正), while 露光 names the physical act of letting light strike film or a wafer, as in 露光装置 for a lithography scanner.

presentation.defJa: 古代インドの思想で、一人ひとりの奥にある変わることのない本当の自分。真我。
presentation.note: A Sanskrit loan used in religion and philosophy writing, often glossed as 真我 or 我; it is exactly the permanent self that Buddhism's 無我 denies.
collocations: アートマンとブラフマン

presentation.meaning: the Westphalian system (order of sovereign states)
presentation.defJa: 主権を持つ国家が互いに対等で、他国の内政に干渉しないことを原則とする国際秩序。
presentation.note: A staple of international-relations and history writing, often invoked when commentators argue that globalization or supranational bodies are eroding state sovereignty.
collocations: ウェストファリア体制の成立
ウェストファリア体制以降
ウェストファリア体制の揺らぎ

presentation.defJa: 宗教や芸の道で、弟子を直接導く師。精神的な指導者。
presentation.note: In Indian religion and the classical arts it carries real reverence, but since the cult scandals of the 1990s it can also evoke a cult leader. Do not confuse it with the native word ぐる (accomplice, as in ぐるになる), usually written in hiragana.

presentation.defJa: 古代インドで宗教や学問に使われた古典の言葉。梵語ともいう。
presentation.note: The neutral modern name; older and Buddhist texts call it 梵語, and its script on Japanese temple markers is 梵字.
collocations: サンスクリット語の経典
サンスクリット語で書かれた
サンスクリット語に由来する

presentation.meaning: default mode network (brain network active at rest)
presentation.defJa: 何かに集中せず、ぼんやりしているときに活発になる脳の領域どうしのつながり。
presentation.note: A neuroscience loan term, often shortened to DMN in popular science writing about mind-wandering and meditation; it contrasts with the networks engaged during focused tasks.
collocations: デフォルトモードネットワークの活動
デフォルトモードネットワークが働く
デフォルトモードネットワークが活発になる

presentation.defJa: 一つの文には一つの事柄だけを書くという、文章を書くときの心得。
presentation.note: A maxim of business-writing and journalism guides; 一文一意 is used interchangeably.

presentation.defJa: 国々が中心と周辺に分かれ、分業によって一つに結びついているとみなす世界全体の仕組み。
presentation.note: A term from Wallerstein's historical sociology, almost always met as 世界システム論 or 近代世界システム in history and development-studies writing.

presentation.defJa: 文の初めの主語と終わりの述語が、うまく対応していない誤り。
presentation.note: A school-grammar and editing term used in essay correction and proofreading; also called 主語と述語のねじれ or simply 文のねじれ.
collocations: 主述のねじれが生じる
主述のねじれに気づく

presentation.meaning: dual-process theory (fast intuitive vs slow deliberate thinking)
presentation.defJa: 人の考え方には、速く直感的なものと、遅く論理的なものの二種類があるとする説。
presentation.note: The psychology umbrella term behind the popular System 1 and System 2 framing; general-audience books often use those labels instead.
collocations: 二重過程理論によれば
二重過程理論の枠組み
二重過程理論を提唱する

presentation.defJa: 種類の違う問題や技術を混ぜて、かわるがわる練習する学び方。
presentation.note: A cognitive-psychology term for interleaving, usually contrasted with ブロック練習 (blocked practice); popular learning-science books also call it インターリーブ学習.
collocations: 交互練習を取り入れる
交互練習とブロック練習

presentation.meaning: the introduction of Buddhism to Japan (6th century)
presentation.defJa: 六世紀半ば、朝鮮半島の百済から日本の朝廷へ、仏の教えが公式に伝えられたこと。
presentation.note: A fixed history-textbook term for the official introduction of Buddhism to Japan, dated 538 or 552, the event behind the clash between the Soga and Mononobe clans.

presentation.defJa: 出会った人とは、いつか必ず別れなければならないということ。世の無常を表す。
presentation.note: A literary four-character idiom of Buddhist origin, often paired with 生者必滅 or 盛者必衰 in farewell speeches, condolences and essays on impermanence.

presentation.defJa: 年齢や性別、職業、場面などの違いによって使い分けられる言葉。
presentation.note: A Japanese linguistics term built on 位相 (variation by social group or situation), as opposed to 方言, which varies by region; it appears mainly in academic and language-teaching writing.

presentation.defJa: 情報を少しの間頭の中にとどめておきながら、同時に考えたり処理したりする働き。
presentation.note: The kanji translation of working memory used in psychology texts; the katakana ワーキングメモリ is more common in popular and education writing.
collocations: 作業記憶に負荷がかかる

presentation.defJa: 古文で、文中の特定の助詞に合わせて、文末の活用形が決まるという決まり。
presentation.note: A core term of classical grammar taught in high-school 古文, rarely used outside discussions of classical texts or the history of the language.

presentation.defJa: 大脳の左右の横、耳に近いところにある部分。音や記憶、言葉の理解にかかわる。
presentation.note: A standard anatomy term in medical news and popular neuroscience, alongside 前頭葉, 頭頂葉 and 後頭葉 for the other lobes.

presentation.defJa: 自分の怠け心や欲望に打ち勝とうとする強い気持ち。
presentation.note: A formal, somewhat old-fashioned word with a moral flavor, common in school mottos and sports commentary; plainer equivalents are 自制心 or 意志の強さ.

presentation.defJa: 昔の中国の皇帝が、周りの国の君主に王の位を与え、形の上で君臣の関係を結んだ国際秩序。
presentation.note: A historians' term for the investiture side of the China-centered order; it overlaps with 朝貢体制 (tribute system), which emphasizes the tribute missions rather than the granting of titles.
collocations: 冊封体制に組み込まれる

presentation.defJa: 文章や話が、むだに長くてまとまりがなく、だらだらしている様子。
presentation.note: A written-style criticism of prose or speeches, close to 冗長; 冗漫 stresses slackness and lack of focus, while 冗長 stresses redundant length.

presentation.defJa: 最初に示された情報が、後の情報よりも強く記憶や印象に残る心理的な傾向。
presentation.note: A psychology term often paired with 新近効果 (recency effect); in business and self-help writing it is the science behind advice about first impressions.

presentation.defJa: 額の裏にある大脳の部分で、考える、計画する、気持ちを抑えるなどの高度な働きを受け持つ。
presentation.note: An anatomy term that became familiar through brain-training (脳トレ) books and games; it refers to the front part of 前頭葉, not the whole frontal lobe.
collocations: 前頭前野が活性化する

presentation.defJa: 労働者が賃金に見合う分を超えて生み出し、資本家のものとなる価値。
presentation.note: A Marxist economics term found in history, economics and social-theory writing; it is a technical concept, not a general word for extra value, which would be 付加価値.

presentation.defJa: 半導体のチップを作るために工場で使われる大型の機械。
presentation.note: A compound term frequent in business and economic-security news; 装置 here means large industrial systems, not handheld tools (器具).
collocations: 半導体製造装置メーカー
半導体製造装置の輸出規制

presentation.meaning: reading slowly to savor a text
presentation.defJa: 文章の意味や味わいを、じっくりと深く読み取ること。
presentation.note: A literary written word for slow, appreciative reading; close to 熟読 (careful reading for understanding) but it stresses enjoying the flavor of the text.

presentation.meaning: tō-on, the latest layer of kanji on-readings, from Song-era and later Chinese
presentation.defJa: 鎌倉時代以降に禅僧や商人を通じて中国から伝わった、漢字の読み方。
presentation.note: A technical term from Japanese linguistics, also called 唐宋音; it is the smallest and latest layer of on-readings, after 呉音 and 漢音.

presentation.defJa: 啓蒙思想の影響を受けて上からの改革を進めながら、絶対的な権力は保ち続けた十八世紀ヨーロッパの支配者。
presentation.note: A history-textbook term for 18th-century rulers of Prussia, Austria and Russia; the system itself is called 啓蒙専制主義 (enlightened absolutism).
collocations: 啓蒙専制君主と呼ばれる
啓蒙専制君主として知られる

presentation.defJa: 得られると予測していた報酬と、実際に得られた報酬との差。
presentation.note: A neuroscience and reinforcement-learning term that appears in popular science writing about dopamine, motivation and learning.
collocations: 報酬予測誤差が生じる
報酬予測誤差を計算する

presentation.defJa: 脳の奥にあって、感情や記憶、本能的な行動に関係する部分。
presentation.note: An anatomical term common in popular psychology and health articles, often contrasted with the reasoning frontal cortex (前頭葉, 前頭前野).
collocations: 大脳辺縁系が活性化する

presentation.defJa: 努力しても無駄だという経験が続いたために、何もしようとしなくなる状態。
presentation.note: A psychology term widely used in articles on education, workplace culture and depression; unlike laziness (怠惰), the passivity is learned from repeated failure.
collocations: 学習性無力感を克服する

presentation.meaning: implementation intention (an if-then plan for acting on a goal)
presentation.defJa: どんな状況になったら何をするかを、前もって具体的に決めておくこと。
presentation.note: A translated psychology term seen in self-help and behavior-change articles; it contrasts with 目標意図 (goal intention), which states only the desired outcome.

presentation.defJa: 昔、中国などの宮廷で皇帝や后に仕えた、去勢された男性の役人。
presentation.note: A historical term used mainly in writing about the Chinese and other imperial courts, often in connection with court intrigue and abuse of power.

presentation.meaning: province (of an empire, esp. ancient Rome)
presentation.defJa: 古代ローマなどで、本国の外にあって直接支配を受けた地域。
presentation.note: A history term used above all for the provinces of ancient Rome; a 属国 is a dependent state that keeps its own ruler, whereas a 属州 is administered directly.

presentation.meaning: jo-ha-kyū, the three-part flow of slow opening, development and swift climax
presentation.defJa: ゆっくり始まり、変化し、速く盛り上がって終わるという三つの段階の流れ。
presentation.note: Originally a term from gagaku and Noh aesthetics, now used broadly in writing about storytelling, music and speeches, often alongside 起承転結 as a structural model.

presentation.meaning: expressions that reflect social relationships (honorific, neutral, blunt or intimate speech)
presentation.defJa: 相手や話題の人物との上下関係や親しさに応じて使い分けられる、敬語やぞんざいな言い方などの言葉づかい。
presentation.note: A linguistics and Japanese-teaching term broader than 敬語: it includes rude, neutral and intimate forms as well as honorific ones.

presentation.defJa: 結びつきに必然的な理由がなく、たまたま決められているという性質。
presentation.note: In linguistics it is a neutral technical term, but in news writing the related 恣意的 usually criticizes decisions made at someone's whim.

presentation.defJa: 覚えた内容を、何も見ないで自分の頭から思い出すことで記憶を強める学習法。
presentation.note: A cognitive-psychology term seen in education articles; it is contrasted with 再読 (rereading), which feels productive but is less effective.
collocations: 想起練習を取り入れる
テストによる想起練習

presentation.defJa: 脳の奥にあり、恐怖や不安などの感情を生み出すアーモンド形の部分。
presentation.note: An anatomical term common in popular science and mental-health writing; 扁桃 means almond, and the tonsils are a different organ called 扁桃腺.

presentation.meaning: technology leakage (loss of know-how to outside parties)
presentation.defJa: 企業や国が持つ大切な技術や知識が、外部に漏れてしまうこと。
presentation.note: A business and policy term common in economic-security news; 流出 implies unintended loss outward, whereas 技術移転 (technology transfer) is a deliberate, agreed handover.

presentation.defJa: 全体と部分、または大きな種類と小さな種類の関係を利用して、ものを言い表す技法。
presentation.note: A rhetoric term used in literary and linguistic writing; it is sometimes treated as a subtype of 換喩 (metonymy) but specifically involves part-whole or genus-species relations.

presentation.defJa: あるものを、それと深いつながりのある別のもので言い表す技法。
presentation.note: A rhetoric term usually contrasted with 隠喩 (metaphor), which relies on similarity rather than contiguity.

presentation.defJa: 本来の意味を持っていた言葉が、しだいに文法的な働きをするものに変わっていくこと。
presentation.note: A linguistics term found in scholarly and popular-linguistics writing; it names a historical process of change, not grammar itself.

presentation.defJa: 言葉や文章がわかりにくく、意味をつかむのが難しいようす。
presentation.note: A bookish word used mainly in criticism and reviews of prose; it is more formal than 難解 and suggests murky, tangled writing rather than simply difficult content.

presentation.meaning: classical Chinese text rewritten in Japanese word order with kana
presentation.defJa: 漢文を日本語の語順に直し、漢字とかなを使って書き表した文。
presentation.note: A term from kanbun education; unlike 現代語訳, a 書き下し文 keeps classical grammar and vocabulary rather than translating into modern Japanese.

presentation.meaning: allusive variation (borrowing from a famous earlier poem)
presentation.defJa: 有名な古い和歌の言葉や趣向を取り入れて、新しい歌を作る方法。
presentation.note: A term from classical poetics, now also used loosely in criticism of music, film and design for respectful, creative borrowing, as opposed to 盗作 (plagiarism).

presentation.defJa: 体温や眠気などが、約一日の周期でくり返される体の仕組み。
presentation.note: The technical term used in science and medical writing; everyday articles more often say 体内時計 (body clock).

presentation.meaning: hybrid word (combining native, Sino-Japanese or foreign elements)
presentation.defJa: 和語、漢語、外来語のうち、違う種類の言葉が組み合わさってできた語。
presentation.note: A term from Japanese lexicology, used alongside 和語, 漢語 and 外来語 when classifying vocabulary by origin.
collocations: 和語と外来語の混種語

presentation.meaning: territory or domain of a state
presentation.defJa: 一つの国が支配している土地の範囲。
presentation.note: A formal, literary word for a state's territory, used mostly in historical writing about empires; in modern news 領土 is the ordinary word.

presentation.defJa: 国王の権力は神から与えられたもので、国民に縛られないとする考え方。
presentation.note: A history and political-theory term from textbooks on early modern Europe, typically contrasted with 社会契約説 (social contract theory).
collocations: 王権神授説と絶対王政
王権神授説を否定する

presentation.defJa: 取り返しがつかないほど、ひどい結果になるようす。
presentation.note: A formal word used in reports on volcanic eruptions, climate change and AI safety; it is close to 壊滅的 (devastating) but emphasizes an irreversible breakdown of a whole system.

presentation.defJa: 条約によって、ある国が他の国から期限を決めて借りた土地。
presentation.note: A history and international-law term tied mainly to 19th-century imperialism in China; unlike a 植民地 (colony), sovereignty formally stayed with the lending state.
collocations: 租借地として手に入れる

presentation.defJa: 人生の教えや戒めを、短く鋭く言い表した言葉。
presentation.note: A literary word for a pithy moral saying, more formal than 名言 (famous quote) and stressing instruction or admonition; it is also the Japanese title of the biblical Book of Proverbs.

presentation.defJa: 臣下などが、正しい手続きによらず君主の位や権力を奪い取ること。
presentation.note: A formal, mainly historical word for illegitimately seizing a throne or power; it is narrower and more condemnatory than 奪取 (seizure).

presentation.meaning: elaboration (in memory encoding, linking new information to existing knowledge)
presentation.defJa: 新しい情報を、すでに知っていることと結びつけたり意味づけたりして、深く覚えようとする心の働き。
presentation.note: A cognitive-psychology term for deepening memory encoding by adding meaning and connections; in general writing it can also mean refining a model or plan in finer detail.

presentation.meaning: reading a text (esp. the Chinese classics) aloud repeatedly without studying its meaning
presentation.defJa: 意味を理解するのは後回しにして、文章を声に出して繰り返し読むこと。
presentation.note: Associated with traditional education in the Confucian classics; unlike 音読, which is any reading aloud, it implies rote recitation that comes before understanding.

presentation.meaning: engo; associated words woven through a poem (a device of classical Japanese poetics)
presentation.defJa: 和歌で、意味の上で関係の深い言葉を一首の中に散りばめて、味わいを深める技法。また、その言葉。
presentation.note: A technical term of classical waka rhetoric, usually taught together with 掛詞 (pivot words); it refers to a web of thematically linked words rather than a single double meaning.

presentation.defJa: 生活や態度にしまりがなく、だらしないようす。
presentation.note: A judgmental word for a life without self-discipline, stronger and more moralizing than だらしない, and often used in self-reproach or personal essays.

presentation.defJa: 「こうなるだろう」という思い込みが人の行動を変え、結果として本当にその通りになってしまう現象。
presentation.note: A sociology and psychology term, also phrased 予言の自己成就; in everyday speech the same idea is expressed with phrases like 思い込みが現実になる.

presentation.defJa: 本当は気づいている都合の悪い事実から目をそらし、自分で自分をだますこと。
presentation.note: An analytical, written term used in psychology, philosophy and essays; it is weightier than 言い訳 because it stresses deceiving oneself rather than others.

presentation.defJa: 自分で選んでいる、うまくできている、人とつながっていると感じるときに、やる気が内側から高まるとする動機づけの考え方。
presentation.note: A specialist term from motivation psychology that typically appears in education, management and sports coaching, often alongside 内発的動機づけ (intrinsic motivation).
collocations: 自己決定理論に基づく
自己決定理論によれば
自己決定理論の三つの欲求

presentation.defJa: 学ぶ人が自分で目標を立て、進み具合を確かめ、やり方を見直しながら進めていく学び方。
presentation.note: An educational-psychology term common in teacher training and curriculum documents; it stresses the learner's planning, monitoring and reflection, not merely 自習 (studying alone).

presentation.meaning: the Sinocentric world order (China at the center, surrounding states as tributaries)
presentation.defJa: 中国を文明の中心とし、まわりの国々をその周辺に位置づけた、東アジアの伝統的な国際関係の考え方。
presentation.note: An academic history term for the tribute-based East Asian order; textbooks often pair it with 朝貢体制 (the tribute system).
collocations: 華夷秩序に組み込まれる

presentation.defJa: 学問や専門の分野で、決まった意味で使われる言葉。専門用語。
presentation.note: A formal, academic synonym of 専門用語 that appears mostly in scholarly writing, whereas 専門用語 is the everyday choice.

presentation.meaning: rule by force (as opposed to rule by virtue); the hegemonic way
presentation.defJa: 徳ではなく、武力や策略によって国を治めたり天下を取ったりするやり方。
presentation.note: A term from Confucian political thought, almost always contrasted with 王道 (rule by virtue); in modern writing it can also describe ruthless dominance in business or sports.

presentation.meaning: tunnel vision; narrowed perspective (also the medical narrowing of the visual field)
presentation.defJa: 見える範囲が狭くなること。また、物事の一部にとらわれて全体が見えなくなること。
presentation.note: Originally an ophthalmology term for a narrowed visual field, now widely used figuratively in psychology and journalism for thinking fixated on a single option.

presentation.meaning: recency effect (the most recent information is remembered best and weighs most)
presentation.defJa: 最後に示された情報ほど記憶に残りやすく、判断にも強く影響するという心の傾向。
presentation.note: A memory-psychology term usually paired with 初頭効果 (primacy effect); despite the kanji 親近, it refers to recency rather than familiarity.

presentation.meaning: linguistic relativity (the idea that language shapes thought)
presentation.defJa: 使う言葉の違いが、ものの見方や考え方に影響を与えるという説。
presentation.note: A linguistics and cognitive-science term closely tied to the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis (サピア＝ウォーフの仮説); discussions usually separate a strong version from a weak one.

presentation.meaning: planning fallacy (underestimating the time and cost a task will take)
presentation.defJa: 作業にかかる時間や費用を、実際よりも少なく見積もってしまう傾向。
presentation.note: A behavioral-economics term for a specific cognitive bias; the everyday way to describe its result is 見積もりが甘い.

presentation.meaning: halting, inarticulate speech; being a poor speaker
presentation.defJa: 話し方がなめらかでなく、言葉がつかえがちなこと。口下手。
presentation.note: A literary word for an awkward, halting speaker, often used sympathetically and contrasted with 能弁 or 雄弁; in conversation people say 口下手.

presentation.meaning: kaeriten; marks added to classical Chinese text to show the Japanese reading order
presentation.defJa: 漢文を日本語の語順で読むために、漢字の左下につけて読む順番を示す記号。
presentation.note: A kanbun term taught in school Japanese classes; it covers marks such as レ点 and 一二点 and is grouped with 送り仮名 under the broader label 訓点.

presentation.meaning: reciprocity (the urge to repay what one has received)
presentation.defJa: 人から何かをしてもらうと、お返しをしなければと感じる心の働き。
presentation.note: A social-psychology term usually seen as 返報性の原理 in marketing and self-help books; it is more technical than the everyday お返し.

presentation.meaning: transparency (openness about how something works or how decisions are made)
presentation.defJa: 仕組みや判断の理由が外からよくわかり、隠しごとがない状態。
presentation.note: A common formal word in politics, corporate governance and AI ethics, frequently paired with 説明責任 (accountability).

presentation.meaning: progressive (Whig) view of history; history as steady progress
presentation.defJa: 歴史は時代とともに、よりよい方向へ一直線に進んでいくものだとする見方。
presentation.note: An academic term in historiography and essays, usually used critically; it overlaps with the English idea of Whig history and with stage theories of development.

presentation.meaning: lucid expression; writing that conveys its meaning clearly
presentation.defJa: 言いたいことが読み手にはっきり伝わるように書くこと。また、そのような文章。
presentation.note: A literary term of praise for prose that communicates clearly, mostly found in the set phrase 達意の文章; it values clarity over ornament, unlike 名文, which can imply stylistic brilliance.

presentation.defJa: 言葉を、話し手が場面に応じて選ぶ意味の仕組みとしてとらえ、社会の中での働きから分析する言語学の一派。
presentation.note: A specialist linguistics term (often abbreviated SFL) for the school founded by M. A. K. Halliday, which analyzes grammar as meaningful choices made in social context.
collocations: 選択体系機能言語学の枠組み
選択体系機能言語学に基づく分析

presentation.meaning: redundant expression; tautology (e.g. saying a headache aches)
presentation.defJa: 同じ意味の言葉を重ねて使う、むだのある言い方。
presentation.note: Read じゅうげん or ちょうげん, it is the standard term in style guides and editing; 二重表現 is a more everyday synonym.

presentation.meaning: threshold (the level at which a response or change begins)
presentation.defJa: ある反応や変化が起こるか起こらないかの境目となる値。
presentation.note: A scientific term read いきち in psychology and medicine but often しきいち in engineering and computing; in everyday writing 境目 or 限界 conveys the idea less precisely.

presentation.defJa: 不安や心の傷から自分を守るために、無意識のうちに働く心の仕組み。
presentation.note: A psychoanalytic term common in psychology textbooks and self-help writing; individual mechanisms such as 合理化 and 投影 are often named alongside it.

presentation.meaning: deliberate practice (focused practice just beyond one's current ability)
presentation.defJa: 今の自分の力を少しだけ超える課題に、目標と振り返りを持って集中的に取り組む練習。
presentation.note: A translated term from expertise research (deliberate practice); it is narrower than ordinary 練習 because it demands clear goals, feedback and work at the edge of one's ability.
collocations: 限界的練習に取り組む

presentation.meaning: power efficiency (work or computation per unit of electricity)
presentation.defJa: 使った電気の量に対して、どれだけの仕事や計算ができるかという割合。
presentation.note: A technical but widely used term in IT and energy news; it is close to 省エネ性能, but in the chip and data-center context it usually means computing work per watt.

presentation.meaning: sound symbolism (a link between speech sounds and meanings or impressions)
presentation.defJa: 言葉の音そのものが、大きさや形、印象などのイメージと結びついていること。
presentation.note: A linguistics term for non-arbitrary links between sound and meaning, especially relevant to Japanese 擬音語 and 擬態語; it challenges the classic view that the linguistic sign is arbitrary.

presentation.meaning: the conscious mind (as opposed to the subconscious)
presentation.defJa: 自分で気づいていて、考えたり判断したりしている心の部分。
presentation.note: Used mainly in contrast with 潜在意識 (the subconscious), more in popular psychology and self-help books than in strict academic writing, which prefers plain 意識.

presentation.defJa: 大脳の内側にあり、注意の切り替えや痛み、感情の調整などにかかわる脳の領域。
presentation.note: A neuroscience term (ACC) that appears in research on attention, pain, conflict monitoring and meditation, often discussed together with the prefrontal cortex.
collocations: 前帯状皮質が関与する

presentation.defJa: AとBの共通点を、しゃれで答える言葉遊び。
presentation.note: The pattern is AとかけてBと解く、その心は, with one pun that fits both A and B.

presentation.defJa: カツオを煮て干し、固くしたもの。
presentation.note: Packets of ready-shaved flakes are often labeled 花かつお or 削り節.

presentation.defJa: 数字などの音を、別の言葉に当てること。
presentation.note: It is sound-matching, not rhyme: 4 can be read よ or し, and 9 can be く.

presentation.defJa: 沖縄の言葉で、なんとかなるという意味。
presentation.note: Okinawan dialect, almost always said as なんくるないさ.

presentation.defJa: 考えるより先に、体が自然に動いて。
presentation.note: 反射 on its own also means the reflection of light.

presentation.defJa: 重なって効果を強め合うこと。
presentation.note: Today it is almost always in 相乗効果; for multiplication in math say 掛け算.

presentation.defJa: 全体の中の、ある決まった部分や場所。
presentation.note: As a counter it is also written か所 or ヶ所.

presentation.defJa: 文章から文字や言葉がぬけ落ちること。
presentation.note: Rare and bookish; for dropping out of a race or group, use 脱落.

presentation.defJa: 大事なことや危ないことが起きたとき。
見て、ちがいや良い悪いを区別する。
勢いよく中へ入ること。新しい段階に入ること。
presentation.note: Very common in news for entering a new period, as in 三日目に突入.

presentation.defJa: 勝って次の試合に進む。最後まで残る。
考えが急に頭にうかぶ。光が一瞬光る。
presentation.note: Usually written in kana; the noun ひらめき means a flash of inspiration.

presentation.defJa: いちばんよいこと。できるかぎりのこと。
presentation.note: 最善を尽くす is the set phrase for doing your best; in shogi the best move is 最善手.

presentation.defJa: 組織などの、新しくなった仕組みや顔ぶれ。
presentation.note: Used for any reshuffled organization: a company, a party, a team or a government.

presentation.defJa: 死んだ後も、たましいは消えずに残るという考え。
presentation.note: A formal word from philosophy and religion.

presentation.defJa: 物事を判断するときの立場。
presentation.note: Almost always used as 〜の見地から or 〜的見地から; formal.

presentation.defJa: 全体をつくっている、それぞれの部分。
presentation.note: Found mostly in manuals and reports; compare 各国 and 各地.

presentation.defJa: 液体などをかき回して混ぜること。
presentation.note: Often written 撹拌 or かくはん. In everyday speech people say かき混ぜる.

presentation.defJa: 和室の奥の、掛け軸や花を飾る所。
presentation.note: The seat with its back to the 床の間 is the place of honor for guests.

presentation.defJa: 沸く温度の差で液体の混ざり物を分けること。
presentation.note: A high school chemistry word. Plain distillation is 蒸留.

presentation.defJa: 何もしなくても、自然にそうなる様子。
presentation.note: Same kanji as 自ら (みずから), which means doing something yourself on purpose.

presentation.defJa: うそやごまかしがないこと。
presentation.note: In speech a bare 正直、 at the start of a sentence means honestly.

presentation.defJa: 遠慮せずに、思ったとおりに言えば。
presentation.note: It often comes before criticism, but it can also introduce honest praise.

presentation.defJa: 根拠がないのに昔から信じられていること。
presentation.note: 迷信深い means superstitious (of a person).

presentation.defJa: 決まりや言いつけ、期待に逆らう。
presentation.note: It takes に: 命令に背く, to disobey an order.

presentation.defJa: 数や量で表して調べる様子。
presentation.note: The opposite is 定性的, qualitative.

presentation.defJa: 切れたり続いたりをくり返す様子。
presentation.note: A weather forecast favourite; 継続的 means continuous, the opposite.

presentation.defJa: 字を書くとき紙の下に敷く板。
presentation.note: 〜を下敷きにする means to base a story or work on something.

presentation.defJa: 重い物の下に押さえつけられる。
presentation.note: A stock phrase in disaster and accident news.

presentation.defJa: 決まった操作のくり返しで作られる、計算できる関数。
presentation.note: A term from mathematical logic; programmers call a function that calls itself 再帰関数.

presentation.defJa: いくつもの例から、一般的な結論を出すようす。
presentation.note: The opposite is 演繹的, deductive; in logic, 帰納的 can also translate recursive.

presentation.defJa: むだがなく、使う目的によく合っているようす。
presentation.note: Same reading as 帰納的, inductive; context tells them apart.

presentation.defJa: 強い磁場の中で原子核が電波に反応する現象。
presentation.note: 共鳴 alone also means sympathy with an idea, as in 考えに共鳴する.

presentation.defJa: 磁石と電波で体の断面を画像にする検査。
presentation.note: Formal written term; doctors and patients just say MRI.

presentation.defJa: 絵を描いて印刷に使う平らな石の板。
presentation.note: Formal and fairly rare. The printing method is 石版印刷; chipmaking lithography is リソグラフィ.

presentation.defJa: 枝や草、髪を切って形を整える。
presentation.note: It can also mean cutting down a text to make it shorter.

presentation.defJa: 思わず笑いたくなるようなおかしさ。
presentation.note: In modern speech it often means ridiculous rather than simply funny.

presentation.defJa: 知能に問題がないのに、字を読むのが難しい状態。
presentation.note: For the developmental condition, ディスレクシア is now the more common word.

presentation.defJa: 読み方がむずかしく、正しく読める人が少ないこと。
presentation.note: Describes a word, not a person; a reading disorder is 失読症.

presentation.defJa: 組み合って戦うこと。難しいことに取り組むこと。
presentation.note: The figurative 〜と格闘する, struggling with a task, is very common.

presentation.defJa: 戦う競技を仕事にしている人。
本番のように行う練習。大学の少人数授業。
presentation.note: Three common uses: practice problems, military or disaster drills, and university seminars.

presentation.defJa: 手がかりが少ない中で、方法を探すこと。
presentation.note: A news word, often in 〜の道を模索する; 暗中模索 means groping in the dark.

presentation.defJa: 包丁で食材を切るときに下に置く板。
presentation.note: まな板の鯉, a carp on the cutting board, is an idiom for being helpless in someone else's hands.

presentation.defJa: よくないことを、こっそり計画する。
presentation.note: Usually negative, but used playfully for harmless mischief.

presentation.meaning: in broken bits, on and off
presentation.defJa: 続かずに、何度も切れるようす。
高い所から見下ろすこと。全体を広く見ること。
presentation.note: In business talk, 俯瞰して見る means stepping back to see the big picture.

presentation.defJa: ねらいを合わせること。その目標。
presentation.note: Outside hunting and the military, it is mostly used in 〜に照準を合わせる, to aim for something.

presentation.defJa: 楽しいことを思って、心がうきうきする。
presentation.note: It can also mean to stand out visually, as in 白い花が浮き立って見える.

presentation.defJa: 焼けるように熱いこと。
presentation.note: Almost always used as 灼熱の〜 before a noun.

presentation.defJa: 目上の人に逆らおうとするようす。
前よりもさらに。もっと。
presentation.note: Do not mix it up with いっそ, which means rather or might as well.

presentation.defJa: 物事や道が始まるところ。
presentation.note: The opposite is 終点.

presentation.defJa: 仕事を分けて、それぞれが受け持つこと。
presentation.note: In the chip industry it means the split between chip designers and the factories that make chips.

presentation.defJa: 二人以上で悪いことをひそかに相談すること。
presentation.note: Standard news pattern: 〜と共謀し、〜した疑い.

presentation.defJa: 物事のいちばん大事なところ。
presentation.note: Usually written 要; it was first the pin that holds a folding fan together.

presentation.defJa: 生き残るか滅びるかを決めるめぐり合わせ。
presentation.note: Used in make-or-break situations, as in 命運を賭ける or 命運がかかる.

presentation.defJa: 物理や化学など、自然のしくみを研究する学問。
presentation.note: Mostly seen in 理学部, faculty of science, and 理学療法, physical therapy.

presentation.defJa: 国や自治体のお金のやりくり。
presentation.note: For a household budget say 家計; 財政 is mainly used for governments.

presentation.defJa: ある目的のために用意するお金。
presentation.note: 資金繰り means juggling cash so you can pay your bills on time.

presentation.defJa: 投資したお金に対するもうけの割合。
presentation.note: When bond prices fall, their 利回り goes up.

presentation.defJa: 人の行動や物事の進行をわざとじゃますること。
presentation.note: Set phrases include 公務執行妨害, obstructing an officer, and 業務妨害, obstructing business.

presentation.defJa: 周りとの関係の中でしめる場所や役割。
presentation.note: Literally the spot where a performer stands; now often used for one's role in a group.

presentation.defJa: うまくいかないと考えて望みを失うこと。
presentation.note: The opposite is 楽観; 悲観的 means pessimistic.

presentation.defJa: 直接は戦わずに、陣営どうしがにらみ合う対立。
presentation.note: Also used casually for a frosty standoff, such as a couple who aren't speaking.

presentation.defJa: 圧倒的な力で地域や分野を支配すること。
presentation.note: 覇権を握る (to seize dominance) is the usual verb; it is also used for business and sport.

presentation.defJa: 強い一国が秩序を支えると世界経済が安定するという説。
presentation.note: An academic term from international relations; you meet it in textbooks and essays, not conversation.

presentation.defJa: 言うまでもなく、当たり前のことだが。
presentation.note: A bit written; in speech people often just say 当然 or もちろん.

presentation.defJa: 得た利益を人々に返すこと。また、もとに戻すこと。
presentation.note: In chemistry 還元 is reduction, the opposite of 酸化, oxidation.

presentation.defJa: お金や品物など、値打ちのある物。
presentation.note: A legal word from the Criminal Code; in daily life people say お金や品物.

presentation.defJa: 決まりを破った人への罰を定めた規則。
presentation.note: 罰則 are the penalty clauses of a law or rule; the Penal Code itself is 刑法.

presentation.defJa: 人からどう見られるかを気にしすぎること。
presentation.note: Often used to tease someone: 自意識過剰じゃない？ means aren't you overthinking it?

presentation.defJa: 多くのものを一か所に集めること。
presentation.note: Written and technical; in speech people say 集まっている. Do not mix it up with 蓄積, building up over time.

presentation.defJa: 辞書の品詞表示で、係り助詞を表す略語。
presentation.note: Rare: a dictionary label read かかりじょ; the full term is 係助詞, かかりじょし.

presentation.defJa: 上と下。上がったり下がったりすること。
presentation.note: 上下線 means both directions of a road or line; 上下関係 means a hierarchy.

presentation.defJa: 上からかぶせて、見えないようにする。
presentation.note: The passive 覆われる is very common, as in 雪に覆われた山.

presentation.defJa: あとから組織などに組み入れること。
presentation.note: Used for towns joining a city and for students transferring into a school.

presentation.defJa: 周りの人に、えらそうな態度をとる。
presentation.note: Plain 威張る means to act big; 〜散らす makes it aimed at everyone around.

presentation.defJa: ひどくえらそうにする。悪く言う言い方。
presentation.note: 〜くさる adds strong contempt, so use it about others, never to someone's face.

presentation.defJa: 作った物のうち、良品として使える割合。
presentation.note: Also used in cooking for the usable part of an ingredient, and for how many accepted students actually enroll.

presentation.defJa: 負担や痛みなどを減らして軽くすること。
presentation.note: The thing reduced is almost always something bad: 負担, 痛み, 被害, リスク.

presentation.defJa: 体が大きく、力が強そうなようす。
presentation.note: Used for people and bodies, not for things or arguments.

presentation.defJa: 刺激などが強く伝わってくるようす。
presentation.note: Casual only: ビンビン is also slang for an erection, so avoid it in formal settings.

presentation.defJa: 冷たさや興奮などがとても強いようす。
presentation.note: ギンギンに冷えた is perfectly safe, but the word is slangy and can sound suggestive.

presentation.defJa: 字を急いで乱暴に書くこと。
飲み食いなどをほどほどにおさえること。
presentation.note: 不節制 means a lack of moderation, as in 不節制がたたる, overindulgence taking its toll.

presentation.defJa: 相手をばかにして、鼻で笑うこと。
presentation.note: The verb form is せせら笑う.

presentation.defJa: あまりにひどくて、言葉にならないこと。
presentation.note: Read ごんご, not げんご. It is used to condemn something as completely unacceptable.

presentation.defJa: 商品につけて、値段を示す小さな札。
苦しさやつらさを、じっとがまんする。
presentation.note: It takes に for what you endure: 寒さに耐える.

presentation.defJa: 人に知られないように、こっそり動くこと。
presentation.note: Today you mostly meet it in お忍び, incognito, and 忍び足, tiptoeing.

presentation.defJa: 目のすぐ前。
presentation.note: A written word; in conversation 目の前 is far more common.

presentation.defJa: 耳の奥にあって、音で震えるうすい膜。
presentation.note: 鼓 means drum, as in 太鼓, so the word is literally drum membrane.

presentation.defJa: 一秒間に進む距離で表した速さ。
presentation.note: Casually, 秒速で means instantly.

presentation.defJa: 怖さで、体が冷たくなるように感じるようす。
あまり感心しない。気が進まない。
presentation.note: Many people now misread it as not scary, so あまり気が進まない is safer in your own speech.

presentation.defJa: となり合う数の比がいつも同じこと。
presentation.note: Almost always met in 等比数列; the arithmetic version is 等差数列.

presentation.defJa: 決まった順に数を並べたもの。
借りたお金を返すこと。
presentation.note: A refund in a shop is 返金, not 返済.

presentation.defJa: 銀行などに預けたお金。
presentation.note: 預金を下ろす means to withdraw money from your account.

presentation.defJa: お金を貸し借りするときの利息の割合。
presentation.note: 金利 is the rate; the money you actually pay or receive is 利息.

presentation.defJa: 元金に対する利息の割合。
presentation.note: Common in contracts and math problems; in conversation people usually say 金利.

presentation.defJa: 数列のいちばん最初の数。
presentation.note: A math-class word; it usually comes with 公比 (common ratio) or 公差 (common difference).

presentation.defJa: お金や制度をうまく使って動かすこと。
presentation.note: Two common uses: 資産運用 (investing money) and 制度の運用 (running a system).

presentation.defJa: 貸し借りしたお金に上乗せされるお金。
利息がつく前の、もとのお金。
presentation.note: Also read もときん, but がんきん is the standard reading in banking.

presentation.defJa: 最初のお金だけに利息をつける計算。
presentation.note: Its opposite is 複利, compound interest.

presentation.defJa: だれが見てもはっきりしているようす。
presentation.note: Usually used with 差, 違い or 証拠, as in 差は歴然だ.

presentation.defJa: 〜のように、という意味の書き言葉。
presentation.note: Formal written style; in speech say のように.

presentation.defJa: あとから言い足すときの書き言葉。
presentation.note: Sentence-initial なお、 adds a side note in notices, emails and articles.

presentation.defJa: その上さらに。それでもまだ。
数を合わせて合計を出す計算。
presentation.note: Subtraction is 引き算, multiplication 掛け算 and division 割り算.

presentation.defJa: 重さのある物どうしが、互いに引き合う力。
presentation.note: A school physics term; in everyday speech people say 重力 or 引力.

presentation.defJa: 星などが回るときの、中心になる線。
presentation.note: Used for planets and stars; a machine's shaft is 回転軸 or シャフト.

presentation.defJa: 回る物が、外へ押し出されるように感じる力。
presentation.note: In political news, 遠心力 means a group is starting to break apart.

presentation.defJa: 物がどこにどれだけあるかという広がり方。
presentation.note: 分布 is how things happen to be spread out; dividing something up on purpose is 配分.

presentation.defJa: 店の商品の数をすべて数えて調べること。
presentation.note: Also written 棚卸し; job hunters use it for taking stock of their own skills.

presentation.defJa: 売るために持っている商品や材料。
presentation.note: An accounting word from financial statements; in a shop people just say 在庫.

presentation.defJa: 思いどおりに、どのようにでもできるようす。
presentation.note: Most often used as 自由自在に before verbs like 操る or 使いこなす.

presentation.defJa: 点の位置を、数の組で表したもの。
図形を式で表し、計算で調べる数学の分野。
presentation.note: Rare; the usual academic term is 解析幾何学.

presentation.defJa: 数字を打ちこんで計算する小さな機械。
損か得かを細かく計算してみる。
presentation.note: Can be literal, or mean working out whether something pays off; the second use is common in business news.

presentation.defJa: ほかよりずっとすぐれていること。
presentation.note: A formal word, almost always used as 卓越した + noun.

presentation.defJa: 計算をするための機械。
presentation.note: In daily life 電卓 is more common; 計算機 sounds technical or old.

presentation.defJa: まっすぐ立っていること。直角に交わること。
presentation.note: The opposite is 水平 (horizontal).

presentation.defJa: 本の言葉がどのページにあるかを並べた一覧。
presentation.note: In computing, インデックス is used as often as 索引.

presentation.defJa: 刑事裁判で罪を問われている人。
presentation.note: News puts 被告 after a name as a title; in civil cases 被告 is the person being sued.

presentation.defJa: 客のふりをして店の品物を盗むこと。
presentation.note: It can also mean the shoplifter, though 万引き犯 is clearer.

presentation.defJa: 借りた物や預かった物を返すこと。
presentation.note: Use 返却 for objects; paying back money is 返済.

presentation.defJa: 証拠を集めて刑事事件として扱うこと。
presentation.note: A news word for police or prosecutors formally making a criminal case against someone.

presentation.defJa: 前からすでにあること。
presentation.note: Both きそん and きぞん are heard; きぞん is now very common.

presentation.defJa: 前から使っている機械や設備。
presentation.note: A word from technical documents; in ordinary writing 既存の装置 is more common.

presentation.defJa: 記事の内容がひと目でわかる短い言葉。
presentation.note: It also means a heading in a document and a headword in a dictionary.

presentation.defJa: いつもと違っていて、めったにないこと。
presentation.note: Very common in news about decisions and procedures, as in 異例の人事.

presentation.defJa: 存在をすっかり消し去ること。
presentation.note: A strong written word. To ignore an opinion on purpose is 黙殺.

presentation.defJa: きのうの夜。
presentation.note: In conversation it means last night and is often written ゆうべ; 〜の夕べ is the name of an evening event.

presentation.defJa: 危ない所や閉じこめられた所からぬけ出すこと。
いなくなった人や物を探すこと。
presentation.note: It also means a legal search of a building, as in 家宅捜索.

presentation.defJa: 東京都の南にあり、横浜市に県庁がある県。
presentation.note: Its police force is 神奈川県警 in the news; Tokyo's police is 警視庁.

presentation.defJa: どこにいるのかわからないこと。
presentation.note: 行方 is read ゆくえ. People also use it jokingly for lost things.

presentation.defJa: 海の上。海の水面のあたり。
presentation.note: 海上保安庁 is the Japan Coast Guard; 海上自衛隊 is the Maritime Self-Defense Force.

presentation.defJa: 天気や地震の情報を出す国の役所。
presentation.note: An advisory is 注意報, a warning is 警報, and an emergency warning is 特別警報.

presentation.defJa: 仕事のために勤め先へ行くこと。
presentation.note: The opposite is 退勤. Staying away without notice is 無断欠勤.

presentation.defJa: 物をしまっておくための棚やたんす。
presentation.note: A category word used in shops and catalogues; a built-in closet is クローゼット or 押し入れ.

presentation.defJa: 専門家が物を調べ、本物かどうかや価値を決めること。
presentation.note: Used both for appraising art or antiques and for forensic tests such as DNA鑑定.

presentation.defJa: 事件や事故を見た人が、その様子を話すこと。
写真や画面に写し出された絵や姿。
presentation.note: 画像 is a still image; moving pictures are 映像 or 動画.

presentation.defJa: 死刑の判決が決まり、刑を待っている人。
presentation.note: A neutral legal and news term.

presentation.defJa: 結果をはっきり決めるほど重要なさま。
後戻りせずに構文を解析できる種類の文法。
presentation.note: A formal-language term; read it as 決定的 plus 文脈自由 plus 文法.

presentation.defJa: 新しく店や事業を始めること。
presentation.note: Also used for new rail lines and stations; 開業医 is a doctor with their own clinic.

presentation.defJa: 店などを新しく開くこと。珍しい言葉。
presentation.note: Very rare word: learn to read it, but say 開業 or 創業 yourself.

presentation.defJa: 物事をとてもすばやく行うさま。
presentation.note: Formal; in speech people say すばやい or 早い.

presentation.defJa: 東京都を受け持つ警察の本部。
presentation.note: Only Tokyo's police has this name; other prefectures have 県警 or 府警.

presentation.defJa: 物を種類や行き先ごとに分けること。
いざという時に使う、いちばん効く手段。
presentation.note: From card games; used for policies, players and products.

presentation.defJa: 銅で作った細い線。
presentation.note: Inside chips the term is 銅配線; 銅線 is actual copper wire.

presentation.defJa: 建物の中で人がどう動くかを考えて通り道を決めること。
presentation.note: An architecture term; in home talk people just say 動線, as in 家事動線.

presentation.defJa: 意味を表すために使う、しるしや文字。
presentation.note: On keyboards and in passwords, 記号 means characters like #, @ and !.

presentation.defJa: 相手の力を低く見て、軽く扱う。
presentation.note: 侮れない, not to be underestimated, is very common in reviews and sports.

presentation.defJa: のちの発展を支える土台をつくる。
presentation.note: A formal phrase common in speeches, obituaries and company histories.

presentation.defJa: 数や量がとても多いようす。
物を作るやり方や手順。
presentation.note: Common in food and craft advertising, as in 昔ながらの製法.

presentation.defJa: 程度が高いこと。また、地上からの高さ。
presentation.note: With a number it means altitude; as 高度な it means advanced or sophisticated.

presentation.defJa: 名簿や台帳に、名前などを書き入れること。
presentation.note: Formal and official; do not confuse it with 搭載 (equipped with), which sounds the same.

presentation.defJa: 規模や大きさを小さくすること。
presentation.note: The opposite is 拡大.

presentation.defJa: 空気を抜いたガラス管で電気の流れを操る部品。
presentation.note: Today you mostly hear it from audio fans and in computer history. The counter is 本.

presentation.defJa: 輸出入をめぐって国の間に起きる対立。
放っておけないほど重大な。
presentation.note: Stiff and formal; it is only used before a noun, as in 由々しき事態.

presentation.defJa: 同じ数を何回も掛け合わせる形の関数。
presentation.note: In news, 指数関数的に simply means growing very fast.

presentation.defJa: 驚くほど勢いや程度が激しい。
presentation.note: Can be good or bad; often written in kana as すさまじい.

presentation.defJa: 国や団体が話し合って決めた約束。
presentation.note: Used between countries or organizations; a private deal between people is 約束 or 契約.

presentation.defJa: 機械などがどれだけよく働くかの程度。
presentation.note: 性能 is how well a machine works; 機能 is what it can do. For people's ability use 能力.

presentation.defJa: 一族が多くの会社を支配する企業グループ。
presentation.note: Korean chaebol is the same word, so 韓国の財閥 is how you say it in Japanese.

presentation.defJa: 力で相手をおさえて支配すること。
presentation.note: A military and police word, also used in sports for dominating the game.

presentation.defJa: 話し合いがまとまらずに終わること。
presentation.note: Almost always with 交渉, 会談 or 協議 as the subject.

presentation.defJa: 全体を動かす、いちばん大事な中心部分。
presentation.note: Also a medical word: 中枢神経 is the central nervous system.

presentation.defJa: 物を作るときの、材料から完成までの段階。
撮ったフィルムを薬で処理して像を出すこと。
presentation.note: Digital photographers also say RAW現像 for processing RAW files.

presentation.defJa: 表面を少しずつそぎ取ること。
presentation.note: Mostly met in compounds such as 鉛筆削り and 削り節; the verb is 削る.

presentation.defJa: 男子と女子が同じ学校で学ぶこと。
ひどくおどろくこと。
presentation.note: Stronger than 驚く and a favorite word in headlines and ads.

presentation.defJa: 地中から湯や水がわき出ること。
presentation.note: Common on onsen information boards; in speech people say 湧き出る.

presentation.defJa: したい放題で、だらしなく暮らすこと。
presentation.note: Rare and literary; in speech say だらしない or 好き勝手.

presentation.defJa: 前を行く相手との差を縮めて迫る。
presentation.note: The noun 追い上げ is very common in sports commentary.

presentation.defJa: 相手より力が弱く、不利な立場。
presentation.note: The opposite is 優勢.

presentation.defJa: 時間をおかずに、すぐ行うさま。
presentation.note: Almost always used as 速やかに in notices and laws; in speech people say すぐに.

presentation.defJa: 全体を支え、ないと成り立たない大事なもの。
presentation.note: Literally the keystone of an arch or a sacred shrine stone; figuratively a linchpin.

presentation.defJa: 組織の中心に立ち、思いどおりに動かす。
presentation.note: Usually negative; it comes from an old Chinese phrase about holding an ox's ear.

presentation.defJa: 香川県の名物で、こしが強いうどん。
presentation.note: 讃岐 is the old name for Kagawa, and こし is the word for the firm, springy bite.

presentation.defJa: お金や物を、見返りなしに差し出すこと。
手紙やメールを届ける相手や住所。
presentation.note: In email programs, 宛先 is the To: field.

presentation.defJa: 郵便物を届ける住所を新しくすること。
presentation.note: Also written 宛先変更.

presentation.defJa: 絵や音楽などの作品を作る人。
presentation.note: 芸術家肌 describes someone with an artistic, unconventional temperament.

presentation.defJa: 顔の形やようす。そのときの表情。
相手に勝とうとして張り合う。けんかする。
presentation.note: 一刻を争う means every second counts.

presentation.defJa: 相手より上になろうと、力や技を比べ合う。
presentation.note: 競う is about comparing skill; 争う can also mean quarrel or fight.

presentation.defJa: 化粧や服でおおわれていない肌。
presentation.note: Very common in cosmetics and clothing ads, as in 素肌にやさしい.

presentation.defJa: 宿で、食事をつけずに泊まること。
presentation.note: The standard spelling is 素泊まり; 素泊り is common on signs and booking sites.

presentation.defJa: 内閣の一番上に立ち、国の政治を率いる人。
presentation.note: Headlines say 首相; the formal title is 内閣総理大臣.

presentation.defJa: 選ばれた議員が法律や予算を決める国の機関。
presentation.note: The Diet has two houses, 衆議院 and 参議院.

presentation.defJa: 医者が患者の体の具合を調べる。
presentation.note: Only for doctors examining patients; looking after a sick person is 看る.

presentation.defJa: 悪くなったものが、もとの状態にもどること。
物の売り買いなど、経済全体の調子。
presentation.note: 景気のいい can also just mean lively or upbeat, as in 景気のいい話.

presentation.defJa: 無理やかたよりがなく、しっかりしたようす。
presentation.note: Used for finances, organizations and upbringing; for a person's body say 健康.

presentation.defJa: 向かい合う二つの側の、どちらも。
presentation.note: Formal; in conversation 両方 or お互い is more common.

presentation.defJa: 世の中の当たり前のマナーから外れていること。
presentation.note: It judges manners, not intelligence.

presentation.defJa: 未練を残さず、思い切りがよい。
presentation.note: Most often seen as the adverb 潔く with verbs like 認める, 謝る or 負けを認める.

presentation.defJa: 起きたことや調べたことを人に知らせること。
presentation.note: ご報告 is also used for sharing personal news like a marriage or a birth.

presentation.defJa: 人が多く集まり、にぎやかで立派なようす。
presentation.note: In casual speech 盛大に can be a joke, as in 盛大に転んだ, I fell over in a big way.

presentation.defJa: 病気やけがを治すこと。また、そのしくみ。
presentation.note: 医療 is health care as a whole; treatment of one illness is 治療.

presentation.defJa: 運がよいこと。よいめぐり合わせ。
presentation.note: 幸運 is a little formal; in speech people often say 運がいい or ラッキー.

presentation.defJa: 話や計画の中身がはっきりしていること。
presentation.note: Most often heard as 具体性に欠ける, lacking specifics.

presentation.defJa: 中身がはっきりしていて、よくわかる様子。
presentation.note: The opposite is 抽象的, abstract.

presentation.defJa: ある面とは逆の、もう一方の面。
presentation.note: Pattern: plain form + 反面. 反面教師 is a bad example you learn from.

presentation.defJa: あれこれと文句や理屈を言うようす。
presentation.note: Almost always つべこべ言う, in a rough scolding.

presentation.defJa: 片手でつかめるほどの量。ごくわずか。
話や文章の中で、あることに触れること。
presentation.note: A common news pattern is 〜への言及を避けた, meaning someone declined to comment.

presentation.defJa: 本当かどうかは別にして、そうだとすると。
presentation.note: Often paired with としても or たら; it also means for now, as in 仮に呼ぶ.

presentation.defJa: ある言葉を使って話す人。
presentation.note: 母語話者 is the written term for native speaker; in speech people say ネイティブ.

presentation.defJa: 仕事や品物に見合って受け取るお金。
presentation.note: Sounds formal; common in contracts, law and debates about fair pay.

presentation.defJa: 学んだり練習したりして、身につけること。
presentation.note: Do not mix it up with 取得, which is for getting a licence or qualification.

presentation.defJa: 銀色に光って見える、白い髪。
目と脳で、見たものを処理するしくみ。
presentation.note: 視覚 is the sense of sight; 視覚系 is the whole system behind it.

presentation.defJa: 古い木や金属がこすれて出る音。
presentation.note: A single creak is ぎいっ.

presentation.defJa: わざとらしくなく、自然なようす。
presentation.note: The adverb さりげなく, casually or without fuss, is very common.

presentation.defJa: 読みかけの本にはさむ目印。
presentation.note: 旅のしおり is the schedule booklet handed out before school trips and group tours.

presentation.defJa: 本気であること。若者の言葉。
presentation.note: Usually written in katakana as ガチ; casual slang, so keep it out of formal speech.

presentation.defJa: 会議で、出された案をよいと認めて決めること。
presentation.note: Mostly passive in news: 可決された. The opposite is 否決.

presentation.defJa: ほかが去ったあとも、その場にとどまること。
presentation.note: In sports news 残留 means avoiding relegation; in food news it means residue.

presentation.defJa: 天皇の一族として、皇室に属する人。
presentation.note: 皇族 are the people; 皇室 is the family as an institution.

presentation.defJa: 入っていた組織や集まりから抜けること。
presentation.note: Brexit is 英国のEU離脱.

presentation.defJa: 天皇とその一族をまとめていう言葉。
presentation.note: 皇室典範 is the law that governs the imperial family.

presentation.defJa: うまくいかないのではないかと心配する。
presentation.note: Formal; most often met as 危ぶまれる. In speech people say 心配だ.

presentation.defJa: 父から子へ、父方の血筋で続く家系。
presentation.note: 男系 is about the line of descent, not about being male (男性).

presentation.defJa: 亡くなった人の財産を家族などが受け継ぐこと。
presentation.note: 相続 is for property; taking over a position or throne is 継承.

presentation.defJa: 決まりとしてはっきり定めたこと。
presentation.note: Do not confuse it with 既定 (already decided), which sounds the same.

presentation.defJa: 思ってもいなかった、困ったことになる。
presentation.note: Always for unwelcome outcomes, attached to a dictionary-form verb.

presentation.defJa: むだに出ていくお金や手間。
presentation.note: Rare and old-fashioned, mostly met in historical novels; in normal speech say 出費 or 無駄遣い.

presentation.defJa: よく調べて、よいものを選ぶこと。
presentation.note: 吟味された素材, carefully chosen ingredients, is a stock phrase on menus and food labels.

presentation.defJa: 事故などがなければ得られたはずの収入。
presentation.note: A legal and insurance term, mostly seen in court and accident news.

presentation.defJa: 答案や演技を見て、点数をつけること。
体に少しひんやりと寒さを感じる。
presentation.note: 肌寒い is a light seasonal chill, not real cold; for that say 寒い.

presentation.defJa: 感覚や頭の働きがとてもするどいようす。
presentation.note: A written word; in speech people usually say 鋭い.

presentation.defJa: 人や船などが一か所に大勢集まること。
presentation.note: Do not confuse it with 終結, which means coming to an end.

presentation.defJa: 将棋や碁の盤の上。そこでの勝負。
presentation.note: 盤上 is the game itself; things happening off the board are 盤外.

presentation.defJa: 時計で、秒を示す細い針。
presentation.note: The hour hand is 短針 and the minute hand is 長針.

presentation.defJa: 大会などで勝って、一番になること。
presentation.note: In sports news 制覇 just means winning a title; the sense of military conquest is mostly historical.

presentation.defJa: 将棋や碁で、盤の上の駒や石の並び方。
小さいころから、すごい才能を見せる子。
presentation.note: A well-known saying: 十で神童、十五で才子、二十過ぎればただの人.

presentation.defJa: 強くゆらす。人の心を大きく動かす。
